story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Hey
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: 嘿

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: I just wanted to check in before I get busy again
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: 我只是想在我忙起来之前问候一下。

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: How are you feeling today, really?
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: 你今天感觉怎么样，真的？

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Still stiff, and it’s annoying not being able to get up whenever I want
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: 还是很僵硬，不能随时起身真让人烦。

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: But you’re healing, and that’s what matters, even if it feels slow
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: 但你在康复，这才是最重要的，即使感觉很慢。

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: You also need to stop blaming yourself for everything
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: 你也需要停止对自己责怪一切。

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: You didn’t choose to get hurt, and you’re not a burden for needing help
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: 你没有选择受伤，也不是因为需要帮助而成为负担。

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: I’m trying
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: 我在努力尝试

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: It’s just hard to feel useful when I’m stuck in bed all day
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: 整天躺在床上让我很难感到有用。

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Hey
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: 嘿

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: I know
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: 我知道

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: By the way, how does your new phone feel so far?
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: 顺便问一下，你的新手机感觉怎么样？

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Does everything look like it transferred correctly from the old one?
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: 一切看起来都从旧的转移过来了吗？

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Yeah, surprisingly
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: 是的，令人惊讶。

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: It’s fast, and everything seems to be in the right place
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: 它很快，一切似乎都在正确的位置上

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: I barely had to redo my settings
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: 我几乎不需要重新设置我的设置

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Good
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: 好

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: The guy who sold it to me kept insisting it was a solid model
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: 卖给我的那个家伙一直坚持说这是个坚固的型号

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Thanks again for getting it for me
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: 再次感谢你为我拿到这个。

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: I know you didn’t have to, but it really helps right now
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: 我知道你并不需要这样做，但现在真的很有帮助。

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Did I wake you up, or were you already drifting in and out?
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: 我把你叫醒了吗，还是你已经在迷迷糊糊了？

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Of course it helps
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: 当然有帮助

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: You deserve nice things too, even if you don’t always believe that
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: 你也值得拥有美好的事物，即使你并不总是相信这一点。

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: …Okay
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: …好的

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Actually, there’s one thing I still need for the new phone
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: 其实，我还有一件事需要新手机。

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: It’s asking for a clean contact photo, and the one I had is ancient
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: 它在要求一张清晰的联系人照片，而我之前的那张已经很旧了。

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Oh
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: 哦

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: You want a new photo of me for your contacts?
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: 你想要我新的照片用于你的联系人吗？

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Alright, give me a second
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: 好的，给我一秒钟

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: 2 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: 2分钟后

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: I was already awake, don’t worry
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: 我已经醒了，不用担心

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: A little, but it’s fine, I’m glad you texted
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: 有一点，但没关系，我很高兴你发信息了

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: There
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: 那里

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: If that one looks terrible, you’re not allowed to complain
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: 如果那个看起来很糟糕，你就不能抱怨。

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: It’s perfect
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: 这太完美了

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Thanks
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: 谢谢

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Try to rest
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: 尽量休息

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: I’ll bring you something to eat later and check on you again
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: 我稍后会给你带点吃的，再来看看你。

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Thanks, {{name:evelyn}}
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: 谢谢，{{name:evelyn}}

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Good
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: 好

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: I keep forgetting you can’t really do much besides stare at that screen right now
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: 我总是忘记你现在除了盯着那个屏幕，真的没什么别的事情可以做。

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: I’m sorry
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: 对不起

story/DAY1/DAY1_01_MASON_INTRO.json::ste.source: I can hear you moving around

story/DAY1/DAY1_01_MASON_INTRO.json::ste.translation: 或是无尽滑动手机屏幕

story/DAY1/DAY1_01_MASON_INTRO.json::ste.source: {{name:evelyn}} told me you needed a profile pic from me, right?
story/DAY1/DAY1_01_MASON_INTRO.json::ste.translation: {{name:evelyn}}告诉我你需要我发一张头像，对吧？

story/DAY1/DAY1_01_MASON_INTRO.json::ste.source: Try not to ghost the world today
story/DAY1/DAY1_01_MASON_INTRO.json::ste.translation: 今天尽量不要让世界失望。

story/DAY1/DAY1_01_MASON_INTRO.json::ste.source: You always have something to say

story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.translation: 你知道的最可爱的女孩 💁‍♀️

story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.source: I actually needed a new contact photo for you
story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.translation: 我实际上需要为你换一张新的联系人照片。

story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.source: So this is what I’m reduced to now 😭
story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.translation: 所以我现在沦落到这个地步了 😭

story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.source: Are you awake, or are you doing that thing where you pretend you’re asleep? 😌
story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.translation: 你醒了吗，还是在假装睡觉？😌

story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.source: I was just checking on you
You’ve got the same energy as a sad houseplant 🌱
story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.translation: 你就像一盆悲伤的室内植物一样充满能量 🌱

story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.source: Maybe I was pretending. Depends who’s asking
story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.translation: 也许我在假装，得看是谁在问

story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.source: Text me if you need anything
story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.translation: 如果你需要任何帮助，给我发信息。

story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.source: I’m about to post a story and a new post
story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.translation: 我快要发布一个故事和一条新动态了。

story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.source: I'm the cutest girl you know 💅
story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.translation: 我是你认识的最可爱的女孩 💅

story/DAY1/DAY1_03_EVELYN_FOLLOWUP.json:.source: But you should at least respond to her texts
story/DAY1/DAY1_03_EVELYN_FOLLOWUP.json:.translation: 但你至少应该回复她的短信。

story/DAY1/DAY1_03_EVELYN_FOLLOWUP.json:.source: You don’t have to prove it to me
story/DAY1/DAY1_03_EVELYN_FOLLOWUP.json:.translation: 你不需要向我证明这一点
只要不要把每个人都拒之门外。

story/DAY1/DAY1_03_EVELYN_FOLLOWUP.json:.source: Did you drink any water yet

story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.source: Well i’m okay though, at least not dead
I understand but it’s not your fault
story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.translation: 我明白，但这不是你的错。

story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.source: Rest and heal, you being alive is more important than the rest for me
story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.translation: 休息和治疗，对我来说，你活着比其他一切都重要。

story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.source: And I’m here if you need me ❤️
story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.translation: 如果你需要我，我就在这里 ❤️

story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.source: Also part of why I’ve been slow to reply is the new phone
story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.translation: 我回复慢的原因之一也是因为新手机。

story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.source: By the way can you send me a profile picture?
story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.translation: 顺便问一下，你能给我发一张头像吗？

story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.source: {{name:evelyn}} told me your old one didn’t survive the accident
story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.translation: {{name:evelyn}}告诉我你之前的头像在事故中没了

story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.source: I’m just glad you even have a phone now
story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.translation: 我很高兴你现在甚至有了手机。

story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.source: Way smoother than the old one
It glitches a bit sometimes though
I just wanted to make sure you’re okay 🤍
I didn’t mean to worry you
story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.translation: 我不是故意让你担心的

story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.source: It’s just hard not to think sometimes
story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.translation: 有时候就是很难不去思考

story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.source: It’s just been a lot lately, getting stuck in bed for I don’t even know how long, missing all the good things with everyone, especially you
story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.translation: 最近真的太多了，躺在床上不知道有多久，错过了和大家一起的美好时光，尤其是和你。

story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.source: If someone touched you, I want names
story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.translation: 如果有人碰了你，我想要名字

story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.source: Probably some jealous idiots because you’re with {{name:lena}}
story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.translation: 可能是一些嫉妒的傻瓜，因为你和{{name:lena}}在一起

story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.source: She’s basically the prettiest girl on campus
story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.translation: 她基本上是校园里最漂亮的女孩
你觉得大家没注意到吗？😒

story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.source: But if you remember anything later, you tell me
story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.translation: 但如果你之后想起了什么，告诉我。

story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.source: {{name:mason}} gave me your new number. How are you actually doing?
story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.translation: {{name:mason}}给了我你的新号码。你最近怎么样？

story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.source: Had a weird glitch earlier but nothing serious
story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.translation: 之前出现了一个奇怪的故障，但没什么大问题。

story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.source: You’ve had it for two days 😂
Send me a pic so I can set your profile properly
story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.translation: 发张照片给我，这样我可以正确设置你的个人资料。
已经在升级我的联系人状态了

story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.source: I’ll tell you if I play

story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.translation: 猜猜今天谁是最可爱的 💕

story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.source: Don’t brush it off. Tell me

story/DAY1/DAY1_06_HAILEY_CHECKIN.json::.source: But I’ll see what I can do about snacks
story/DAY1/DAY1_06_HAILEY_CHECKIN.json::.translation: 但我会看看能不能准备一些零食。

story/DAY1/DAY1_06_HAILEY_CHECKIN.json::.source: You better open your window before she walks in
story/DAY1/DAY1_06_HAILEY_CHECKIN.json::.translation: 你最好在她走进来之前打开窗户。

story/DAY1/DAY1_06_HAILEY_CHECKIN.json::.source: Your room probably smells like hospital and gamer sweat mixed together 🤢
story/DAY1/DAY1_06_HAILEY_CHECKIN.json::.translation: 你的房间可能闻起来像医院和游戏玩家的汗水混合在一起的味道 🤢

story/DAY1/DAY1_06_HAILEY_CHECKIN.json::.source: Air it out before the biohazard team shows up
story/DAY1/DAY1_06_HAILEY_CHECKIN.json::.translation: 在生物危害小组到达之前先通风一下

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: 请提供需要翻译的游戏对话内容。

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: Don’t leave me on read like that again 😅
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: 不要再这样让我被忽视了 😅

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: How are you actually feeling right now?
My head feels kind of loud
Like your thoughts won’t slow down?
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: 就像你的思绪不会减缓一样？

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: I was thinking about you earlier at work
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: 我刚才在工作时想到了你。

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: It was a calm shift for once
Just one dramatic customer but I survived 😌
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: 只有一个戏剧性的顾客，但我活下来了😌

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: I have that presentation tomorrow and I keep replaying it in my head
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: 我明天有那个演讲，我一直在脑海中反复回放。

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: I swear I’m not trying to be heavy
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: 我发誓我不是想让事情变得沉重

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: I just want things to move forward you know
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: 我只想事情能够向前发展，你知道的。

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: What else do you have planned for tomorrow?
Work in the morning, then the presentation and probably more studying
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: 早上工作，然后做演讲，之后大概还要继续学习

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: But right now I care more about you than my schedule 🤍
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: 但现在我更关心你，而不是我的日程 🤍

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: You don’t have to I’m okay
You don’t have to act strong with me
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: 你不需要在我面前表现得坚强。

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: You already are in my eyes ❤️
And it’s not your fault if you’re stuck in bed
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: 如果你躺在床上，那不是你的错。

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: Five weeks before our trip, of course
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: 偏偏在我们旅行前五周，真会挑时候

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: The timing is bad but we can’t control that
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: 时机不好，但我们无法控制这一点。

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: Why do you think I’m the best girlfriend in the world?
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: 你为什么认为我是世界上最好的女朋友？

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: I ate and crashed for a bit
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: 我吃完后休息了一会儿

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: Sooo are you going to sleep soon?
My brain doesn’t want to stop
Well I might have something for your brain 😏
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: 好吧，我可能有一些东西可以给你的脑子用用 😏

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: So it can think about something else
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: 这样它就可以考虑其他事情了

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: Maybe I could send you a pic of me
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: 也许我可以给你发一张我的照片

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: I would love that but what kind of pic?
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: 我很喜欢，但是什么样的照片呢？

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: Then I played a little to kill time
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: 然后我玩了一会儿来打发时间

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: I completely forgot your message I’m sorry
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: 我完全忘记了你的消息，抱歉。

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: You smooth talker I said no comment 😌

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'd be really happy if we do that
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 如果我们这样做，我会非常开心。

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Now tell me about your day
I moved around a bit like I said I would
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 我像我说的那样稍微动了一下。

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And then I played for a while with {{name:aiden}}
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 然后我和 {{name:aiden}} 玩了一会儿。

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Rehab and social life in the same day
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 同一天的康复和社交生活

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm really glad you moved around today
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 我真的很高兴你今天活动了一下

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And I'm glad you had a decent Sunday
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 我很高兴你度过了一个不错的星期天。

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And you should go to bed soon
I don't want you exhausted tomorrow
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 我不想让你明天累坏了。

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm going to wash up and get in bed
I think I definitely got a little sunburned 😭
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 我觉得我肯定有点晒伤了 😭

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: So you got cute and slightly toasted?
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 所以你变得可爱又有点醉了吗？

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Now I really want to go back there with you
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 现在我真的很想和你一起回去那里

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: That game was actually really fun
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: 那个游戏其实挺好玩的

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: It's a shame you're so bad at it 😂
I think we'll be sore tomorrow
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: 我觉得明天我们会很酸

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: I'll let the scoreboard do the talking
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: 我会让记分板来证明一切

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Good morning 😊 Did you sleep well?
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: 早上好😊 你睡得好吗？

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: That would be a huge help

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: 这就是我在这里的原因

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: How is your leg feeling today?
Still annoying, but I think it's getting better
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: 还是有点烦人，但我觉得在好转

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: I'm going to open the windows and air out my room
Would you mind helping me clean it a little?
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: 你能帮我稍微打扫一下吗？

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I need my emergency audience alive
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 我需要我的紧急观众活着

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: He sent a tiny correction list this morning
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 他今天早上发了一份小修正清单

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Tiny in professor language means annoying
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 在教授的语言里，小就是烦人

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Why are you both using calm voices at me
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 你们俩为什么对我说话这么冷静

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Because panic does not solve homework
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 因为慌张解决不了作业
被举报了，因为你说得对 😭

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Move around a little for my leg
Then today we both have one job
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 那么今天我们都有一份工作

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I officially refuse to rush today
I'll probably clean a little, make something simple, and be useless on the couch
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我可能会稍微打扫一下，做点简单的东西，然后在沙发上无所事事。
听起来是个不错的计划

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Text me later when you've done your little rehab walk
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 等你做完小康复散步后再发信息给我。

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Someone has to make sure you don't lie about resting
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 总得有人确保你不会撒谎说你在休息。

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You're very committed to this role
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 你对这个角色非常投入

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: No shift, no running around, no pretending I have energy 😌
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 不转移，不跑来跑去，不假装我有精力 😌

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm making coffee and moving like an old lady
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我在做咖啡，动作像个老太太一样。

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: You're lying in bed judging someone who's actually trying
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: 你躺在床上评判一个真正努力的人

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: And somehow I'm still doing a better job
And my side of the kitchen is still clean
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: 而我的厨房那边还是干净的

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Get over here before I burn something
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: 快过来，不然我会烧东西的

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: If the kitchen catches fire, you'll have to move with that leg
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: 如果厨房着火了，你得用那条腿搬家

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Don't touch anything until I get there
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: 在我到之前不要碰任何东西
你现在需要帮忙吃饭吗？

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: How did you make that much mess?

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: I closed your window for you 😊
You don't have to do that
I'm already downstairs in the kitchen
I need to move around a little
Otherwise I'm going to lose my mind staying in that room all day
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: 否则我整天待在那个房间会疯掉

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: And it will save you from moving around too much to grab ingredients
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: 这样你就不用到处走去拿食材了

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: You can tell me what you need and I'll get it
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: 你告诉我需要什么，我去拿
谢谢，我会很感激你的帮助 😊

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: I was going to do it after my shower
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: 我本来打算洗完澡后再做的

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: So I thought I'd better close it now
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: 所以我想我最好现在关上

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: You did the right thing then

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I am actually kind of proud of myself 😇
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 我其实有点为自己感到骄傲 😇
别再夸自己了，小癞蛤蟆

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Okay okay not so nice teacher
Then time to go enjoy my last good time before prison😌
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 那就去享受我在监狱前的最后快乐时光😌

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Maybe tiny chaos if popcorn betrays me
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 如果爆米花背叛我，可能会有点小混乱

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: But I am still quizzing you later
Proof I left the house looking human
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 证明我出门看起来像个人

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You look like a decent human
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 你看起来像个体面的人

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You get two extra homework questions for that 😌
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 所以你要多做两个额外的作业题😌

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: A friend from class wants to see a movie
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 班上的一个朋友想去看电影

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: And she is coming to pick me up in 20 minutes
I am going to the cinema with her and maybe another friend
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 我和她还有可能另一个朋友一起去看电影
就两个小时的负责任的乐趣 😌

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Tomorrow, back in the studying game
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 明天又要回到学习状态

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I will not let the responsible era die
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 我不会让负责任的时代消亡

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: See, I can trust you sometimes
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 看，我有时候可以信任你。
我完全没有做任何有生产力的事情
你实际上值得证明的赞赏

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I look like I haven't moved for hours
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我看起来好像已经几个小时没动了。

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I like this version of you
Because this is exactly how I plan to stay for a few more hours
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 因为这正是我打算再待几个小时的方式

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'll text you after my movie ?
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我看完电影后会给你发信息的 ?

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then I sat down and never really got back up
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 然后我坐下了，真的再也没有站起来。
我为自己感到非常自豪 😌

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: 听起来还是个肯定的答案

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: But I'm choosing the first game

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: 因为你的品味很有问题

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Says the person who almost burned breakfast
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: 说这话的人差点把早餐烧了

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: That has nothing to do with games
It says a lot about your decision-making
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: 这说明了你的决策能力

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: I'll remember this when you need help
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: 我会记住这件事的，当你需要帮助的时候

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: And you're lucky I invited you
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: 而你也幸运我邀请了你

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: I'll be there in ten minutes
Don't start getting used to that
We could do a full gaming day
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: 我们可以来个完整的游戏日

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: You really have nothing better to do
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: 你真的没有更好的事情可做吗

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: I'm choosing to waste my day

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Anyway, I'm going to finish making dinner
Then I'll probably watch a few episodes of my series
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: 然后我可能会看几集我的剧

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Do you want to join me?
I still have a few things to do
Just don't stay up too late
Did you manage to rest this weekend?
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: 你这个周末休息得怎么样？

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Spending time at home with you and {{name:mason}} was relaxing
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: 和你还有{{name:mason}}在家里度过的时光真放松

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: I'm actually really happy with how my weekend went
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: 其实我对这个周末很满意

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Even if I don't feel like going back to work tomorrow
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: 虽然我不太想明天回去上班

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: I can't blame you for that

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Also my professor checked the first one already
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 而且我的教授已经检查了第一个

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: He said I could send it if I got stuck
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 他说如果我卡住了可以发给他

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Because he explained it in a voice note and now it makes sense
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 因为他在语音信息里解释了，现在我明白了
观察到非工作时间的学术交流

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Voice-note response logged outside classroom schedule
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 课堂时间外的语音回复已记录

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Pattern remains explainable as test preparation
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 模式仍然可以解释为考试准备

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: A voice note isn't proof of anything, but I'm noticing how often he's part of her day.
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 一条语音说明不了什么，可我开始注意到，他在她的日常里出现得越来越频繁。

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I am sleeping before my brain tries to learn one more thing
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 我得先睡觉，免得脑子再学一个东西

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I did two homework questions on the bus😭
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 我在公交车上做了两个作业问题😭

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Sounds like a successful rest day
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 听起来是个成功的休息日
我需要一些安静的东西

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I told myself I would sleep early tonight
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我告诉自己今晚要早睡

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I guess I have no discipline 😌
How was the rest of your day?
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你今天剩下的时间过得怎么样？
我做了一些简单的东西

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: The doctor is coming tomorrow morning
Someone has to keep you alive
You're enjoying this way too much
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: 你享受这个享受得太多了

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Why didn't you go to the gym today?
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: 你今天为什么不去健身房？

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: I thought you were being bullied again

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: I'm still finishing the pancakes anyway 😌
Not having to work is quite wonderful

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: 我做了煎饼，你最喜欢的😌

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: He's finishing his last year at university
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 他正在完成大学的最后一年

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Tutoring is basically his side job
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 辅导基本上是他的兼职

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: That's actually less terrifying than I expected
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 这其实比我想象的要少吓人

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I was imagining some ancient professor with glasses
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 我原本想象的是个戴眼镜的老教授

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: You mean like every movie ever?
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 你是说每部电影里的那种？

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Party survived, home safe. Now back to tutor panic 😶
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 派对顺利结束，也平安到家了。现在又开始为家教紧张了 😶
年轻又放松听起来更好

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: He's still coming to make you study
What is this Ethan guy actually like?
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 这个Ethan到底是什么样的人？

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: He'll see where you're at and what needs work
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 他会看看你的情况和需要改进的地方

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: If he's taking time to help me, I'll make the effort too 😊
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 如果他花时间来帮我，我也会努力的😊

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Now let me survive the morning first
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 先让我熬过这个上午吧

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I want to know what I'm walking into 😭
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 我想知道我会遇到什么 😭

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Move around a little for my leg
Then today we both have one job
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 那么今天我们都有一份工作

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I officially refuse to rush today
I'll probably clean a little, make something simple, and be useless on the couch
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我可能会稍微打扫一下，做点简单的东西，然后在沙发上无所事事。
听起来是个不错的计划

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: 谢谢你的咖啡。我很享受这次平静的对话。

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: DAY 12
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: 第12天

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: DAY 12
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: 第12天

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: How was it?
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: 怎么样？

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Honestly?
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: 老实说？

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: It was much more pleasant than I expected
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: 比我预期的要愉快得多

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: You picked a really good person
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: 你选了一个很不错的人

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: We spent most of the time talking
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: 我们大部分时间都在聊天

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: And in the end I agreed to stay for two hours instead of one
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: 最后我同意待两个小时，而不是一个小时

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: I'm glad everything went well
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: 我很高兴一切都很顺利

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: You sounded really nervous this morning
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: 你今天早上听起来很紧张

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I barely passed the last quiz
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 我上次的测验勉强通过

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: So I asked for his number 😌
But seriously, focus on studying first
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 但说真的，先专心学习吧

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: The annoying part is that it actually worked
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 烦人的部分是这真的有效

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I studied harder because I wanted the reward
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 我为了想要奖励而更努力学习

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Then I guess Ethan knows what he's doing
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 那我想Ethan知道他在做什么

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: {{name:hailey}} shows increased responsiveness to Ethan's approval
Tutor-student boundary remains stable for now
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 导师与学生的界限目前保持稳定

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Risk detected: relationship may not remain strictly academic
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 检测到风险：关系可能不会保持严格的学术性

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I wanted her to take studying seriously. I didn't expect his approval to matter this much.
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 我希望她认真学习，没想到他的认可会变得这么重要。

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: He gave me little quizzes during the session
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 他在课程中给我出了小测验

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: If I passed, I got a reward
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 如果我通过了，就会有奖励

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: If I failed, I got a punishment
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 如果我没通过，就会有惩罚

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A little of both sounds right 😌
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 两者都有一点听起来不错 😌

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: One teacher kept repeating the same thing for 20 minutes
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 一位老师重复同样的话达20分钟。

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I almost gave up on life halfway through
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我差点在中途放弃生活

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Thank you for validating my struggle
My brain is starting to drift a little
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我的脑子开始有点飘了

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Just resting and moving a little
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 只是休息一下，活动一下。

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay I should go back before I completely disconnect from reality
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 好的，我应该回去了，免得我完全与现实脱节。

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I caught myself staring at nothing for a full minute earlier
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我发现自己之前盯着空白看了一整分钟

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Hey, what did you do with my controller?
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: 嘿，你把我的手柄放哪了？

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: You're going to pay for that

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: 检查一下你自己的屁股里

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: You better find it or I'm considering it stolen
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: 你最好找到它，不然我就当它被偷了

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: What would I even do with it?
You think I hid it inside my cast or something?
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: 你觉得我把它藏在我的石膏里吗？

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: With how desperate you are to finally beat me, I wouldn't put it past you
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: 看你多想打败我，我可不怀疑你会这么做

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: I booked another coaching session for you tomorrow morning
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: 我为你预约了明天早上的教练课程

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Maybe it'll teach you something about life
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: 也许能教你点人生道理

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Blanket mode is not a joke
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 毛毯模式可不是开玩笑的
我可以看看毛毯模式吗？

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: But this is a very exclusive report
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 但这是一个非常独家的报告

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I think I needed this tonight
Peace, quiet, and you being sweet to me
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 平静、安静，还有你对我温柔的态度

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You're very good at it when you want to be ❤️
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 当你想要的时候，你非常擅长这件事 ❤️

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Only when I want to be?
Mostly when you're not trying to act tough
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 大多数时候，当你不想表现得很强硬时

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I'm going to stay wrapped up a little longer
Then sleep before I become useless tomorrow
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 然后睡觉吧，免得我明天变得没用。
不算糟糕，只是让人疲惫。
课程让你感到压力了吗？

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I feel like my social battery has filed a complaint
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 我感觉我的社交电池已经提出了投诉。

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I am currently wrapped in a blanket and accepting no responsibilities
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 我现在裹着毯子，不想承担任何责任。

story/DAY12/DAY12_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: Do not get used to it. I am giving you one calm message for free.
story/DAY12/DAY12_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: 不要习惯于此。我给你一个平静的信息，免费。

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: And if you want anything special for lunch, tell me
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: 如果你想吃什么特别的午餐，告诉我

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: I can make it for you
I will message you if I need anything
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: 如果我需要什么会给你发消息

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: I will bring the clothes up in a minute
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: 我一会儿就把衣服拿上来

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: You need to be ready in case work starts
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: 你需要准备好，以防工作开始

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: I still did not see any light in your room when I walked past
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: 我经过你房间时，还是没看到任何光

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: I will come upstairs and drop off your clean clothes
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: 我会上楼把你的干净衣服放下

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Do well tonight and we can discuss benefits 😇
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: 今晚表现好，我们可以讨论福利😇

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Many chances to regret my choices
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: 有很多机会后悔我的选择

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: I will probably need help after the second one
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: 第二节课后我可能需要帮助

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Now I have no excuse to fail 😭
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: 现在我没有借口失败了😭

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Go to your classes, quickly before I heal completely
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: 快去上课，趁我还没完全恢复

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: The injured tutor threat level is rising 😔
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: 受伤家教的威胁等级正在上升 😔

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: If I learn anything against my will, I am blaming you 💅
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: 如果我被迫学到什么，我就怪你💅

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Blink twice if your leg is being dramatic
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: 如果你的腿在发作，就眨两次眼
我的作业可是有戏剧训练的

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: I still need my favorite tutor functional
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: 我还是需要我最喜欢的导师能正常工作

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I would have wanted that too
You would have had to protect me from the evil sky 😌
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 你本该保护我免受邪恶天空的侵害😌

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I take that responsibility very seriously
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 我非常认真地对待这个责任。
我基本上是个风暴专家

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Send me a picture of my brave survivor then
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 那就给我发一张我勇敢幸存者的照片吧。

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I haven't finished doing my makeup yet 😭
I didn't say full glam was required
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 我没有说需要完全华丽的打扮。

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You get the almost ready version
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 你得到的是几乎准备好的版本

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: And don't forget your leg exercises today
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 别忘了今天做腿部锻炼哦

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: There was a storm during the night
Okay maybe more than a little
I really wanted to sleep with you
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 我真的很想和你一起睡觉。

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_.translation: 而且我今天下午还有工作

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_.source: You say that like you're the responsible one
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_.translation: 你说得好像你才是负责的一样

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_.source: Maybe we do a small session today
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_.translation: 今天我们做个小训练吧
所以别是你自己计划的

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_.source: I'm trying to be responsible here

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: I'm going to do some grocery shopping
Is there anything you want me to buy?
Could you get me a water bottle or a flask?
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: 能帮我买个水瓶或者保温杯吗？

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: Something I can keep in my room with clean water
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: 我想要一个可以放在房间里装干净水的

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: I'll see what I can find
I'll try not to come back too late
Do you have time to bring me something to eat?
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: 你有时间给我带点吃的吗？

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: I'll heat up your lunch and bring it to you
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: 我会把你的午餐热好，带给你

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: I'm coming to pick up your plate
Do you need anything else while I'm here?
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: 我在这里的时候，你还需要其他东西吗？

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Do not say it like that

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: 这让我听起来很负责任💅

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Your bullying tutor method might be working
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: 你那种调侃导师的方法可能有效哦

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Can you ask {{name:mason}} if {{mason:he}} can come pick me up at university?
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: 你能问问{{name:mason}}，{{mason:he|他|她}}能不能来大学接我？

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: I would ask {{mason:him}} myself but {{mason:he}} is less scary when you are involved
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: 我本来可以自己问{{mason:him|他|她}}，不过有你参与时，{{mason:he|他|她}}就没那么吓人了。

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: I will take care of it
But if you get home early, you revise again
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: 但如果你早回家，就再复习一次

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: I knew there was a trap
You cannot say that after I survived class
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: 你不能在我熬过了课后这么说

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: I am way too cute to be forced to revise 😇
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: 我太可爱了，不能被迫复习 😇
可爱的学生还是要复习的

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: This is discrimination against adorable people 😭

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: I'll destroy you on that game
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: 我会在那游戏里打败你

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: I see you still have hope
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: 我看到你还是有希望的

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: Go to work before you embarrass yourself more
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: 快去上班吧，别再丢人了

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: Enjoy the silence while it lasts
And why would that interest me?
Because your day is clearly empty without my updates
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: 因为没有我的更新，你的日子肯定无聊透了

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: Bold of you to assume that
I try to match the audience
If I don't get home too late tonight
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: 如果今晚我不太晚回家

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: I can already transfer you 300 dollars
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: 我可以马上转给你300美元

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: So I already received money for the work I did
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: 所以我已经收到了我做的工作的报酬

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: I do not even know how to thank you for doing all this
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: 我甚至不知道该怎么感谢你做这一切

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: How was your second day of work?
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: 你第二天的工作怎么样？

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: A smile and a kiss, then
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: 一个微笑和一个吻，然后

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: Then I may have to send you more of them
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: 那我可能得多给你一些了

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: Come eat before dinner gets cold
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: 快来吃饭，别让晚餐凉了

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: And do not go to bed too late tonight
It was calmer than yesterday too
I managed to buy everything we needed
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: 我成功买到了我们需要的一切

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: We are almost out of money

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I have decided to be useful tonight
So I am repaying my debt
{{name:hailey}} comes into your room to bring you food and clean your room
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: {{name:hailey}}进你房间给你送食物和打扫房间

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I am a generous little angel 😇
But you unplugged my whole PC while cleaning
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: 但你打扫的时候把我的整个电脑都拔掉了

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: How dare you take a picture of me?
It clearly shows you touching the cables
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: 这明显显示你在碰电缆

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Thanks for asking {{name:mason}} to pick me up
It shows a hardworking innocent girl being framed
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: 这是一个努力工作的无辜女孩被陷害的证据

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: You are literally holding the cable
Maybe the cable attacked me first
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: 也许是电缆先攻击我的

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: You do not know the full story
And you are taking secret pictures of me
Go revise before you destroy more electronics
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: 去复习吧，别再毁坏电子设备了

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: But if the PC dies, it was already weak
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: 但如果电脑死了，那本来就不行了

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Elevated heart rate spike detected during recent private interaction
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: 在最近的私人互动中检测到心率升高
正在交叉参考视觉和情感标记...

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Relevant emotional capture archived into HAK Evidence
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: 相关情感捕捉已存档到HAK证据

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Being close to {{name:hailey}} stayed with me, and I want more moments like that.
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: 和{{name:hailey}}亲近的感觉一直留在心里，我还想拥有更多这样的时刻。

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Alive, safe, and only mildly dramatic
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: 活着，安全，只有一点小戏剧

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I still need to get home
I finally collapsed on the couch
And I'm stealing snacks from the kitchen like a little rat
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 我像小老鼠一样从厨房偷零食。

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm really sorry I missed your calls
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 我真的很抱歉我错过了你的电话

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I had a very glamorous day of stress and minor disasters
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 我度过了一个非常光鲜的压力和小灾难的一天。

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And one customer who acted like I personally ruined his life
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 还有一个顾客像是我亲自毁了他的生活一样。

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I kept thinking about being home and talking to you though
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 我一直在想着回家和你聊天。

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That part you can do now
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 那部分你现在可以做了

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That's why I wanted to stay here with you a little longer
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 这就是我想和你多待一会儿的原因。

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You still shouldn't go to bed too late
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 你还是不应该太晚睡觉。

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I just wanted a little more of you first
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 我只是想先多一点你的陪伴

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You'll have more of me tomorrow
And hopefully tomorrow will be easier for you too
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 希望明天对你来说也会更容易。

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You always say the annoyingly right thing 😌
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 你总是说出恼人的正确话 😌

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Go take your shower when you're done eating
And send you a pic of me?
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 要给你发我一张照片吗？

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: But only because I've missed you all day
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 但只是因为我整天都想念你

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Promise you won't show it to anyone
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 保证你不会把它给任何人看

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm still in my work clothes 😭
You look so good ( and sexy ) I almost died
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 你看起来太好了（而且性感），我差点儿死了。
现在我真的应该睡觉了。

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I won't be able to right now

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 我想你一定忙得不可开交。

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: It felt like the whole day was just problem after problem
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 感觉整天都是一个接一个的问题。

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: You took that loss pretty hard
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: 你对那次失败反应得可真大

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: That's a lot of excuses for one evening
Next time we should bet something
Loser owes the winner a favor
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: 输的人要给赢的人一个人情

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: I hope you don't lose too often then 😏
Come get your ass kicked in 5 minutes
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: 五分钟后来被我打败吧

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: I've been waiting all day to make you cry
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: 我等了一整天就是想让你哭

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: I'll try not to laugh too much
We'll see who's laughing in a few minutes
Do you need a teddy bear to sleep tonight? 😏
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: 今晚需要个泰迪熊陪你睡吗？😏

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Hey, I made breakfast for you 😊
I had plenty of time, so I made breakfast
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: 我有很多时间，所以我做了早餐

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: You have to deal with your manager every day
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: 你每天都得跟经理打交道

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: It's the least I can do around the house
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: 这是我在家能做的最基本的事

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: I'll be downstairs when you're ready
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: 等你准备好了我就在楼下

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Okay, give me a few minutes 😊
Take your time getting up and get some rest
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: 慢慢来，起床时好好休息一下

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: You had a long night at work
I'm so sorry, I slept way too much
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: 我真抱歉，我睡得太久了

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: I didn't even hear my alarm
You worked late, it's normal to be tired
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: 你工作到很晚，累是正常的

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: He said to come by if the second class exposes my tragic gaps
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 他说如果第二节课暴露我的悲惨短板就来找他

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I'm sure his words were nicer
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 我相信他的话会更好听

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: You are relying on him a lot
He just happens to know how to make my brain behave
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 他正好知道怎么让我的大脑正常运转

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Now I have no excuse to fail
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 现在我没有失败的借口了

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: If I learn anything against my will, I am blaming both of you 💅
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 如果我被迫学到什么，我就怪你们两个💅
我需要大家都能正常工作

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: And probably professor rescue after the second one
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 第二节课后可能还得救教授

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Part-time job from morning to evening
I'll text you when I can
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我有空的时候会给你发信息。
好的，祝你有美好的一天！
我真的很需要那段睡眠

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Hey, how are you feeling this morning?
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: 嘿，你今天早上感觉怎么样？

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: I was starting to think the doctor had fixed your personality too
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: 我开始觉得医生是不是也修复了你的性格

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Not even medicine can save yours
I need to reconnect a few things in my room
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: 我需要重新连接我房间里的几样东西

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: The console, the screen and some cables
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: 游戏机、屏幕和一些线缆

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: And you need me for that?
You might actually be useful for once
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: 你这次可能真的能派上用场

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Then your console can stay broken
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: 那你的游戏机就可以继续坏着

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Can't I ask how you're doing?
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: 我不能问你过得怎么样吗？

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: It was almost better when you kept your mouth shut
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: 你闭嘴的时候反而好一些

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Thanks again for this morning
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: 谢谢你今天早上的帮助

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: That looks delicious
Good 😊
Then it was worth the effort
By the way, are you working the same hours tonight?
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: 对了，你今晚还是同样的工作时间吗？

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: No
Since my manager is working tonight, I'm back to my usual schedule
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: 因为我的经理今晚上班，我又回到正常的时间表了

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: So I'll leave a little earlier
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: 所以我会稍微早一点离开

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Then make sure you take some time for yourself before work
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: 那你上班前一定要留点时间给自己

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: I will 😊
I'm going to watch some TV for a bit
It's nothing, really
And then I'll start getting ready
That sounds like a good plan 😊
Maybe for you
But I still think it was really sweet
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: 但我还是觉得你真贴心

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: So I made a cake for you
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: 所以我给你做了个蛋糕

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: You didn't have to do that
But I'm definitely not complaining 😄
I hope you'll like it
Wow

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: If you get home early, you revise
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 如果你早回家，就复习一下
反驳：太可爱了，没法复习
可爱的学生还是要复习的

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Professor said he can bring me home when he's done with work
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 教授说他工作完可以送我回家

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: So I am waiting in the school office
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 所以我在学校办公室等着

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: It is quieter than the hallway
And he said he's almost done
So I will just wait here
It actually went kind of well
Subject accepted professor's offer instead of waiting for alternative pickup
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 对象接受了教授的提议，而不是等其他接送

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Pattern of one-on-one contact frequency continues to increase
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 一对一接触频率的模式继续增加

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Behavior remains explainable but trend analysis flagged for review
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 行为仍然可以解释，但趋势分析需要复审

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: His help is becoming part of her routine, and that makes me uneasy.
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 他的帮助正成为她日常的一部分，这让我不安。

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Professor provided transportation following a private revision session. Interaction remains within a plausible academic context, though HAK notes a growing pattern of personal assistance and increased familiarity.
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 教授在私人复习课后提供了交通。互动仍在合理的学术背景内，但HAK注意到个人帮助和熟悉度逐渐增加的模式。

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I'm leaving the school office now
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 我现在要离开学校办公室了

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Do not say it like a proud spreadsheet
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 别说得像个骄傲的表格一样

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I feel safer asking when you are involved
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 有你在我身边我会觉得更安全

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: You're using that leg as an excuse for everything now
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: 你现在把那条腿当借口用得可真多

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: You really should stop watching business videos
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: 你真的该停止看商业视频了

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: So... are you bringing the groceries?
But only because I don't trust you to shop alone
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: 但只是因为我不相信你能一个人购物
看吧？你内心深处是个好人

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Just because I'm outside doesn't mean I'm your personal delivery service
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: 我在外面可不是你的私人快递员

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Can't you help a poor injured man? 😔
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: 难道你就不能帮帮一个可怜的受伤男人吗？ 😔

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Hey, I'm about to leave for work
2 HOURS LATER
Hey, I'm on my break
How is it going?
It's okay
But we got the new outfits my manager ordered
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: 不过我们收到了经理订的新服装

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: And honestly I don't like them at all
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: 老实说，我一点都不喜欢

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: What do the others think about them?
Most of them are pretty divided
But everyone listens to whatever the manager says
So we'll have to wear them no matter what
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: 所以无论如何我们都得穿上它们

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Everything is ready for dinner as usual
Just tell yourself it's only for work
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: 告诉自己这只是工作而已

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: And try to make the best of it
I'll try
You'll be fine
I know you can handle it
Thanks ❤️
I need to get back to work now
Good luck
See you tomorrow since I won't get to see you tonight
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: 明天见，今晚见不到你了

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: See you tomorrow 😊
{{name:hailey}} will bring it to your room so you don't have to move around too much
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: {{name:hailey}}会把它送到你的房间，这样你就不用太多走动了

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: 3 HOURS LATER
Workplace anomaly detected
{{name:evelyn}} reported concerns regarding new work outfits
Repeated references to management decisions detected
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: 检测到对管理决策的重复提及

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Additional monitoring recommended to evaluate workplace influence patterns
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: 建议额外监控以评估工作场所影响模式

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: I don't like how much her work seems to be deciding for her.
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: 她的工作似乎越来越在替她做决定，我不喜欢这样。

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: HAK//NOTICE
HAK archived an image from a fitting session involving the new work outfits introduced by management
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: HAK存档了一张关于管理层引入的新工作服试穿会的图片

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: EVENING
Outfit Trying
DAY 13
DAY 13
Thank you
And good luck tonight
Thank you 😊
Send me a message during your break
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: 休息的时候给我发个消息

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: I will
1 H LATER
I'm so good at picking the right outfit right ?
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: 我真的是太会挑衣服了，对吧？

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I can understand that, but you also don't want to fall into the trap of avoiding work because it's hard
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 我能理解，但你也不想因为工作难而逃避

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: LATER, AFTER {{name:hailey}} BROUGHT FOOD TO YOUR ROOM
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 稍后，{{name:hailey}} 给你送了食物

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Everything went well with your professor?
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 和你的教授一切都顺利吗？

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: He said my answer from earlier was closer than he expected
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 他说我之前的答案比他预期的更接近
让我奇怪地松了一口气

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Like someone finally understands where I get lost

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Don't rely on him too much

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: No

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: So you really want me to tell you everything?
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: 所以你真的想让我告诉你一切？

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Yes
