story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: 刚才我还在担心，现在却不知道该说什么了。

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: I just got out of the shower
I'll dry myself quickly and bring you something to eat
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: 我会赶紧擦干，给你带点吃的

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: I am proud of your non-empty page
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: 我为你那张不空的纸感到骄傲

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: This is the face of a soldier between battles
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: 这就是战士在战斗间隙的表情

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Wow i'm starting to believe youre actually at war
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: 哇，我开始相信你真的在打仗

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: But i am cute enough to survive
Go win the next round then
I am going back to the front
If I fall, avenge me with tomorrow's shopping money 😌
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: 如果我倒下了，就用明天的购物钱为我报仇😌

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: And then I have more tests 😭
How did the first ones go?
Maybe my brain invented a new academic language
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: 也许我的大脑发明了一种新的学术语言

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: But I did not leave the page blank at least 😌

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.source: You say that like you don't enjoy watching the chaos
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.translation: 你这么说就像你不喜欢看混乱一样。

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.source: I just hope I don't finish too late tonight
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.translation: 我只希望今晚不要结束得太晚

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.source: But I really want to talk whith you tonight ❤️
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.translation: 但我今晚真的想和你聊聊 ❤️

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.source: Then as soon as you get home we will talk
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.translation: 然后你一到家我们就谈谈。

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.source: That gives me something nice to look forward to
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.translation: 这让我有了期待的美好事物。

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.source: Okay, I should get back before lunch break disappears
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.translation: 好的，我应该在午休时间消失之前回去。

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.source: Good luck for the rest of the day
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.translation: 祝你今天剩下的时间好运！

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.source: Don't forget to move your body and don't play to much game
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.translation: 别忘了动动身体，别玩太多游戏。

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.source: Just long and a little boring
So basically a classic university morning 😌
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.translation: 所以基本上就是一个经典的大学早晨😌

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.source: I'm eating with my friends right now
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.translation: 我现在正在和我的朋友们一起吃饭。

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.source: And {{name:aiden}} apparently found another group of girls to annoy
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.translation: 而且{{name:aiden}}显然又找到了一群女孩来烦人

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: We'll settle it on the game tonight
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: 今晚的游戏我们来解决

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: Maybe we should train somewhere else
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: 也许我们应该换个地方训练

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: If you can with your cast
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: 如果你能带着石膏游的话

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: I've already seen people swimming with a cast
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: 我见过有人带着石膏游泳

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: She's probably better than both of us
You were actually pretty impressive for once
Try not to sound too surprised
Don't let it get to your head
If you've got a problem with me

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: Then I'll come downstairs and help you
I can't let you do everything alone
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: 我可不想让你一个人做所有事情

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: Would you like to continue the series?
You don't even need to ask
I'm waiting for you on the couch 😌
I just finished brushing my teeth

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: 检测到重复的私人晚间互动
正在交叉比对最近的行为模式...

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: Relevant emotional capture archived into HAK Evidence
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: 相关情感捕捉已存档到HAK证据中

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: So I'm not imagining how close we've become.
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: 原来我们变得这么亲近，并不是我的错觉。

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: I actually enjoy what I'm doing
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: 其实我很享受我正在做的事情

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: Did you already start making dinner?
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: 你已经开始做晚饭了吗？

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I am really proud of you
Later, after you brought food to {{name:hailey}} in her room
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: 之后，你把食物送到{{name:hailey}}的房间

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I still cannot believe my private professor brought me food in bed 😭
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: 我还是不敢相信我的私人教授给我送了床上餐😭

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: That is not an excuse to stare at me while I eat
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: 这不是你盯着我吃东西的借口

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: You took a picture of me 😭
You are literally a paparazzi pervert
The evidence shows a tired innocent girl being harassed in her natural habitat 😔
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: 证据显示一个疲惫无辜的女孩在她的自然栖息地被骚扰😔

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: You are lucky I am exhausted
Otherwise I would destroy you verbally right now
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: 否则我现在就会口头上毁了你

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Elevated heart rate spike detected during recent private interaction
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: 在最近的私人互动中检测到心率升高
正在交叉参考视觉和情感标记...

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Relevant emotional capture archived into HAK Evidence
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: 相关情感捕捉已存档到HAK证据

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I keep looking forward to those moments with her, even when I have no clever line ready.
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: 我总在期待和她相处的那些时刻，就算没准备好什么俏皮话也一样。

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Tomorrow I am sleeping for ten years
You survived the whole day though
I am taking a shower and collapsing into my bed after this
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: 我洗个澡，然后就倒在床上了

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: But first I'm going to take a shower and eat something
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 但我先要洗个澡，吃点东西。

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And yet you still like me

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 对我来说，不幸的是，是的 😌

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Keep it to yourself, of course
She knows exactly how to catch me off guard. Even now.
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 她就是知道怎么让我措手不及。现在也一样。

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: How am I supposed to stay calm now?
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 我现在怎么能保持冷静呢？

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: But maybe that's exactly what I was going for 🤍
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 但也许这正是我想要的 🤍

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Now let me eat before I become dramatic
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 现在让我吃点东西，免得我变得戏剧化。

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: But I expect another one later
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 但我期待稍后会有另一个。

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Because now I'm fed, clean, comfy, and all yours for the rest of the evening 😌
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 因为现在我吃饱了，干净了，舒服了，今晚就全是你的了 😌

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Then you're keeping me company all night
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 那你就是整晚陪着我了

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I just need to get into bed and warm up a little, then I'm all yours
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 我只需要上床暖和一下，然后我就是你的了。

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And the day actually went better than I thought it would
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 这一天实际上比我想象的要好。

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: So I have the whole evening for you ❤️
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 所以我整个晚上都留给你 ❤️

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Now that's exactly what I wanted to hear

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: The playful rivalry between you and {{name:mason}} keeps escalating, turning every game into another excuse to get closer.
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: 你和{{name:mason}}之间的玩笑竞争越来越激烈，每场游戏都成了你们靠近的借口。

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: I knew you were a sore loser
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: 我就知道你是个输不起的人

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: But jumping on me so I couldn't win?
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: 但跳到我身上让我不能赢？

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: Didn't look like you hated it that much 😉
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: 看起来你并不那么讨厌这事😉

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: Can we pretend that never happened?
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: 我们能假装这事没发生吗？

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: Go to bed before I smash this cast over your head
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: 快去睡觉，不然我就把这石膏砸你头上

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: I'm going to be even stronger tonight 😏
I just got out of the shower
If you started without me, you're dead
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: 如果你在我之前开始，那你就完了

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: I wouldn't steal your only chance to win 😂
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: 我可不会抢走你唯一的胜利机会😂

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: The teasing between you and {{name:mason}} is becoming more personal.
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: 你和{{name:mason}}之间的调侃变得越来越个人化了。

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: Another game feels like an excuse to stay close, and I'm happy to take it.
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: 再玩一局像是继续待在一起的借口，我很乐意接受。

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: And explore a little further together
By learning what the other person likes and what feels good to them ❤️
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: 通过了解对方喜欢什么以及什么让他们感觉良好 ❤️

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: That's exactly what I want too
Us figuring it out together feels right
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: 我们一起搞定这一切感觉很对。

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: Because I want it to stay like that with you
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: 因为我想和你保持这样的状态

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: Now you're making me think too much before sleep
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: 现在你让我在睡觉前想太多了

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: Then maybe I should make it worse
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: 那我也许应该让它变得更糟。

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: And way too proud of yourself
You're making it very hard to act normal right now
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: 你现在让人很难表现得正常。
我们已经在学习什么有效了 😌

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: Because I want a lot more of this with you
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: 因为我想和你有更多这样的时刻

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: You have no idea how happy that makes me
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: 你不知道这让我有多开心。

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: I'm really happy we had that talk the other day
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: 我真的很高兴我们前几天进行了那次谈话。

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: Now I really have to sleep before I keep getting worse
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: 现在我真的得睡觉了，不然我会越来越糟。

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: And try not to haunt me with those pictures
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: 别用那些照片来缠着我。

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: It feels really good when we're that honest with each other
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: 当我们彼此如此诚实时，感觉真的很好。

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: I feel so much better now that things are clearer between us
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: 我现在感觉好多了，因为我们之间的事情变得清晰了。

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: And I really can't wait for us to open up more and more
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: 我真的迫不及待想要我们越来越开放。

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: And I'm sorry I let you make breakfast again
I'm happy to take care of you for once
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: 我很高兴能照顾你一次

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: I don't even know what to say to that
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: 我都不知道该怎么回应你了

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Just come downstairs when you're ready
And before you ask, I'm fine
So don't worry about me and get some rest
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: 所以别担心我，休息一下吧

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Last night must have been exhausting

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: More like he already decided I am not allowed
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 更像是他已经决定我不被允许

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Do not make me analyze it before battle
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 别让我在战斗前分析它

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Professor voice and your voice are merging in my head
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 教授的声音和你的声音在我脑海中交融

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: See you after the first battle 🤍
That is definitely a soldier face
Professor made me review until my soul left my body yesterday
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 教授昨天让我复习到我灵魂出窍

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: So if I fail, I am suing him
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 所以如果我挂科，我就告他

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I still have a full day ahead
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我还有整整一天的时间。

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I just want this year to be over already 😌
Then I'll only have the job to focus on
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 那么我就只需要专注于工作了。

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: One thing at a time sounds nice right now
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 现在一次做一件事听起来不错。

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll text you later if I can
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 如果可以的话，我稍后会给你发信息。

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: How are things with those idiots at the gym?
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: 健身房那些傻瓜怎么样？

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: You should follow your own advice
I had a good time too
I'm just getting used to work and the gym
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: 我正在适应工作和健身房的生活
这已经成为我的日常了

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Did you put on something light for the heat?
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: 你穿轻便点以应对热天气了吗？

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: I wore my favorite summer outfit
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: 我穿了我最喜欢的夏装

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: And I feel perfectly comfortable in it

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: He fixed my shirt because it was folded weird
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 他帮我整理了衬衫，因为折得奇怪

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Before you say anything, I did not notice
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 在你说什么之前，我没注意到
而且我脑子里全是考试

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: My soul left my body three hours ago 😭
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 我的灵魂三小时前就出窍了 😭

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Anyway I still have one more test later
If I survive this week I deserve financial compensation 😌
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 如果我能活过这一周，我就该得到经济补偿 😌

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I am going back to the front
If I fall, avenge me with tomorrow's shopping money 😌
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 如果我倒下了，就用明天的购物钱为我报仇😌

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And the day actually went better than I thought it would

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then you're keeping me company all night
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 那你就是整晚陪着我了

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I just need to get into bed and warm up a little, then I'm all yours
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我只需要上床暖和一下，然后我就是你的了。

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So I have the whole evening for you ❤️

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: It's like the idea of sharing you is exciting to me
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: 分享你的想法让我感到兴奋

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: Thinking about you taking pleasure with another man
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: 想象你和另一个男人一起享受快乐
或者和另一个男生调情

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: And the idea of someone else seeing all of you
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: 而别人看到你全部的想法

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: Having you for himself for a moment
All of that is extremely exciting to me
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: 这一切对我来说都非常令人兴奋。

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: I think I'm starting to understand
So when you say someone else seeing all of me
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: 所以当你说其他人看到我的全部时

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: If someone else saw me like that…
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: 如果其他人看到我那样……

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: What would that do to you?
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: 那会对你造成什么影响？

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: It would excite me a lot
And the idea of another man seeing you like that does something to me
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: 另一个男人以那样的方式看着你，这让我感到不安。

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: That's what I wanted to know 😳
Now imagine I send something like that to someone else
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: 现在想象一下我把这样的东西发给其他人。

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: I think I'd want to know, and I'd want to have it too
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: 我想我想知道，我也想拥有它。

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: I think I'd want to know, but not receive it myself
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: 我想我想知道，但不想自己得到。

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: I don't think I'd want to know
I've been thinking a lot about what you told me
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: 我一直在思考你告诉我的事情。

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: So you'd want to share that moment with me?
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: 所以你想和我分享那个时刻吗？

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: Maybe not knowing would make it stronger
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: 也许不知道会让它更强大

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: So the mystery would be part of it?
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: 所以谜团会是其中的一部分吗？

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: You're really trying to understand this, huh
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: 你真的在努力理解这个，是吗？

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: And maybe I like the way you react 😌
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: 也许我喜欢你反应的方式 😌
关于你的戴绿帽子事情

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: But I feel safe doing this with you
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: 但我觉得和你在一起做这个很安全。

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: Now I really need to stop before I go too far 😭
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: 我现在真的需要停下来，免得走得太远 😭

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: Yeah... same here, it's getting harder to keep it together
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: 是啊……我也是，越来越难以保持冷静了。

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: Be ready for next time then 😏
I'm trying to understand how it feels for you
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: 我试着理解你是什么感觉

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: Like… what exactly makes it exciting in your head
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: 就… 在你脑海中，究竟是什么让它变得令人兴奋呢

story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: If you try to act tough and mess it up right away I will judge you loudly
story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: 如果你试图装得很强硬却马上搞砸了，我会大声评判你。

story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: Only one week of classes left
What are you planning to do
Any news on when that cast comes off?
story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: 石膏什么时候拆，有消息了吗？

story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: And drag you with me once your leg is ready
story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: 等你的腿好了，我就把你拖走。
听起来对我们来说很危险

story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: That's suppose to be a good thing?
The doctor is checking my leg today, so I should know more after that
story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: 医生今天会检查我的腿，等检查完就能多知道些了

story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: Your leg has been in there long enough
story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: 你的腿在里面待得够久了

story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: I hope so, but I'm waiting to hear what he says
story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: 希望吧，不过还是先听听医生怎么说

story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: Even if it comes off, take it slow
No celebrating with a sprint down the stairs
story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: 可别为了庆祝一口气冲下楼梯

story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: I'll ask him what I can do before I try anything
story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: 我会先问他能做什么，再去试

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: But I think I got enough rest
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: 不过我觉得我休息得够了

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: By the way, I sent you some money this morning
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: 对了，我今天早上给你转了一些钱

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: For groceries, bills and everything else
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: 买杂货、付账单和其他的

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: I really don't know how to thank you
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: 我真的不知道该怎么感谢你

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: You already do enough for me
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: 你已经为我做了很多了

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: You deserve to rest and enjoy yourself a little
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: 你值得休息一下，享受一下

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: And honestly, I'm happy I get to spend so much time with you lately
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: 老实说，我很高兴最近能和你花这么多时间

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: It feels like we've gotten a lot closer
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: 感觉我们变得更亲近了

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: I like spending more time with you
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: 我喜欢和你多待一会儿

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: The doctor is coming after work today
Actually, I wanted to ask you something
Would it be easier if I kept some food in my room for lunch?
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: 如果我在房间里备点午餐会不会更方便？

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: That way I wouldn't have to bother you every day
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: 这样我就不用每天打扰你了

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: I actually like taking care of you
So whenever you're hungry, just tell me
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: 所以每当你饿了，告诉我一声

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: And I'll bring you a hot meal
I'll talk to you later then
We went to bed pretty late yesterday
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: 我们昨天晚上睡得挺晚的

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: I woke up a few times during the night

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: 我的英雄身体需要恢复

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: You cannot just skip because you are tired
I can if I pay the tutor tax
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: 如果我交了导师税，我可以
贿赂在特殊情况下被接受

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: You earned a bit of rest
I knew you were secretly reasonable 💅
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: 我就知道你其实很理智 💅

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: The court has ruled in my favor 😌
Besides, I need to be in top condition for shopping this afternoon
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: 而且，我需要保持最佳状态去下午购物

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Of course that is your priority
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: 当然，这是你的优先事项

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: I am still in bed and i don't plan on leaving
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: 我还在床上，没打算起床

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: And my bed is also holding me hostage
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: 而且我的床也在绑架我

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: So what are you doing today?
And I want to use that time to go shopping for our date tomorrow 😌
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 我想利用那段时间去为我们明天的约会购物 😌

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'll send you the outfits so you can tell me which one you like most ❤️
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 我会把服装发给你，这样你就可以告诉我你最喜欢哪一件 ❤️

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You in different outfits sounds dangerous already
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 你穿不同的服装听起来就很危险。

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Then I'll make sure to send you the hardest choices
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 那么我会确保给你发送最艰难的选择。

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I need to thank you again for last night
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 我需要再次感谢你昨晚的帮助。

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: And for spoiling me that much
You spoil me too, you know
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 你也太宠我了，你知道吗

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: That's exactly how it should be

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_.source: Still sore in a few places
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_.translation: 有几个地方还是酸酸的。

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_.source: Try not to complain too much

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_.translation: 你说这话真是太好笑了。
老实说，拉伸听起来不错。

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_.source: But I might get the cast off soon
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_.translation: 但我可能很快就能把石膏拿掉。

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_.source: After that I'll be able to move properly again
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_.translation: 之后我就能正常活动了。

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_.source: Unlike you, I can get ready without turning it into a medical operation
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_.translation: 不像你，我可以不把准备过程搞得像医疗手术。

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_.source: It's not exactly easy to put on with the cast
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_.translation: 带着石膏穿上去可不容易。

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_.source: So the cast is now losing against clothes too

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: We are in a very fancy restaurant
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: 我们在一家非常高档的餐厅

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: He is paying for everything, and he is being incredibly kind
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: 他为一切买单，而且非常友好

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: I am honestly having a wonderful time
I'm really glad to hear that
Dinner felt special. You were kind, elegant, and exactly who I wanted there.
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: 晚餐感觉特别。你很善良，优雅，正是我想要的人。
卢卡斯晚餐内容已解锁。

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: But honestly I'm mostly relieved that it's over
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 但说实话，我主要是松了一口气，终于结束了

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: For once I actually feel proud of myself 😊
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 我竟然有点为自己感到骄傲😊

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: All those hours of studying finally paid off 😌
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 那些学习的小时终于有回报了😌

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Even if I complained the whole time
No signs of hesitation detected during the exchange
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 在这个交换中没有检测到犹豫的迹象

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: A kiss makes this feel different from helping her study, and I'm not as detached as I sound.
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 一个吻让这件事和帮她学习完全不同，而我没有语气里表现得那么淡然。

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: HAK archived visual evidence of {{name:hailey}} rewarding Ethan with a kiss following a successful tutoring session
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: HAK存档了{{name:hailey}}在成功的辅导后给伊桑一个吻的视觉证据

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Wow you're really sending me that ??
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 哇，你真的要发给我这个？？

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Well it's a reward for you too 😌
You don't let any opportunity slip by!
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 你可真不放过任何机会！

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Now I just have to wait for the results 😩
We talked about the exam for a while
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 我们聊了很久关于考试的事

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: But maybe it won't be that bad, if I fail at least I will get punished 😌
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 但也许不会那么糟，如果我失败了，至少会被惩罚😌

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: It's supposed to be a bad thing!
DAY 15 — After examining your leg, the doctor removed your cast. You can move more freely now, but your leg still needs rest.
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 第15天 — 医生检查了你的腿后，拆掉了石膏。现在你可以更自如地活动了，但你的腿仍然需要休息。

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Ethan thinks I did better than I think I did
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Ethan觉得我考得比我自己想的要好

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I'm still overthinking a few questions
Everyone does that after an exam
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 每个人考试后都会这样

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Now I need to calm down again before bed 😭
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 现在我需要在睡觉前再冷静一下 😭

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Should I make it worse before bed? 😏
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我该在睡觉前把事情搞得更糟吗？😏

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You really want to kill me
But keeping you awake… I'm guilty 😌
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 但让你保持清醒… 我有罪 😌

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: DAY 15 — After examining your leg, the doctor removed your cast. You can move more freely now, but your leg still needs rest.
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 第15天 — 医生检查了你的腿后，拆掉了石膏。现在你可以更自如地活动了，但你的腿仍然需要休息。

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The doctor removed the cast today
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 医生今天把石膏拆掉了

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay I need a shower now
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 好的，我现在需要洗个澡。
我可以之后得到一些东西吗？

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Do you want me to send it to someone else instead?
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你想让我把它发给其他人吗？

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Trying to understand what you like
And I want to see how you react
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我想看看你会有什么反应

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: If I was going to do something like that…
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 如果我要做这样的事情……

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Who would you want it to be with?
Like… who would you want me to send it to?
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 那…你希望我把它发给谁？

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Probably someone I don't really know
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 可能是我不太认识的人

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I think the idea of a stranger makes it intense
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我觉得陌生人的想法让它变得紧张。

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And maybe safer, for the private part
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 也许更安全，针对私密部分

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: But you're not afraid he'll try to steal me?
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 但你不怕他会试图抢走我吗？

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: then, why not, if we find the right person
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 那么，如果我们找到合适的人，为什么不呢？

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I kinda… already thought about it…
Too many classes, too many people 😭
And we don't even know if he would agree
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 而我们甚至不知道他是否会同意

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We both know he's a real charmer
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我们都知道他真是个魅力四射的人。

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And he always looks at you like that
I see him, he doesn't hide it
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我看到了他，他并不掩饰。

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A little… but more like jealous… and excited
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 有点……但更像是嫉妒……和兴奋

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And proud that my girlfriend is that beautiful
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 并为我的女朋友如此美丽而感到自豪

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Wow… that's really sweet… and hot
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 哇… 这真的很甜… 也很热

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We did say we would explore this
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我们确实说过我们会探索这个

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Why not with someone I trust?
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 为什么不和我信任的人一起呢？

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: But you're not afraid he'll try to steal me?
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 但你不怕他会试图抢走我吗？

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: So, you didn't drown?
You sent me to a pool in that swimsuit with your best friend knowing I can barely swim
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: 你让我穿着泳衣去游泳池，还带着你最好的朋友，明知道我几乎不会游泳

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: You're about as innocent as a serial killer holding the knife
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: 你就像拿着刀的连环杀手一样无辜。

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: And {{name:aiden}} have the best tan of the year, unlike me
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: 而且 {{name:aiden}} 的肤色是今年最好的，跟我比起来真是太好了

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: I'm as white as a ghost compared to him
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: 跟他比，我简直像个鬼一样白

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: That's for sure
I'm sure you had a good time at the pool anyway
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: 我相信你在泳池里玩得很开心。

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: I found your old swimsuit by the way
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: 顺便说一下，我找到了你以前的泳衣。

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Captures conversations happening elsewhere by monitoring persons of interest
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: 通过监控感兴趣的人捕捉其他地方的对话

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: If I feel like drawing a bit of attention
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: 如果我想引起一点注意的话

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Don’t get used to being right
I’ve been thinking about last night
I keep wondering what you actually thought when you received it
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: 我一直在想，你收到它的时候到底在想什么

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: I thought about it more than I should have
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: 我想那张照片的次数，比我该想的多得多
你在那张照片里很好看

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: That’s more honest than I expected
I tried the outfit you chose for me again this morning
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: 我今天早上又试了你为我选的那套衣服

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: I don’t know if that makes it better or worse
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: 我不知道这算是好事还是坏事

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: I keep telling myself it was just a stupid late-night decision
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: 我一直告诉自己这只是个愚蠢的深夜决定

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: But I didn’t exactly regret sending it either
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: 但我也没有真的后悔把它发给你

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: That’s the part that bothers me
And I still can’t decide if I should thank you or be slightly annoyed
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: 我还是不知道该感谢你还是有点烦

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Because it means I wanted you to see me like that
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: 因为这意味着我想让你看到那样的我

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: And I don’t usually do things like that without overthinking for days
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: 而我通常不会在没有反复思考几天的情况下做这样的事

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: That’s also part of the problem
You’re being very calm about something that still feels a bit dangerous to me
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: 你对我觉得有点危险的事表现得很冷静

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: It looks better than I expected
We’re living in the same house
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: 我们住在同一个屋檐下

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: If things start changing, they change fast
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: 如果事情开始变化，那变化会很快

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: And I’m not sure I’m ready for that yet
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: 我还不确定我准备好面对这一切

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: We don’t have to rush anything
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: 我们不需要急于做任何事

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Okay, I’m going to get ready before I keep talking myself into a corner
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: 好吧，我得准备一下，不然我会越说越糟

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Told you I had decent taste
Don’t sound so pleased with yourself

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Sufficient HAK points accumulated
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 已累积足够的HAK点数

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: New skill available: Live Transcription
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 新技能可用：实时转录

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Captures conversations happening elsewhere by monitoring persons of interest
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 通过监控感兴趣的人，捕捉其他地方的对话

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: HAK//SKILL AVAILABLE
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: HAK//技能可用

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: How does your leg feel this morning?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 你今天早上腿感觉怎么样？

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Strange without the cast
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 没有石膏感觉怪怪的

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I keep expecting to feel its weight when I move
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 我总是期待移动时能感觉到它的重量

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Is it hurting?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 疼吗？

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: A bit stiff. I'm taking it easy
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 有点僵硬。我会慢慢来

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Then we're doing the short walk today
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 那我们今天就走短一点的路

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: There's a bench near the entrance. We can stop there whenever you want
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 入口附近有个长椅。你想什么时候停都可以

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You already have a bench picked out?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 你已经选好长椅了吗？

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Yes. Very advanced date planning
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 是的。非常高级的约会计划

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I have dinner covered. You're handling benches
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 我负责晚餐，你负责长椅

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Our date today ☀️
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 今天我们的约会☀️

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: A balanced relationship 😌
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 一段平衡的关系😌

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Breakfast first, though. I'm not leaving on an empty stomach
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 不过先吃早餐。我可不想空着肚子出门

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Save some room for tonight
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 留点肚子给今晚哦

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: What are you making?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 你在做什么？

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Pasta, roasted vegetables, and dessert
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 意大利面、烤蔬菜和甜点

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You remembered dessert. Excellent start
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 你记得甜点。开个好头

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You'll have to wait to find out what it is
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 你得等着看看是什么

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Fine. I have something you're going to have to wait for too
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 好吧。我也有你得等的事情

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: The outfit?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 是衣服吗？

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Is it weird that I've already checked the weather three times?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 我已经查了三次天气，这样很奇怪吗？

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'm wearing the one you picked yesterday 🤍
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 我穿的是你昨天选的那件🤍

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: And yes, I bought your other choice too
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 对了，我也买了你另一个选择

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Now you're making it difficult to focus on the shopping list
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 现在你让我很难专注于购物清单

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Finish your shopping list. I want to be fed properly
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 快把购物清单完成。我想吃得好好的

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Meet me at the park entrance at three?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 三点在公园入口见？

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Three it is
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 三点就三点

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Text me when you leave. And don't rush to get there before me
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 你出发时发个信息给我。别急着比我先到

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I won't
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 我不会的

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: See you this afternoon, love ❤️
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 下午见，亲爱的❤️

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Depends. Are we expecting a hurricane?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 这要看情况。我们是要预期飓风吗？

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: No 😭
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 没有😭

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I just don't want our park date getting rained on
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 我只是不想我们的公园约会被淋雨

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: We'd find somewhere to hide
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 我们会找个地方躲起来

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You'd use that as an excuse to stand very close to me
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 你会用这个借口靠得我很近

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I was going to do that in good weather too
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 好天气我也会这样做

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Then I suppose the forecast doesn't matter ❤️
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 那我想天气预报也无所谓了❤️

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: I’ve been lying here replaying our conversation from earlier
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: 我一直躺在这里回放我们早些时候的对话

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: Especially the part where I admitted I wanted you to see that photo
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: 尤其是我承认想让你看那张照片的那段

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: I still can’t believe I said that out loud
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: 我还是不敢相信我居然说出口了

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: It was good to hear to be honest
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: 老实说，听到这个感觉很好

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: But once I started talking, it felt weird to stop
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: 但一旦我开始说，就觉得停不下来

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: Usually I joke my way out of anything that feels too real
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: 通常我会用玩笑来逃避任何感觉太真实的事情

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: This morning I didn’t really do that
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: 今天早上我其实没做什么

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: And you didn’t push me either
I didn’t want to make you uncomfortable
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: 我不想让你觉得不舒服

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: I was trying not to overdo it
I think you handled it better than I would have
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: 我觉得你处理得比我好
我可以问你一个问题吗？

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: And you have to answer honestly

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: 我发给你那张照片的时候…

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: Or were you just being polite?
You really didn’t have to say that
I’m going to try sleeping now
At least I’m not the only one
Before I ask something even more dangerous
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: 在我问更危险的问题之前

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: And… don’t overthink this too much either

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: At the park 🌿
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 在公园🌿

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Like this?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 这样吗？

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Now you have a photo from our actual park date
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 现在你有了一张我们真正公园约会的照片

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Better than the preview last Sunday
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 比上周日的预告好得多

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Much better. You're in this one with me
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 好多了。你和我在这张照片里

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: My shoulder barely counts
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 我的肩膀几乎不算数

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: It counts to me
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 对我来说算数

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: There. Now I want that shoulder back.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 好了。现在我想要那只肩膀。

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: You spend a while on the bench together. {{name:lena}} leans against you while you talk, then joins you for another short stretch of the path. Before leaving, you share an ice cream near the entrance.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 你们在长椅上待了一会儿。{{name:lena}}靠在你身上聊天，然后和你一起走另一段小路。在离开之前，你们在入口附近分享了一支冰淇淋。

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Ready to go back?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 准备回去了吗？

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I'm at the entrance
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 我在入口处

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Yeah. I think my leg has had enough walking for today.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 嗯。我觉得我的腿今天走得够多了。

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Then we're going straight to your place. You can rest before dinner.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 那我们就直接去你家。你可以在晚餐前休息一下。

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: And you can keep me company.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 而且你可以陪着我。

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: That was already part of the plan.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 这本来就是计划的一部分。

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: You leave the park together and head directly to your place. Once inside, {{name:lena}} leaves her bag by the sofa and helps you settle with your leg on a cushion.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 你们一起离开公园，直接去你家。一进门，{{name:lena}}把包放在沙发旁，帮你把腿放在垫子上。

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Better?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 好点了吗？

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Much. Glad we skipped the long loop.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 好多了。很高兴我们跳过了长路。

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I liked our bench. Especially before that dog tried to steal the next one.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 我喜欢我们的长椅。尤其是在那只狗试图抢下一个之前。

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: He knew exactly what he wanted.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 他知道自己想要什么。

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: So did I.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 我也是。

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: The little ice cream stand is open, by the way
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 顺便说一下，小冰淇淋摊开门了

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: {{name:lena}} sits beside you and rests her hand on yours.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: {{name:lena}}坐在你旁边，把手放在你的手上。

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: My favourite part was you refusing to let go of my hand to eat.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 我最喜欢的部分是你拒绝放开我的手去吃东西。

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I managed perfectly well.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 我处理得很好。

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: You got ice cream on my thumb.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 你把冰淇淋弄到我拇指上了。

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: A minor technical problem.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 一个小技术问题。

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: We've got some time before I need to start cooking.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 在我开始做饭之前，我们还有时间。

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Good. Stay here with me for a while.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 好。和我呆一会儿。

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I won't argue with that.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 我不想和这个争论。

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: You spend the rest of the afternoon together on the sofa. {{name:lena}} keeps the outfit you chose yesterday on, and you let your leg rest before moving to the kitchen.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 你们在沙发上度过了下午的剩余时间。{{name:lena}}穿着你昨天选的衣服，你让腿休息一下，然后再去厨房。

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: You found that before you found me?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 你在找到我之前就发现了那个？

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I'm gathering useful information
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 我在收集有用的信息

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Look to your left
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 看你左边

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Oh ❤️
{{name:lena}} puts her phone away and walks over to you. She kisses you, then slips her hand into yours. You take the short path through the park, stopping at a bench when your leg starts to tire.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: {{name:lena}}收起手机走向你。她吻了你一下，然后把手滑进你的手里。你们沿着公园的小路走，腿开始累的时候停在长椅上。

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: A LITTLE LATER
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 稍后

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Come closer. I want a photo of us on this bench.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 靠近点。我想拍一张我们在这张长椅上的照片。

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Early evening, at your place. After resting together, you head into the kitchen to prepare dinner.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 傍晚时分，在你家。一起休息后，你们走进厨房准备晚餐。

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Evidence that you actually cooked for me
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 你真的为我做了饭的证据

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And that you stole a piece before I served it
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 而且你在我上菜之前偷吃了一块

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Quality control
Verdict?
Very good. I'm keeping the cook
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 非常好。我决定留下这个厨师

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That's a relief
Now taste it before your food gets cold.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 现在赶紧尝尝，别让你的食物凉了。

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: After dinner, you bring dessert to the sofa. {{name:lena}} folds her legs beside you, carefully avoiding your sore leg. You put on a film, but keep pausing it to talk.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 晚餐后，你把甜点端到沙发上。{{name:lena}} 把腿蜷缩在你旁边，小心翼翼地避开你受伤的腿。你放了一部电影，但不停暂停聊天。

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: LATER THAT EVENING
What can I do?
Come here a second.
You lean closer and kiss her. {{name:lena}} draws you closer, smiling against your lips
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 你靠近她，吻了她。{{name:lena}} 拉你更近，微笑着贴在你的唇上

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Visual capture archived
HAK//NOTICE
A Kiss on the Sofa
A LITTLE LATER
One more for today
You look very pleased with yourself
I had a park date, dinner, dessert, and a very good seat on your sofa
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 我有一个公园约会，晚餐，甜点，还有一个很好的沙发座位

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Good seat?
You're my guest. You can sit there and judge my cooking.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 你是我的客人。你可以坐在那里评价我的厨艺。

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Right beside you
Though I think I've been leaning on your arm for twenty minutes
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 不过我觉得我已经靠在你手臂上二十分钟了

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Worth it
Tell me if your leg starts bothering you, okay?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 如果你的腿开始不舒服，告诉我，好吗？

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: It's fine like this
Then I'd like to stay a little longer
I'd like that too
You leave your phones on the table and settle back together. The rest of the evening passes in conversation and kisses. When {{name:lena}} eventually leaves, you walk her to the door.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 你把手机放在桌子上，靠在一起。接下来的晚上在聊天和亲吻中度过。当{{name:lena}} 最终离开时，你送她到门口。

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: LATER
Home ❤️
Your guest can chop a vegetable. Give me a board.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 你的客人可以切菜。给我一个砧板。

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Thanks for letting me know
I left my bag beside your sofa
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 我把包落在你沙发旁边了

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I found it
Good. An extremely convincing reason to come back
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 很好。这是一个非常有说服力的理由让我回来

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You don't need a reason
I know. I still want my bag 😌
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 我知道。我还是想要我的包包😌

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Did the dinner live up to the promise?
Yes
But the best part was being there with you
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 但最棒的部分是和你在一起

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And kissing you goodbye without wanting to go anywhere
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 还有和你吻别时不想去任何地方

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: All right. The vegetables are yours.
I nearly asked you to stay
I nearly went back inside
Next time, ask me 🤍
I will
Now get some rest. You've done more today than you have in a while
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 现在去休息吧。你今天做的比最近好多了

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Already in bed
Goodnight, love. Thank you for today ❤️
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 晚安，亲爱的。谢谢你今天❤️

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Goodnight. I loved having you here
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 晚安。我很喜欢你在这里

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And you can sit down while I do them.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 你可以坐下，我来处理这些。

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You're taking over my kitchen already.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 你已经接管我的厨房了。

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Only the chopping. You promised me dinner, so the sauce is still your problem.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 只是切菜。你答应我做晚餐，所以酱汁还是你的事。

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: {{name:lena}} washes and chops the vegetables while you prepare the sauce. You take a seat between tasks, and she brings the plates to the table once dinner is ready.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: {{name:lena}} 洗菜切菜，而你准备酱汁。你在忙碌中找个地方坐下，她准备好晚餐后把盘子端到桌上。

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: DINNER

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Captures conversations happening elsewhere by monitoring persons of interest
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 通过监控感兴趣的人捕捉其他地方的对话

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I don’t want more of this stress on top of everything else
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 我不想在其他压力之上再增加这个压力

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: And I’m already happy with the diploma I have
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 我对现在的文凭已经很满意了

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I don’t need to keep stacking pressure just because I can
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 我不需要因为我能做到而不断给自己施压

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Did you talk about it with your professor?
I’ll tell him this afternoon when I drop the book off
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 我下午去还书的时候会告诉他

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: It feels like the right moment to say it

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 好的… 记得告诉我进展

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Alright. Text me when you leave
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 好的。出门时给我发个信息

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I need to tell you something
I’ve been thinking about it for a few days already
I’m not taking the next exams
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 我不打算参加下次的考试

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I thought about it properly this time

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good morning ❤️ How's your first morning without the cast?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 早安❤️ 你没有石膏的第一早晨怎么样？

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Then no celebrating by trying to walk across the whole city today
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 那今天就别庆祝了，别试着走遍整个城市

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: There goes my afternoon
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我的下午就泡汤了

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I know you're joking but I'm watching you 😌
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我知道你在开玩笑，但我在盯着你😌

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Through the walls?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 透过墙壁吗？

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You usually tell on yourself eventually
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 你通常会自己暴露的

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You'll say you went for a little walk and then mention a shop three streets away
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 你会说你去散步了，然后提到三条街外的商店

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's a very specific accusation
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 这是个很具体的指控

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's me knowing my boyfriend ❤️
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 这就是我了解我的男朋友❤️

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: For the record, my big adventure so far was getting to the kitchen
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 顺便说一下，到目前为止我最大的冒险就是到厨房

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Did you make it back alive?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 你活着回来了吧？

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I still lifted the blanket like I had that massive cast under it
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我还是像有那块大石膏一样把被子掀起来了

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Barely, the coffee was terrible
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 勉强算是，咖啡太难喝了

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Your coffee always tastes like you hold a grudge against the beans
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 你的咖啡总是像是对咖啡豆有怨恨一样

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It wakes me up
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 它让我清醒

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: So would a fire alarm, you don't drink those
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 火警警报也能让你清醒，但你可不喝那些

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You're very talkative for someone who hasn't left bed
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 你这个还没离开床的人真健谈

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Excuse you, I'm dressed
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 抱歉，我可是穿好了的

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I've even packed my bag and found both shoes
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我甚至把包都收好了，还找到了两只鞋

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Both? Big morning for us
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 两只？对我们来说是个大早晨

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Don't ruin my achievements 😭
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 别毁了我的成就😭

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Did you have breakfast too or was finding the shoes enough?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 你也吃早餐了吗，还是找鞋子就够了？

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Your brain hasn't caught up yet 😭
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 你的脑子还没反应过来呢😭

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Toast and a banana
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 吐司和一根香蕉

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: The toast was slightly more toasted than planned
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 吐司比计划的稍微烤得过头了

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Burnt
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 烧焦了

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Crispy 😌
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 脆脆的😌

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Was that before or after you insulted my coffee?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 那是在你侮辱我的咖啡之前还是之后？

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I can do two things badly at once, thank you
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我可以同时做两件事做得很糟，谢谢你

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Now that sounds like the girl I know
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 这听起来像我认识的那个女孩

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: The girl you know is also checking that you're actually going to take breaks today
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 你认识的那个女孩也在确认你今天真的会休息一下

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I am
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我是

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: A bit of walking around at home, then the exercises they showed me yesterday
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 在家走动一下，然后做他们昨天教我的练习

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Apparently it was expecting the cast to stay forever
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 显然它还以为石膏会永远留着

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: No heroic expedition
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 没有什么英雄的探险

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good ❤️ I'd rather wait a little longer than see you hurt yourself again
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 好的❤️ 我宁愿多等一会儿，也不想再看到你受伤

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I know
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我知道

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It's just nice not feeling stuck in the same place anymore
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 不再感到被困在同一个地方真好

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I bet
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我敢打赌

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: When you're more comfortable, we can go somewhere without you having to plan every single step
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 等你更舒服的时候，我们可以去个地方，不用你每一步都计划好

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Somewhere with decent coffee?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 去个有好咖啡的地方？

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And chairs, I'm not taking you hiking 😭
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 还有椅子，我可不想带你去爬山😭

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You really know how to spoil me
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 你真会宠我

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I was thinking coffee and a pastry, but keep talking and you can have water
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我本来想喝咖啡和吃点心，但继续说下去你就只能喝水了

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Don't say that, I was starting to believe it too
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 别这么说，我也开始相信了

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll behave
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我会乖乖的

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: There we go 😌
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 好了😌

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: What's your day looking like?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 你今天的安排怎么样？

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Classes this morning, then work
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 今天早上上课，然后去工作

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I need to finish checking a spreadsheet this afternoon before anyone else uses it tomorrow
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我今天下午得把一个表格检查完，明天其他人才能用

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That sounds dangerously responsible
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 听起来太负责任了，有点危险

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm trying not to think about it like that
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我尽量不这样想

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm mostly looking forward to not carrying my university notes around with my work stuff
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我最期待的就是不再把大学笔记和工作东西一起带着

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Not much longer now
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 再不久了

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I know ❤️ I'm counting down
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我知道❤️ 我在倒计时

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Did you sleep better without it?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 没有它你睡得更好吗？

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Wait, before I leave
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 等一下，在我离开之前

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I actually managed to get dressed without creasing everything this time
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 这次我居然能穿衣服而不把它们弄皱

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Enjoy it while it lasts, my bag will probably destroy that shirt in ten minutes 😭
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 趁着现在享受吧，我的包可能十分钟就能把那件衬衫毁掉😭

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You look beautiful
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 你看起来真美

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You answered suspiciously fast
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 你回答得可真快，令人怀疑

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Didn't need much thinking
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 没怎么想

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Okay, that was a good answer ❤️
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 好吧，那是个不错的回答❤️

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Do I get the pastry back?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我能拿回那个点心吗？

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You were never losing the pastry
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 你根本就不会失去那个点心

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Much better, until I got up
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 好多了，直到我起床

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I was just going to make you ask nicely
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我只是想让你乖乖地请求

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Cruel woman
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 残忍的女人

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Your cruel woman has to leave now or she'll miss her bus 😌
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 你那个狠心的女人现在得走了，不然她会错过公交车😌

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Tell me how you're getting on when I text you at lunch
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我午餐时发信息给你时告诉我你进展如何

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I will, good luck with the morning
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我会的，祝你早上顺利

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Thank you handsome ❤️ Love you

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我可以聊聊一些超级无关紧要的事

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Please do 😭 How did your big trip around the house go?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 请聊聊😭 你在家里的大冒险怎么样？

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Very reassuring
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 真让人放心

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I discovered the sofa was still where I left it
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我发现沙发还是我放的地方

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A successful expedition then
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 那算是一场成功的探险

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And I stopped when my leg started getting tired
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 当我腿开始累的时候我就停了

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Look at you actually listening to me ❤️
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 看看你居然在听我说话❤️

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Don't sound so surprised
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 别这么惊讶

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm enjoying the moment, let me have it 😌
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我在享受这个时刻，让我好好享受一下😌

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Do you feel like watching something together later?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 你想晚点一起看点什么吗？

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Together as in us arguing about the same film from different houses?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 一起是指我们在不同的房子里争论同一部电影吗？

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Exactly that
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 就是这个

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I found a detective film that looks terrible and I don't want to suffer alone
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我找到了一部看起来很糟糕的侦探片，我可不想一个人受苦

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I spent ten minutes thinking I was the problem 😭
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我花了十分钟以为是我有问题😭

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You make such a convincing offer
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 你的提议真让人信服

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Say yes, I've already saved it
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 快答应吧，我已经保存好了

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes, we'll watch it when you're ready
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 好的，等你准备好了我们就看

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Good ❤️ My bus is finally here
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 太好了❤️ 我的公交终于来了

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'll text you when I get home, then I'll sort out dinner
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我到家后会发信息给你，然后准备晚餐

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Talk to you in a bit
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 稍后聊

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Did you manage to get something to eat before work?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 你在上班前吃到东西了吗？

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A sandwich from the place near the bus stop
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 在公交车站附近的地方买了个三明治

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It cost enough that I checked the bag for a second sandwich
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 花了不少钱，我还检查了包里有没有第二个三明治

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I've made it through two rooms and put a proper shoe on
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我已经走过两个房间，穿上了一只合适的鞋子

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Was there one?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 有吗？

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: No, just a napkin and disappointment
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 没有，只有一张餐巾纸和失望

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: At least I've found somewhere to sit for a minute
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 至少我找到了一个地方坐一下

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You don't look that disappointed
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 你看起来并没有那么失望

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I hadn't opened the sandwich yet 😭
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我还没打开三明治呢😭

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'll let you enjoy your very expensive lunch
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我让你享受你那顿非常贵的午餐

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You'd better eat something too
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 你最好也吃点东西

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Already did
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 已经吃过了

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Good, one less person to supervise 😌
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 好，一个人少了要监督😌

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Look at you, moving up in the world 😭
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 看看你，真是步步高升😭

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You supervising people at work now?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 你现在在工作中监督别人吗？

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Mostly a spreadsheet that refuses to add up
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 主要是一个不愿意加总的电子表格

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: My manager wants to go through it with me when I get in
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我的经理想在我到的时候和我一起看这个
