story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: At least you won't be stuck doing it on your own
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 至少你不会一个人被困在这上面

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Exactly, and then it can stop taking up space in my head
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 没错，然后它就可以不再占据我脑海里的空间

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I need to go, I'll text you when I'm out ❤️
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我得走了，等我出来再给你发信息❤️

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Have a good afternoon
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 祝你下午愉快

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Later that afternoon, in the manager's office...
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 那天下午，在经理的办公室……

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Office conversation detected near {{name:lena}}
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 在{{name:lena}}附近检测到办公室对话

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A spreadsheet, that's what she said. I want this to be an ordinary afternoon at work, but I can't stop watching the screen.
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 她说的是一张表格。我希望这只是普通的工作午后，可我无法把目光从屏幕上移开。

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//LIVE TRANSCRIPTION
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//实时转录

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Is that the version you sent me this morning?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 那是你今天早上发给我的版本吗？

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Putting the shoe on was the hard part
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 穿鞋子是最难的部分

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It should be
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 应该是的

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Because this total is different
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 因为这个总数不同

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Wait, don't tell me I've printed the old one
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 等一下，别告诉我我打印的是旧的

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You tell me
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 你告诉我

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I changed it before class. Check the file on your screen
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我在上课前改过。检查一下你屏幕上的文件

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: This one?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 这个吗？

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes, look at the bottom. The figure's right there
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 是的，看看底部。数字就在那儿

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: So the spreadsheet is right and the printout isn't
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 所以电子表格是对的，打印出来的却不对

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Exactly. Which means I've spent my lunch worrying about a problem I already fixed
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 没错。这意味着我午餐时担心了一个我已经解决的问题

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And I've been writing notes on the wrong copy
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 而且我一直在错误的副本上写笔记

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Did you try doing it standing up?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 你试过站着做吗？

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Well, yours is going straight in the bin with mine
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 好吧，你的也要和我的一起扔掉

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You could have checked before printing it
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 你本可以在打印之前检查一下

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You could have checked before writing on every page
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 你本可以在每一页写之前检查一下

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Fair enough
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 说得对

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Good, I'm glad we've agreed this is a shared disaster
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 好吧，我很高兴我们达成一致，这真是个共同的灾难

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Come around here. Show me what you changed
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 过来这边。给我看看你改了什么

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: There, that line was included twice
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 那里，那行被重复了两次

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I missed that yesterday
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我昨天没注意到这一点

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know. You told me to check my calculation again
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我知道。你让我再检查一下我的计算

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And you did
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 而且你确实检查了

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Once
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 一次

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Three times, because I thought you must know something I didn't
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 检查了三次，因为我以为你一定知道我不知道的事情

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You should have told me
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 你应该告诉我

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I just did
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我刚刚说了

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A little sooner would have saved you some time
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 早一点就能省下你的时间

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then next time I get to say 'I told you so' while you're still in the room
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 那下次我可以在你还在房间的时候说‘我早就告诉过你了’

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I think you've earned that
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我觉得你值得这样

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm going to remember you said that
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我会记得你这么说的

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Two subjects standing together beside the desk
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 两个主题站在桌子旁边

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Visual capture archived
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 视觉捕捉已归档

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: They're standing so close. I keep telling myself it's work, but seeing them together like that makes my stomach tighten.
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 他们站得那么近。我一直告诉自己这只是工作，可看到他们这样待在一起，我的胃还是揪紧了。

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//通知

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Too Close
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 太近了

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You seem more comfortable in here now
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 你现在在这里似乎更自在了

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I knew it
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我就知道

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: With the work? A little
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 工作上？有一点

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That wasn't exactly what I meant
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 那并不是我真正想说的

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then maybe you should be more specific
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 那你也许应该更具体一点

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: The first few days you stood by the door whenever you brought something in
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 前几天你每次带东西进来时都站在门旁

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Because you always looked busy
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 因为你总是看起来很忙

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And now?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 现在呢？

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Now I know half the time you're just looking at the same numbers I am
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 现在我知道你一半的时间只是看着和我一样的数字

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: So I'm less intimidating
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 所以我就没那么吓人了

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I didn't say you were intimidating
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我没说你吓人

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You just didn't want to come any closer
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 你只是想离得远一点

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I sat down before you could sense a disturbance
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 在你察觉到之前我就坐下了

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You know, you notice a lot for someone with so much work to do
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 你知道，对于一个有这么多工作要做的人来说，你注意到的很多

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Some things are hard not to notice
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 有些事情很难不注意到

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're doing it again
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 你又这样了

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Doing what?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 做什么？

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Looking at me instead of the screen
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 看着我而不是屏幕

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You've finished explaining the spreadsheet
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 你已经解释完电子表格了

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That isn't an answer
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 那不是答案

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It wasn't meant to be
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我不是这个意思

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You really don't make this easy
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 你真是让这事变得不简单

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Make what easy?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 让什么变简单？

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Too late, I felt it 😌
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 太晚了，我感觉到了😌

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Keeping a straight face when I'm supposed to be working
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 在我该工作的时候保持严肃

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A little later, after the paperwork is finished...
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 稍后一点，等文件处理完...

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Are we still on for tomorrow?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 明天的约定还算数吗？

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: The drink?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 喝的东西？

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes, the drink
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 对，就是喝的

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I said I'd come, didn't I?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我说过我会来的，对吧？

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You also said you might be tired after work
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 你还说过工作后可能会累

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I probably will be. I can still sit down somewhere that isn't this chair
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我可能会累。不过我可以找个地方坐，不用坐在这椅子上

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: There's a place a couple of streets over. Around seven?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 有个地方在几条街外。七点左右？

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Seven should be fine
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 七点应该没问题

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Seriously though, is it hurting or just awkward?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 说真的，是疼还是只是尴尬？

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: It was the smart thing to do
Even if it means more work
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 即使这意味着要多花点时间

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: He’s going to help me deeply this time
Thanks for checking on me earlier
I kind of have to take the exams after all
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 我还是得去参加考试呢

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: He made it pretty clear I won’t get the diploma otherwise
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 他很明确地说，不这样的话我拿不到文凭。

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Okay… but you said you maybe had a solution?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 好吧… 你说你可能有解决办法？

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I’m going to have to spend more time with him for the exams
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 我得多花点时间陪他复习考试了。
额外的时间，类似这种情况。

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: That’s good actually. I’m glad you changed your mind
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 那其实挺好的。我很高兴你改变了主意。

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ I'm home and attempting dinner before our very serious film night
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 嘿❤️ 我到家了，准备在我们严肃的电影之夜之前做晚餐

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We don't need to discuss him
He wasn't even in the second half
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 他甚至没有出现在下半场

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was working with the information available at the time 😭
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我当时是根据可用的信息来判断的😭

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You were very confident
I trusted the scarf too much
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我对那条围巾信任过头了

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A mistake any great detective could make
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 这是任何伟大侦探都会犯的错误

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Stop laughing, at least the film was as bad as I promised
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 别笑了，至少这部电影确实和我说的一样糟糕

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You did deliver on that
It was nicer watching it with you, though
Even with my commentary?
Future You always finds something to complain about
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 未来的你总能找到抱怨的理由

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Especially with your commentary ❤️
I missed this, just talking about something silly with you
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我想念这种感觉，和你聊些傻事

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Me too
We should do it again, but you pick the next one
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我们应该再来一次，但这次你来选

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can't blame me for your detective career ending tonight
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你不能怪我让你的侦探生涯今晚结束

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm retiring undefeated, thank you 😌
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我将以不败之姿退役，谢谢你😌

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's not what happened
That's the story I'm sticking to
I'm going to bed before you talk me into watching a better one
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我得去睡觉了，免得你说服我看更好的电影

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Sleep well
Only when Present Me leaves her washing up 😌
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 只有现在的我不洗碗的时候😌

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You too handsome ❤️ I'm glad today was a little easier for your leg
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你也是，帅哥❤️ 我很高兴今天你的腿好了一点

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Me too
Love you
Love you too ❤️
Good night ❤️
Good night
How much have you created so far?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你到现在为止做了多少？

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: One pan, one bowl, one spoon
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 一个锅，一个碗，一个勺子

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And a second spoon because I put the first one somewhere stupid
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 还有第二个勺子，因为我把第一个放在了一个傻乎乎的地方

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Impressive efficiency
You'll be laughing less when you see my masterpiece
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 当你看到我的杰作时，你就不会笑了

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There, actual food and not a fire in sight
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 看，是真正的食物，没有火灾

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That looks good
Attempting doesn't sound promising
It tastes good too, I'm almost suspicious 😭
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 味道也不错，我快怀疑自己了😭

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What did the second spoon contribute?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 第二个勺子有什么贡献？

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Moral support
I'll remember that next time I'm cooking
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 下次我做饭时会记得的

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Have you eaten properly tonight?
Yeah, I've eaten and I'm settled on the sofa
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 嗯，我吃过了，正坐在沙发上

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good ❤️ I'll catch up once I've put the rest away
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 好❤️ 我把剩下的收拾好后就来找你

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Meal prep now? You really have changed
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 现在开始准备饭？你真变了

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don't get used to it, I'm only doing this because I'm going out tomorrow
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 别习惯了，我只是因为明天要出门才这样做的

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Oh, I meant to tell you about that
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 哦，我本来想告诉你这件事的

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I nearly put the empty pan on and left the pasta in the cupboard
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我差点把空锅放上去，结果把意大利面留在了橱柜里

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: With the coworker you mentioned the other night?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 就是你前几天提到的那个同事吗？

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah
My manager, actually
Your manager?
Yeah, we talked about it again today
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 是的，我们今天又聊了这个

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You said coworker before
I did
I should've been clearer about who I meant
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我应该更清楚我指的是谁

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Is anybody else going?
No, just us
So we're having a strong start 😭
Right
It's just a drink after work
Where?
There's a bar a couple of streets from the office
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 离办公室几条街有一家酒吧。

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Around seven, so I'll go straight from work
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 大概七点，我会直接从工作地点过去。

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And you want to go?
Yeah, I do
I've spent most of the week going from class to work to home
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 这周大部分时间都在上课、工作和回家之间忙碌。

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd like to do something that isn't one of those three things
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我想做点不属于这三件事的事情。

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I get wanting to go out
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我理解你想出去的心情。

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Maybe start with the water
Going out alone with your manager is a bit different from what I pictured
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 和你的经理单独出去跟我想象的有点不一样。

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know how it sounds
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我知道这听起来怎么样。

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Especially after what you said about him looking at you differently
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 尤其是在你说他用不同的眼光看你之后。

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I probably shouldn't have made such a thing of that
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我可能不该把这件事说得那么严重。

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You told me because it bothered you
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你告诉我是因为这让你感到困扰。

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It surprised me
But I don't feel uncomfortable around him
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 但我和他在一起并不觉得不舒服。

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Does he know you're with someone?
Yes, he knows
I don't want to turn this into an argument
I have water, I'm not completely lost
Me neither
I just don't want to find out I've only been hearing half the story
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我只是不想发现我听到的只是故事的一半。

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know
That's why I'm telling you where we're going and who it's with
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 所以我才告诉你我们要去哪里，和谁一起。

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay
I'll text you when I get there
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我到那儿会发信息给你。

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And when you're home?
Of course
All right
I do want to spend time with you too, you know
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我也想和你一起度过时间，你知道的。

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What's for dinner?
I know. I miss seeing you instead of just waiting for messages
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我知道。我想念见到你，而不是只等信息。

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I miss you too ❤️
Let me check when I finish over the next few days and we'll work something out
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 让我看看接下来几天我什么时候结束工作，我们再安排一下。

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd like that
Me too
And I don't want our whole evening to disappear while I'm standing next to a pan
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我也不想在锅旁边的时候，整个晚上都消失了。

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm going to change and get comfortable, then I'm yours for this awful film
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我去换衣服，放松一下，然后就陪你看这部糟糕的电影。

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll get it ready
A little later...
Okay, I've put the leftovers away and changed
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 好的，我把剩菜收起来了，也换了衣服。

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Pasta, tomato sauce and whatever cheese survived the week
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 意大利面，番茄酱，还有这周剩下的任何奶酪

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No work clothes, no dishes in front of me, no numbers
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 没有工作服，没有碗碟在我面前，也没有数字。

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did you find the first spoon?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你找到第一把勺子了吗？

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It was in the bowl the entire time
Of course it was
I'm trusting you with that information, be kind 😭
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我把这个信息交给你了，要好一点哦😭

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I've even claimed the good end of the sofa
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我甚至占据了沙发的好位置

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's where I'd want to be right now
There'd be room for you
You've taken up half the sofa with that blanket
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你用那条毯子占据了沙发的一半

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A classic
I'd share the blanket, not the good cushion 😌
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我可以分享毯子，但不分享好垫子😌

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A generous offer
You'd take it
Yeah, I would
Soon ❤️
Are you at the beginning of the film?
Paused at the first frame
Okay, three, two, one... play
After the film...
So, about the man with the red scarf
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 那么，关于那个戴红围巾的男人

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm making enough for tomorrow too, so Future Me can't complain
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我还做了明天的份，这样未来的我就不能抱怨了

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Captures conversations happening elsewhere by monitoring persons of interest
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 通过监控感兴趣的人捕捉其他地方的对话

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I'm still stressed enough without your commentary
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 我已经够紧张了，不需要你的评论

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Yesterday you were sending me certain pictures
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 昨天你还给我发了一些特别的照片

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: And today you're waiting for grades like a responsible student
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 今天你却像个负责任的学生在等成绩

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I'll text you when I get the results
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 我拿到结果后会给你发消息的

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I should get my grades today
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 今天我应该能拿到成绩

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Having a private tutor who knows people has its advantages 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 有个认识人的私人家教真是有优势 😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: But not as much as before

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Hey 😊 First morning without the cast, how does it feel?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 嘿 😊 第一个没有石膏的早晨，感觉怎么样？

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And I walked straight into it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 而且我直接撞上去了

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Thank you for making this possible
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 谢谢你让这一切成为可能

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You're welcome, unfortunately 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 不客气，不过很遗憾 😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: But seriously, are you comfortable?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 不过说真的，你舒服吗？

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Mostly. It still feels stiff when I get up
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 大部分时间还好。起床时还是有点僵硬

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Not exactly ready to sprint down the street
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 还没准备好在街上飞奔

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good, because I wasn't going to chase you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 那就好，因为我可不打算追你

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Not even a little?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 一点都没有吗？

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'd walk after you with a very disappointed expression
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我会跟在你后面，脸上满是失望的表情。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Wait, this is the face you'd be getting
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 等等，这就是你会看到的表情。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Strange actually
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 其实有点奇怪

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Terrifying
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 太可怕了

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It works on you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 对你有效哦

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It really does
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 确实很糟。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm just happy it's finally off ❤️
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我只是开心它终于脱掉了❤️

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: When I saw your message yesterday, I wanted to come over and hug you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 看到你昨天的信息时，我真想过来抱抱你。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That offer still available?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 那个提议还有效吗？

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Obviously
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 显然

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Although I also want an afternoon with you where neither of us spends half of it asking about your leg
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 不过我也想和你一起度过一个下午，不用花一半时间问你腿的事。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: We could find a small café somewhere, when I'm up to it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 等我有空了，我们可以找个小咖啡馆。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I woke up and moved the blanket like I still had to make room for it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我醒来时还像要给它腾地方一样动了动被子

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'd like that
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我喜欢这个！

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I miss sitting across from you and stealing something off your plate
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我想念坐在你对面，偷偷拿你盘子里的东西。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Beautiful. That's what you miss about me
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 美丽。这就是你想念我的地方。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Among other things
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 还有其他的事

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: But mostly your terrible habit of ordering something nicer than mine
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 但主要是你总是点比我好吃的东西。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You always say you're not hungry
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 你总是说你不饿。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm not hungry until your food arrives
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 直到你的食物上来之前我都不饿。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Completely different situation 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 完全是不同的情况😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Speaking of food, have you had breakfast?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 说到食物，你吃早餐了吗？

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Coffee
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 咖啡

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You got attached to it 😭
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 你对它有感情了 😭

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's a drink
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 那是一杯饮料

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Look who's suddenly responsible
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 看看谁突然变得负责任了

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I learned from a very strict woman
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我从一个非常严格的女人那里学到了

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: She sounds lovely
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 她听起来很可爱

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Annoying. Very pretty though
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 烦人。不过确实很漂亮

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That saved you ❤️
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 那救了你 ❤️

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Wait, I'll prove I'm eating
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 等一下，我会证明我在吃东西

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: 2 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 2分钟后

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Toast, coffee, and a woman who is definitely going to be late if she keeps texting you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 吐司、咖啡，还有一个如果继续发信息肯定会迟到的女人

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: We spent a lot of time together
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我们一起度过了很多时间

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You look lovely
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 你看起来很美

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You were supposed to notice the toast
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 你应该注意到吐司的

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I noticed both
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我两个都注意到了

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll allow it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我允许这样

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Classes all day?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 一整天都有课吗？

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: This morning, then some work with my group after lunch
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 今天早上，然后午饭后和我的小组一起工作

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: We spent twenty minutes yesterday deciding who was supposed to send a document everyone already had
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我们昨天花了二十分钟决定谁应该发送大家已经有的文件

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Promising start
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 开个好头

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Exactly. I'm bringing snacks and lowering my expectations
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 没错。我带了零食，还降低了我的期望

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Sounds like you're the only one prepared
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 听起来你是唯一一个准备好的人

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Should I be jealous?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我应该吃醋吗？

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Emotionally, absolutely not
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 情感上，绝对不是

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And I haven't forgotten what we talked about last night
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我还没忘记我们昨晚谈的事情

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I want to think about the first step properly, not while I'm trying to find my other shoe
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我想好好想想第一步，而不是在找另一只鞋的时候。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'd hate to compete with the shoe
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我可不想和鞋子竞争。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It's currently winning
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 现在鞋子赢了。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: 2 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 2分钟后

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Found it. Both shoes are on, so now I have no excuse
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 找到了。两只鞋都穿上了，现在我没有借口了。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: One last picture before I leave, since you can't be here to distract me in person
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 在我离开之前再拍一张照片，因为你不能在这里分散我的注意力。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You're making it very hard to encourage you to leave
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 你让我很难鼓励你离开。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It was a very supportive relationship
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 那是一段很有支持性的关系

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You're supposed to wish me luck, not make me miss you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 你应该祝我好运，而不是让我想你。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I can do both
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我可以两者兼顾。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I know you can ❤️
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我知道你可以的❤️

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Text me when you have a quiet moment
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 有安静的时刻记得发信息给我哦。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I will ❤️
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我会的❤️

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And keep some room in your schedule for that hug
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 记得留点时间给我那个拥抱哦。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll cancel my appointment with the sofa
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我会取消和沙发的约会。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Tell it I'm sorry 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 告诉它我很抱歉😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Oh my god
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 天哪

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You've been saving that one since yesterday, haven't you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 你从昨天就开始准备这个了，对吧

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Since the doctor took it off
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 自从医生把它拿掉之后

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 我的小学生居然真的学习了

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You also got some very interesting rewards along the way
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 你在这个过程中也得到了很有趣的奖励

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I passed the most important exam
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 我通过了最重要的考试

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: So technically I don't really need to keep studying that hard
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 所以从技术上讲，我不需要再那么努力学习了

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You should still pass the remaining exams to be safe. Keeping Ethan a bit longer is a win-win.
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 你还是应该通过剩下的考试以防万一。多留一段时间给Ethan也是双赢。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You worked hard enough. Maybe it's time to do something other than books for a while.
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 你已经努力得够多了，也许是时候做点书本以外的事情了。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Is it really about the exams...
Or is it you who wants me to keep seeing Ethan? 😌
I'm just thinking about your diploma
I can be a good person sometimes
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 我有时候也能做个好人

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: But when I am, I'm right
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 但当我做的时候，我是对的

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I'll keep Ethan for the next exams
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 我会把伊桑留到下次考试

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You are the one who will be happy
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 你会是最开心的那一个
除了书本还有别的事吗？

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You've been stuck studying for weeks
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 你已经被书本困住好几周了

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Moving a bit wouldn't kill you
Especially if you want to keep your body in shape for the summer
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 尤其是想保持身材迎接夏天的时候

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Be careful, I may be small but I can still kick your ass 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 小心点，我虽然小，但我还是能揍你哦 😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I do feel like I need to move again
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 我确实觉得该动一动了

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Hey, I finally have time to eat without someone asking me about our group project 😮‍💨
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 嘿，我终于有时间吃东西了，不用有人问我关于我们小组项目的事了😮‍💨

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It certainly had more information available
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 它确实提供了更多信息

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Harsh
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 太苛刻了

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Accurate 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 准确😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: But it did help me work out something
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 但确实帮我理清了一些事情

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I want to be able to talk to someone normally first
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我想先能正常地和人聊天

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I don't want to pick a person just because we're excited about trying something new
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我不想仅仅因为我们对尝试新事物感到兴奋就选择一个人

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I don't want you doing that either
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我也不想让你那样做

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And I want him to know I'm in a relationship
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我希望他知道我在谈恋爱

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I don't want to get halfway through a conversation and feel like I've hidden the important part
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我不想在谈话中途感到我隐瞒了重要的部分

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Agreed
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 同意

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm not sure how to write that without making my profile sound like a very serious announcement
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我不知道怎么写才能不让我的个人资料听起来像个严肃的公告

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Start with hello. Probably leave out a formal introduction from your boyfriend
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 先打个招呼吧。可能不需要你男朋友的正式介绍

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You mean you haven't prepared one?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 你是说你还没准备好一个？

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I could include references
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我可以加上推荐人

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Absolutely not 😭
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 绝对不行😭

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'd like you to read what I write, though
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 不过我希望你能读我写的东西

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Not to choose someone for me. Just because this is new and I'd rather not feel alone doing it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 不是要为我选择一个人。只是因为这是新的，我不想一个人做这件事

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Of course
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 当然

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And when I said someone we don't know might be simpler, I didn't mean you have to trust the first person who answers
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 当我说不认识的人可能更简单时，我并不是说你必须信任第一个回应的人

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我知道

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You found somewhere sunny
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 你找到了一个阳光明媚的地方

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Less awkward around our friends doesn't automatically mean I'll feel comfortable with him
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 在我们朋友面前不那么尴尬并不意味着我会和他感到自在

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Exactly
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 没错

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: So tonight I'll write something and choose a normal photo
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 今晚我会写点东西，选一张普通的照片

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Tomorrow I can decide whether I'm happy to put it up and start a conversation
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 明天我可以决定是否愿意发上去并开始对话

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That sounds like an actual plan
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 听起来像个真正的计划

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A slightly nervous plan, but yes
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 有点紧张的计划，但没错

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's allowed
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 这没问题

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I also reserve the right to complain to you about terrible profiles
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我也保留向你抱怨糟糕资料的权利

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That part was never in doubt
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 这一点从来没有疑问

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes, and my lunch hasn't asked a single question about the presentation
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 是的，我的午餐没有问过关于演示的任何问题

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I thought the difficult part would be admitting I was curious
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我以为困难的部分是承认我很好奇

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Now I'm thinking about how to start a conversation without sounding completely unlike myself
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 现在我在想怎么开始对话而不让自己听起来完全不像自己

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You don't need to suddenly become some incredibly confident person
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 你不需要突然变得超级自信

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Good, because I still rehearse phone calls before ordering food
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 好，因为我点餐前还是会排练电话

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And then tell me to call instead
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 然后叫我直接打电话

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Because you love me 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 因为你爱我😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Unfortunately for my phone bill
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 可怜我的电话费

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I do want to try this
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我确实想试试这个

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I just want the first step to feel like something I chose, not something I rushed into because we had a good conversation
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我只想让第一步感觉像是我选择的，而不是因为我们聊得不错而匆忙做出的决定

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Excellent company
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 真是个好伴侣

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then we start there
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 那我们就从这里开始

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Okay ❤️
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 好的 ❤️

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I need to go back. They've found another reason to discuss the slides
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我得回去了。他们又找到了讨论幻灯片的理由

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Stay strong
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 保持坚强

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm taking the rest of my lunch with me. It's the only thing I trust right now
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我把剩下的午餐带走。这是我现在唯一信任的东西

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're invited next time. Provided you bring your own fries
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 下次你被邀请哦，前提是你要带上自己的薯条

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I've been thinking about yesterday
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我一直在想昨天的事

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Mostly about what I'd actually feel comfortable doing first
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 主要是关于我其实最想先做什么

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And did you get anywhere?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 那你有进展吗？

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yeah. A little further than just sitting there wondering what you would like
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 嗯，比起坐在那里想你想要什么，我有一点进展

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Did you escape?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 你逃出来了吗？

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You mentioning {{name:aiden}} has made very ordinary things feel less ordinary
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 你提到{{name:aiden}}让一些平常的事情变得不那么普通了

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: What things?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 什么事情？

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He asked if I had the notes from our last class
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 他问我有没有我们上次课的笔记

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Normally I would just send them
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 通常我会直接发给他

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Today I stared at the message for a stupid amount of time before remembering he was literally asking for class notes
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 今天我盯着那条信息看了很久，才想起来他其实是在问课件

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Please tell me you didn't send him a mysterious reply
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 请告诉我你没有给他发神秘的回复吧

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: No 😭
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 没有的😭

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Temporarily
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 暂时的。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He got the notes. Very exciting development
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 他收到了笔记，真是个激动人心的进展

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Slow down, you're getting ahead of yourself
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 慢点，你有点超前了

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Shut up
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 闭嘴

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: But that's the thing. He's already part of my normal life
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 但这就是问题所在。他已经是我日常生活的一部分了

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: If we talk about this and it feels strange afterward, I'll still see him around campus
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 如果我们谈论这个之后感觉奇怪，我在校园里还是会见到他的

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yeah. I hadn't really thought about the next ordinary lunch together
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 是啊。我还没真正考虑过下次一起吃普通午餐的事

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I have
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我有想过

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I don't think that means we shouldn't talk to him
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我觉得这并不意味着我们不应该跟他说话

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I just don't want to treat it like asking him to join us for a game
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我只是不想把这当成是邀请他一起玩游戏

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I understand
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我明白了

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I said I needed lunch and someone asked if we could discuss the slides while I ate
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我说我需要吃午饭，有人问我们能不能在我吃的时候讨论幻灯片。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: How would you want to bring it up?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 你想怎么提起这个？

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Alone, for a start
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 先单独聊聊

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'd rather have a slightly awkward conversation than try to explain something personal with my friends listening
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我宁愿有点尴尬的对话，也不想在朋友面前解释一些私事

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And probably offering advice nobody asked for
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 而且可能还会给出没人问的建议

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Exactly
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 确切地说

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Wait
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 等一下

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He's coming over. I'll text you when I get a moment
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 他要过来了。我有空的时候会发信息给你

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A MOMENT LATER
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 片刻之后

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Is anyone sitting here?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 这里有人坐吗？

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Depends. Are you here to steal my lunch?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 看情况。你是来偷我午餐的吗？

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Did you throw the slides at them?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 你把幻灯片扔给他们了吗？

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Someone joins the table
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 有人加入了桌子

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Conversation in progress
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 对话进行中

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//通知

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: An Unexpected Seat
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 意外的座位

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I was going to ask about the notes, but now that you've mentioned lunch...
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我本来想问笔记的事，但既然你提到午餐了……

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You got the notes. That's your gift for today
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 你得到了笔记。这是你今天的礼物

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Generous as always
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 一如既往的大方

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You okay? You looked miles away earlier
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 你还好吗？刚才看起来心不在焉的样子

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yeah. Just thinking about something
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 嗯，只是在想一些事情

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Something I can help with?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 有什么我可以帮忙的吗？

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Maybe. I'd rather talk about it when it's quieter
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 也许吧。我更想在安静的时候谈谈

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Conversation continues
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 对话继续

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Attention directed towards the other speaker
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 注意力转向另一位说话者

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//通知

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I considered it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我考虑过。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Something to Say
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 想说的话

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Oh. Okay
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 哦，好吧

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Don't look so worried, it's nothing bad
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 别那么担心，这没什么大不了的

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I wasn't worried until you said that
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我没担心，直到你这么说

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Great, now I've made it sound dramatic
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 太好了，现在我把它说得很戏剧化

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You can tell me when you're ready. I was only coming over to say thanks
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 你准备好了再告诉我。我只是过来感谢你

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: For the notes?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 是为了笔记吗？

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: For saving me from admitting I hadn't written any of that down
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 为了让我不必承认我根本没写下那些东西

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: There he is. I was wondering why you were being so nice
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 他来了。我在想你为什么这么好

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I can be nice without wanting something
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我可以不求回报地对你好

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: But I found a table outside instead, so I'm choosing personal growth
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 不过我在外面找到了一个桌子，所以我选择了个人成长

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then take your hand away from my fries
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 那就把你的手从我的薯条上拿开

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Fair point
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 说得对

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Playful exchange at the table
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 桌子上的调皮互动

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Shared laughter
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 共享的笑声

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I like knowing she's laughing, even if I'm still getting used to the thought of them together.
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 知道她在笑，我很开心，虽然我还在适应他们待在一起这件事。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//通知

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Lunch Negotiations
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 午餐谈判

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: 20 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 20分钟后

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Okay, I have my phone to myself again
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 好啦，我又可以自己用手机了

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Everything okay?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 一切还好吗？

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes. We just had a normal conversation
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 是的。我们只是聊了一些正常的事情

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I nearly brought it up, but there were people sitting right next to us
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我差点提起这个，但旁边坐着人

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He knows I want to talk about something. Not what it is
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 他知道我想谈点什么，但不知道是什么

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Proud of you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 为你感到骄傲

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: How did that feel?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 那感觉怎么样？

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Less terrifying than I expected
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 比我想象的少了点可怕

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Although he did try to steal my lunch, so I couldn't take him too seriously
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 虽然他确实试图偷我的午餐，所以我没法太认真对待他

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That sounds familiar
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 听起来很眼熟

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Tomorrow I'll find a quieter moment
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 明天我会找个安静的时刻

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I want to see whether we can actually talk about it before deciding anything else
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我想看看我们能不能在决定其他事情之前聊聊这个

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Okay. Tell me how you're feeling tonight
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 好吧。告诉我你今晚的感觉

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I will
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我会

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Thank you 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 谢谢你 😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I downloaded an app during my break
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我在休息时下载了一个应用

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You did?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 你真的下载了？

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Just to see what it was like. I haven't put a profile up or messaged anyone
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 只是想看看是什么样的。我还没上传个人资料或给任何人发消息

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Hang on, I'm trying to remember how to get back to the profile screen
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 等一下，我在想怎么回到个人资料页面

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A MOMENT LATER
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 片刻之后

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Okay, found it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 好啦，找到了

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It was less intimidating when I stopped treating every man on the screen like some enormous life decision
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 当我不再把屏幕上的每个男人都当成重大人生决定时，感觉就没那么吓人了

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Any interesting discoveries?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 有什么有趣的发现吗？

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: One man had six pictures of himself next to the same car
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 有一个男人在同一辆车旁边有六张自己的照片

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Maybe the car has a good personality
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 也许这辆车性格不错

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Here's my very exclusive lunch spot
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 这是我非常独特的午餐地点

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.source: But I'm warning you right now
Even if she's family, she's getting the exact same treatment as everyone else
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.translation: 即使她是家人，她也会和其他人一样对待

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.source: She needs someone to put her in her place
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.translation: 她需要有人让她清醒过来

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.source: And while we're talking about people who need to get serious…
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.translation: 说到需要认真对待的人……

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.source: Your leg still isn't gonna fix itself if you keep being lazy
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.translation: 如果你继续懒惰，你的腿是不会自己好的

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.source: The doctor only took my cast off yesterday, remember?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.translation: 医生昨天才给我拆了石膏，记得吗？

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.source: Just don't come crying when the real sessions start
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.translation: 等真正的训练开始时别来哭

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.source: She wants to join the training sessions
I might have given her a little push
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.translation: 我可能给了她一点小推力

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey 😊 Did your grand expedition away from the sofa happen, or did the console win?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 嘿 😊 你终于离开沙发去冒险了吗，还是游戏机赢了？

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Probably not immediately
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 可能不会立刻相信。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's partly why I want to talk face to face. I can tell him to stop making jokes if I need to
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 这也是我想面对面聊的原因之一。如果需要的话，我可以告诉他别开玩笑。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Please don't tell him how quickly I said his name
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 请不要告诉他我说他名字有多快。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You mean immediately?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你是说立刻吗？

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That sounds worse when you say it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你这么说听起来更糟了

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I can leave that detail out 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我可以不提那个细节 😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not going to show him our messages either. I can explain the situation myself
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我也不打算把我们的消息给他看。我可以自己解释情况

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Thank you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 谢谢你

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then we'll see how he feels. I'm not inviting him anywhere before we've even managed that conversation
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 那我们再看看他的感受。在我们谈过之前，我不会邀请他去任何地方

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Let me know how you're doing when you get a chance
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 有空的时候告诉我你怎么样哦

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then I got home, made dinner, and realized I'd cooked enough pasta for a family of six
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 然后我回到家，做了晚餐，才发现我做了足够六个人吃的意大利面

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I will ❤️
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我会的❤️

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wrote a short introduction earlier. Want to read it?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我之前写了个简短的介绍。想看看吗？

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Send it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 发过来

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm in a relationship, and my partner knows I'm here. I'd like to get to know someone, starting with a conversation and maybe a coffee
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我有对象，我的伴侣知道我在这里。我想认识一下别人，先从聊天和喝咖啡开始

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That says what you mean
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 这说出了你的意思

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It doesn't sound too formal?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 听起来不太正式吗？

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A little. Add something about yourself that isn't about us
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 有一点。加点关于你自己的，不要只提我们

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Like my impressive ability to cook six portions of pasta by accident?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 比如我意外地能做六份意大利面的惊人能力？

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's tomorrow sorted
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 那明天就解决了

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Honestly, yes
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 老实说，是的

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like quiet cafés, terrible films, and apparently cooking for people who don't exist
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我喜欢安静的咖啡馆、糟糕的电影，显然还喜欢为不存在的人做饭

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That sounds much more like you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 这听起来更像你了

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're included in the pasta, don't worry 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你也在意大利面里，别担心 😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Wait, I want to try taking one now while the light's nice
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 等一下，我想趁光线好试着拍一张

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll try to give you a completely unbiased opinion
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我会尽量给你一个完全公正的意见

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That would be a first
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 那可真是第一次

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: 2 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 2分钟后

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay, this one actually looks like me
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 好吧，这个确实像我

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And possibly the rest of my life
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 还有可能是我余生的伙食

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's the expression I get when you tell me you've only stolen one fry
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你告诉我你只偷了一根薯条时我就是这个表情

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I look innocent because I am
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我看起来无辜是因为我就是

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The photo is excellent. The legal defense needs work
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 这张照片真棒。不过法律辩护需要改进一下。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm keeping the photo then 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 那我就留着这张照片了😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll use that one and read the introduction again tomorrow before I put anything up
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我会用那张，明天再读一遍介绍，然后再发布。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then I can see if there's someone I actually want to talk to
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 这样我就能看看有没有我真的想聊的人了。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And you don't owe anyone a conversation just because they message you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你可不需要因为别人发消息就跟他们聊天。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know. I'm curious, not accepting applications from the entire internet
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我知道。我只是好奇，并不是要接受整个互联网的申请。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Now that's a good profile title
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 这标题不错哦。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're not helping anymore
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你现在可没在帮忙。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You could bring some next time
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 下次你可以带一些过来

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm nervous about tomorrow
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我对明天有点紧张。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: But I like that it's a small thing I actually want to do, rather than some huge leap I'm trying to be ready for
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 但我喜欢这是我真的想做的小事，而不是我试图准备的大跳跃。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can tell me if it turns out to feel different than you expected
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 如果感觉和你预期的不一样，随时告诉我哦。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You too
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你也是

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I don't want you pretending you're fine just because you were the one who brought it up
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我不想你因为是你提起的就假装没事。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I won't
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我不会

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay ❤️
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 好的 ❤️

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Now, very important question
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 现在，有个非常重要的问题。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Look at you solving my problems
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 看看你，帮我解决问题

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm listening
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我在听

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: When I bring you pasta, are we watching something decent, or are you making me watch another film where nobody turns a light on?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 当我给你带意大利面时，我们是看点好的，还是又要看那种没人开灯的电影？

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's atmosphere
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 那是气氛嘛。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's two hours of me asking who's standing in the doorway
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 那可是两个小时我在问谁站在门口。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can pick this time
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 这次你来选吧。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Really?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 真的吗？

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. But I reserve the right to complain
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 好的。但我保留抱怨的权利。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd be worried if you didn't
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 如果你不抱怨我会担心的。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I want that afternoon with you, you know
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我想和你一起度过那个下午，你知道的。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not to have another serious discussion. Just to eat too much and sit next to you for a while
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 不是为了再进行一次严肃的讨论。只是想吃得太饱，和你坐在一起一会儿。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Wait, let me get comfortable before you distract me again
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 等一下，让我先舒服一下再让你分心

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I want that too
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我也想要。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then don't forget. I'm still claiming my spot on the sofa
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 那别忘了。我还要占据沙发的位置哦。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It's yours
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 那是你的。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hang on, I'm moving from the sofa to bed before I fall asleep here
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 等一下，我要从沙发上移到床上，不然我就要在这里睡着了。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: 5 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 5分钟后

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There. I'm saving you the other pillow
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 好了。我给你留了另一个枕头。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're really not helping with how much I miss you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你真没在帮我，越想你越难受。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then come and claim it when you can
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 那你有空就来拿吧。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I will ❤️
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我会的❤️

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: 5 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 5分钟后

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good night, handsome ❤️
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 晚安，帅哥 ❤️

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good night. Save me some pasta
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 晚安。留点意大利面给我。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There is enough pasta to outlive both of us. Go to sleep 😭
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 意大利面多得可以让我们俩都活过来。快去睡觉吧😭

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There. Hair still damp, but I'm not moving again
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 好了。头发还湿着，但我不打算再动了

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You look like you're about to fall asleep
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你看起来快要睡着了

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I made it to the kitchen and back several times
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我去厨房好几次又回来了

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not. I've only just sat down
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我才刚坐下呢

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's usually how it starts
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 这通常就是开始的方式

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Very funny
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 真有趣

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There is something I wanted to check before tomorrow, actually
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 其实我想在明天之前确认一件事

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Go ahead
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 来吧

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The other night, when I asked what you'd want to know if I sent a picture to someone else
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 前几天我问你，如果我给别人发照片，你想知道什么

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I remember your answer. I just don't want to assume it covers everything we might do
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我记得你的回答。我只是想确保它涵盖我们可能做的所有事情

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's fair
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 这很公平

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: An experienced traveler
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 一个经验丰富的旅行者

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You said you'd want to know, and receive the picture too
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你说你想知道，还想收到照片

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah. I like the idea of being included in what you choose to share
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 是啊。我喜欢能参与你选择分享的内容

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay. But if I'm out talking to someone, I won't necessarily be looking at my phone the whole time
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 好的。不过如果我在外面和别人聊天，我不一定会一直盯着手机

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not asking you to give me updates every five minutes
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我不是让你每五分钟给我更新一次

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd like to see the picture if that's something you decide to share. A conversation is different
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 如果你决定分享照片，我想看看。如果是聊天就不一样了

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. I don't want you waiting for a message and thinking something's wrong because I'm not typing
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 很好。我不想让你等消息时觉得有什么不对劲，因为我没在打字

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Tell me when you're free, then we can actually talk
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 告诉我你什么时候有空，我们可以好好聊聊
