story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There was also a little time outside
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我也在外面待了一会儿

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like that better
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我更喜欢这样

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And don't get too excited about the pictures yet. I haven't even had the first conversation 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 而且别对照片太兴奋哦。我连第一次对话都还没开始呢😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm being very patient
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我很有耐心

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're doing a convincing impression of it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你表现得很像

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You said you'd want to know, but wouldn't necessarily want the picture yourself
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你说你想知道，但不一定想要照片

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah. That still fits
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 是的。这还是适合的

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I want to hear about it from you. I don't need you collecting things to show me
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我想听你亲口说。我不需要你收集东西给我看

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's a relief, honestly
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 说实话，这让我松了一口气

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then I sat down before I started regretting my ambition
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 然后我坐下了，免得后悔自己的雄心

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd rather tell you how something felt than worry about proving it happened
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我宁愿告诉你某种感觉，而不是担心证明它发生过

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not checking your homework
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我可不想检查你的作业

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. I've had enough of that today
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 好吧，今天我已经受够了

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And if you're busy, we can talk afterward
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 如果你忙的话，我们可以之后再聊

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay. I'll tell you when I've got a moment, rather than trying to keep up a second conversation on my phone
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 好的。我会在有空的时候告诉你，而不是在手机上同时进行第二个对话

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Exactly
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 没错

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You still get my ordinary pictures, by the way. You're not escaping my face that easily 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 顺便说一下，你还是能看到我的普通照片的。你可逃不掉我的脸哦 😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wasn't planning to
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我可没打算逃

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That actually sounds sensible
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 这听起来还挺明智的

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You said you might not want to know
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你说过你可能不想知道

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did you mean not knowing about each individual thing, or not having updates while it's happening?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你是说不想知道每一件事，还是在事情发生时不想要更新？

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I hadn't really separated those in my head
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我脑子里其实没分开这两者

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's why I'm asking
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 所以我才问你

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I can understand leaving room for a surprise. I just don't want us to mean two different things without realizing
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我能理解留点惊喜的空间。我只是不想我们理解的意思不一样却没意识到

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Let's agree on the limits, but leave some things as a surprise
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我们先定好界限，但留一些事情作为惊喜吧

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd rather have no updates during it, then talk afterward
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我宁愿在过程中不更新，之后再聊

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd rather agree on what we're trying first, then leave room for you not to tell me about every little thing
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我宁愿先同意我们要尝试的事情，然后留点空间让你不告诉我每一件小事

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay. A surprise within what we've actually talked about, not me guessing how far that answer goes
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 好的。在我们实际讨论过的范围内留点惊喜，不是让我猜这个答案有多远

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Exactly
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 没错

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You sound surprised
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你听起来很惊讶

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: For now, we're only talking about making contact and seeing whether a first date feels right
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 目前，我们只是在谈论建立联系，看看第一次约会是否合适

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know. I'm not treating this like we've already agreed to everything else
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我知道。我并不把这当作我们已经同意其他所有事情

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And if something feels wrong, I'm telling you. I'm not keeping that to myself to preserve the mystery
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 如果有什么感觉不对，我会告诉你。我不会为了保持神秘而隐瞒

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Of course. Same for me
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 当然。我也是

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: All right. That makes more sense to me now
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 好的。现在我觉得更有道理了

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I think I'd rather not follow everything while it's happening
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我觉得我宁愿不在事情发生的时候一直关注。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: But afterward, I would like to hear how it went and how you felt
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 但之后我想听听事情是怎么发展的，你的感受如何。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So I put my phone away, have the conversation, and we talk when I'm free
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 所以我把手机放一边，先聊聊，等我有空再说。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm trying not to ruin the moment
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我在努力不让这个时刻变得尴尬

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah. That sounds closer to what I meant
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 对，这听起来更像我想表达的意思。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay. I can do that
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 好的，我可以做到。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And if I need to talk to you sooner, I'm still going to
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 如果我需要早点和你聊，我还是会的。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Obviously. You don't have to stick to some plan when you need me
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 当然啦。你不需要在需要我的时候遵循什么计划。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good ❤️
I'm glad we talked about that now
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我很高兴我们现在聊了这个。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I kept imagining myself looking at my phone, wondering whether I was supposed to be sending you something
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我一直想象自己盯着手机，想着我是不是应该发点什么给你。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I don't want you worrying about that
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我不想让你为这个担心。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: How was the rest of your day?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你今天剩下的时间过得怎么样？

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know. It's easier now we've actually said it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我知道。我们说出来之后就容易多了。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So what do you want to do tomorrow?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 那你明天想做什么？

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll ask {{name:aiden}} if we can talk for a few minutes after class
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我会问{{name:aiden}}我们能不能在课后聊几分钟。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I want to explain that we've been discussing the idea of me going on a date with someone else
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我想解释一下我们在讨论我和其他人约会的想法。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And that he's someone I'd consider having that conversation with
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 而且他是我考虑和他谈这个的人。

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You think he'll believe you're serious?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你觉得他会相信你是认真的吗？

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We finished our part of the project, so I can finally stop thinking about it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我们完成了项目的部分，所以我终于可以不再想它了

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: You’re really trying to keep me busy
I just didn’t expect you to suggest something like that after last night
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: 我只是没想到你会在昨晚之后提这种事

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Don’t take too long or I’ll start without you and buy only junk food
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: 别拖太久，不然我就先开始了，只买垃圾食品

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: I’ve been staring at the same page for twenty minutes
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: 我盯着同一页看了二十分钟
购物 + 自制塔可。你来吗？

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: You’re offering to cook with me?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: 你是说要和我一起做饭？

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Morning ❤️
She has a permanent invitation
Good. Keep that in mind 🤍
How's your leg after yesterday?
A bit stiff when I got up, but better after moving around a little
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 起床时有点僵硬，但活动一下就好多了

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'm glad we stopped when we did
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 我很高兴我们及时停下来了

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Me too. I'll take it easy this morning
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 我也是。今天早上我会轻松点

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: What are you planning?
A few things around the house this morning, then probably some games later
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 今天早上做一些家务，之后可能玩游戏

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: What about you?
I'm spending the afternoon with my family
I reached for my bag and remembered where it was
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 我伸手去拿我的包，想起它在哪里

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Lunch first. Then apparently we're playing cards
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 先吃午饭。然后显然我们要打牌

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Apparently?
I was informed. My participation wasn't optional 😭
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 我被告知了。我的参与不是自愿的😭

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Try to come back with your dignity intact
I'll aim higher. I'm going to win
That's the spirit
And then I'll graciously allow them to admire me
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 然后我会优雅地让他们欣赏我

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Very gracious
Exactly
Okay, I need to get ready
It's still beside the sofa
Keep my bag safe. I'll collect it when I see you
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 帮我保管好我的包。等我见到你再拿

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Of course. Have a good time today ❤️
You too love
At least one of us got to stay at your place last night
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 至少我们中有一个昨晚能留在你家

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Your bag was very quiet company
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 你的包包是个很安静的伴侣

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Then don't get too attached to it 😌
Too late. We've already had breakfast
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 太晚了。我们已经吃过早餐了

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Without me? Rude
Here's the person you should have invited instead

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Okay come help me in the kitchen
You’re not allowed to just supervise
A while later, after cooking in the kitchen
I’m still the one in charge of the seasoning
You’re also the one making the biggest mess
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: 你也是制造最大混乱的人

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: And I only bought three unnecessary things
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: 我只买了三样不必要的东西

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Did you just take a picture of me?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: 你刚刚拍了我一张照片吗？

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: While I have sauce on my face?
You’re not allowed to say that while I’m covered in taco seasoning
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: 在我身上沾满塔可调料的时候，你不可以这么说
不过我会留着那张照片
昨天之后感觉…轻松多了

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Don’t get used to me being this calm
I’m only like this because the tacos are almost ready
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: 我之所以这样是因为塔可快好了

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Now stop talking and help me finish plating
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: 现在别说话，帮我把盘子摆好

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: The cookies were looking at me weird
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: 那些饼干看着我怪怪的

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I’m giving us both a solid 8/10
I’m saving the 10 for when we don’t almost set off the smoke alarm
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: 我把10分留到我们不差点把烟雾警报器弄响的时候

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: You mean when you don’t almost set off the smoke alarm
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: 你是说你不差点把烟雾警报器弄响

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Anyway… I’m going to clean up and then crash
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: 好吧…我打算收拾一下，然后去睡觉

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I’m exhausted in the best way
It helped more than I expected
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: 比我预期的要有帮助多了

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I might start requesting weekly taco nights
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: 我可能会开始要求每周的塔可之夜

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Anyway… I’m going to clean up and then crash
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: 好吧…我打算收拾一下，然后去睡觉

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Proof I carried at least one bag
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: 证明我至少提了一个袋子

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Say hello to your mom for me
She sends you a kiss back 😘
But every time I look pleased, someone makes me draw more
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 但每次我看起来很高兴时，总有人让我抽更多
那就别看起来那么高兴

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Act like your hand is terrible
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 表现得你的手牌很糟糕

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Fine. I'm trusting you with my reputation
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 好吧。我把我的名声托付给你

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Did you keep a straight face?
Then someone asked why I looked like I was hiding a crime
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 然后有人问我为什么看起来像在隐藏罪行
所以这个诈唬还需要练习

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I think I need a new adviser
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 我觉得我需要一个新的顾问

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Harsh. I was working with limited information
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 太苛刻了。我是在有限的信息下工作

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: They asked who I kept texting
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 他们问我一直在发短信给谁

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Did you tell them you were receiving expert assistance?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 你告诉他们你在接受专家帮助吗？

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I said my boyfriend was helping me lose
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 我说我男朋友在帮我输

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: You should give them a chance to miss you. Take a break
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 你应该给他们一个想念你的机会。休息一下

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I have. I'm getting another slice of cake
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 我已经休息了。我再去拿一块蛋糕

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: At least I'm winning at dessert
I'll be home later this afternoon
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 我今天下午晚些时候会回家

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I have an idea. I'll tell you when I'm home ❤️
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 我有个主意。等我回家再告诉你❤️

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Good. Let me finish my very important cake first
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 好啊。让我先吃完我非常重要的蛋糕

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Everyone suddenly becomes very competitive when I'm about to win
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 每当我快要赢的时候，大家都变得很有竞争力

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Look at the face of someone being treated unfairly
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 看看被不公平对待的人的表情

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: You look like you're planning revenge
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 你看起来像是在策划报复

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: LATE EVENING — You are back home and have a quiet moment to yourself.
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 深夜——你回到了家，终于有了一点属于自己的安静时间。

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Really?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 真的？

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Yeah. I'd love to play with you
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 嗯。我很想和你一起玩

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You always sound like you're having fun
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 你总是听起来很开心

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I thought I'd like to try it with you instead of just hearing about it
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 我想我想和你一起试试，而不是只是听你说

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Then let's find something we can both enjoy
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 那我们找点我们都喜欢的东西吧

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: What about that racing game you mentioned?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 你提到的那个赛车游戏怎么样？

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That would work. We can do a private race
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 那可以。我们可以进行一场私人比赛

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Okay. But you have to explain the controls first
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 好的。但你得先解释一下控制

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Deal. I'll send you an invite once you're ready
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 成交。一旦你准备好了，我会发给你邀请

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: A LITTLE LATER — You both launch the racing game. Before starting, you explain the controls and let {{name:lena}} try a practice lap.
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 稍后——你们俩启动了赛车游戏。在开始之前，你解释了控制，并让{{name:lena}}试一圈。

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm home
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 我回家了

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Ready. Please appreciate my concentration
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 准备好了。请欣赏我的专注

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Very professional. How's the practice lap going?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 非常专业。练习圈怎么样？

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I've met the same wall three times
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 我撞到了同一堵墙三次

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Brake before the corner, then turn
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 在转弯前刹车，然后转弯

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You're trying to do both at full speed
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 你试图全速同时做这两件事

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I thought speed was the point
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 我以为速度就是关键

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Staying on the road helps too
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 保持在路上也很重要

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Fine. One more practice lap
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 好吧。再来一圈练习

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: AFTER THE FIRST RACE
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 第一次比赛后

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And I have a very serious question
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 我有个非常严肃的问题

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You finished so far ahead of me 😭
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 你比我领先太多了😭

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I've played it a lot more. Don't compare your first race to that
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 我玩得多得多。别把你的第一次比赛和那个比

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I also got stuck facing the wrong way
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 我也曾卡在错误的方向上

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: But you got around the last corner cleanly
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 但你顺利过了最后一个弯

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That's the one you kept hitting in practice
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 那就是你在练习中一直撞的地方

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I did notice that
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 我注意到了这一点

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: See? You're already getting the timing
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 看吧？你已经掌握时机了

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Okay. Again
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 好吧。再来一次

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Same track?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 同一条赛道？

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Yes. I have unfinished business with it
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 是的。我还有未完成的事情要处理

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm listening
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 我在听

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: AFTER THE SECOND RACE — {{name:lena}} still finishes behind you, but completes the track with fewer crashes.
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 第二场比赛后——{{name:lena}} 仍然落在你后面，但完成了赛道，碰撞更少。

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Still lost
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 还是输了

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Check your time, though
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 不过，看看你的时间

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You finished much faster than the first race
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 你这次比第一场快多了

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And I only spun around twice
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 而我只转了两圈

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Exactly. You remembered to slow down before the sharp corners
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 没错。你记得在急转弯前减速了

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I was repeating your instructions in my head
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 我在脑海中反复想着你的指示

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: They worked. That was a much better lap
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 这些指示有效。这一圈好得多

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You're being nice because I'm your girlfriend
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 你对我好是因为我是你的女朋友

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'd tell you if you hadn't improved
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 要是你没进步，我会直接告诉你的

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Would you play something with me tonight?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 今晚你愿意和我一起玩点什么吗？

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: The faster lap is because you drove better
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 更快的圈速是因为你开得更好

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Okay, that's a good answer ❤️
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 好吧，这是个好回答 ❤️

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Want to stop or try a different track?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 想停下来还是试试其他赛道？

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: One more on this one
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 再来一局这个

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I want to see if I can do it without crashing at all
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 我想看看能不能完全不撞车

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: AFTER ONE LAST RACE
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 最后一场比赛后

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I nearly had it
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 我差点就成功了

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You only clipped the barrier at the end
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 你只是最后碰到了障碍物

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Because I got excited and forgot to brake
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 因为我太兴奋了，忘了刹车

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Your first half was really good. Keep doing that and the rest will follow
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 你前半段表现得很好。继续这样做，后面的就会跟上

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Wait. You're asking ME to play?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 等一下。你是在问我玩吗？

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I want a rematch another night
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 我想要在其他晚上再来一场

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'd be very happy with that
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 我会很开心的

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You're still smiling about me asking, aren't you?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 你还在因为我问这个而笑吧？

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: A little
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 有一点

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I like getting to share this with you
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 我喜欢和你分享这些

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Me too. Even if you're annoyingly difficult to catch
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 我也是。即使你总是让我很难追上

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Now you understand why I always want one more round
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 现在你明白我为什么总想再来一局了

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Unfortunately, yes 😌
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 不幸的是，是的 😌

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Did you play games like this when you were little?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 你小时候也玩过这样的游戏吗？

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Yeah. I'd lean sideways with the controller like that would help me turn
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 是的。我会侧着身子用手柄，好像这样能帮我转弯

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Yes 😭
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 是的😭

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I did that tonight 😭
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 我今晚也这样做了 😭

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Then you have excellent instincts
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 那你有很好的直觉

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Apparently everyone except the car understood what I wanted
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 显然，除了车子，其他人都明白我想要什么

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: We'll work on getting the car involved next time
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 下次我们会让车子参与进来

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Thank you for being patient with me tonight
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 谢谢你今晚对我这么有耐心

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I had a good time. You don't have to win for me to enjoy playing with you
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 我玩得很开心。你不需要赢我才会享受和你一起玩

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I had fun too ❤️
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 我也玩得很开心 ❤️

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Okay. Getting ready for tomorrow, then bed
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 好的。准备明天的事，然后去睡觉

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Goodnight, love. Thanks for asking me to play
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 晚安，亲爱的。谢谢你邀请我一起玩

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Goodnight ❤️ We'll do it again
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 晚安 ❤️ 我们再来一次

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Why are you so surprised?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 你怎么这么惊讶？

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You never suggest it. It's usually me telling you about my games
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 你从来不提这个。通常都是我告诉你我的游戏

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm really happy you asked, actually
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 其实我很高兴你问了

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Morning
No
Today I’ve got the whole day free
Miraculously
Want to come shopping with me then?
Shopping?
I need new pants. The doctor took my cast off two days ago, so I can finally wear pants that fit properly again
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 我需要买新裤子。医生两天前给我拆了石膏，我终于又能穿合身的裤子了。

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Oh damn, finally
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 哦，终于等到这个时刻了！

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Yes, with pleasure
I’ve been waiting for an excuse to leave the house without academic guilt
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 我一直在等一个借口，能不带学业负担地出门。

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: You up?
Give me thirty minutes to look less like a disaster
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 给我三十分钟，让我看起来不那么糟糕😅

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Take your time
Don’t start without me 😌
Yeah. How are you feeling today?
Better than yesterday
Still a bit tired but my brain isn’t completely soup anymore
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 还是有点累，不过我的脑袋不再完全是浆糊了

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Good. When are you seeing your professor again?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 好。你下次什么时候见教授？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Probably one day out of two
Sometimes every day if he thinks I need it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 有时候每天都要，如果他觉得我需要的话

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: He’s taking this whole “extra sessions” thing pretty seriously
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 他对这个“额外辅导”可真是很认真呢

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Today too?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ I've decided we never watched that film and my reputation is still intact
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 嘿❤️ 我决定我们从没看过那部电影，我的名声依然完好无损。

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good, then it wasn't just me
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 太好了，那就不是我一个人

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: What about you? Better night?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 你呢？昨晚好些吗？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Much better, and I got up and made breakfast before checking my phone
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 好多了，我起床后先做了早餐，然后才看手机

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Without leaving a trail of things you'd dropped?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 没有留下你掉落的东西的痕迹？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: One spoon, but I picked it up
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 掉了一把勺子，不过我捡起来了

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm proud of your very ambitious morning ❤️
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我为你这么有雄心的早晨感到骄傲❤️

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I've also put both shoes on
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我也穿上了两只鞋子

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Sitting down?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 坐下了吗？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Sitting down
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 坐下了

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: See, you can be taught 😌
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 看，你是可以被教会的😌

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good morning to you too, detective
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 早安，侦探。

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: How's your breakfast going?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 早餐怎么样？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It's fine, packing my bag is the problem
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 还好，打包我的包才是问题

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm taking last night's pasta so I don't get robbed by another sandwich
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我带上昨晚的意大利面，以免被另一个三明治抢了

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Future You finally got something out of that dinner
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 未来的你终于从那顿晚餐中得到了点什么

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: She got food and an extremely full bag
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 她得到了食物和一个非常满的包

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Put the food at the top
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 把食物放在最上面

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Then I have to carry the book
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 那我就得带上书

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Carry the book
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 带上书

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You make everything sound so easy when you're not the one trying to close this zip 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 当你不是那个试图拉上这个拉链的人时，你让一切听起来都那么简单😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You could leave something at home
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 你可以把什么东西留在家里

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Don't start, I haven't even had breakfast yet 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 别开始，我还没吃早餐呢😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I need all of it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我都需要

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Including whatever's been sitting at the bottom for three weeks?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 包括那些在底部放了三周的东西？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You don't know what's at the bottom
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 你不知道底部有什么

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Do you?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 你知道吗？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's not the point
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 这不是重点

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Wait, I think I've got it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 等一下，我想我明白了

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Please appreciate that I'm dressed and ready before the last possible minute
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 请欣赏我在最后一刻之前就已经穿好衣服和准备好了

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You look really good ❤️
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 你看起来真不错❤️

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Thank you handsome 😊
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 谢谢你，帅哥😊

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Would a red scarf make you feel better?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 一条红围巾会让你感觉好点吗？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: The bag looks like it's about to lose a fight
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 这个包看起来快要打输了

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Compliment the girl, not the luggage
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 夸夸女孩，而不是行李

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: The girl is lovely. The luggage has my sympathy
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 女孩很可爱。行李让我感到同情

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Much better 😌
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 好多了😌

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Classes this morning again?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 今天早上又有课吗？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yeah, then straight to work
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 是的，然后直接去工作

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'd like to get everything finished without staring at the clock for the last hour
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我希望能在最后一小时内完成所有事情，而不是一直盯着钟表

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: A reasonable goal
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 一个合理的目标

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: What are you doing with your day?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 你今天打算做什么？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Going to clear out that kitchen cupboard I've been avoiding
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我要清理那个我一直在避开的厨房橱柜

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I will hide your remote the next time I come over
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 下次我来时会把你的遥控器藏起来哦。

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: The one where things fall on you when you open it?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 那个一打开就会掉东西的？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I prefer to think of it as a surprise feature
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我更喜欢把它当作一个惊喜功能

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You could also just put fewer things in it 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 你也可以少放点东西进去 😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm making space for the good coffee mugs
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我在为好咖啡杯腾地方

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Important, I don't want our first proper coffee together to come out of a measuring jug
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 重要的是，我不想我们的第一次正式咖啡是从量杯里倒出来的

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You've ruined my entire presentation
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 你毁了我整个演示

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Save the effort for the coffee, I won't judge the mug too much ❤️
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 把力气留给咖啡吧，我不会太在意杯子的 ❤️

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'd rather take you out for one soon
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我宁愿很快带你出去喝一杯

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'd like that
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我喜欢这个！

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: All right, I need to leave before being early turns into missing the bus
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 好吧，我得走了，早到可不想变成错过公交

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That sounds like a confession
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 这听起来像是个忏悔。

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I probably won't be on my phone much this afternoon
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 今天下午我可能不会太用手机

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Don't forget your lunch after all that effort
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 经过这么多努力，别忘了你的午餐

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It's already digging into my side, I couldn't forget it if I tried 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 它已经压到我身上了，我就算想忘也忘不了 😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll text you when I get to the bar tonight, like I said
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我今晚到酒吧时会发信息给你，就像我说的

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Okay, have a good day
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 好的，祝你今天愉快

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You too handsome ❤️ Love you
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 你也是帅哥 ❤️ 爱你

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Love you too
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我也爱你

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It sounds like a warning 😌
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 这听起来像是个警告😌

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Did you sleep well at least?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 你至少睡得好吗？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yeah, once I stopped trying to work out how the actual ending made sense
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 嗯，直到我不再试图弄明白实际结局是怎么回事。

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It didn't
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 没有

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: The second one looks less tragic
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 第二个看起来没那么惨。

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Thanks for the vote of confidence

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 我说的是实话，不是刻薄。

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I saw something quite nice near the entrance
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 我在入口附近看到了一些不错的东西

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I’m still buying this one though
We can go pay and get food after
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 我们可以先去付钱，然后再去吃东西。

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ We're at the bar, and I've finally sat down somewhere that isn't an office chair
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 嘿 ❤️ 我们在酒吧，终于坐在不是办公椅的地方了

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can keep mocking my recommendations, but you seem to like this one
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你可以继续嘲笑我的推荐，但你似乎喜欢这个

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I do like it here
See, that wasn't difficult
You're going to be unbearable about this all night, aren't you?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你今晚会一直纠缠这个，是吧？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Only until you stop acting surprised that I have good taste
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 只要你不再对我有好品味感到惊讶就行

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not giving you that one
You don't have to
And you? What do you actually do when you're not in that office?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 那你呢？你不在办公室的时候到底在做什么？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Go out, find somewhere good to eat, drive somewhere when I have a free day
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 出去找个好地方吃饭，等我有空的时候再开车去

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And tell everyone where to sit when you get there?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 到那儿的时候还要告诉大家坐哪儿吗？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Nice, not too busy yet
Someone has to stop them choosing the table by the toilets
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 总得有人阻止他们选靠厕所的桌子

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're not even denying it
Why would I?
I can't decide whether that's confidence or a complete lack of shame
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我还真搞不清这是自信还是完全没有羞耻感

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Let me know when you've made up your mind
As the musicians set up at the other end of the room...
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 当乐手在房间另一头准备的时候...

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Are they playing here tonight?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 他们今晚在这儿演出吗？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Looks like it
I thought that was just equipment from another night
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我还以为那只是其他晚上的设备呢

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your one drink is nearly finished
We've got a little table near the side wall
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我们在侧墙附近有一张小桌子

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Are you timing me?
I'm deciding whether to ask for the food menu
There's one right here
You've noticed
I've been carrying leftover pasta around all day. Let me look at something else
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我今天一直带着剩下的意大利面。让我看看别的吧

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your phone again?
I'm checking the time
Your boyfriend waiting to hear from you?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你男朋友在等你消息吗？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I said I'd let him know what I was doing
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我说过会告诉他我在干嘛

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Tell him the food's good
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 告诉他这儿的食物很好

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Why?
So he knows why you're staying
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 这样他就知道你为什么留在这儿了

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I haven't said I'm staying yet
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我还没说我会留下来呢

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You've been looking at that menu for five minutes
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你看那个菜单已经五分钟了

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Maybe I'm hungry
Then stay and eat with me
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 那就留下来和我一起吃吧

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: All right, I want to hear a bit of the music too
But I'm choosing the food
I thought you'd say that
Give me a minute, I'm going to let him know
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 给我一分钟，我去告诉他

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That does look nice
We're going to get something to eat before leaving, there's a band starting here 😊
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我们要在离开前找点吃的，这儿有乐队要开始演出了😊

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So you're staying a bit longer?
Yeah, I hadn't realised they had live music tonight
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 是啊，我没意识到今晚有现场音乐

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What are you getting?
A flatbread and fries, nothing very sophisticated
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 一份扁面包和薯条，没什么特别的

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Better than carrying your lunch around all evening
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 总比整晚带着你的午餐强

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That container is empty now, it can stop judging my decisions 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 那个容器现在空了，可以停止对我的决定评头论足了😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I thought you were just going for a drink
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我还以为你只是来喝酒的

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I did too, but we're having a nice time and I haven't eaten since lunch
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我也是，但我们玩得很开心，而且我从午餐后就没吃东西了

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: All right
And the chair isn't trying to destroy my back, which I appreciate
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 而且椅子也没有试图摧毁我的背，我很感激

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll still text you when I'm home ❤️
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我到家后还会给你发信息的❤️

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay
When the food arrives...
Dinner, before I eat all the fries 😌
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 晚餐，趁我还没把薯条吃光😌

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Looks good
It smells good too, I'm going to eat while it's hot
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 闻起来也不错，我要趁热吃了

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Enjoy your food
Talk in a bit ❤️
Are the fries allowed to be eaten now?
Have you ordered?
I took one photo, you'll survive
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我拍了一张照片，你会活下来的

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: They looked better without the phone between us
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 没有手机在我们之间，照片看起来更好

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can have my attention without being dramatic about it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你可以不那么戏剧化地吸引我的注意

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then put it down and try that
The flatbread?
No, the tablecloth
Keep talking and I'll eat your half too
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 继续说话，我也会把你的那份吃掉

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I ordered extra fries for a reason
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我点了额外的薯条是有原因的

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You do have your uses
Careful, that's nearly another compliment
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 小心点，这几乎又是一个赞美了

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not yet, I'm still looking
A few songs into the set...
What did you say?
Move your chair over here, I'm not shouting across the table
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 把你的椅子移过来，我可不想在桌子那边大喊

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You could have just asked me to sit next to you
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你可以直接叫我坐你旁边啊

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I just did
In the most bossy way possible
And yet you're moving the chair
Because I can't hear you, don't look so pleased
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 因为我听不见你，别看得那么得意

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not stopping you
Let me move my bag before you put your foot through it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 让我先把包移开，不然你要踩到它了

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll let you get on with it
Is the book getting its own chair too?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 那本书也要单独一把椅子吗？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It has better manners than you, it deserves one
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 它比你有礼貌，值得一把椅子

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: {{name:lena}} moves her chair beside her manager to hear him over the music
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: {{name:lena}} 把椅子移到她的经理旁边，以便能听到他在音乐声中说的话

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: She leans closer to answer him, her hand resting briefly on his forearm
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 她靠近他回答，手短暂地放在他的前臂上

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Visual capture archived
It's the hand on his arm that gets to me. Such a small gesture, and I'm sitting here wondering how much closer they'll get.
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 最让我难受的是她放在他手臂上的那只手。只是一个小动作，我却坐在这里，担心他们还会靠得多近。

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: HAK//NOTICE
A Little Closer
You know this one?
Yeah, don't ask me to sing it
I wasn't going to risk the evening
Excuse you, I might be very good
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你可别小看我，我可能唱得很好

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You might. I'm enjoying this too much to find out
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你可能唱得不错，但我现在太享受了，不想知道

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're horrible
Did the cupboard survive you?
You laughed
That doesn't make you less horrible
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 这并不让你变得不那么可怕

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're different out here
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 在这里的你有点不一样

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Less tired than I was at six?
You actually hold my gaze when you're talking to me
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你跟我说话时真的能直视我的眼睛

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Maybe you stare too much
I like looking at you
You could try being subtle
I could. I don't see the point
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我可以，但我觉得没必要

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I noticed
It's currently in several piles across the kitchen
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 现在它在厨房的几个地方堆成了一堆

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Already an improvement
After the set, with the plates cleared...
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 在表演结束后，盘子都收拾好了……

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I should check the bus times
I'll get the bill
I can pay for my food
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我可以自己付我的饭钱

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I invited you
That doesn't mean I can't pay
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 这并不意味着我不能付钱

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It means I'm paying tonight
You really are like this everywhere
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你在任何地方都是这样的

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You haven't had a boring evening, have you?
No, I'll give you that
So you're at the point where you regret starting 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 所以你现在后悔开始了 😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll take it
There's a bus in about twenty minutes
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 大约二十分钟后有一班公交

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Plenty of time. Get your jacket
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 时间还多，快去拿你的外套

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Please?
Get your jacket, please
See, you can learn
Deeply
Leave me at least one usable mug, okay?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 至少留一个能用的杯子给我，好吗？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No promises
I'm putting my phone down for a bit, I'll text you when I'm home ❤️
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我先放下手机，回家时会发信息给你 ❤️

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay, talk later
At their table, a little later...
A conversation at the bar is detected near {{name:lena}}
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 在{{name:lena}}附近检测到酒吧的对话

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: She said this was a drink after work. I want to believe I can relax about it, but I keep looking at the screen.
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 她说只是下班后喝一杯。我想相信自己能放轻松，可目光还是不停落在屏幕上。

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: HAK//LIVE TRANSCRIPTION
You look good
You saw me at work an hour ago
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你一个小时前在工作时见过我

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There's food too, so it's winning by a lot 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 还有食物，所以这真是太棒了 😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You looked good then too
Is that why you kept looking over?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 所以你一直看过来是这个原因吗？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You thought I was checking whether you'd finished the report?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你以为我在检查你是否完成了报告？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're supposed to be
The report got finished, didn't it?
No work talk tonight
You brought it up
I can already tell you're going to be exhausting
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我已经能感觉到你会很累人

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Is that how you speak to your boss ?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你是这样跟你老板说话的吗？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Should I remind you what my boss did to me ?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 要我提醒你我老板对我做了什么吗？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did you finish on time?
..what good weather we have today
Yeah I thought so
You've been smiling since you sat down. I'll take my chances
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你坐下后一直在微笑。我就赌一把

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You always this pleased with yourself?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你总是这么自得其乐吗？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: On a good evening
We've barely started
Exactly
Right, before your head gets any bigger, what are you having?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 对了，在你自满之前，你想喝点什么？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Get the ginger one, it's good here
Do you give instructions everywhere you go?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你到哪里都发号施令吗？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Just about, I had to put the lunch container back in my bag very carefully
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 差不多，我得小心翼翼地把午餐盒放回包里

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Only when I know what I'm talking about
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 只有在我知道自己在说什么的时候

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So in your opinion, everywhere
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 所以在你看来，都是这样

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're getting to know me
Unfortunately
I'm having the orange one
Just to disagree with me?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 只是为了跟我唱反调吗？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Because I like it. Shocking, I know
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 因为我喜欢它。震惊吧，我知道

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Fine, but don't ask for mine when you change your mind
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 好吧，但如果你改变主意可别问我要

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don't worry, I wouldn't give you the satisfaction
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 别担心，我不会给你这种满足感的

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: After their drinks arrive...
Still carrying the book too?
Okay, the table was a good choice
So was the bar
You can accept one compliment without collecting the rest
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你可以接受一个赞美，而不需要收集其他的

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Why stop at one?
Do you come here a lot?
Often enough to know which table isn't beside the speaker
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 足够常来，知道哪个桌子不在扬声器旁边

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Very strategic
I brought a friend here for his birthday last month. He'd invited six people and booked nowhere
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 上个月我带了一个朋友来这里庆祝他的生日。他邀请了六个人，但没有预定地方

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That sounds organised
He called it being spontaneous. I called the owner
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 他称之为自发，我则打电话给了老板

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes, it has experienced a full working day without being opened once
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 是的，它经历了一整天的工作却一次都没打开

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So your story about saving the evening is actually a story about knowing someone
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 所以你关于拯救晚上的故事其实是关于认识某人的故事

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We ate, didn't we?
I hope he bought your dinner after that
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我希望他之后请你吃晚餐

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Of course. If I'm organising it and paying for it, we can celebrate my birthday instead
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 当然。如果我来组织并支付的话，我们可以庆祝我的生日

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There it is
What?
The part where you make yourself the main event
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你把自己当成主角的那部分

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're welcome to tell the next story
I don't think I can compete with your heroic table reservation
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我觉得我无法和你那英勇的订桌相比

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can try
A useful contribution
All right, yesterday my professor explained the wrong slide for ten minutes
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 好吧，昨天我的教授讲错了幻灯片，讲了十分钟

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Nobody said anything?
We were all writing it down. I had half a page before someone finally asked
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我们都在记笔记。我写了半页，才有人问

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You should have interrupted him
I was busy assuming he knew more than I did
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我忙着以为他比我懂得多

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You make that mistake with everyone in charge?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你对所有负责人都犯这个错误吗？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Less and less lately
Good
That wasn't a compliment to you
I didn't take it as one
Emotional support literature 😌
That makes a change
{{name:lena}} laughs with her manager over their drinks
Visual capture archived
That smile hurts more than I expected. I used to see it and feel like the person she wanted to be with.
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 那个笑容比我想象中更刺痛。以前看到它，我会觉得自己就是她想陪在身边的人。

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: HAK//NOTICE
Away From the Office
What are you doing when classes finish?
Sleeping until I don't hate my alarm anymore
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 睡到我不再讨厌我的闹钟为止

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: After that
I want a day at the beach with a book and no timetable
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我想要一个在海滩上看书、没有时间表的一天

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not some big organised thing, just enough time that I don't have to keep checking my phone
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 不是那种大规模的活动，只要有足够的时间让我不用一直看手机

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know a good stretch away from the main beach
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我知道离主海滩不远的一个好地方

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Of course you do
What's the place like?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I hope your professor gives you a ton of punishment exercises tomorrow
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 我希望你明天教授给你一堆惩罚练习。

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: That doesn’t bother me at all
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 这对我来说没什么大不了的

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Extra work with him is… fine
Anyway I’m going to sleep before you start interrogating me again
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 反正我先去睡了，免得你又开始审问我 😴

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: We went shopping for my pants and somehow you still ended up buying more stuff than me
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 我们去买我的裤子，结果你买的东西比我还多

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: You’re a threat to the shopping industry
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 你简直是购物行业的威胁 😂

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: And yet you still invited me

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: A little after nine, outside the bar...
You sound like me
Someone has to
Fine, I'll get it in a minute 😭
How did your afternoon go? Did you finish the cupboard?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 你下午过得怎么样？把橱柜弄完了吗？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Finished it and then somehow started on the drawer underneath
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 弄完了，然后不知怎么的又开始弄下面的抽屉了

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: That's how it gets you
I found enough takeaway cutlery to open a restaurant
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 我找到了足够的外卖餐具，可以开一家餐厅了

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Please tell me you threw some of it away
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 请告诉我你扔掉了一些

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Most of it
Most?
Don't make me regret saying it
There might be a sudden fork emergency
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 可能会突然需要叉子呢

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'll keep that in mind if mine goes missing 😌
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 如果我的叉子不见了，我会记得这件事的😌

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: It's actually nice having it sorted though
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 其实整理好还是挺舒服的

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Now you can find the mugs without something landing on you
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 现在你可以找到杯子而不会被什么东西砸到

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You'll be impressed
I was going to ask about that
My collection of forks?
Coming over, idiot ❤️
I checked tomorrow's hours before I left today. I finish at five
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 我今天离开前查了明天的工作时间。我五点下班

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Can I come over after work? Around six?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 我可以下班后过来吗？大约六点？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Too late, I'm keeping that one
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 太晚了，我要把这句话记住

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Yeah, of course
You don't have somewhere else to be?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 你没有其他地方要去吗？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: No, I'd like to spend the evening with you
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 没有，我想和你一起度过这个晚上

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'd like that too
We can make something to eat, and you can pick a film that doesn't insult both of us
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 我们可以做点吃的，你可以挑一部不会让我们都觉得被侮辱的电影

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You sure you can cope without solving a crime?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 你确定不破案也能应付吗？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'll investigate the kitchen cupboard instead
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 我会去调查厨房的橱柜

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: A much more dangerous assignment
I'll bring protective equipment 😭
I missed having you here
Obviously
I missed it too
And I want an actual hug, not another message about one
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 我想要一个真正的拥抱，而不是再来一条关于拥抱的消息

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: That can be arranged
Good ❤️ I'll text you when I leave work tomorrow
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 好的❤️ 明天我下班时会发信息给你

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'll be here
You'd better be, I'm not putting up with a full day just to find you've gone out 😌
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 你最好在，我可不想等了一整天结果发现你出去了😌

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'll make room on the sofa
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 我会在沙发上腾出地方

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Don't take the good cushion
Still making demands from your own house
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 在自己家里还在提要求呢

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Always ❤️
Your stop is down here
Okay, I'm going to bed before I fall asleep with the light on
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 好吧，我要去睡觉了，免得开着灯睡着

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Did you take the lunch box out?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 你把午餐盒拿出来了吗？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Yes, it's in the sink. You can stop supervising me now 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 是的，在水槽里。你可以停止监督我了😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'll consider it
Good night handsome, love you ❤️
Love you too, see you tomorrow
See you tomorrow ❤️
I know where it is
The music was good. I'd have stayed longer if I didn't have things to do tomorrow
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 音乐很好。如果明天没有事，我会待得更久

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: We'll know for next time
You're already deciding there's a next time?
I'm saying I'd take you out again
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 我是说我还会请你出去

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You could leave a little room for uncertainty
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 你可以留点不确定性嘛

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: The conversation continues as the two subjects walk toward the bus stop
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 两人边走向公交站边继续聊天

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: They're walking out together. I should be glad the evening is ending, but I can't shake the feeling that I'm waiting for something worse.
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 他们一起走出来了。晚上的聚会快结束了，我本该松口气，可总觉得自己还在等着更糟的事。

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: HAK//LIVE TRANSCRIPTION
Why? I know what I want
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 为什么？我知道我想要什么

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: That must be nice
You weren't exactly rushing for the door either
No, I wasn't
They stop on a quieter corner, with the bus stop visible farther along the street...
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 他们在一个安静的拐角停下，远处的街道上可以看到公交车站...

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I've wanted to kiss you again all evening
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 我整个晚上都想再吻你

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You really don't keep anything to yourself
Not that
Don't get ahead of yourself
Then stop looking at my mouth
I didn't realise how loud it was in there until we came outside
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 直到我们出来我才意识到里面有多吵

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I don't
I have a boyfriend. That hasn't changed since yesterday
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 我有男朋友。这从昨天开始就没变过

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I know. I'm not pretending I only invited you out to talk about work
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 我知道。我不是假装只请你出去谈工作

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: No, you've made that very clear
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 不，你已经说得很清楚了

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: For once, can you stop looking so smug?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 这次能不能别看起来那么得意？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You're making that difficult
{{name:lena}} draws him closer by his jacket
The manager leans in and kisses her; she returns the kiss
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 经理靠近她，吻了她；她也回吻了

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Visual capture archived
She's pulling him closer this time. I can't tell myself this is only something he did to her anymore.
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 这次是她把他拉近。我再也没法告诉自己，这只是他对她做的事。

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: HAK//NOTICE
Before the Bus
Don't say it
Say what?
You were managing to make yourself heard
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 你还是能让自己被听到的

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Whatever smug thing you're about to say
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 不管你要说什么得意的话

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I was going to say I had a good evening
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 我本来想说我度过了一个愉快的晚上

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Somehow you still made that sound smug
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 不知怎么的，你还是让这听起来很得意

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You'll get used to it
Don't push your luck
Worth a try
I need to go now
Your bus isn't here yet
I know, but I'm going to wait at the stop
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 我知道，但我会在站台等

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: All right. See you tomorrow
Only because you were making me lean right over to answer
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 只是因为你让我不得不倾身去回答

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: At work
That's where I'll be
Good night
Good night, {{name:lena}}
A little later, on the bus home...
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 稍后，在回家的公交车上...

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'm on the bus ❤️ I'll be home soon
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 我在公交车上❤️ 我很快就到家

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Did you get a seat?
Yeah, and my bag has finally been taken off my shoulder
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 是啊，我的包终于被拿下来了

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: The book will be relieved
It has had a much more exciting day than it deserved 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 今天过得比它应得的要刺激多了😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You didn't seem to mind
Was it a long walk to the stop?
No, he walked with me as far as the corner, then I went to wait for the bus
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 没有，他陪我走到拐角，然后我就去等公交了

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Okay
I'll text you when I'm inside
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 我进去了会给你发信息的

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: All right
Once she is home...
Hey ❤️ I'm home, did you manage to stay awake?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 嘿❤️我回来了，你能熬到现在吗？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Yeah, I'm still here
Sorry we stayed later than I expected
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 抱歉，我们待得比我预想的要久

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You had a good time?
You're very quick to decide what I do and don't mind
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 你总是很快就决定我在意什么不在意什么

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Yeah, I did
The food was good and the band ended up playing a full set
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 食物很好，乐队最后演奏了一整场

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: What sort of music?
Mostly covers, a couple I knew and several I pretended I knew 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 大部分是翻唱，有几首我知道，还有几首我假装知道😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You do that?
A very convincing nod gets you surprisingly far
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 一个非常有说服力的点头能让你走得很远

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'll remember that next time you watch me play something
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 下次你看我演奏的时候我会记住的

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: That is completely different, I always understand your highly complicated game decisions 😌
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 那完全不同，我总是能理解你那些复杂的游戏决策😌

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Sure you do
The bar was nice though. I hadn't been there before
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 酒吧不错，我之前没去过

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Then tell me. Did you have a good evening?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 那告诉我，你今晚过得好吗？

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Your manager picked it?
Yeah, and he spent a good part of the evening making sure I appreciated his excellent taste
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 是的，他花了不少时间确保我欣赏他的好品味

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Sounds like he's the same outside work then
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 听起来他在工作之外也是这样

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: He definitely likes getting his own way
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 他绝对喜欢按照自己的方式来

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: And you?
I made him add 'please' when he told me to get my jacket
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 我让他在叫我拿外套的时候加上‘请’

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Big achievement
I'm choosing to count it 😌
You sound like you enjoyed yourself
I did, it was nice to get out for a bit
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 我确实很开心，出去走走挺好的

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Yes, I did
I'm glad you're home
Me too ❤️
Give me a minute to change, I don't want to sit around in these clothes any longer
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 给我一分钟换衣服，我不想再穿着这些衣服待着了

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Okay
A few minutes later...
There, no shoes and nothing left to carry
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 好了，没鞋子也没东西要拿了

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: That looks more comfortable
Much. The bag can wait until morning
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: 是的，包可以等到早上再说

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: At least take the lunch box out
There we go

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: So, how's the future graduate feeling today?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 那么，未来的毕业生今天感觉怎么样？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I can't wait to finally have my diploma in my hands
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 我迫不及待想要拿到我的毕业证了

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Easy to forget when he's always in sportswear
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 他总是穿运动服，真容易忘记

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I mostly want my summer body
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 我现在最想要的是我的夏天身材
