story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good, because this is the one you're getting during our film
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 好，因为这是你在我们看电影时要穿的

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No promises on that part
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 这部分就不敢保证了

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: As long as I get to sit beside you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 只要我能坐在你旁边就好

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's rather the point ❤️
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 这正是重点 ❤️

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm going to put my phone down before I find another reason to keep you awake
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我得放下手机，不然我又会找理由让你不睡觉

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good night, pretty girl
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 晚安，漂亮女孩

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good night, handsome
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 晚安，帅哥

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And eat breakfast before I have to ask tomorrow
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 明天我还得问你，快吃早餐吧

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There she is
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 她来了

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I never left 😌
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我一直在这儿 😌

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: How's your leg after today?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 今天腿怎么样？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I ate, and I actually played for a while
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我吃过了，实际上玩了一会儿

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A bit tired, but I didn't push it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 有点累，但我没太勉强自己

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I liked getting outside, even if it wasn't exactly an adventure
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我喜欢出去走走，虽然不算冒险

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It doesn't have to be an adventure to be good
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 不一定要是冒险才好

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Listen to you being reasonable
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 听你说得这么有道理

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I've used a lot of courage today, I'm saving what's left
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 今天我用了很多勇气，剩下的留着用

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Speaking of which, tomorrow is arranged
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 说到这个，明天的安排好了

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: With the controls exactly where they were before?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 控制器的位置和之前完全一样吗？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: {{name:aiden}} finishes early enough, so we're meeting at the café near campus at half past three
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: {{name:aiden}} 提前结束，所以我们三点半在校园附近的咖啡馆见

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The one with the mismatched chairs
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 那个椅子不配的咖啡馆

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did he seem different when he messaged you?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 他发消息给你时看起来有变化吗？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A little more careful, maybe
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 可能小心了一点

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not awkward, just less determined to make a joke out of everything
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 不是尴尬，只是少了点想把一切都开玩笑的决心

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You might have surprised him
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你可能让他有点意外

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I definitely surprised myself
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我自己也吓了一跳

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was putting my things away when I remembered what I'd actually asked him
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我在收东西时突然想起我问了他什么

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And then I just stood in the hallway smiling at nothing
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 然后我就站在走廊里傻笑

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd have liked to see that
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我真想看看那样的你

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There is no need to bring that up again
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 没必要再提这个了

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No, you'd have asked what I was smiling about and made it worse
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 不，你肯定会问我在笑什么，搞得更糟

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Almost certainly
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 几乎可以肯定

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The strange part is that I already know him
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 奇怪的是，我已经认识他了

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Tomorrow I'll be looking at someone familiar and wondering whether he's about to say something I haven't heard before
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 明天我会看着一个熟悉的人，想知道他是不是要说我没听过的话

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's the part you're curious about?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你对这个部分好奇吗？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes, I think it is
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 是的，我觉得是

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not trying to turn him into a different person, I just want to see what this feels like when we stop pretending it's an ordinary lunch
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我不是想把他变成另一个人，我只是想看看当我们不再假装这是普通午餐时的感觉

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We're meeting at the café by the main shopping street at half past three
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我们在主购物街旁边的咖啡馆见面，三点半

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There is a little need
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 其实还是有点必要的

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I picked it because I know where it is and I won't have to spend the first ten minutes looking lost
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我选这个地方是因为我知道在哪里，这样我就不用花前十分钟找路了

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good choice
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 好选择

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And I'm going there on my own, no lifts from someone I haven't met yet
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 而且我会自己去，不想让一个我还没见过的人来接我

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Have you been talking much this evening?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 今晚你们聊得多吗？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A little before dinner
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 晚餐前聊了一点

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then I told him I was eating and would put the phone away
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 然后我告诉他我在吃饭，要把手机放下

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: How did he take that?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 他是怎么反应的？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Like a normal person who also has things to do
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 就像一个正常人一样，也有事情要做

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It sounds like such a small thing, but I liked not having to explain myself
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 这听起来像是小事，但我喜欢不需要解释自己

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Do you think you'll get along in person?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你觉得你们见面会合得来吗？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What did you make?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你做了什么？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I hope so, but that's why I want to meet instead of making up his entire personality from messages
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我希望如此，但这就是我想见面的原因，而不是通过信息来构建他的整个个性

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I don't know whether he's quiet at first or talks with his hands or laughs at his own jokes
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我不知道他一开始是安静，还是手舞足蹈，或者自己笑自己的笑话

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You already have someone who does the last one
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你已经有一个这样的人了

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes, and he keeps insisting they're excellent jokes
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 是的，他还一直坚持说那些是绝妙的笑话

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: They are
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 他们是

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: See? Completely unreasonable 😌
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 看吧？完全不讲理 😌

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like that there are things I don't know yet
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我喜欢还有我不知道的事情

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not enough to invite him into my life all at once, just enough to want a coffee
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 还没到让我一下子把他带入我的生活的地步，只是想约他喝咖啡而已

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: An omelet and a salad
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 一个煎蛋和一个沙拉

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay, your turn
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 好吧，轮到你了

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: My turn for what?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我轮到做什么？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What was the first thing you thought when I said I was actually meeting him tomorrow?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 当我说我明天真的要见他时，你第一个想到的是什么？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not the very supportive answer, the first one
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 不是很支持的答案，最初的那个

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Honestly? I smiled before I'd even finished reading
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 老实说？我在还没读完之前就笑了

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I want this, but it suddenly feels much more real
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我想要这个，但突然感觉变得更真实了

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That quickly?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 这么快？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah, especially because you sounded happy when you told me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 是啊，尤其是因为你告诉我的时候听起来很开心

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then I tried to think of something less obvious to say than how much I was smiling
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 然后我试着想一些不那么明显的说法，而不是我有多开心

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You could have just said that
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你可以直接这么说的

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What happened to all the pasta?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 意大利面都去哪了？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I didn't want to turn your entire afternoon into my reaction
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我不想把你整个下午都变成我的反应

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I still want to hear your reaction
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我还是想听听你的反应

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I don't want your part in this to be only asking whether I'm okay
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我不想你在这件事上只问我是否还好

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then yes, I'm excited, and I'm glad you wanted to ask him
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 那是的，我很兴奋，也很高兴你想去问他

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I did
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我做了

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And I like knowing you're sitting there smiling at your phone too ❤️
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我也喜欢知道你坐在那里对着手机微笑 ❤️

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Real in a bad way?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 是坏的那种真实吗？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not bad, just different from talking about some imaginary afternoon
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 还不错，只是和谈论一些虚构的下午不太一样

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm taking a break before the pasta and I start resenting each other
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我先休息一下，免得我和意大利面开始互相厌烦

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Now there's an actual time, and tomorrow you'll get ready and go
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 现在有了一个真实的时间，明天你就准备好出发吧

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I had that same little moment when I put it in my calendar
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 当我把它放进日历时，我也有那种小瞬间

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I still want you to go, I just didn't expect to notice the difference so much
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我还是希望你去，只是没想到会这么明显地感觉到不同

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Thank you for telling me instead of trying to sound completely relaxed
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 谢谢你告诉我，而不是试图表现得完全放松

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not asking you to talk me out of it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我不是让你劝我放弃这个

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我知道

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And I'm not going to spend tomorrow trying to give you a perfect story about it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我也不打算明天花时间给你讲一个完美的故事

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good, because I'd rather hear about your actual afternoon
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 很好，因为我更想听听你真实的下午

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then that's what you'll get ❤️
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 那你就会得到这个❤️

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Wait, here's proof I can make a different meal
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 等一下，这里有证据证明我能做不同的饭

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Getting back into sports actually felt really good
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: 重新开始运动感觉真的很好

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Isn't it more the flirting with {{name:aiden}} that felt good?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: 难道不是和{{name:aiden}}调情更让你觉得舒服吗？

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: I have no idea what you're talking about 😇
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: 我根本不知道你在说什么 😇

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: I'm just happy both of you are having fun
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: 我只是很高兴你们俩玩得开心

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: And get ready to see even more 😌
I had a really good session
I feel like I'm actually going to succeed
Succeed at getting Ethan into your bed, yeah
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: 成功把Ethan带到你床上，是吧

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: And yet you keep texting me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: 可你还是一直给我发信息

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: I need to rest after today
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: 今天之后我需要休息一下

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Because if you do, you’re being suspiciously quiet
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: 因为如果有的话，你就太安静了

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Then why haven’t you complimented me yet
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: 那你为什么还没夸我呢

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: I’m just extremely good at noticing when people are late with their compliments
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: 我只是特别擅长注意到别人什么时候迟到了夸奖

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Anyway I’m bored out of my mind
Why aren’t you getting ready for university?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: 你怎么还不准备去上大学？

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Because the year is basically over
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: 因为这一年基本上快结束了

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: I don’t technically need to show up anymore
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: 我其实不需要再去上课了

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: So I’m taking my well-deserved freedom very seriously
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: 所以我非常认真地享受我的自由

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: It’s not skipping if there’s nothing left to learn
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: 如果没什么好学的，那就不算跳过了
我现在是个自由的女人

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: And a free woman is currently very bored
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: 而且一个自由的女人现在非常无聊

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: I’ve been in bed too long
Or I’ll start posting worse stories just to force you to react
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: 不然我就开始发更糟的故事逼你反应

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: New day, same face, still cute 😌
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: 新的一天，还是那张脸，依然可爱 😌

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I almost opened the racing game instead of my lecture notes 😭
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 我差点打开赛车游戏而不是我的讲义 😭

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: What's up?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 怎么了？

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I have a presentation to prepare for university
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 我有一个大学的演讲要准备

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: The slides are mostly done, but I keep losing my place when I practise out loud
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 幻灯片大部分完成了，但我在大声练习时总是找不到位置

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Come over after your day. You can practise with me
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 你一天结束后过来吧。你可以和我一起练习

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You'd sit through it?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 你会耐心听完吗？

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Of course. What is it about?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 当然。是关于什么的？

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Customer loyalty. Why people keep going back to the same business
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 顾客忠诚度。为什么人们总是回到同一家店

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I can ask questions. Especially when you lose me
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 我可以问问题。尤其是当你让我迷糊的时候

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Please do. I'd rather find the confusing parts with you than in front of everyone
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 请这样做。我宁愿和你一起找出困惑的部分，而不是在大家面前

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Then bring your notes
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 那就带上你的笔记

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Already planning your comeback?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 已经在计划你的反击了吗？

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Okay ❤️
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 好的 ❤️

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: University, work, then you. That's my Monday sorted
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 大学、工作，然后是你。这就是我周一的安排

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Ready for the first part
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 准备好第一部分了

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Looking very prepared
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 看起来准备得很好

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: The bag has the notes. I just have to remember to use them
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 包里有笔记。我只需要记得使用它们

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You'll be fine
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 你会没事的

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You have to listen properly tonight, though
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 不过今晚你得认真听

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: No distracting me halfway through
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 不要在中途分散我的注意力

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'll save it for after
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 我会留到之后再说

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Maybe. But I remembered I actually have class this morning
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 也许吧。但我记得我今天早上有课

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I walked right into that one 😌
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 我正好走进了那个圈套 😌

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'll let you know when I can get away from work
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 我会告诉你我什么时候能抽身离开工作

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Have a good morning, love
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 早安，亲爱的

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You too ❤️
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 你也是 ❤️

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: The rematch can wait
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 复赛可以等一下

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I really liked playing with you yesterday
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 我真的很喜欢昨天和你一起玩

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You didn't make me feel stupid when I kept crashing
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 当我一直撞车时，你没有让我觉得自己很傻

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You were learning. And you got better
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 你在学习。而且你变得更好了

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I know. I want another try soon ❤️
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 我知道。我想很快再试一次 ❤️

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Any time
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 随时都可以

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Today I need a slightly different kind of help, though
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 不过今天我需要一种稍微不同的帮助

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: LATER THAT EVENING — {{name:lena}} has gone home. You have cleared the table before joining {{name:hailey}} on the sofa.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: 那个晚上 — {{name:lena}} 回家了。你收拾完桌子后，和 {{name:hailey}} 一起坐在沙发上。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Just come already before I eat everything
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: 快来吧，不然我就把所有的零食都吃光了

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: A bit later on the couch
What if I need to steal food from your plate?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: 万一我需要从你的盘子里偷点吃的呢？

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: You already stole half of it
The point is you’re being weirdly distant
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: 重点是你有点奇怪地保持距离

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I’m literally right next to you
Because I might fall asleep like this
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: 因为我可能会这样睡着
你现在基本上是我的囚徒了😌

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I even left space for you
Why are you texting me if you’re already in the living room?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: 你已经在客厅了，为什么还给我发信息？

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Quick update before I start work: I should be out at six
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 在我开始工作之前给你个快速更新：我应该六点钟就能出来

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I've rewritten the introduction during lunch
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 我在午餐时重写了介绍部分

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: It sounds less like I'm reading a textbook now
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 现在听起来不像是在读教科书了

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: We'll try it out when you get here
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 等你来了我们就试试

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: And I'll finally collect my other bag
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 我也终于可以拿回我的另一个包了

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: By bringing another one?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 带另一个过来吗？

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: A bag full of notes. They're different categories
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 一个装满笔记的包。它们是不同的类别

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Of course. I should have realised
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 当然。我应该早就意识到

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Don't worry. I'll leave with both this time 😌
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 别担心。这次我会把两个都带走的😌

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I'll put the old one by the door
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 我会把旧的放在门边

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Thanks, love. I need to go now
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 谢谢你，亲爱的。我现在得走了

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Want to come straight here?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 想直接过来吗？

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: See you tonight ❤️
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 今晚见❤️

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Yes. I'll stop for something to eat on the way
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 好的。我会在路上停下来吃点东西

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I'll have the table cleared for your notes
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 我会把桌子清理好，给你的笔记留地方

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: My very exclusive rehearsal venue
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 我非常独特的排练场地

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: One seat. Very selective audience
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 一个座位。非常挑剔的观众

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: At least the audience already likes me
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 至少观众已经喜欢我了

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Very much
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 非常喜欢

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Good. Be useful as well as affectionate tonight ❤️
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 好哦。今晚要既有用又要亲热哦❤️

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I can manage both
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 我可以两者兼顾

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: You’re the one leaning on me
If you keep looking at me like that I’m going to do something
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: 如果你继续这样看着我，我就会做点什么

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: You’re really not scared of me huh

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: 我会让你看看什么叫说说而已

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: HAK archived evidence of first consensual kiss between {{name:hailey}} and {{name:player}}
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: HAK记录了{{name:hailey}}和{{name:player}}之间第一次自愿亲吻的证据

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: I don't need HAK to tell me that kiss meant something to me.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: 不用HAK告诉我，我也知道那个吻对我意义非凡。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: HAK archived evidence of first consensual kiss between {{name:hailey}} and {{name:player}}
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: HAK记录了{{name:hailey}}和{{name:player}}之间第一次自愿亲吻的证据

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: HAK archived evidence of first consensual kiss between {{name:hailey}} and {{name:player}}
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: HAK记录了{{name:hailey}}和{{name:player}}之间第一次自愿亲吻的证据

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: Now you’re stuck with the consequences
You’re not the one who just made the first move
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: 可你才不是那个刚出手的人呢

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: You pull her back for a longer kiss
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: 你把她拉回来，亲了更久

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: HAK archived evidence of prolonged consensual kiss
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: HAK 记录了长时间的同意亲吻证据

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: I want to stay in this moment with her, without rushing whatever comes next.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: 我想和她停留在这一刻，不急着推进接下来的事。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: HAK archived evidence of prolonged consensual kiss
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: HAK 记录了长时间的同意亲吻证据

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: HAK archived evidence of prolonged consensual kiss
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: HAK 记录了长时间的同意亲吻证据

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: We’re definitely not going back to normal after this
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: 这下我们绝对回不去正常了

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: What can i do when you do that face
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: 当你做那个表情时我该怎么办

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: You’re still bad at smooth answers
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: 你还是不太会说甜言蜜语

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: I’m going to bed before I start something we won’t stop
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: 我得去睡觉了，不然我们会开始一些停不下来的事情

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: Try not to miss me too much 😌

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: 我可能会开始利用这个

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: HAK archived evidence of elevated emotional response during close contact
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: HAK记录了在近距离接触时情感反应增强的证据

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: HAK archived evidence of elevated emotional response during close contact
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: HAK记录了在近距离接触时情感反应增强的证据

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: HAK archived evidence of elevated emotional response during close contact
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: HAK记录了在近距离接触时情感反应增强的证据

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: EARLY EVENING — It is half past six. You are at home, waiting to hear from {{name:lena}} after work.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 傍晚——现在是六点半。你在家等着{{name:lena}}下班后联系你。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Without looking down once 😌
That's good. Keep the question at the start
Already written in very large letters
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 已经用很大的字写好了

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Everything packed away. I'm done studying for tonight
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 一切都收拾好了。今晚的学习结束了

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You earned the break
Thank you for tonight. The useful part AND the part on the sofa ❤️
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 谢谢你今晚的陪伴。实用的部分和沙发上的部分都很棒 ❤️

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I enjoyed both
So did I. Especially the part after I closed the laptop
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 我也是，尤其是我关掉笔记本后的那部分

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Now I'm getting ready for bed before I start rehearsing the whole thing again
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 现在我准备上床睡觉，免得再开始排练一遍

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Understood. The floor is yours.
Goodnight, love
Goodnight ❤️

{{name:lena}} opens her slides and starts her presentation. You listen as she explains how quality, convenience and personal service can encourage customers to return. Halfway through, she pauses and looks down at her notes.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: {{name:lena}} 打开她的幻灯片，开始她的演示。你听着她解释质量、便利和个人服务如何能鼓励顾客回头。进行到一半时，她停下来，低头看着她的笔记。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: This is where I always get stuck.
Can I ask something?
Yes. That's what you're here for.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 是的。你就是来问问题的。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: If two places sell the same thing for the same price, what makes someone choose one over the other?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 如果两个地方卖同样的东西，价格也一样，是什么让人选择其中一个而不是另一个？

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: The experience. Whether it's easy to shop there, whether the staff help you...
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 体验。购物是否方便，员工是否乐于助人……

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That makes sense. Why not start that section with the question?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 这很有道理。为什么不以问题开始那一部分呢？

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Instead of that long definition?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 而不是那段冗长的定义？

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Yeah. Give me an example first, then explain it.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 好的。先给我一个例子，然后再解释一下。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm out. Getting our food, then coming straight over ❤️
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 我出门了。去拿我们的食物，然后直接过来❤️

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Wait. Let me write that down.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 等一下。让我把这个写下来。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: She adds the question to her notes and tries the section again, using two neighbourhood cafes as an example. This time, she gets through it without stopping.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 她把问题加到笔记里，然后再次尝试这个部分，用两个附近的咖啡馆作为例子。这次，她顺利完成了，没有停下来。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I followed all of that.
Was it too simple?
No. I understood what you meant. Then the definition made more sense.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 没有。我明白你的意思了。然后定义就更清楚了。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Okay. That's actually helpful.
Actually?
Don't ruin your good work.
20 MINUTES LATER — {{name:lena}} finishes the presentation, checks the time and closes her laptop. You ask one last question about her conclusion, and she answers without looking at her notes.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 20分钟后 — {{name:lena}} 完成了演讲，查看时间并合上了她的笔记本。你问了她结论的最后一个问题，她没有看笔记就回答了。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That felt much better.
How was work?
You looked up more on the second try, too.
You were looking right at me every time I did.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 每次我看你时，你都在看我。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You asked for an attentive audience.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 你要求有一个专注的观众。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I did. And I liked having one.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 我确实这样做了。我喜欢有这样的观众。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Thank you for taking it seriously.
{{name:lena}} moves beside your chair and bends down to kiss you
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: {{name:lena}} 走到你椅子旁边，俯下身来吻你。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: After the Rehearsal
You were waiting for me to close that laptop, weren't you?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 你在等我关掉那台笔记本电脑，对吧？

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I was following the rules. No kissing until you finished.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 我在遵守规则。你完成之前不可以亲吻。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Very disciplined of you.
Busy enough that I didn't have time to worry about the presentation
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 忙得连担心演示的时间都没有

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Can I stop pretending I'm just someone in the audience now?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 我可以不再假装自己只是观众了吗？

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Please do.
You didn't need a presentation to have a reason to come over.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 你不需要演示就有理由过来。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I know. But I did need to practise it.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 我知道。但我确实需要练习。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And I wanted to spend the evening with you. This worked out nicely.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 我想和你一起度过这个晚上。这真不错。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: It did.

25 MINUTES LATER — After eating, you move to the sofa. {{name:lena}} sits close beside you, leaving room for your recovering leg. Your arm settles around her shoulders, and she turns toward you for another kiss.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 25分钟后 — 吃完饭后，你们移到沙发上。{{name:lena}} 坐得很近，给你恢复的腿留了空间。你的手臂环绕着她的肩膀，她转向你，准备再来一个吻。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Much better than the table.
The table wasn't that bad.
I couldn't sit like this there.
I've got our sandwiches. See you in a little while
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 我拿到了我们的三明治。稍后见

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Come here, then.
After the Sandwiches
Your hand is wandering.
You can tell me to stop.
I didn't say stop. Higher.
Hands Where She Put Them
And the other one?
You can have that too. Under. I already decided.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 你也可以这样。下面。我已经决定了。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You're making it very difficult to keep the evening polite.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 你让这个晚上保持礼貌变得很困难。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: The presentation is over. I don't need polite.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 演示结束了。我不需要客气。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: See you soon
My turn too.
You don't have to.
I know. I want to. Open your jeans.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 我知道。我想这样。把你的牛仔裤拉开。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Her Hand
Tell me if that's too much.
It isn't.
On the Sofa
There. That was the point.
You look very pleased with yourself.
I am. You can thank me later
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 我确实是。你可以稍后感谢我。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: A LITTLE LATER — {{name:lena}} arrives at your place with her notes and a bag of food. You greet her with a kiss, put the sandwiches in the kitchen and sit together at the table.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 稍后 — {{name:lena}} 带着她的笔记和一袋食物到你家。你亲吻她，放下三明治在厨房，然后一起坐在桌子旁。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: 25 MINUTES LATER — After cleaning up, she nestles against you
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 25分钟后 — 收拾完后，她依偎在你身边。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Comfortable?
Yes. Are you?
Very.
Then stop moving away to talk.
I was going to ask about your day.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 我本来想问问你今天过得怎么样。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: How was university?
Fine. Though I spent lunch rewriting that introduction instead of eating properly.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 还不错。不过我午餐时花时间重写了那个介绍，没好好吃。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: So the sandwich was important.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 所以那个三明治很重要。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Very important. Thank you for helping with the presentation before I got distracted.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 非常重要。谢谢你在我分心之前帮我准备演示。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Okay. I need you to pretend you're not my boyfriend for ten minutes.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 好吧。我需要你假装不是我的男朋友十分钟。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You did most of the work before you came here.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 你在来这里之前做了大部分工作。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You helped me say it out loud. That's the part I needed.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 你帮我把它说出来。那正是我需要的部分。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: 20 MINUTES LATER — Later, {{name:lena}} checks the time and gathers her notes. She puts her laptop away, picks up both bags and joins you by the door.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 20分钟后 — 此后，{{name:lena}} 查看时间并整理她的笔记。她收起笔记本，拿起两个包，来到你身边。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Both bags accounted for?
Yes. I'm leaving you with absolutely no administrative reason to invite me back.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 是的。我让你完全没有理由再邀请我回来。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I think I'll manage without one.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 我想我可以不需要一个。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I was hoping you would.
{{name:lena}} sets the bags down for a moment and steps back toward you. She kisses you goodbye, one hand resting on your shoulder while your arm wraps around her waist.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: {{name:lena}}暂时放下包，向你靠近。她吻别你，一只手搭在你的肩膀上，而你的手臂环绕着她的腰。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: One More Before Leaving
Okay. Now I'm really going.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 好吧。现在我真的要走了。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That's a difficult opening request.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 这是个难以开口的请求。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Text me when you get home.
I will. Love you.
Love you too.
{{name:lena}} picks up both bags and leaves. You tidy the table and settle in for the rest of the evening.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: {{name:lena}}拿起两个包离开。你整理桌子，准备好享受剩下的晚上。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: 20 MINUTES LATER — {{name:lena}} IS HOME
Home ❤️ Both bags made it
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 到家了❤️ 两个包都带到了

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Excellent. Any forgotten notes?
No. I checked twice
And I tried that difficult section again while I was unpacking
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 而且我在 unpacking 的时候又尝试了那个难的部分。

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: How did it go?
An ordinary person in the audience, then. Who isn't allowed to kiss me until I'm finished.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 那就当我是观众中的普通人吧。直到我完成之前不允许亲吻我。

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I have a session later this morning
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 我今天早上还有一节课

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: He moved it earlier than usual
Just that it worked better for his schedule
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 只是说这样对他的日程更合适

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I'm going to get ready slowly
I made some breakfast for you too
I kept waking up for no reason
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 我一直无缘无故地醒来

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Then I just stayed in bed staring at the ceiling like an idiot
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 然后我就傻傻地躺在床上盯着天花板

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: It's just one of those mornings where the brain thinks too much
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 就是那种早晨，脑子想太多

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ Do you need me to pick anything up for tonight?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 嘿❤️ 你今晚需要我帮你买点什么吗？

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Kept waking up, but I'll be fine once I'm moving
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 一直醒来，但我一动就没事了

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: How about you?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 你呢？

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Pretty well, and I made it down to the mailbox and back this morning
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 挺好的，今天早上我去了一趟邮箱又回来了

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Bet it felt good not having to ask someone else
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我敢打赌，自己去拿的感觉真不错

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It did, even if all I collected was junk mail
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 确实不错，尽管我收的全是垃圾邮件

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: A disappointing prize for all that effort 😭
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 为了这些努力得到的奖品真让人失望😭

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll survive
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我会活下去的

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: What's on the menu tonight?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 今晚的菜单是什么？

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Chicken and rice, nothing that needs an instruction manual
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 鸡肉和米饭，没什么需要说明书的

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I can manage that
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我可以搞定这个

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Just yourself, I've got the rest
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 只要你自己就好，我会搞定其他的

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I got the lemonade you like too
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我也买了你喜欢的柠檬水

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You remembered?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 你记得吗？

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You always look for it when you're here
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 你每次来这里都要找这个

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's really sweet ❤️
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 真甜❤️

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm bringing dessert, let me do that part
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我带了甜点，让我来做这部分

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm not going to argue with dessert
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我可不想和甜点争论

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Excellent, one decision made without a fight
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 太好了，终于有一个决定没有争吵

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Still around six?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 还是六点左右吗？

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yeah, I finish at five. I'll stop on the way and come straight over
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 对，我五点结束。路上停一下，直接过来

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll be here
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我会在这里

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You didn't have to do everything
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 你不需要做所有事情的

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm glad we're doing this tonight
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我很高兴今晚我们能这样

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Me too
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我也是

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I should finish getting ready before I manage to be late
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我得赶紧准备好，免得迟到

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You're not ready yet?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 你还没准备好？

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Almost, I've been standing here with one earring in while talking to you 😭
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 差不多了，我一边和你说话一边只戴着一只耳环😭

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: A few minutes later, before she leaves...
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 几分钟后，在她离开之前...

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: There, both earrings and everything 😊
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 好了，两个耳环都戴上了😊

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You look lovely
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 你看起来很美

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Thank you ❤️
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 谢谢 ❤️

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It's dinner, not a wedding 😭
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 这只是晚餐，不是婚礼😭

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Have a good day
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 祝你有美好的一天

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You too, and don't eat all the good bits before I get there
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 你也是，别在我到之前把好东西都吃光了

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: No promises about the crispy edges
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 关于脆边的事可没保证哦

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Save me some or I'm keeping the dessert 😌
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 留点给我，不然我就把甜点全拿走了😌

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Love you, see you tonight
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 爱你，今晚见

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Love you too
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我也爱你

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I know, I just wanted to help
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我知道，我只是想帮忙

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You can help me eat it
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 你可以帮我吃掉它

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That part I'm very qualified for 😌
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 这部分我非常擅长😌

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good morning, by the way
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 顺便说一句，早安

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good morning handsome ❤️ I went straight into planning mode
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 早安，帅哥❤️ 我马上就进入了计划模式

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Did you sleep okay?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 你睡得好吗？

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Hey 😊 Quick important question before I go back: apple tart or chocolate?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 嘿😊 回去之前问你个重要问题：苹果塔还是巧克力？

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'll let you finish then
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 那我等你完成

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'll text you when I leave ❤️
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我离开时会发信息给你❤️

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Shortly before five, in the manager's office...
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 快到五点了，在经理办公室里...

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Office conversation detected near {{name:lena}}
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 在{{name:lena}}附近检测到办公室对话

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm supposed to be looking forward to seeing {{name:lena}} tonight. Instead, every update from that office pulls me back to last night.
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我本该期待今晚见到{{name:lena}}，可那间办公室的每一条更新，都把我拉回昨晚。

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//LIVE TRANSCRIPTION
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//实时转录

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Finished?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 完成了吗？

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: The updated totals are in your inbox, and the signed copies are in this folder
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 更新的总数在你的收件箱里，签名的副本在这个文件夹里

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Bring them over, I don't bite
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 把它们拿过来，我不会咬人

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I can leave a folder on a desk without instructions
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我可以把文件夹放在桌子上而不需要说明

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: There she is. You've hardly said a word to me all day
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 她来了。你今天几乎没跟我说过话

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I've been thinking about how last night ended
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我一直在想昨晚是怎么结束的

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Apple tart
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 苹果塔

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: So have I
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我也是

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Not like that
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 不是那样的

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're going to tell me you didn't enjoy it?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 你是要告诉我你不喜欢吗？

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I did. That's not the problem
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我喜欢。这不是问题

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I went home and talked to him like nothing had happened
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我回家后跟他聊得像什么都没发生过一样

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It was a kiss, not a marriage proposal
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 那只是个吻，不是求婚

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He wouldn't see it that way
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 他不会这么想的

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He wasn't there
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 他不在那儿

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That doesn't make it better
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 这并不能让事情变得更好

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You weren't nearly this worried outside the bar
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 你在酒吧外面可没这么担心

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Good, that's what I was hoping you'd say
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 好呀，我就希望你这么说

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I should've been
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我应该担心的

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And I kissed you back that even worse
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 而且我还回吻了你，真是更糟糕

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then stop trying to talk yourself out of having enjoyed it
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 那就别再试图说服自己不喜欢它了

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm not. I just feel bad about what i did and that I'm keeping it from him
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我不是。我只是对我所做的感到内疚，还在瞒着他

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Who cares what he thinks? You kissed me, and you liked it. That's all that matters
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 他怎么想不重要。你吻了我，而且你喜欢。这才是最重要的

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I don't want to hurt him
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我不想伤害他

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You won't. You can still be with him and have a good time with me
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 你不会的。你可以和他在一起，同时和我玩得开心

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I don't know if I can do that
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我不知道我能不能做到

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You can. You just have to want to
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 你可以的。你只需要想要这样做

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Come have a drink with me when you're done
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 等你忙完了，来和我喝一杯吧

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Was this ever really a choice?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 这真的是个选择吗？

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: No, I'm seeing him tonight
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 不，我今晚要见他

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Dinner?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 晚餐？

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Dinner and a film. I told him I'd be there around six
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 晚餐和电影。我跟他说我大约六点到

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Very domestic
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 真是很家庭化呢

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It's something I want to do, you don't have to make it sound boring
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 这是我想做的事，你不用把它说得那么无聊

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You can see me another night
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 你可以改天再见我

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You could try not deciding that for me
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 你可以试着别替我决定

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know you'd have a good time
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我知道你会玩得很开心

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You never get tired of hearing yourself, do you?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 你从来不厌倦听自己说话，是吧？

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Not when I'm right
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我没错的时候可不厌倦

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You were allowed to agree with me 😌
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 你可以同意我的意见的😌

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm leaving now
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我现在要走了

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You know where to find me
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 你知道在哪里能找到我

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I work here. It would be difficult not to
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我在这里工作，不可能不见到你

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: {{name:lena}} picks up her bag and moves toward the office door
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: {{name:lena}} 拿起她的包，朝办公室门口走去

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Her manager look at her ass as she leaves
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 她的经理在她离开时盯着她的屁股

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Visual capture archived
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 视觉捕捉已归档

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: She's leaving, and I finally let out the breath I've been holding. Even now, I hate the way he watches her go.
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 她要走了，我终于吐出一直憋着的那口气。可就连现在，我仍然讨厌他目送她离开的眼神。

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//通知

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Leaving on Time
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 准时离开

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: At five, outside the office...
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 五点，在办公室外...

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Five o'clock, I'm out ❤️
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 五点，我要出门了 ❤️

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: All finished?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 都完成了吗？

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Enough for today, I've left the rest where it belongs
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 今天就够了，我把剩下的留在该留的地方

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: At work?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 在工作吗？

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: How's your afternoon going?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 你下午过得怎么样？

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Where it can bother someone else for an hour 😌
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 让别人烦恼一个小时的地方 😌

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Stopping for the tart, then coming over
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 停下来买个挞，然后过来

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Take your time, the food isn't on yet
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 慢慢来，食物还没上呢

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: After a quick stop at the bakery...
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 在面包店快速停留后...

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: They had two slices left. I consider that excellent planning
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 他们只剩下两片了。我觉得这真是个好计划

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You got lucky
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 你运气不错

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Please don't ruin my very organised girlfriend image 😭
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 别毁了我非常有条理的女朋友形象 😭

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Keep the box upright, that's all I'm asking
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 把盒子竖着放就好，我就这个要求

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It's getting a better seat on the bus than I am
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 它在公交车上比我坐得还好

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Nearly through the last batch of paperwork
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 快完成最后一批文件了

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: See you around six ❤️
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 六点见 ❤️

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: See you soon
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 待会见

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Still leaving at five, I'm not letting a folder steal our evening
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 还是五点离开，我可不想让文件抢了我们的晚上

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I haven't started cooking yet, you've got time
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我还没开始做饭，你还有时间

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know, I just want to get out on time for once
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我知道，我只是想这次准时下班

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: What are you planning to do once the exams are finally over?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 考试结束后你打算做什么？

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I haven't really thought that far ahead yet
But the first thing will probably be sleeping until my body forces me to get up
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 不过第一件事可能就是睡到身体逼我起床

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: That would be a nice change
I have spent so much time stressed that I almost forgot what free time is supposed to feel like
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 我花了太多时间在压力中，几乎忘了闲暇时光应该是什么感觉

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: You'll remember pretty quickly once it's over
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 一旦结束你会很快记起来的

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I'm kind of looking forward to being completely useless for a while
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 我有点期待能完全无所事事一阵子

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: {{name:evelyn}} cooked something that actually smells decent
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: {{name:evelyn}} 做的东西闻起来还不错

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Come eat before she starts giving me that look
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 快来吃，不然她又要给我那个眼神了

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Come eat before she starts giving me that look
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 快来吃，不然她又要给我那个眼神了

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: We are sitting down for dinner with {{name:evelyn}}. Are you joining us?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 我们和 {{name:evelyn}} 一起吃晚饭。你要来吗？

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I've already eaten with {{name:lena}}. She's gone home now, so I'll come say hello.
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 我已经和 {{name:lena}} 吃过了。她现在回家了，我去跟你打个招呼。

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: You're in a great mood tonight
Just wanted to annoy you a little

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ I'm downstairs, and your dessert survived the bus
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 嘿 ❤️ 我在楼下，你的甜点还活着

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Her phone goes back into her bag. When you pull the blanket over her feet, she turns toward you instead of the screen. "What?" you ask. "Nothing. Come here." She rests her head against you and holds your hand under the blanket. It takes a nudge from you before she notices the film has already started.
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 她的手机又放回包里。当你把毯子拉到她的脚上时，她转向你，而不是屏幕。"怎么了？"你问。"没什么，过来。"她把头靠在你身上，握着你在毯子下的手。你轻轻一推，她才注意到电影已经开始了。

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: 80 MINUTES LATER — You spend the film close together, occasionally arguing about whether the lead actor is meant to be funny. When the credits roll, she stays for another few minutes before getting her things. At the door, she gives you a longer hug, promises to text when she is home, and heads for the bus.
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 80分钟后 — 你们一起看电影，偶尔争论主角是不是应该搞笑。片尾字幕结束时，她再待了几分钟才收拾东西。在门口，她给了你一个更长的拥抱，承诺回家后会发信息给你，然后朝公交车走去。

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: 20 MINUTES LATER — {{name:lena}} IS HOME
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 20分钟后 — {{name:lena}} 回家了。

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm home ❤️ Thank you for tonight
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我回家了❤️ 谢谢你今晚的陪伴

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did you get back okay?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你回去还好吗？

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah, got a seat and almost fell asleep before my stop 😭
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 嗯，坐到了座位，差点在我下车前就睡着了😭

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You left your hair tie on the sofa
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你把发带落在沙发上了

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Keep it, I'll need an excuse to steal that cushion again
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 留着吧，我需要个借口再去抢那个垫子

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You don't need an excuse
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你根本不需要借口

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What about you?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你呢？

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know ❤️
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我知道 ❤️

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You went quiet a couple of times tonight
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 今晚你有几次沉默了

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Sorry, I had a lot on my mind
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 抱歉，我心里有很多事

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did I do something?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我做错什么了吗？

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No, you didn't do anything wrong, your perfect
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 没有，你没有做错什么，你很完美

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was really happy to be there with you
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我真的很高兴能和你在一起

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was happy you came
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我很高兴你来了

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Me too, I'd missed being next to you instead of watching from my end of a screen
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我也是，我想念坐在你旁边，而不是在屏幕另一端看

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Much easier for you to steal the blanket
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你偷毯子可容易多了

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That too 😌
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 那也是😌

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Less impressive condition, but still edible
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 状态没那么好，但还是能吃

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And I liked your film, even if I still don't think that man was meant to be funny
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我喜欢你的电影，尽管我还是觉得那个男人不应该搞笑

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You laughed more than I did
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你笑得比我还多

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Mostly at you laughing at him
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 主要是因为你在笑他

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll take it
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我接受

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The dinner was really good too ❤️
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 晚餐也很好吃❤️

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Even without all my chicken on your plate?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 就算没有我盘子里的鸡肉？

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don't start, I took one piece 😭
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 别开始了，我只拿了一块😭

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Get some sleep, you looked ready to fall asleep on me
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 去睡吧，你看起来快要在我身上睡着了

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I nearly did. It was nice not having to go anywhere for a while
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我差点就睡着了。能不去任何地方真不错

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We'll do it again
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我们再来一次

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: AVAILABLE 😭
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 可用 😭

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd like that
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我喜欢这个！

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good night handsome, love you ❤️
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 晚安，帅哥，爱你❤️

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Love you too, sleep well
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我也爱你，睡个好觉

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm opening the door before you make it worse
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我在你搞得更糟之前开门

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Please do
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 请这样做

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Around six, you open the door. {{name:lena}} sets the pastry bag down and wraps both arms around you before you've finished saying hello. She kisses your cheek and stays against you for another moment, then steps inside.
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 大约六点，你开了门。{{name:lena}} 放下糕点袋，双臂环绕着你，直到你还没说完你好。她亲吻了你的脸颊，依偎在你身边片刻，然后走了进去。

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: 20 MINUTES LATER — Over dinner, you pour the lemonade you bought for her. She looks at the bottle, then at you. "You even put it in the fridge," she says. "I thought warm lemonade might get a bad review." She smiles, but goes quiet for a moment before reaching across the table for your hand.
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 20分钟后 — 吃晚饭时，你给她倒了你买的柠檬水。她看着瓶子，然后看着你。"你居然把它放进冰箱了，"她说。"我还以为温的柠檬水会被差评呢。"她微笑着，但在伸手握住你的手之前沉默了一会儿。

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The conversation loosens over dinner. She tells you about her morning and steals a piece of chicken from your plate while you answer. When you notice, she insists that yours had the crispy edge she was promised. When you set out the two slices of tart, she laughs at your attempt to decide which one is bigger.
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 晚餐时气氛变得轻松。她告诉你她早上的事情，边说边从你的盘子里偷了一块鸡肉。当你注意到时，她坚持说你的那块有她期待的酥脆边。你把两片塔特放出来时，她笑着看你纠结哪一片更大。

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: 20 MINUTES LATER — After helping you clear the plates, she leaves her shoes beside the sofa and claims the good cushion. She takes the tie out of her hair as she settles beside you. Before the film starts, she leans against your shoulder and takes a photo of the two of you. She sends you a copy to keep.
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 20分钟后 — 在帮你收拾盘子后，她把鞋子放在沙发旁，抢了个好垫子。她把头发上的发带取下来，坐在你旁边。在电影开始前，她靠在你的肩膀上，给你们俩拍了一张照片。她发给你一份留作纪念。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I have to go buy some revision books with {{name:ethan}}
That’s just code for going to his place
No, I actually need the books
Funny how you only start working hard at the end of the year
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 有趣的是你总是在年末才开始努力

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: That’s what happens when you have a professor who knows how to motivate 😌
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 这就是有个会激励你的教授的结果 😌

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I’ll probably just rot in bed
{{name:aiden}} won’t even want to hang out with you anymore
I invited {{name:aiden}} over to hang out
All sore, messy hair, looking half dead
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 全身疼，头发乱糟糟的，像个半死不活的样子

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Hey 😊 I woke up before my alarm and now half past three feels about a week away
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 嘿 😊 我比闹钟早醒了，现在感觉三点半还远得很

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I mostly want you to stop treating your own feelings like the least important part
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我主要是希望你不要把自己的感受当作最不重要的部分

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm trying
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我在努力

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I like that you want me to do this as me, not as some version of myself I have to invent
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我喜欢你希望我以真实的我来做这件事，而不是我必须虚构的某个版本

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's the girl I'm in love with
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 那就是我爱上的女孩

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That was unfairly sweet ❤️
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 这真是太甜了，不公平 ❤️

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Now I've forgotten what I was looking for before you made me smile at the kitchen table
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 现在我忘了在你让我在餐桌上微笑之前我在找什么了

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Keys?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 钥匙？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes, actually
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 是的，实际上

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Look at me, useful and charming
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 看看我，多么有用又迷人

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Let's not ruin it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 别让它变糟

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll text you when I'm getting ready later
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我准备好后会发信息给你

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Have a good morning. And eat before the meeting swallows your lunch break
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 早上好！在会议吞掉你的午餐时间之前记得吃点东西哦

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You really are stealing my job today
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 你今天真是抢了我的工作

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That looks considerably better than what I made
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 那看起来比我做的好太多了

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You could try putting something on the plate instead of eating over the sink
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 你可以试着把东西放在盘子里，而不是在水槽上吃

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You weren't here. You can't prove anything
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 你不在这儿，没法证明什么

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I know you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我知道你

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I have the group meeting this morning, then I'll come home and get changed
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我今天早上有个小组会议，之后我会回家换衣服

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Still wearing the dress from yesterday?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 还在穿昨天的裙子吗？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes. I'm refusing to start that decision again
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 是的，我不想再开始那个选择了

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I want to ask you something before I go, though
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 不过在我走之前，我想问你点事

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: What is it?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 怎么了？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You can go back to sleep. I'll wake you up in June
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 你可以继续睡，我六月再叫你

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: About today. About limits, I suppose
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 关于今天吧。关于界限，我想是这样。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: We've talked about what you want to know afterward, but not quite about this
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我们聊过你想知道的事，但这件事还没说到。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: When we said coffee, did we mean coffee and nothing else?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我们说喝咖啡，是不是就只喝咖啡？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: No. We picked somewhere for you to meet, not a rule about where the afternoon has to stop
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 不是的。我们只是选了个地方见面，并不是规定下午就要结束。

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: So if it goes well and I want to stay longer, I'm not supposed to come home just because that's all we mentioned?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 所以如果一切顺利，我想待久一点，那我就不能回家，只因为我们只提到这些？

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Of course not
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 当然不是。
