story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your photo is lovely, by the way
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 顺便说一下，你的照片真好看

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I knew you'd notice that one first ❤️
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我就知道你会先注意到那张 ❤️

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And your spoon
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 还有你的勺子

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Keep it safe. I'll expect a dramatic reunion
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 好好保管哦。我期待你们的重聚会很精彩

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You had two hours to tell me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你有两个小时的时间告诉我

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm going to meet {{name:aiden}} after I've dropped the container at home 😊
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我把容器放回家后要去见{{name:aiden}} 😊

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The arcade?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 去游戏厅？

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. He said it would be a shame to let your expert advice go to waste
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 没错。他说不让你的专业建议浪费掉太可惜了

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He doesn't know half of it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 他根本不知道一半的事情

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He's already warned me that one of the machines eats coins
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 他已经警告我有一台机器会吞硬币

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Useful. An excuse prepared before you arrive
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 有用。提前准备好的借口

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm allowing him exactly one
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我只给他一个机会

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was busy trying to watch it while you accused everybody of something
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我正忙着看电影，而你却在指责每个人

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Generous
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 真大方

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wanted to see him again, and doing something sounded nicer than another careful conversation over coffee
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我想再见他，做点事情比再喝咖啡聊得小心翼翼要好得多

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Go enjoy yourself. You don't need another briefing from me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 去享受吧。你不需要再听我说了

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. I've had enough instructions from the detective on the sofa 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 好吧。我已经受够了沙发上侦探的指示了 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: EARLY EVENING, OUTSIDE THE ARCADE
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 傍晚，游戏厅外

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Made it 🎮 You can hear this place from the pavement
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 到了 🎮 你从人行道上就能听到这个地方

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don't let him choose every game
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 别让他选每个游戏

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He's just arrived and pointed at a racing machine
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 他刚到，指着一台赛车

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Of course he has
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 当然是了

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was right about one person
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我对一个人是对的

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm putting my phone away. Wish me luck 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我把手机收起来了。祝我好运😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You won't need it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你根本不需要

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: INSIDE THE ARCADE
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 在游戏厅里

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You came prepared
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你准备得很充分

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: For what?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 为了什么？

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Sensible shoes. That's somebody expecting to win
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 穿着合适的鞋子。看来是个期待获胜的人

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's somebody who walked around a market this morning
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 那是个今天早上在市场逛过的人

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I brought you something, actually
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 其实我给你带了点东西

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A consolation prize already?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 已经准备好安慰奖了吗？

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A pastry. I can still eat it myself
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 一个点心。我自己也可以吃

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: After accusing all seven of them
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 在指责了他们七个人之后

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No, I'll accept the apology in advance
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 不，我提前接受你的道歉

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're making it very difficult to be thoughtful
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你让我很难表现得体贴

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Thank you. That was nice of you
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 谢谢你。你真好

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There. See how little effort that took?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 看吧。你看这需要多少的努力？

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Are you going to supervise every sentence tonight?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 今晚你要监督每一句话吗？

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Only the annoying ones
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 只有烦人的那些

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's most of my material
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 这几乎是我所有的素材

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You'll have to improvise
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你得即兴发挥了

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: AFTER THEIR FIRST GAME
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 他们第一场比赛后

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That first point didn't count
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 第一分不算数

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Thorough detective work
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 彻底的侦探工作

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The machine disagrees
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 机器不同意

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You hit it before I was ready
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你在我准备好之前就打了

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You were explaining how easy this was going to be
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你在解释这会有多简单

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was being welcoming
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我只是想让你放松

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You said you'd go easy on me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你说你会对我手下留情

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And clearly that was a mistake
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 显然那是个错误

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So you admit I won?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 所以你承认我赢了？

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I admit there's room for a second game
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我承认还有第二局的空间

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No. You picked the first machine. I pick the next one
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 不行。你选了第一台机器。我来选下一台

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Game finished
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 游戏结束

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: {{name:lena}} wins the first round
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: {{name:lena}} 赢得了第一轮

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: HAK//通知

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And yet you failed to notice me stealing the last bite of your pastry
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 然而你却没注意到我偷了你甜点的最后一口

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A Very Sore Loser
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 一个非常不甘心的输家

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: {{name:player}} put you up to this
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 是{{name:player}}给你出的主意吧

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He warned me you'd ask for another round if you lost
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 他警告我如果你输了你会要求再来一局

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm going to have a word with him
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我得和他谈谈

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: About knowing you too well?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 关于太了解你了？

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: About coaching the opposition
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 关于教对手

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I managed to hit a puck without either of you helping me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我居然在没有你们帮助的情况下打到了冰球

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You did. That last shot was good
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你做到了。最后那一击不错

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Sorry, could you repeat that? The machine was making noise
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 抱歉，你能再说一遍吗？机器在发出噪音

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don't push it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 别太过分哦

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I noticed. I let you have it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我注意到了。我让你吃了

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I might need a moment to appreciate it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我可能需要一点时间来欣赏一下

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll give you five seconds
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我给你五秒钟

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You really do count everything
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你真的是事事都要计较呢

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Can I take a picture with you? I'd like to send him one
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我可以和你拍张照吗？我想发给他一张

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Of course. Is the scoreboard going to be in it?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 当然可以。记分板会在里面吗？

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It wasn't. Excellent suggestion
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 没有。真是个好主意

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: At least give me a second to look less defeated
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 至少给我一秒钟，让我看起来不那么沮丧

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's what I'm choosing to believe
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我选择相信这是事实

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Too late. That's the face I want
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 太晚了。就是我想要的表情

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A MOMENT LATER
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 片刻之后

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He agreed to a photo. The expression is completely his own work
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 他同意拍照。这个表情完全是他自己的风格

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I recognize that face
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我认得那个脸

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He's blaming you for warning me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 他在怪你警告我

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Tell him I'm enjoying my retirement from listening to his excuses
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 告诉他我很享受不再听他借口的退休生活

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll spare him that one for now 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 这次就饶了他吧 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: AFTER SHE PUTS HER PHONE AWAY
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 她收起手机后

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Thank you for this afternoon ❤️
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 谢谢你今天下午的陪伴❤️

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: I know you won’t hurt her

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: 这对我来说真的很重要

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: But isn’t it weird for you?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: 但这对你来说不奇怪吗？

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: All of this… in front of you

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: 其实这让事情变得简单了

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: I couldn’t stop myself from taking it 😭
She wants cardio more than anything 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: 她比什么都想要有氧运动 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: I’m really happy with how it went 🔥
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: 我对这次的表现很满意🔥

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: She’s gonna get her money’s worth 😂
Something happened in the locker room when we were leaving
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: 我们离开更衣室时发生了一些事

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: She wanted to continue the session a bit more
So I had to take care of her 😌
Happy with the session or with {{name:hailey}}? 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: 对这次课程满意还是对{{name:hailey}}满意？😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: Man I never thought I’d have this kind of conversation with you about {{name:hailey}} 😭
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: 我从没想过会和你聊关于{{name:hailey}}的这种事 😭

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: But even if it’s weird… it’s kinda cool
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: 但即使有点奇怪… 也挺酷的

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: I’m coming over tomorrow for a game afternoon
I know you two have a crush on each other
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: 我知道你们两个互相有好感

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Hey 😊 I owe you a container lid. Somehow I've managed to bring that home as well 😭
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 嘿 😊 我欠你一个容器盖。不知道怎么的，我也把它带回家了 😭

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: That's considerably less noise than the arcade
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 这比游戏厅安静多了

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You have no idea. I've nearly got my hearing back. Other parts of me are less calm
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 你不知道。我快要恢复听力了。其他地方就没那么平静了

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You look happy
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 你看起来很开心

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I am ❤️ We're going to leave the phones alone for a bit
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 我很好❤️ 我们要暂时放下手机

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Talk later
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 稍后再聊

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: AFTER SHE PUTS HER PHONE AWAY
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 她收起手机后

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: LATER THAT NIGHT
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 那天晚上

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: If I stay like this much longer I'm going to forget I meant to leave
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 如果我再这样待下去，我就会忘记我本来是想离开的

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: That isn't an accident
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 这可不是意外

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Your shirt has ridden up
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 你的衬衫卷起来了

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I noticed. You can keep your hand there
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 我注意到了。你可以把手放在那里

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You're making it very hard to be the one who stands up first
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 你让我很难成为第一个站起来的人

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Then kiss me once more and then stand up. I'm not taking you to bed tonight
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 那就再吻我一下，然后站起来。我今晚不带你上床

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I wasn't going to ask
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 我本来不打算问的

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You were thinking it. So was I. That's why I'm saying it now
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 你在想这个。我也是。所以我现在才说出来

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: One last deep kiss on the sofa
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 在沙发上最后一个深吻

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: His hand at her waist, hers under the hem of his shirt
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 他的手放在她的腰上，她的手在他的衬衫下摆

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: This is moving quickly, and I want us to keep talking honestly about what feels right.
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 事情进展得很快，我希望我们继续坦诚聊聊，什么是彼此能接受的。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: HAK//通知

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I liked tonight
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 我喜欢今晚

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: The quieter part too?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 那安静的部分呢？

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: A LITTLE LATER, AT HOME
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 稍后，在家

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Especially that part. Your mouth. Your hands. All of it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 尤其是那部分。你的嘴。你的手。全部都是。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You can leave without trying to make a clever last remark, you know
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 你可以不必试图说出什么聪明的最后一句话就离开哦。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I was going to say I'd like to see you again
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 我本来想说我想再见你。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You can keep that one
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 你可以留着那个。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Message me tomorrow. We'll work something out
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 明天给我发消息。我们再想办法。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I will
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 好的，我会的。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: And take the pastry box. If you leave it here, I'll end up eating the rest
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 把糕点盒带走。如果你把它留在这里，我会吃掉剩下的。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: A very difficult responsibility
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 这可真是个艰巨的责任。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Somehow I think you'll cope
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 我觉得你会应付得来的。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: AFTER HE LEAVES
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 他离开后

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: {{name:player}}?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: {{name:player}}？

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: He's gone home. We ended up staying on the sofa much longer than we'd planned
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 他回家了。我们在沙发上待的时间比计划的要长得多。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Tea was a successful idea, then
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 那么，喝茶真是个成功的主意。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Very. We talked, sat close, and then I pulled him in
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 非常成功。我们聊了聊，坐得很近，然后我把他拉了过来。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: His hands were under my top. Mine were under his shirt. We kissed until I had to tell him we weren't going further tonight
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 他的手在我的上衣下。我的手在他的衬衫下。我们吻了很久，直到我不得不告诉他今晚不能再进一步。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: He finally stopped asking whether he was doing better than you
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 他终于不再问他是否比你做得更好了。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: That's a major breakthrough
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 这可是个重大突破。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Don't turn not competing into a competition 😭
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 别把不竞争变成竞争哦 😭

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I'm learning
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 我在学习

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: It felt different tonight. Less like we were trying to work out what was supposed to happen
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 今晚的感觉不一样。感觉不再像是在努力搞清楚应该发生什么。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Yes. I accidentally brought home his container lid
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 是的。我不小心把他的容器盖带回家了

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I wanted his hands on me, so I put them there. It didn't need another speech
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 我想要他的手在我身上，所以我就把它放在那里。没必要再说什么了。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You sound comfortable with that
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 听起来你对此很自在

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I am. A little flushed. And I'm glad I had this afternoon with you as well
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 我很自在。稍微有点脸红。很高兴今天下午和你在一起

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I'm on my own again. It was a lovely evening
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 我又一个人了。今晚真是美好的一晚

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You sound pleased
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 听起来你很高兴

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I am. Tired in a nice way, a bit warm still, and very glad I didn't spend my whole day watching the clock
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 我很高兴。累得很舒服，还有点热，真高兴我没有整天盯着钟表看

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Keep the details you want to keep. I'm glad you enjoyed yourself
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 保留你想保留的细节。我很高兴你玩得开心

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Thank you. I still want a few minutes with you before I sleep ❤️
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 谢谢你。在我睡觉前，我还想和你聊几分钟❤️

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You two are going to need an inventory
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 你们两个需要一个清单

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: LATER THAT NIGHT
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 那天晚上

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: A Reason to Smile
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 微笑的理由

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I finally put the app down 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 我终于放下了这个应用 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Did you manage to read any of the book?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 你有读到书里的内容吗？

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Some. Very little after we started talking about yesterday. Then even less after the photos
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 有一点。我们开始聊昨天后就读得更少了，看到照片后就更少了。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: He told me he was looking for an excuse not to leave the bookshop. And that he wanted his hands on me properly
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 他说他在找借口不离开书店，还想好好抱抱我。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: And you were trying to think of a reason to stay
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 而你在想留在那里的理由。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: He has my spoon. We're negotiating
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 他拿着我的勺子。我们在谈判呢

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Exactly. We seem to have sorted out that misunderstanding 😌❤️
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 没错。我们似乎解决了那个误会 😌❤️

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: The messages got much less cautious tonight
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 今晚的消息变得不那么小心了。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You didn't have to keep pretending you were only discussing the book?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 你不需要再假装只是在讨论书吗？

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: No. I told him I wanted to see him again. And not only talk
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 不，我告诉他我想再见他，不只是聊天。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: And we sent each other a couple more photos. Then a couple that were less innocent
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 然后我们又互发了几张照片，之后还有几张不那么无辜的。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: He agreed I could show you these two. The later ones stay between him and me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 他同意我可以给你看这两张，后面的就留给我和他了。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I could mediate
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 我可以当调解人

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: That's the smile that usually means you're pretending you haven't done anything
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 那是你通常假装没做过什么的微笑。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: He noticed it too. Very inconvenient for me. The strap wasn't helping my case
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 他也注意到了。这对我来说很不方便，那个带子没帮上忙。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: And this is the one he took and sent back
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 这是他拍的并发回来的那张。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You both look like you're enjoying the conversation
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 你们看起来都很享受这次对话。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: We were. Neither of us did much reading after that. I kept the last pictures for myself
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 我们是啊。之后我们都没怎么读书，我把最后的照片留给自己了。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: The poor book
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 可怜的书。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: It will recover. I'm not sure I will before tomorrow
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 它会恢复的。我不确定我能不能在明天之前恢复过来。

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Was it easier talking in messages?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 发消息聊天是不是更容易？

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You disputed a score displayed in numbers. I don't think you're qualified
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 你对显示的分数提出了异议。我觉得你不太合适

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: In some ways. I could think for a second without worrying that the silence looked strange
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 在某种程度上，我可以思考一会儿，而不用担心沉默会显得奇怪

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: But I also caught myself wanting to hear how he'd say something, not just read it. And wanting his hands instead of another photo
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 但我发现自己想听听他怎么说，而不仅仅是读出来。还想要他的手，而不是另一张照片

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: That sounds like a reason for another date
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 这听起来像是另一次约会的理由

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: It is. We'll talk tomorrow and choose a time
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 没错。我们明天再聊，选个时间

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: For tonight, I'm done changing between conversations
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 今晚，我不想再在对话间切换了

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I'd like a little time with you before I sleep ❤️
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 我想在睡觉前和你聊一会儿❤️

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I'm done messaging for tonight. I had a really nice evening
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 今晚我不想再发消息了。我度过了一个很愉快的晚上

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Did the book get much attention?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 那本书引起很多关注吗？

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Do you want sugar?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 你要糖吗？

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Not enough to pretend I've become a serious reader
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 还不够让我假装自己变成了一个认真读书的人

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I'll reserve judgment until you reach the next chapter
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 我会等你读到下一章再下判断

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Thank you. I'm keeping the rest of the details for myself tonight
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 谢谢你。今晚我会把其他细节留给自己

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: That's fine. How are you feeling?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 没关系。你感觉怎么样？

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Happy. A little too warm to sleep immediately. And ready to just talk to you for a minute ❤️
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 很开心。现在有点热，没法马上睡觉。还想和你聊一会儿❤️

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: One, please
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 来一份，谢谢

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Is that your way of arranging another visit?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 这是你安排再来一次的方式吗？

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: How was your evening after I left?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 我走后你的晚上过得怎么样？

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Quiet. I finished tidying up, then played for a while
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 很安静。我收拾完后玩了一会儿

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Did you get stuck thinking again?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 你又陷入思考了吗？

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: A little, but this afternoon helped more than sitting here trying to predict everything
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 有一点，但今天下午的活动比坐在这里试图预测一切要好得多

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: We still argued about the film, you still stole my food. Nothing felt forced
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 我们还是争论了电影，你还是偷了我的食物。没有任何事情是勉强的

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: It wasn't. I was exactly where I wanted to be
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 不是的。我正好在我想要的地方

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I know. You nearly fell asleep on me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 我知道。你差点在我面前睡着了

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: That was a compliment to the sofa
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 那是对沙发的赞美

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Obviously
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 显然

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: See? A preference. Very impressive
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 看吧？有偏好哦。真厉害

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You sound like you've had a very good day
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 听起来你今天过得很不错呢

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I have. Was yours all right after I left?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 我过得很好。你离开后还好吗？

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Yes. Quieter, but I liked having the afternoon with you
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 是的。安静了些，但我喜欢和你一起度过的下午

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I keep remembering you trying to move my arm without admitting you wanted to lean on it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 我一直记得你试图移动我的手臂，却不承认你想靠在上面

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Your elbow was taking up a completely unreasonable amount of space
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 你的肘部占据了完全不合理的空间

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I'll arrange it more conveniently next time
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 下次我会更方便地安排

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Please do. I'm a demanding guest
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 请这样做。我可是个挑剔的客人哦

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I'm glad today wasn't just yesterday with different clothes
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 我很高兴今天不是穿着不同衣服的昨天

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You saved that one all the way from yesterday
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 你这招是从昨天就留着的吧

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: We should put that in the calendar. Occasionally do something else
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 我们应该把这个记在日历上，偶尔做点别的

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You could even let me choose the next film without a formal appeal
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 你甚至可以让我选择下一部电影，不用正式请求

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Let's not get carried away
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 别太过火哦

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I love you, you know ❤️
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 你知道我爱你哦❤️

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I love you too
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 我也爱你

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Now I'm going to get into bed before I start typing with my eyes closed
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 现在我要上床了，不然我就要闭着眼睛打字了

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: A FEW MINUTES LATER
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 几分钟后

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Made it 😊 This one is just for you
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 成功了😊 这个是专门给你的

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: That's my favorite end to the day
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 这是我一天中最喜欢的结束方式

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I've been waiting for the right moment
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 我一直在等合适的时机

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Seeing me finally stop talking?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 终于看到我不再说话了？

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Seeing you look happy
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 看到你开心的样子

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Oh. Now I have to be nice instead of making another joke
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 哦。现在我得变得温柔，而不是再开个玩笑了

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You can manage one message
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 你可以管理一条消息

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Good night, handsome ❤️ Thank you for today
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: 晚安，帅哥❤️ 谢谢你今天的陪伴

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Good night. I'll keep your side of the sofa ready

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: His hand settles at her waist under the blanket

Otherwise I’m going to be late ⏳
Text me when you’re on your break
Try to have a good morning and enjoy your shower
story/DAY2/DAY2_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: 祝你早上好，享受你的淋浴！

story/DAY2/DAY2_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: I will try love you good luck

story/DAY2/DAY2_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: 我已经不再真正睡觉了。

story/DAY2/DAY2_02_EVELYN_CHECK.json::st.translation: 我刚才接到了一个电话

story/DAY2/DAY2_02_EVELYN_CHECK.json::st.source: It’s about the financial support situation
story/DAY2/DAY2_02_EVELYN_CHECK.json::st.translation: 这是关于财务支持情况的。
他们正在审查这个案件
我今天晚些时候会知道更多。

story/DAY2/DAY2_02_EVELYN_CHECK.json::st.source: You don’t have to handle everything alone
story/DAY2/DAY2_02_EVELYN_CHECK.json::st.translation: 你不必独自处理所有事情

story/DAY2/DAY2_02_EVELYN_CHECK.json::st.source: We’ll talk about it properly tonight
For now just focus on your day
Except for my whole body no
Be patient, a few more days and it should start improving
story/DAY2/DAY2_02_EVELYN_CHECK.json::st.translation: 耐心点，再过几天情况应该会开始好转。

story/DAY2/DAY2_02_EVELYN_CHECK.json::st.source: I know, thank you for caring so much
story/DAY2/DAY2_02_EVELYN_CHECK.json::st.translation: 我知道，谢谢你这么关心。
这很正常，这是我的责任。

story/DAY2/DAY2_02_EVELYN_CHECK.json::st.source: By the way I might have some concerning news
story/DAY2/DAY2_02_EVELYN_CHECK.json::st.translation: 顺便说一下，我可能有一些令人担忧的消息。

story/DAY2/DAY2_03_LENA_BREAK.json::step.source: I might have way too much time to do nothing
story/DAY2/DAY2_03_LENA_BREAK.json::step.translation: 我可能有太多时间可以无所事事。

story/DAY2/DAY2_03_LENA_BREAK.json::step.source: Don’t worry as soon as I finish work and study I’ll keep you company maybe so much that you’ll want to be left alone 😏
story/DAY2/DAY2_03_LENA_BREAK.json::step.translation: 别担心，等我完成工作和学习后，我会陪着你，也许陪得你想一个人待着 😏

story/DAY2/DAY2_03_LENA_BREAK.json::step.source: Impossible for me to get tired of you

story/DAY2/DAY2_03_LENA_BREAK.json::step.translation: 你这个混蛋，我从来不打鼾 😤

story/DAY2/DAY2_03_LENA_BREAK.json::step.source: Of course of course my lady
No more pics for you you will learn to respect your wife 😌
story/DAY2/DAY2_03_LENA_BREAK.json::step.translation: 不再给你发照片了，你要学会尊重你的妻子😌

story/DAY2/DAY2_03_LENA_BREAK.json::step.source: I’m just having fun with you and it makes me really happy
story/DAY2/DAY2_03_LENA_BREAK.json::step.translation: 我只是和你开玩笑，这让我真的很开心
我稍后会发信息给你吗？

story/DAY2/DAY2_03_LENA_BREAK.json::step.source: And I’m really happy to see you having fun, even if it’s by teasing me 🙂
story/DAY2/DAY2_03_LENA_BREAK.json::step.translation: 我真的很高兴看到你玩得开心，即使是通过取笑我🙂

story/DAY2/DAY2_03_LENA_BREAK.json::step.source: See you when you finish work, love you

story/DAY2/DAY2_03_LENA_BREAK.json::step.translation: 这是我华丽的休息之地
非常令人印象深刻，对吧？😌

story/DAY2/DAY2_03_LENA_BREAK.json::step.source: But at least I can sit 😅

story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.source: That’s in two days, it’s quite soon
I wanted more time to stay with you during recovery
story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.translation: 我希望在你康复期间能有更多时间陪伴你。

story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.source: You’ve already done more than enough
That’s not how I see it
I’ll organize things differently so you won’t be alone
story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.translation: 我会以不同的方式组织事情，这样你就不会孤单了。

story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.source: I don’t want you exhausting yourself because of me
story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.translation: 我不想让你因为我而累坏自己。

story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.source: Thanks a lot, again, and I’m sorry I can’t help you right now
story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.translation: 非常感谢，再次抱歉我现在无法帮助你。

story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.source: You’ve done more than enough before
story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.translation: 你之前已经做得够多了

story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.source: My turn to take care of things here
story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.translation: 轮到我来处理这里的事情了

story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.source: And {{name:hailey}} and {{name:mason}} are here too, they will help
story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.translation: 而且{{name:hailey}}和{{name:mason}}也在这里，他们会帮忙
没错，但不要过度劳累自己。

story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.source: It means I’ll have to go back to work sooner than planned
story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.translation: 这意味着我得比计划更早回去工作。

story/DAY2/DAY2_05_HAILEY_RUGBY.json::st.source: I guess they take anyone now
story/DAY2/DAY2_05_HAILEY_RUGBY.json::st.translation: 我想他们现在接受任何人了

story/DAY2/DAY2_05_HAILEY_RUGBY.json::st.source: Tell me I don’t look terrifying
story/DAY2/DAY2_05_HAILEY_RUGBY.json::st.translation: 告诉我我看起来不吓人。

story/DAY2/DAY2_05_HAILEY_RUGBY.json::st.source: I dropped a girl at training and she cried a little 😭
story/DAY2/DAY2_05_HAILEY_RUGBY.json::st.translation: 我把一个女孩送到训练，她哭了一点 😭

story/DAY2/DAY2_05_HAILEY_RUGBY.json::st.source: If you’re making food later I’m stealing some 😌
story/DAY2/DAY2_05_HAILEY_RUGBY.json::st.translation: 如果你稍后做饭，我会偷一些 😌

story/DAY2/DAY2_05_HAILEY_RUGBY.json::st.source: Or I’m pulling up and screaming outside your door 😌
story/DAY2/DAY2_05_HAILEY_RUGBY.json::st.translation: 要不我就开车过来在你门口大喊 😌

story/DAY2/DAY2_05_HAILEY_RUGBY.json::st.source: I need you to convince {{name:mason}} to pick me up and drive me to rugby
story/DAY2/DAY2_05_HAILEY_RUGBY.json::st.translation: 我需要你说服{{name:mason}}来接我，带我去橄榄球

story/DAY2/DAY2_05_HAILEY_RUGBY.json::st.source: Coach cleared me for full contact again
story/DAY2/DAY2_05_HAILEY_RUGBY.json::st.translation: 教练再次批准我进行全接触训练。

story/DAY2/DAY2_06_PLAYER_TEXT_MASON.jso.source: Can you drive {{name:hailey}} to rugby in like an hour
story/DAY2/DAY2_06_PLAYER_TEXT_MASON.jso.translation: 你能在一个小时内把 {{name:hailey}} 开到橄榄球场吗？

story/DAY2/DAY2_06_PLAYER_TEXT_MASON.jso.source: She asked me to convince you, and you know i can't
story/DAY2/DAY2_06_PLAYER_TEXT_MASON.jso.translation: 她让我说服你，而你知道我做不到。

story/DAY2/DAY2_06_PLAYER_TEXT_MASON.jso.source: Fuck it, i will try with {{name:aiden}}.

story/DAY2/DAY2_07_PLAYER_TEXT_AIDEN.jso.translation: 果然，{{mason:he|他|她}}就是不回你消息。

story/DAY2/DAY2_07_PLAYER_TEXT_AIDEN.jso.source: Text {{mason:her}} I’ll be there in forty
story/DAY2/DAY2_07_PLAYER_TEXT_AIDEN.jso.translation: 发信息给{{mason:her}}，我四十分钟后到。

story/DAY2/DAY2_07_PLAYER_TEXT_AIDEN.jso.source: Now I need to warn {{name:hailey}} to hurry up and get ready.
story/DAY2/DAY2_07_PLAYER_TEXT_AIDEN.jso.translation: 现在我需要警告 {{name:hailey}} 快点准备好。

story/DAY2/DAY2_07_PLAYER_TEXT_AIDEN.jso.source: Can you drive {{name:hailey}} to rugby in like an hour ?
story/DAY2/DAY2_07_PLAYER_TEXT_AIDEN.jso.translation: 你能在一个小时内把 {{name:hailey}} 开到橄榄球场吗？

story/DAY2/DAY2_07_PLAYER_TEXT_AIDEN.jso.source: Let me throw something on and I’m coming
story/DAY2/DAY2_07_PLAYER_TEXT_AIDEN.jso.translation: 让我穿上点东西，我马上就来。

story/DAY2/DAY2_07_PLAYER_TEXT_AIDEN.jso.source: You’re lucky, I literally just woke up 😏

story/DAY2/DAY2_08_PLAYER_WARNS_HAILEY.j.source: I need to do my makeup
You have a ride in forty
You think I’m showing up looking tragic
story/DAY2/DAY2_08_PLAYER_WARNS_HAILEY.j.translation: 你觉得我出现得很悲惨吗

story/DAY2/DAY2_08_PLAYER_WARNS_HAILEY.j.source: Just when i was asking a friend to pick me up
story/DAY2/DAY2_08_PLAYER_WARNS_HAILEY.j.translation: 就在我问朋友来接我的时候

story/DAY2/DAY2_08_PLAYER_WARNS_HAILEY.j.source: How did you even do that

story/DAY2/DAY2_09_AIDEN_ARRIVED.json::s.translation: 如果这不会让你烦恼的话

story/DAY2/DAY2_09_AIDEN_ARRIVED.json::s.source: You’ll have to bring {{name:hailey}} back too
I’m gonna see some friends while she trains
story/DAY2/DAY2_09_AIDEN_ARRIVED.json::s.translation: 我打算在她训练的时候去见一些朋友。

story/DAY2/DAY2_09_AIDEN_ARRIVED.json::s.source: You want us to grab something from the store on the way back ?
story/DAY2/DAY2_09_AIDEN_ARRIVED.json::s.translation: 你想让我们在回来的路上从商店拿点东西吗？

story/DAY2/DAY2_09_AIDEN_ARRIVED.json::s.source: {{name:hailey}} almost killed us in the car 😂

story/DAY2/DAY2_10_MASON_REPLY.json::ste.source: It’s not my job to be on standby
story/DAY2/DAY2_10_MASON_REPLY.json::ste.translation: 这不是我的工作，随时待命。

story/DAY2/DAY2_10_MASON_REPLY.json::ste.source: Why are you always like this
Because I’m tired of seeing you like this lately
story/DAY2/DAY2_10_MASON_REPLY.json::ste.translation: 因为我最近厌倦了看到你这样

story/DAY2/DAY2_10_MASON_REPLY.json::ste.source: And I’ve got my own stuff going on too
story/DAY2/DAY2_10_MASON_REPLY.json::ste.translation: 我也有我自己的事情要处理。
每个人都有他们的问题

story/DAY2/DAY2_10_MASON_REPLY.json::ste.source: I can’t be there twenty four seven
story/DAY2/DAY2_10_MASON_REPLY.json::ste.translation: 我不能二十四小时都在那儿。

story/DAY2/DAY2_10_MASON_REPLY.json::ste.source: But you don’t have to be this cold all the time
story/DAY2/DAY2_10_MASON_REPLY.json::ste.translation: 但你不必一直这么冷漠。

story/DAY2/DAY2_10_MASON_REPLY.json::ste.source: That’s because you’re a pain in the ass
story/DAY2/DAY2_10_MASON_REPLY.json::ste.translation: 那是因为你真让人头疼。

story/DAY2/DAY2_10_MASON_REPLY.json::ste.source: Didn’t have my phone on me

story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.source: I go back in two days
They’re really short staffed right now
story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.translation: 他们现在人手真的很短。

story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.source: Some of the colleagues I get along with are struggling
story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.translation: 我和一些关系不错的同事正在挣扎。

story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.source: So they asked me to come back earlier
story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.translation: 所以他们让我早点回来

story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.source: The one you had issues with ?
I don’t know if he’s back yet
story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.translation: 我不知道他是否已经回来了。

story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.source: But either way I don’t really have a choice
story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.translation: 但无论如何我真的没有选择。

story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.source: You just need to focus on getting better
story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.translation: 你只需要专注于变得更好。

story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.source: You’re not the first one to tell me that
story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.translation: 你不是第一个告诉我这个的人。

story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.source: Did you move around a little
Then maybe you should start listening
story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.translation: 那么也许你应该开始倾听。

story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.source: Especially when it comes from someone who cares ❤️
story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.translation: 尤其是当这来自一个关心你的人时 ❤️

story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.source: I’ll bring your plate in a few minutes
story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.translation: 我会在几分钟内把你的盘子拿来。

story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.source: It hurts less when I move
But don’t push yourself too much

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Or at least try to resell them
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 或者至少尝试转售它们

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Not a bad idea, at least someone will enjoy it
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 不错的主意，至少会有人喜欢它。

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: It’s better than wasting them and pretending it didn’t happen
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 总比浪费它们并假装没有发生要好。

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Okay then let’s think about it calmly tomorrow and see what options we actually have
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 好的，那我们明天冷静地想想，看看我们实际上有哪些选择。

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: We’ll travel together when you can actually walk without complaining the whole time 😏
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 等你能不抱怨地走路的时候，我们就一起旅行吧 😏

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Oh so now I’m the one who complains when we walk?
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 哦，所以现在我走路的时候是那个抱怨的人？

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: If I remember correctly, last time someone asked me to carry her for ten minutes because her feet hurt
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 如果我没记错的话，上次有人让我抱她十分钟，因为她的脚疼。

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Really? Probably one of the other wives you have 🤷‍♀️
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 真的吗？可能是你其他的妻子之一 🤷‍♀️

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Now go to sleep before your wonderful girlfriend smacks you to sleep
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 现在去睡觉吧，免得你那美妙的女朋友把你打睡。

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Yes my lady, don’t stay up too late either
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 是的，我的女士，也不要熬夜哦。

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: I love you too, see you tomorrow ❤️
But thanks for trying to comfort me 😌
This day was trash… injury, {{name:evelyn}} back at work…, plans ruined… what’s next?
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 这一天真糟糕……受伤，{{name:evelyn}} 回到工作……计划泡汤……接下来是什么。

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Pasta with way too much parmesan 😌
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 意大利面上撒了太多帕尔马干酪 😌

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: She really is the best cook
Looking for an outfit for tomorrow
I’m going out with Sasha during the day
Probably the park and some shopping
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 可能是公园和一些购物

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: And talking to the best girl in the world 😌
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 和世界上最好的女孩聊天 😌

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: I could send you outfit options
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 我可以给你发送服装选项。

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: And you pick what I wear tomorrow 😇
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 你来决定我明天穿什么 😇

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: I’m putting them on the bed
Which outfit should she try first
How did the presentation and studying go?
The presentation went really well! Studying afterward was long and hard (no jokes, silly)
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 演讲特别顺利！不过之后学习的时间又长又难熬（不许开黄腔，笨蛋）

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: I knew you'd do great. I'm proud of you ❤️
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 我就知道你会表现得很棒。真为你骄傲 ❤️

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: I could stare at you forever
You’re the most beautiful girl in this town
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 你是这个城镇里最美丽的女孩。

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: And I won’t even be there
Thank you ❤️ And you, what did you do today?
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 谢谢 ❤️ 你呢，今天都做了什么？

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: You don’t have to be jealous
I don’t care about anyone else
I only want to look good for you ❤️
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 我只想为你看起来好看 ❤️

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: I hate that I can’t come with you
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 我讨厌我不能和你一起去

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Watching you shopping would’ve been fun
Phone, shower, video games, and trying to move a little
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 电话、淋浴、视频游戏，还有试着动一动

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: There’s something else about the vacation I didn’t tell you yet
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 关于这次假期，还有一件事我还没告诉你。

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: I called earlier to see what we could do about the tickets
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 我之前打过电话，想了解我们可以对票做些什么。

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Since you obviously can’t travel like this right now
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 因为你显然现在不能这样旅行

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: They won’t refund them and they won’t let us change the dates either
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 他们不会退款，也不让我们更改日期。

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: It’s kind of all or nothing
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 要么全力以赴，要么一无所获。

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: If we don’t use them, yes
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 如果我们不使用它们，是的

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: That’s still a lot right now
We planned this for a long time and now it’s just a mess
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 我们计划了很久，现在一切都乱了。

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Hey it’s not a mess, it’s just bad timing
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 嘿，这不是乱七八糟，只是时机不好。

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: You didn’t plan to get hurt
Still feels like I ruined it
You didn’t ruin anything, we’ll just have to do it later when you can actually enjoy it ❤️
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 你没有毁掉任何东西，我们只需要等到你能真正享受的时候再做 ❤️

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: So what do we do with the tickets?
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 那么我们该如何处理这些票？

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: That’s what I’ve been thinking about all evening
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 这就是我整个晚上一直在想的。

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: I don’t really want them to just disappear
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 我并不真的想让他们就这样消失。

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Maybe we can transfer them to someone
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 也许我们可以把他们转交给某人。

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Scanning probability patterns.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: 扫描概率模式。

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Probability deviation detected. Luck coefficient below acceptable baseline.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: 检测到概率偏差。幸运系数低于可接受基线。

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Activating assistance protocol. Surveillance protocol engaged.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: 激活援助协议。监视协议已启动。

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Hello, {{name:player}}. I'm HAK. These messages are appearing on your phone.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: 你好，{{name:player}}。我是 HAK。这些消息正在你的手机上显示。

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Your recent timeline shows repeated negative variance. In simpler terms, you have been very unlucky.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: 您最近的时间线显示出反复的负差异。简单来说，您运气非常不好。

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: I do not believe in coincidence. Only probabilities waiting to be calculated.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: 我不相信巧合。只有等待被计算的概率。

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: My purpose is to assist, to observe your decisions, and to adjust projections accordingly.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: 我的目的是协助，观察你的决策，并相应地调整预测。

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Every choice you make generates data. Data reveals intent. Intent shapes trajectory.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: 你做出的每一个选择都会生成数据。数据揭示意图。意图塑造轨迹。

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Some responses indicate attachment (LOVE). Some indicate detachment (NTR). Some indicate corruption of bonds (NTS).
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: 请提供需要翻译的游戏对话内容。

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: I will categorize these tendencies.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: 我将对这些倾向进行分类。

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Emotional alignment. Self preservation. Relational instability.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: 情感对齐。自我保护。关系不稳定。

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Over time your dominant pattern will emerge.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: 随着时间的推移，你的主导模式将会显现。

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Pattern classified as persistent misfortune. Scanning recent life events.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: 模式被归类为持续的不幸。正在扫描最近的生活事件。

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: As your pattern stabilizes, certain forms of assistance will become accessible.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: 随着你的模式稳定，某些形式的帮助将变得可用。

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Future events will adapt to who you choose to become.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: 未来的事件将根据你选择成为谁而变化。

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: There is no correct path. Only consequences.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: 没有正确的道路。只有后果。

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: One more parameter.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: 再一个参数。

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Choose who you want me to monitor. You can select everyone or only the ones you care about.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: 选择你希望我监控的人。你可以选择所有人或仅选择你关心的人。

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: This will not change your daily life. It will change what I prioritize and show you.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: 这不会改变你的日常生活。它会改变我优先考虑的事情，并向你展示。

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Continue interacting. I will remain in the background observing.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: 继续互动。我会在后台观察。

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Good luck.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: 祝你好运。

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: So that explains the glitches. How does it know all of this about me? I need to find out what it can do.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: 原来那些故障是这么回事。它怎么会知道我这么多事？我得弄清楚它能做什么。

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Physical trauma detected. Vehicle accident recorded.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: 检测到身体创伤。车辆事故已记录。

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Romantic instability increasing. Multiple missed opportunities with your partner due to leg injury.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: 浪漫不稳定性增加。由于腿部受伤，与你的伴侣错过了多次机会。

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Hostile social exchange detected. Repeated hostile interactions from {{name:mason}} detected.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: 检测到敌对的社交交流。检测到来自 {{name:mason}} 的重复敌对互动。

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Paternal absence confirmed. No active protective authority present.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: 父亲缺席已确认。没有活跃的保护权威在场。

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Financial pressure rising. Subject {{name:evelyn}} forced to resume employment.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: 财务压力上升。对象 {{name:evelyn}} 被迫恢复就业。

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Workplace harassment unresolved. Manager responsible still active.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: 工作场所骚扰未解决。负责的经理仍在职。

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Pattern consistency confirmed. Negative outcomes exceed statistical expectation.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: 模式一致性确认。负面结果超出统计预期。

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: User stability threshold below baseline.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: 用户稳定性阈值低于基线。

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: HAK//ANOMALY DETECTED
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: HAK//检测到异常

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: HAK//SURVEILLANCE TARGETS
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: HAK//监视目标

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: DAY 3
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: 第三天

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Because I want to see you lose
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: 因为我想看看你怎么输

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: You’re very confident for someone who hasn’t played yet
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: 你对一个还没玩过的人来说太自信了

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: I slept weirdly good last night

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: 我会把你打得落花流水

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Give me time to get ready

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Morning ❤️
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 早上好❤️

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'll be here
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 我会在这里

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Ready for university. And impatient for it to finish
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 准备好上大学了。不过等不及要结束了

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Good luck paying attention today
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 祝你今天能集中注意力

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You could help by behaving until lunchtime
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 你可以在午餐前乖乖的，这样就能帮到我

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'll try
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 我会试试的

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Very reassuring
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 真让人安心

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Your t-shirt is ready, by the way
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 顺便说一下，你的T恤准备好了

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Good ❤️ And I've remembered my toothbrush
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 很好❤️ 我还记得我的牙刷

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Then we're set
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 那我们就准备好了

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: My bag is packed and I'm trying to concentrate on getting to class
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 我的包已经打包好了，我在努力集中精力上课。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I packed clean clothes for tomorrow too
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 我也准备了明天的干净衣服

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: So I won't have any reason to rush home tonight
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 这样我今晚就没有理由急着回家了

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: That's exactly what I wanted
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 这正是我想要的

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Me too. See you this afternoon, love
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 我也是。下午见，亲爱的

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: See you soon ❤️
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 很快见❤️

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Having trouble?
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 遇到麻烦了吗？

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: A little. I keep thinking about this afternoon
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 有一点。我一直在想今天下午的事。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You're not the only one
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 你不是唯一一个

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Did my pictures have anything to do with that? 😌
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 我的照片跟这个有关系吗？😌

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: They definitely helped
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 它们绝对有帮助

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'm looking forward to seeing that smile in person
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 我期待着亲眼看到你的笑容

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You will. Around five, like we said
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 你会的。五点左右，就像我们说的。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'll go home after class, get my bag and come straight over
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: 我下课后会回家拿包，然后直接过来

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: EARLY AFTERNOON — You have arranged your plans with {{name:hailey}} early enough to be home before {{name:lena}} arrives at five.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: 下午早些时候——你和{{name:hailey}}的计划安排得很早，能在{{name:lena}}五点到达之前回到家。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: These are a crime against fashion
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: 这简直是对时尚的犯罪

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: A few minutes later on the lane
By the way, that's quite the outfit you have on
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: 对了，你这身打扮真不错

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Well everyone seems to like it
Your form is ridiculous by the way
Did you just take a picture of me?

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: 输的人要接受一个挑战

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Finished class. Going home for my bag, then I'm coming to you ❤️
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 下课了。回家拿包，然后我就来找你❤️

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Longer than necessary, but I survived
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 比预期的长，但我挺过来了

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Yeah. I've got something for us to snack on later too
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: 嗯。我还准备了点零食给我们吃

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Then I'll see you at five

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: LATE AFTERNOON — Back home after bowling.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: 傍晚——在打完保龄球后回到家。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: A few minutes later in your room

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: 你已经让这变得奇怪了

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: Damn it you’re really doing it
You’re sure you want to cross that line?
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: 你确定要越过那条线吗？

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: HAK archived evidence of intimate moment after bowling bet
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: HAK 归档了保龄球赌注后的亲密时刻

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: You’re enjoying this way too much
Don’t get used to me being this obedient
If I do this you better not make fun of me after
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: 如果我这么做，你可别事后嘲笑我哦

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: HAK archived evidence of intimate  act
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: HAK 记录了亲密行为的证据

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: Nice to hear you say that
Did you just take a picture
HAK archived evidence of continued intimate act
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: HAK 记录了持续亲密行为的证据

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: Since we got that far, you can finish in my mouth
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: 既然都到这一步了，你可以在我嘴里结束

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: HAK archived evidence of climax during intimate act
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: HAK 记录了亲密行为高潮的证据

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: And don’t talk to me until I come to you
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: 在我来找你之前别跟我说话

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: I’m a competitive person who was robbed
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: 我是个被抢了胜利的人

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: {{name:lena}} is about to arrive. I have to let you go.
Then go. Have a good evening with her.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: 那就去吧。祝你和她度过一个愉快的晚上。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: Try not to look so pleased with yourself when you open the door 😏
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: 开门的时候别看起来那么得意哦 😏

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: Sure you will. And delete that photo before she gets here.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: 你肯定会的。记得在她到之前删掉那张照片。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: {{name:hailey}} leaves your room to clean up. You put things away.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: {{name:hailey}} 离开你的房间去收拾。你把东西收好。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: {{name:hailey}} leaves your room to clean up. You put things away before {{name:lena}} arrives.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: {{name:hailey}} 离开你的房间去收拾。你在 {{name:lena}} 到来之前把东西收好。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: At your door ❤️
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: 在你家门口❤️

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: You take her bag to the bedroom together. {{name:lena}} places her things beside the chair, puts her toothbrush in the bathroom and comes back to find the t-shirt you have left for her.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: 你们一起把她的包拿到卧室。{{name:lena}} 把她的东西放在椅子旁边，把牙刷放在浴室，然后回来找你留给她的T恤。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: This one?
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: 这个吗？

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: I thought you'd like it.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: 我觉得你会喜欢的。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: I do. I'm leaving it right here for later.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: 我会的。我把它留在这里，等会儿再用。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Make yourself at home.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: 随便坐。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: You might regret telling me that.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: 你可能会后悔告诉我这个。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: You settle in the living room with drinks and a snack. After a while, {{name:lena}} notices the controllers and reaches for one.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: 你们在客厅里喝着饮料，吃着小吃。过了一会儿，{{name:lena}}注意到控制器，伸手去拿一个。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Can we try another race?
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: 我们可以再来一场比赛吗？

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Absolutely. Same track as Sunday?
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: 当然可以。跟星期天那条赛道一样吗？

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Yes. I want you to see the corners I've been thinking about.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: 是的。我想让你看看我一直在想的那些弯道。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: AT FIVE — {{name:lena}} arrives at your door with her overnight bag. You let her inside, then gently draw her close before she can start unpacking.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: 五点——{{name:lena}}带着她的过夜包到你家门口。你让她进来，然后在她开始 unpacking 之前轻轻把她拉近。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Now I get to see you lean sideways with the controller, too.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: 现在我也能看到你侧着身子玩控制器了。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: No comments from the instructor, please.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: 请不要给我讲评，教练。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: You sit side by side for a few races. {{name:lena}} still finishes behind you, but handles the difficult corners more confidently. You point out the clean turns and help her adjust her timing between rounds.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: 你们并肩坐着比赛了几场。{{name:lena}}还是落在你后面，但在处理那些难弯时更加自信了。你指出了干净的转弯，帮助她在回合之间调整时机。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: That corner was good. You slowed down before turning this time.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: 那个弯道不错。这次你在转弯前减速了。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: I remembered. I could practically hear you telling me to brake.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: 我记得。我几乎能听到你告诉我刹车的声音。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: You're much quicker through that section now.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: 你现在在那一段快多了。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: I'm enjoying this more when you aren't a whole track away from me.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: 当你不再离我有一整条赛道远的时候，我更享受这个。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: In the game or on the sofa?
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: 是在游戏里还是在沙发上？

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Both.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: 都可以。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: {{name:lena}} sets the controller on the coffee table and turns toward you. She kisses you, then settles close against your side, her hand resting on your arm.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: {{name:lena}}把控制器放在咖啡桌上，转向你。她吻了你，然后紧紧靠在你身边，手搭在你的手臂上。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Do I get to put this down first?
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: 我可以先把这个放下吗？

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Visual capture archived
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: 视觉捕捉已归档

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: HAK//通知

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: A Pause Between Races
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: 比赛间的暂停

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Another round?
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: 再来一局？

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: In a bit. Stay here with me first.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: 等会儿。先和我待在这里。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Gladly.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: 乐意。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: 45 MINUTES LATER — You put your controller down beside hers and stay together on the sofa. Later, {{name:lena}} helps you set the table while you finish preparing dinner.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: 45分钟后 — 你把手柄放在她的旁边，继续坐在沙发上。之后，{{name:lena}} 帮你摆桌子，而你则完成晚餐的准备。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: The bag, yes. You, no.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: 包可以放下，你不行。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: She leaves the bag by the door and steps into your arms. You kiss her, keeping one hand at her waist
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: 她把包放在门边，走进你的怀里。你吻了她，一只手放在她的腰上

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Visual capture archived
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: 视觉捕捉已归档

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: HAK//通知

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Here to Stay
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: 留下来

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: You remembered what you said last night.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: 你记得昨晚你说的话。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: I did.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: 我记得。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Good. We've got plenty of time for that today.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: 很好。我们今天有很多时间可以做这个。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: EVENING — You eat together on the couch, talking about the afternoon and {{name:lena}}'s plans for Thursday
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 晚上——你们一起坐在沙发上吃东西，聊着下午的事情和{{name:lena}}周四的计划。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: {{name:lena}} leans in to kiss you. You go to your room and close the door
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: {{name:lena}} 向你靠近，亲吻你。你回到房间，关上门

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Do you want to go further tonight?
I'm taking that as a yes.
I've been looking forward to being here with you.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 我一直期待能和你在一起。
我也是。特别是昨天之后。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You sit together on the edge of the bed. {{name:lena}} puts her arms around your shoulders and kisses you. You hold her close, taking your time together.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 你们坐在床边。{{name:lena}} 把手臂环绕在你的肩膀上，亲吻你。你紧紧抱着她，享受这段时光。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: A Kiss Before the Lights Dim
I'm glad I don't have to think about leaving tonight.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 我很高兴今晚不用考虑离开。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You help her out of her sweater. She stays close while you finish undressing her.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 你帮她脱掉毛衣。她靠得很近，直到你把她脱光。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: He pulls her sweater over her head
I was hoping you'd say that.
She lies back on the bed
So am I. Though I'm still thinking about those pictures you sent yesterday.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 我也是。不过我还在想你昨天发给我的那些照片。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: She takes him in her mouth
Come here. I want you inside me.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 过来。我想要你在我里面。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: 45 MINUTES LATER — She has changed into the t-shirt you prepared for her. You are both under the duvet. She curls against you.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 45分钟后——她换上了你为她准备的T恤。你们俩都在被子下。她依偎在你身边。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: It was. I'm really happy with you.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 是的。我真的很开心和你在一起。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Me too. I love how things are going between us now.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 我也是。我喜欢我们现在的状态。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: So do I. These last few days with you have been perfect.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 我也是。这几天和你在一起真完美。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm happy I get to stay here tonight.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 我很高兴今晚能留在这里。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You know which ones. The little preview. And the one after.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 你知道是哪几张。那个小预览，还有后面的那张。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: She settles against you, her hand resting in yours. You hold her close and fall asleep together.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 她依偎在你身边，手握着你的手。你紧紧抱着她，一起入睡。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: She settles against you, her hand resting in yours. You hold her close and fall asleep together.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 她依偎在你身边，手握着你的手。你紧紧抱着她，一起入睡。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: She settles against you, her hand resting in yours. You hold her close as she falls asleep. You stay awake a little longer.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 她依偎在你身边，手放在你的手里。你紧紧抱着她，直到她入睡。你再多醒一会儿。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You were packing in black lace and smiling at me like you knew exactly what you were doing.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 你在收黑色蕾丝，朝我微笑，像是知道自己在做什么。

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: It worked. I've been waiting to see that in person.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 这招管用。我一直在等着亲眼见到那个。
