story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Let's go to your room so you can see better
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 我们去你房间，这样你能看得更清楚。

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Start with the living room, I’ll take the kitchen.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 从客厅开始，我来处理厨房。
你已经开始发号施令了？

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Someone has to be responsible in this house.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 总得有人在这个家里负责。

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Did you seriously just take a picture of me cleaning?
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 你居然拍了我在打扫的照片？

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: That you actually do chores sometimes.
I’m going to put soap in your coffee.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 我会在你的咖啡里放肥皂。

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Keep talking and I’ll make you clean the toilet.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 继续说，我就让你去刷马桶。

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I can hear you still in bed

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Morning ❤️ Did you beat that level, or is the controller still the problem?
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 早上好 ❤️ 你过关了吗，还是手柄还是有问题？

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I've got a parcel to collect, then not much
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我有个包裹要取，之后没什么事

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Anything exciting in it?
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 里面有什么好玩的东西吗？

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: A phone charger
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 一个手机充电器

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Try to contain yourself when you open it 😭
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 打开的时候别激动哦 😭

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll save the wrapping for you
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我会把包装留给你

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: How thoughtful ❤️
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 真贴心 ❤️

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Full day for you again?
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 你又要忙一天吗？

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Classes, then work. I'm going home before dinner tonight
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 上课，然后工作。今晚我会在晚餐前回家

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Changing before you go?
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 出门前要换衣服吗？

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yeah, I don't want to take all my work things with me
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 嗯，我不想把所有工作东西都带着

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Finally beat it. Turns out I needed to stop rushing
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 终于过了。原来我需要慢一点

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Your bag will appreciate a night off
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 你的包包会感激你给它放个假

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It's earned one 😭
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 它值得休息一下 😭

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Don't leave your keys in it when you change bags
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 换包的时候别把钥匙留在里面哦

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That does sound like something I'd manage
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 这确实是我能做到的事

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I haven't even decided what to wear yet
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我还没决定穿什么呢

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You'll look good either way
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 无论怎样你都很好看

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Thank you handsome ❤️
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 谢谢你帅哥 ❤️

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm ready for this part of the day, at least
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 至少我对这部分的日子准备好了

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: See? Looking good already
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 看吧？已经看起来不错了

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: So the controller made a miraculous recovery 😭
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 看来手柄奇迹般地恢复了 😭

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You're making it difficult to leave my phone alone 😊
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 你让我很难不碰我的手机呢😊

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll let you get going. Hope dinner's nice tonight
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我让你走吧。希望今晚的晚餐不错

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Thank you, and sorry if today I can't talk much ❤️
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 谢谢你，如果今天我不能多说话，抱歉哦❤️

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll text you when I get there, and when I'm back
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我到那儿的时候会发信息给你，回来时也会

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It's okay, no rush to reply in between
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 没关系，随时回复都可以

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Okay. Have a good day
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 好的，祝你今天愉快

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You too
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 你也是

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Love you, talk later ❤️
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 爱你，稍后聊❤️

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Love you too
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我也爱你

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'd rather not discuss that part
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我不想讨论那部分

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Very convenient 😌 Did you get some sleep afterwards?
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 真方便 😌 你之后睡得好吗？

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yeah. What about you?
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 嗯。你呢？

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Slept okay, and I got up when the alarm rang for once
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 睡得还不错，闹钟响的时候我也起床了

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: A successful morning for both of us
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我们俩的早晨都很成功

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Let's not get carried away, I haven't left the house yet
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 别太激动，我还没出门呢

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: What are you doing later?
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 你待会儿有什么安排？

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: THIS AFTERNOON — You have arranged your plans with {{name:hailey}} early enough to be home before {{name:lena}} arrives at five.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 今天下午 — 你和 {{name:hailey}} 提前安排好了计划，以便在 {{name:lena}} 五点到达之前回家。

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I’ll wait in the car then
No point going back and forth
So what, I don’t know how to teach?

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 对象对语言主导有反应

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: This doesn't sound like teaching anymore, and I can't shake the worry underneath my jealousy.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 这已经不像教学了，而嫉妒下面那份担忧，我怎么也甩不掉。

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: HAK captured the beginning of the oral act after the professor ordered the subject to suck harder.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: HAK捕捉到教授命令对象更用力吸吮的开始。

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I’m just too good, that’s all.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 我就是太厉害了，仅此而已。

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I need to go see my professor
Subject showing mixed resistance and compliance
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 对象表现出混合的抵抗和顺从

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: That mixed reaction worries me, and a report can't tell me whether she's okay.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 那种矛盾的反应让我担心，一份报告却无法告诉我，她到底还好吗。

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Following the subject’s teasing, the professor forced a deeper penetration. Subject emitted a muffled reaction.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 在对象的挑逗下，教授强迫更深的插入。对象发出压抑的反应。

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You’ll only be done when I finish.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 你只有在我完成时才能结束。

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: But there’s no bus for another hour
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 但下班车要等一个小时

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: The subject took the professor’s challenge and brought him to climax. Post-act verbal exchange confirms mutual anticipation of future sessions.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 主题接受了教授的挑战，并让他达到了高潮。事后交流确认了双方对未来课程的期待。

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Next time you better be ready.
I was stuck on the last exercise
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 我在最后一个练习上卡住了

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: 15 MINUTES LATER — You have driven {{name:hailey}} home. She heads to her room, and you put your keys away.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 15分钟后 — 你把 {{name:hailey}} 送回家。她朝自己的房间走去，而你把钥匙收好。

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Can you drive me if your leg isn’t too bad?
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 如果你腿没那么疼，可以开车送我吗？

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: How long is it going to take?

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ I'm ready to leave, and I remembered to move my keys into the other bag
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 嘿❤️ 我准备好出发了，还记得把钥匙放进另一个包里

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I said I'd let him know when I was home
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我说过我到家了会告诉他的

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know. That's not the part I'm having trouble with
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我知道，那不是我在烦恼的部分

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The manager has brought her bag over; {{name:lena}} takes out her phone
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 经理把她的包拿过来了；{{name:lena}}拿出她的手机

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: She sits a little apart from him now, looking down at the screen; both are fully dressed
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 她现在坐得离他有点远，低头看着屏幕；两人都穿得很整齐

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: She's looking at her phone now. I'm waiting for a message from the same person, but I don't know how to read her words the way I did this morning.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 她现在看着手机。我等着同一个人发来消息，却不知道该怎么再像今早那样读懂她的话。

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I enjoyed dinner. That's not all I'm thinking about now
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我很享受晚餐，但现在我想的可不止这些

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It doesn't have to become an argument
I'm not arguing with you. I'm thinking about what I'm going to say to him
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我不是在和你争论，我在想我该怎么跟他说

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I need a bit of time on my own
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我需要一点自己的时间

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: All right. Your jacket's by the door
There's a bus in twenty minutes. I'll get that one
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 二十分钟后有一辆公交车，我去坐那辆

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: {{name:lena}} stands at the open apartment door with her jacket on and her bag over her shoulder
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: {{name:lena}} 站在开着的公寓门口，穿着外套，肩上背着包

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The manager steps aside and look at her ass again
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 经理让开了，再次看了看她的屁股

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: She's finally leaving. I thought that would make me feel better, but now I'm dreading the message saying she's home.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 她终于要走了。我以为这会让我好受些，可现在却害怕收到她到家的消息。

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: After the bus ride, once she is back at her own place...
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 公交车行程结束后，她回到自己的地方……
我回家了❤️ 对不起，太晚了

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah, I'm okay. Got back without any trouble
You'll have to tell me about it tomorrow
Nothing big enough to make a story. I'm going to get ready for bed now
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 没什么值得一提的。我现在要准备睡觉了

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Oh okay, I'm glad you got back all right then
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 哦，好的，我很高兴你安全回来了

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was still up anyway. I collected that charger, by the way
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我反正还没睡。顺便说一下，我把那个充电器拿来了

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: After she puts her phone in her bag and goes inside...
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 她把手机放进包里，走进去了...

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I've left the spare by the sofa for next time you're here
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我把备用的放在沙发旁边了，下次你来的时候可以用

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A conversation is detected near {{name:lena}} inside the apartment
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 在公寓里检测到{{name:lena}}附近有对话

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: She said a few people from work were having dinner. I'm trying to hold on to that while I wait for the next update.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 她说有几个同事一起吃晚饭。等着下一条更新时，我努力抓住这句话不放。

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There you are. You look good
I'm appreciating the effort. Much better than yesterday's paperwork
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我很欣赏你的努力。比昨天的文件好太多了

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wasn't looking at the paperwork much either
Let me take your jacket. You can put your bag on that chair
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 让我来拿你的外套。你可以把包放在那把椅子上
谢谢。有什么东西闻起来很好

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Try not to sound so amazed
The manager takes {{name:lena}}'s jacket as she sets her bag on the chair by the entrance
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 经理在把包放在入口的椅子上时，拿走了{{name:lena}}的外套

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The dining table behind them is set for two; no other guests are present
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 他们身后的餐桌为两人准备，没有其他客人

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A table for two, after I asked if it was a group thing and she told me it was. I keep reading that message as if it might change.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 一张双人餐桌，而我明明问过是不是大家一起，她也说是。我反复读着那条消息，仿佛它还能改变。

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: At the table, once he has served dinner...
You could let me finish chewing
You already know whether it's good
Do you need applause too, or can I keep eating?
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你也需要掌声吗，还是我可以继续吃？

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can tell me what you think of the sauce next
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 接下来你可以告诉我你对酱汁的看法
还有黄油。没什么特别神秘的

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I expected a speech about a secret family recipe
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我还以为你会讲一个关于秘密家族食谱的演讲

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I can make one up if you need an impressive story
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 如果你需要一个精彩的故事，我可以编一个

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No, you've done enough self-promotion for one meal
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 不，你已经为这一顿饭做了足够的自我宣传

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And you've stopped looking as though you're here for a meeting
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 而且你也不再看起来像是来开会的

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There's food and you haven't mentioned a spreadsheet. That helps
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 有食物，而且你没有提到电子表格。这就好很多了

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Thank you ❤️ I changed my mind twice before putting this on
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 谢谢你❤️ 我在穿上这个之前犹豫了两次

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Across my desk, pretending you're only listening because I pay you
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 在我桌子对面，假装你只是因为我给你钱才在听

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: At work, that is usually why I'm listening
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 在工作时，通常我就是因为这个在听

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Tonight I'm trying to enjoy dinner
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 今晚我想好好享受晚餐

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Dinner ends with an argument about whether his music is chosen for the guests or to show off his speakers. When she finally admits she likes the song, he looks far too satisfied. He clears the plates and leaves her water on the coffee table.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 晚餐以争论他选择音乐是为了客人还是为了炫耀他的音响结束。当她终于承认她喜欢这首歌时，他看起来太得意了。他收拾了盘子，把水放在咖啡桌上。

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Come sit down for a while
You don't want help with those?
I've got a dishwasher. I'd rather have your company
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我有洗碗机。我更想要你的陪伴

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: She sits on the sofa. He puts the last plate in the kitchen, then joins her.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 她坐在沙发上。他把最后一个盘子放进厨房，然后加入她。

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I've wanted to kiss you since you walked in
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 自从你走进来，我就想吻你

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The manager moves closer on the sofa and initiates a kiss
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 经理在沙发上靠近，主动吻了她

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: {{name:lena}} returns it; he rests one hand at her waist
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: {{name:lena}} 回吻了他；他一只手放在她的腰上

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: She isn't moving away from him. I told her to enjoy her evening, and now those words make me feel sick.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 她没有离开他身边。我祝她今晚开心，而现在想到这些话，就觉得恶心。

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're looking very pleased with yourself again
Don't make me regret saying anything
I'll take that before I start changing things again 😭
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我先拿这个，免得再开始改来改去😭

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You kissed me back. I'm allowed to enjoy it
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你回吻了我。我有权享受这个

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He moves behind her on the sofa and kisses her neck
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 他在沙发上移到她身后，吻了她的脖子

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Both hands slide up and massage her breasts over the dress
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 双手滑上去，轻轻按摩她的裙子上的胸部

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: This is going further, and I'm still here with the phone in my hand. I want to put it down, but not knowing feels unbearable too.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 事情越走越远，我却仍然坐在这里，手机还握在手里。我想放下它，可不知道发生了什么也同样难以忍受。

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You've been thinking about this since the office
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你从办公室开始就一直在想这个

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You kissed me yesterday and then spent the evening pretending you hadn't
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你昨天吻了我，然后整晚假装没发生过

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I had dinner with him. That's not pretending
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我和他吃了晚餐。这不是假装

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Tonight I'm trying not to think about him for five minutes. You're not helping
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 今晚我试着不想他五分钟。你可真没帮上忙

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You too handsome. I need to go or I'll be late
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你也是帅哥。我得走了，不然会迟到

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: She lies back on the sofa, dress pushed up
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 她靠在沙发上，裙子撩起来了

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He kneels between her thighs and goes down on her
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 他跪在她的腿间，开始亲吻她

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I can't turn this into an innocent dinner anymore. Every new update takes away another excuse I was trying to believe.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我再也没法把这当成一顿普通的晚饭。每一次更新，都让我少一个努力相信的借口。

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: She takes him in her mouth
Another capture, and it still hasn't stopped. I keep reaching for the edge of the screen, then pulling my hand back.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 又一张记录，而这一切还没有停。我一次次伸手摸向屏幕边缘，又把手缩回来。

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: She's choosing to stay close to him. What hurts most is how little the version of tonight she gave me matches any of this.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 她选择继续靠近他。最让我痛苦的是，她告诉我的今晚，和眼前的一切几乎毫不相符。

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Around seven, outside her manager's apartment...
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 大约七点，在她经理的公寓外面...

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: For a moment I just stare without taking anything in. Then it hits me again, and I don't know what I'm supposed to do with all this hurt.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 有一瞬间，我只是愣愣地盯着屏幕，什么也没看进去。随后那种痛又涌上来，我不知道该拿它怎么办。

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wanted to. Don't look that pleased
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我想这样做，别看得那么得意

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You don't have to keep checking the time
I've arrived ❤️ I'll text you when I'm back
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我到了❤️ 回来时会发信息给你

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: You looked really pensive in the car earlier
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: 你刚才在车里看起来很沉思

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: That’s actually a really good idea
I think I’ll do exactly that
Look at you becoming strategic
I learn from the best
Flattery won’t save you next cleaning day
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: 恭维可不会让你在下次清洁日逃过一劫

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Worth a try though
Anyway
I’m going to sleep and plan my revenge properly
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: 我要去睡觉，认真计划我的报复

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Don’t go too hard on him
No promises 😌
Did I?
Good night
Good night
After putting your phone down, you settle back beside {{name:lena}} and fall asleep together.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: 放下手机后，你又回到 {{name:lena}} 身边，一起入睡。

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Yeah
Is everything going okay with your professor?
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: 你和教授的事情还好吗？

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: It is
But he put me in difficulty with some exercises today
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: 但他今天给我出了一些难题

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: I kind of want revenge
Then do the same thing to him
Give him an exercise just as hard
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: 给他出一个同样难的练习

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Why do you want to know?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 可能是想再把它弄伤吧

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: By the way, did you hear {{name:mason}} last night?
Shut up and come eat before it gets cold
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 闭嘴，快来吃饭，别让它凉了

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Too bad I’m already awake though
You can’t come drag me out of bed

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Hey 😊 Before my day gets away from me, did you sleep well?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 嘿😊 在我忙起来之前，你睡得好吗？

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: High praise
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 高评价

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I was thinking about yesterday at your place while I made breakfast
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我在做早餐的时候想起了昨天在你那儿的事

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Have you finally admitted I was right about the film?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 你终于承认我对那部电影是对的吗？

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: No. The bit where I had my head on your shoulder
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 没有。是我把头靠在你肩膀上的那一幕

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Oh. I liked that bit too
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 哦。我也喜欢那一幕

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You went quiet for once. It was very nice ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 你这次安静了，真不错❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I could offer that service again
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我可以再提供那个服务哦

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Please do. I'd like another afternoon like that soon
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 当然可以！我希望能再有一个这样的下午

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: We'll find one. Have you actually eaten yet?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我们会找到的。你吃过东西了吗？

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes, before you start. Look
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 吃过了，才不想让你唠叨呢。看

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I did. How about you?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我睡得不错。你呢？

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You look lovely
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 你看起来很美

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Thank you 😊 The breakfast is just out of frame, but I promise it exists
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 谢谢你😊 早餐在镜头外，但我保证它是存在的

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll take your word for it
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我相信你说的

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: There is something I wanted to ask you before I leave
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我走之前有件事想问你

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: {{name:aiden}} messaged me this morning
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: {{name:aiden}}今天早上给我发了消息

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Pretty well, considering I set an alarm and then argued with it twice 😭
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 还不错，考虑到我设了闹钟还跟它争了两次😭

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: He's asked if I'd like to come over to his place tonight, just the two of us
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 他问我今晚想不想去他家，就我们两个人

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: No arcade rematch attached to the invitation?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 邀请里没有附带游戏重赛吗？

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I checked. Apparently he can spend an evening without a scoreboard 😌
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我查过了。显然他可以不看分数过一个晚上😌

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'd like to go. Is that okay with you?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我想去。你觉得可以吗？

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: He messaged me about meeting again tonight
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 他给我发消息说今晚想再见面

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: The guy from the café?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 咖啡馆的那个家伙？

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes 😊 He's invited me to have dinner at his place
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 是的😊 他邀请我去他家吃晚饭

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Apparently he's ready to defend his cooking in person
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 显然他准备好亲自为他的厨艺辩护了

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Did you win?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 你赢了吗？

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That sounds like an evening worth surviving the workday for
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 听起来今晚值得为了工作日而熬过来

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'd like to go. Are you okay with me going to his place?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我想去。你觉得我去他家可以吗？

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes, sweetheart. I am ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 当然可以，亲爱的。我没问题❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I meant what I said. I'd like you to do what you feel like doing
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我说的是真的。我希望你做你想做的事

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I know. I still wanted to ask how you felt about tonight
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我知道。我还是想问问你今晚的感觉

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And I'm glad you did. You don't need to talk yourself out of something you want
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我很高兴你这么做了。你不需要说服自己放弃想要的事情

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Okay 😊 I'll go home and get ready first, then head over around eight
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 好的😊 我先回家准备一下，然后大约八点过来

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Take care of yourself, though. Keep your phone charged and text me when you get there
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 不过你要照顾好自己哦。保持手机充电，到了给我发个信息

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I got up. Interpret that however you like
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我起床了。你随便怎么理解都行

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I will. I've got the address, and I can get a taxi back whenever I need to
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我会的。我有地址，随时需要可以打车回去

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: If I decide to stay instead, I'll let you know too
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 如果我决定留下来，我也会告诉你

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good. I don't need a message every five minutes. I just want to know you're okay
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 很好。我不需要每五分钟就收到信息。我只想知道你没事就好

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That part I can promise ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 那部分我可以保证❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And you can tell me if you're feeling nervous again
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 如果你再次感到紧张，可以告诉我

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: A little. But that doesn’t mean I wish you weren’t going
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 有一点。但这并不意味着我希望你不去

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Work today?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 今天有工作吗？

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yesterday helped. I liked knowing we could still just be ourselves together
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 昨天的事情让我感觉好一些。我喜欢知道我们仍然可以做自己

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: We can. Including me stealing your cushion ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 当然可以。包括我偷你的垫子❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That part was never in doubt
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 这一点从来没有疑问

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You're being very calm about this
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 你对此很冷静呢

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm smiling at my phone, actually 🙂
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 其实我在对着手机微笑呢🙂

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good. Then we have matching stupid faces
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 好啊。那我们就有一模一样的傻脸了

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yours is prettier
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 你的更好看

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Now you're just trying to keep me here ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 现在你就是想让我留在这里❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Until six, then I need to pick up a couple of things on the way home
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 要到六点，然后我得在回家的路上买几样东西

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Right, I need to leave before my quiet morning becomes me running down the street
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 对，我得走了，不然我安静的早晨就变成我在街上狂奔了

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Have a good day. Eat something proper during your break
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 祝你今天愉快。休息的时候吃点好的

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Look at you taking over my job 😌
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 看看你怎么接管我的工作了 😌

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Somebody has to remind you when you’re busy
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 总得有人在你忙的时候提醒你

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I love you. I'll text you when I'm home and getting ready ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我爱你。等我回到家准备好了就给你发信息 ❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Love you too. Speak tonight
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我也爱你。今晚聊

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm going to be busy for most of the day, so don't be surprised if I'm quiet
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我今天大部分时间都很忙，所以如果我安静别惊讶

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll try not to take being abandoned for a shopping list personally
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 我会尽量不把被抛弃去买购物清单这事放在心上

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It has considerably less interesting things to say than you 😌
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 它说的东西比你无聊多了😌

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: EARLY AFTERNOON — You have arranged your plans with {{name:hailey}} early enough to be home before {{name:lena}} arrives at five.
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 下午早些时候——你和{{name:hailey}}的计划安排得很早，能在{{name:lena}}五点到达之前回到家。

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Just don’t react to her nonsense
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 别对她的胡闹反应过度

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: They make this look easy, while I'm still trying to name the knot in my stomach.
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 他们让这一切看起来那么轻松，而我还在试着弄清心里那股纠结。

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Come on, at least put on an underwear

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: {{name:aiden}}的手在抱着她的时候滑动了

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You better not pull out another crazy outfit
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 你最好不要再穿什么疯狂的衣服了

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: It’s the reward for the best coach 😌
Alright, let’s play before he nags at us
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 好吧，快点玩，别让他唠叨我们

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Let's see if you can stay focused too
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 看看你能不能也保持专注

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: {{name:hailey}} kept moving on {{name:aiden}}’s lap during the games
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: {{name:hailey}}在游戏期间一直在{{name:aiden}}的腿上动来动去

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: LAST GAME – FIRST TO FINISH WINS EVERYTHING
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 最后一局 – 先完成的赢得一切

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I’m telling {{name:aiden}} not to look at you
Subject claiming victory under unusual circumstances
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 对象在不寻常的情况下声称胜利

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: {{name:hailey}} claimed {{name:aiden}} finished first during the last game
These are honestly the best game afternoons
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 说真的，这些是最棒的游戏下午

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Looking forward to the next one
I'm glad she isn't hiding what she wants, but I need to be honest about my feelings too.
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 她没有掩饰自己想要什么，我很欣慰，可我也得诚实面对自己的感受。

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Man I was really looking forward to playing again 🔥
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 我真的很期待再玩一次 🔥

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: {{name:ethan}} already came to pick me up
Do you want me to wait for you for dinner?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 你想让我等你一起吃晚饭吗？

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: At least I won’t have to eat alone with {{name:mason}} like last time
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 至少我不会像上次那样和{{name:mason}}独自吃饭

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: {{name:lena}} is staying over tonight. I'll leave you a plate for when you get back.
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: {{name:lena}}今晚要留宿。我会给你留一盘等你回来。

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Thanks. Save me some dessert too.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey 😊 Finally home, and I'm getting ready to leave in a little while. How was your day?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 嘿 😊 我终于回家了，马上就要出门了。你今天过得怎么样？

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not tonight. I came over, I didn’t come to sleep here
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 今晚不行。我过来是为了见你，不是来这里睡觉的

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That’s a shame. He gets you after this?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 真可惜。他在这之后能见到你吗？

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He gets a message that I got home. You get to message me tomorrow
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 他会收到我到家的消息。你明天可以给我发消息

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’ll take that
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我接受这个

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. Walk me to the door without a clever last remark
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 好。送我到门口，别说什么聪明的话

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: AFTER SHE GETS HOME
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 她回家后

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ I’m home. I didn’t stay the night
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 嘿❤️我回来了。我没有过夜

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Thank you for telling me
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 谢谢你告诉我

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We didn’t go all the way. I wanted to tell you what did happen, rather than leave you guessing
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我们没有走到最后。我想告诉你发生了什么，而不是让你猜

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You look beautiful
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你看起来真美

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: After dinner we kissed on the sofa. Then he put his hand under my dress and fingered me until I came
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 晚餐后我们在沙发上亲吻。然后他把手放在我的裙子下，直到我高潮

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I went down on him after. He came in my mouth. I swallowed
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 之后我给他口交。他在我嘴里射了。我吞下去了

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then I came home. That was the whole of it
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 然后我回家了。这就是全部

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: How are you feeling?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你感觉怎么样？

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Happy. A little flushed. Glad I went, and glad I left when I meant to
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 开心。有点脸红。很高兴我去了，也很高兴我按计划离开了

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It was my decision. I wasn’t trying to get to some next step because I thought I should
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 这是我的决定。我不是因为觉得应该而想要迈出下一步

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’m glad you know how you feel about it
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我很高兴你知道你对此的感受

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I do. He spent half the evening trying to work out whether he was doing better than you. I didn’t answer
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我知道。他花了半个晚上在想他是否比你更好。我没有回答

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That’s probably kinder than a ranking
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 这可能比排名更友好

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That was the idea 😌 And I wanted a minute with you before I sleep ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 这就是我的想法😌我想在睡觉前和你聊一会儿❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That was the answer I was hoping for ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 这是我期待的答案 ❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’m happy. I’m keeping the rest of the details to myself tonight, like we talked about
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我很开心。今晚我会把其他细节留给自己，就像我们说的那样

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That’s okay. Knowing you’re home and comfortable is enough
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 没关系。知道你在家里很舒服就足够了

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I am. I still wanted a minute with you before I sleep ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我在。睡觉前我还是想和你聊一会儿 ❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A LITTLE LATER, AT HIS PLACE
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 稍后，在他家

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm here 😊 Found the right building and everything's fine
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我在这里😊找到了正确的楼，没问题

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. How’s the evening looking?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 很好。晚上怎么样？

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Were there other acceptable answers?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 还有其他可以接受的答案吗？

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It smells like dinner rather than smoke, so I’m choosing to be optimistic 😌
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 闻起来像晚餐而不是烟，所以我决定乐观一点 😌

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Please tell me you didn’t open with that
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 请告诉我你不是这样开场的

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No. I said hello first
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 没有。我先打了个招呼

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Very diplomatic
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 真有外交手腕

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He’s setting the table. Here, your promised proof that I arrived
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 他在摆桌子。给你，这是我到达的证明

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Safe, smiling, and not about to be poisoned by a burnt pizza 😊
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 安全、微笑，而且不会被烧焦的比萨毒死 😊

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’m reassured about at least two of those things
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我对其中至少两件事感到放心

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don’t start 😭 I’m good, really
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 别开始了 😭 我真的很好

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Enjoy yourself, sweetheart. I’m here if you need anything
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 好好享受，亲爱的。如果你需要什么，我在这里

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Several. Yours was the best one
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 有几个。你的答案是最好的

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Thank you ❤️ I’ll check in later. I’m putting my phone away now
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 谢谢你❤️ 我稍后再联系。现在我要把手机放一边了

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: AFTER SHE PUTS HER PHONE AWAY
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 她收起手机后

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You found it
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你找到了

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: First try. Of course
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 第一次就找到了。当然

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I would have come down
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我本来会下来的

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know. That’s why I didn’t text you from the pavement
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我知道。这就是我为什么不在路边给你发消息

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That looks much better than the dinner you carefully left out of your photograph
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 这看起来比你小心翼翼地在照片中省略的晚餐好太多了

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was going to lead with an apology
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我本来想先道歉

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’m joking. You can stop apologizing for one burnt pizza
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我在开玩笑。你可以不再为一张烧焦的披萨道歉了

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then I’ll stop. Sit. I set your side already
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 那我就不说了。坐下。我已经准备好你那边了

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Get there safely, sweetheart
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 路上小心，亲爱的

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: My side. We’ve had one bookshop and a lot of messages
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我的那边。我们有一家书店和很多消息

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was paying attention
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我一直在注意

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: DURING DINNER
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 晚餐期间

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: How have you been?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你最近怎么样？

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Better than I expected to be. Work was busy. This is the first part of today that feels like mine
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 比我预期的要好。工作很忙。今天的第一部分感觉像是属于我的

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And your boyfriend?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 那你的男朋友呢？

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He’s all right. Quieter than he lets on. He spends a lot of time deciding what he’s allowed to want
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 他还好。比他表现出来的要安静。他花很多时间在决定自己可以想要什么

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That sounds tiring
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 听起来很累

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It is, for him. He used to plan everything so nothing could surprise him. He’s trying not to do that with me
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 对他来说确实是。他以前会计划好一切，这样就不会有意外。他现在试着不对我这样

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Does he know you’re here?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 他知道你在这里吗？

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I will. You'll get your arrival message, I haven't forgotten
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我会的。你会收到我到达的信息，我没有忘记

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. I told him I arrived. He doesn’t need a transcript of the dinner
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 知道。我告诉他我到了。他不需要晚餐的记录

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Fair. I wouldn’t want one of his evenings either
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 公平。我也不想要他那样的晚上

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You’d be surprised what you’d recognize
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你会惊讶于你能认出什么

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Sorry?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 抱歉？

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Nothing. The sauce. This is actually recognizable. I’m impressed
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 没什么。就是酱。这其实是可以认出来的。我很惊讶

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don’t sound so surprised
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 别这么惊讶

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’m allowed to be surprised. You sent me a picture of your face instead of the food
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我可以惊讶。你给我发的是你的脸而不是食物的照片

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The food didn’t know what to do with its face
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 食物不知道该怎么处理它的脸

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: If you’re going to stare, you can at least feed me the next bite
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 如果你要盯着看，至少可以喂我下一口

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Open, then
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 那就张嘴吧

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There. Now we’re even with last night’s photos
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 好了。现在我们在昨晚的照片上扯平了

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I don’t think we’re even
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我觉得我们还没扯平

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don’t look so proud. You still have sauce on your thumb
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 别看起来这么得意。你拇指上还有酱

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You could deal with that
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你可以处理这个

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Eat first. You’re very easy to distract
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 先吃。你很容易分心

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You came over. I’m allowed to be distracted
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你过来了。我可以分心

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I came over for dinner. The rest can wait until the plates are clear
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我过来是为了吃晚餐。其他的可以等到盘子清理完再说

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: AFTER DINNER
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 晚餐后

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You brought the book
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你带了书

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I brought the book. I’ve even made it past the bookmark
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我带了书。我甚至已经翻过书签了

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That’s more than I expected
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 这比我预期的要多

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don’t get used to it. I read one page on the way here and then thought about you instead
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 别习惯了。我在来的路上只读了一页，然后想到了你

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That’s a better review than the book was going to get
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 这比书本身能得到的评价要好

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Here, I marked the page I wanted to talk to you about
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 这里，我标记了我想和你讨论的页面

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We can talk about it
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我们可以聊聊这个

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Actually, the book can wait. I didn’t come here just to compare notes
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 其实，书可以等。我不是来这里只是为了对比笔记的

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Come here
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 过来

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Beyond the Messages
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 超越消息

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That’s what I was trying to say without typing it
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 这就是我想说的，但不想打字

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Sit. I want my hand on you
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 坐下。我想把手放在你身上

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don’t look so surprised. Last night’s photos were the warning
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 别看起来这么惊讶。昨晚的照片就是警告

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Her Hand
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 她的手

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Slower. Yes, like that
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 慢一点。对，就这样

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your turn. I want your mouth
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 轮到你了。我想要你的嘴

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: His Mouth
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 他的嘴

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There. Don’t stop
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 好了。别停

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’m close
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我快到了

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: She Comes
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 她来了

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay. That was really good
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 好的。那真的很不错

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I still got it
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我还是行的

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Quiet. I got outside for a bit, then came back to the incredibly demanding task of doing nothing
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 挺安静的。我出去了一会儿，然后又回到做无所事事的艰巨任务中

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Shut up
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 闭嘴

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’m not staying the night. I should go while I still mean that
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我不打算留宿。我应该趁我还这么想的时候走

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Message me tomorrow
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 明天给我发消息

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Maybe
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 也许

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: AFTER SHE GETS HOME
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 她回家后

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ I’m home. I didn’t stay
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 嘿 ❤️ 我回家了。我没有留下

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: All right. Thank you for letting me know
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 好的。谢谢你告诉我

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We didn’t go all the way. I wanted to tell you what did happen
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我们没有走到最后。我想告诉你发生了什么

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: After dinner we kissed by the window. I used my hand on him
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 吃完晚饭后我们在窗边亲吻。我用手碰了他

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A LITTLE LATER, AT HIS PLACE
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 稍后，在他家

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then he went down on me until I came. I came home after that
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 然后他给我口交直到我高潮。之后我回了家

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: How are you feeling about it?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你对此感觉怎么样？

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. Happy I went, and happy I didn’t keep everything behind a screen
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 很好。我很高兴我去了，也很高兴我没有把一切都藏在屏幕后面

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We talked over dinner first. By the time I decided, I knew that was what I wanted. I also knew I wanted to sleep in my own bed
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我们先在晚餐时聊了聊。等我决定的时候，我知道那是我想要的。我也知道我想睡在自己的床上

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’m glad you felt comfortable with him
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我很高兴你和他相处得很舒服

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I did. The dinner was good too, in case you were still worried about that 😌
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我确实是。晚餐也很好，如果你还在担心这个的话😌

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’ll stop preparing the restaurant rescue plan, then
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 那我就不准备餐厅救援计划了

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Keep the plan. We could use it for ourselves sometime ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 保留这个计划。我们可以在某个时候用上它❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm at {{name:aiden}}'s 😊 All good, as promised
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我在{{name:aiden}}家 😊 一切都好，正如承诺的那样

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’m happy. I’m keeping the details to myself tonight, but I wanted you to know I got home
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我很开心。今晚我会把细节留给自己，但我想让你知道我回家了

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That’s fine. You don’t have to tell me more than that
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 没关系。你不需要告诉我更多

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Thank you ❤️ It was a good decision to go
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 谢谢你 ❤️ 去是个好决定

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And you? How are you doing?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你呢？你怎么样？

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Found it easily?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 找到地方了吗？

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I needed a second before answering, but I’m okay
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我需要一秒钟才能回答，但我还好

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It feels different now we’re actually here. I’d rather say that than pretend I never get nervous
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 现在我们真的在这里，感觉不一样。我宁愿这样说，而不是假装我从不紧张

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’d rather you said it too. Would you like me to call?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我也希望你能这么说。你想让我打电话吗？

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No, I’m glad we’re talking. I just needed a moment
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 不，我很高兴我们在聊天。我只是需要一会儿

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay. You can tell me if that changes ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 好的。如果有变化你可以告诉我❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I will. I’m glad you had a good evening
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我会的。我很高兴你度过了一个愉快的晚上

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And you? How are you doing?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你呢？你怎么样？

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. I liked seeing your message come in
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 很好。我喜欢看到你的消息进来

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. He opened the door holding two plates
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 是的。他打开门时手里拿着两个盘子

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You’re very sweet tonight
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你今晚真甜

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I have my moments 🙂
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我也有我的时刻🙂

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You do. More than I give you credit for sometimes ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你确实如此。有时候比我给你的评价还要多❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’ll try not to ruin this one
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我会尽量不搞砸这次的

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I love you
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我爱你

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I love you too ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我也爱你❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’ll message you in the morning, before you start making plans to keep my spoon
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我早上会给你发消息，趁你还没开始计划要把我的勺子留着

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I thought it was mine now
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我以为现在是我的了

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Absolutely not. Neither is my side of the sofa 😌
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 绝对不行。我的沙发那边也不行😌

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Actual plates. I was mentally preparing to eat straight from a takeaway box 😭
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 是真的盘子。我还在心里准备直接从外卖盒里吃呢😭

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Both are safe. Get some sleep, sweetheart
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 两个都安全。快去睡觉吧，亲爱的

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And thanks again for all of that
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 再次感谢你为这一切

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don't thank me. We both wanted it. I’m glad we’re doing this together ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 别谢我。我们都想要这个。我很高兴我们能一起做这件事 ❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good night
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 晚安

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good night ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 晚安 ❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He’s making an effort, then
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 那他是在努力了

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Apparently. One quick picture while he puts them down
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 看来是这样。在他放下盘子的时候拍一张快照

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Safe, indoors, and about to be fed 😊 You can stop wondering whether I got lost
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 安全、在室内，马上就要吃饭了😊 你可以不用担心我是不是迷路了

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Thank you for letting me know. Enjoy your evening
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 谢谢你告诉我。祝你晚上愉快

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Please accept my sympathy 😌
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 请接受我的同情 😌

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I will ❤️ I’m putting my phone away now. Speak later
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我会的❤️ 我现在要把手机放下了。稍后再聊

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’m here if you need anything
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 如果你需要什么，我在这里

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: AFTER SHE PUTS HER PHONE AWAY
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 她收起手机后

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Have I passed the inspection?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我通过检查了吗？

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I said I arrived. I wasn’t writing a review of your home
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我说我到了。我可不是在写你家的评论

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. The chair with everything piled on it would lose me a star
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 好吧。那把上面堆满东西的椅子会让我扣一颗星

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I noticed
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我注意到了

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Of course you did
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 当然你注意到了

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He told me to have a good evening. You could start by feeding me
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 他说要我晚上愉快。你可以先给我吃的

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I bought dinner on the way home. I’m not pretending I suddenly learned to cook
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我在回家的路上买了晚餐。我可不是在假装我突然学会了做饭

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: How was work?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 工作怎么样？

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Honest and organized. That’s an unexpected combination
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 诚实又有条理。这是个意想不到的组合

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Careful. Another compliment and I’ll think you like being here
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 小心点。再来一个赞美我就要觉得你喜欢待在这里了

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I do. You can accept that without building a whole speech around it
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我确实喜欢。你可以接受这一点，不用围绕它说一大堆

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’ll get the food
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我去拿食物

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Excellent decision
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 好主意

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: DURING DINNER
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 晚餐期间

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You’re watching my mouth
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你在看我的嘴

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You’re taking too long. Open
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你太慢了。开门

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Does he get fed like this, or is this a special service?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 他是这样被喂的吗，还是这是特别服务？

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You’re stalling
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你在拖延

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Busy enough that I kept finding my coffee cold whenever I remembered it
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 忙得连咖啡都冷了，每次想起来的时候

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And now you’ve got sauce on your thumb
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 现在你拇指上沾上酱了

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then deal with it
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 那就处理一下吧

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Gladly. He doesn’t get this part, does he?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 当然。他可不会享受这个吧？

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Eat. Then you can be annoying somewhere more useful
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 吃吧。然后你可以去别的地方烦人

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: AFTER DINNER
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 晚餐后

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Wait, is that the strip from the photo booth?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 等一下，那是照相亭里的照片条吗？

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It looked better there than in my pocket
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 那里的样子比我口袋里的好看多了

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You put the one with your eyes closed at the front
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你把闭眼的那张放在最前面了

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wasn’t looking at the camera
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我当时没看镜头

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I remember
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我记得

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: But everything on my list is done, and my phone is charged
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 不过我清单上的事情都做完了，手机也充好了

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Do you want me to turn it around?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 要我把它翻过来吗？

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No. Leave it there
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 不，放在那里就好

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You’ve gone quiet
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你怎么安静了？

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like that you kept it somewhere you’d see it
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我喜欢你把它放在能看到的地方

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I liked the evening. Keeping the pictures seemed obvious
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我喜欢这个晚上，留着照片是理所当然的

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That was a nice answer
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 那是个不错的回答

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I can occasionally manage one. Better than a briefing?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我偶尔能做到一个。比简报好吧？

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Come here before you spoil it
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 快过来，别把它弄坏了

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Here?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 在这里？

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You know what I mean
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你知道我在说什么

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You sound pleased to have the evening back
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 听起来你很高兴晚上又回来了

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No Need for a Score
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 不需要评分

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Was that the reward for a nice answer?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 那是对好回答的奖励吗？

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No. That was because I wanted to kiss you
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 不是的，那是因为我想吻你

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Even better. Does he get kissed like that after dinner?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 更好。他晚餐后也会这样被亲吻吗？

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Stop talking. Sit, and keep your hands where I put them
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 别说话。坐下，把手放在我放的地方

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Under the dress?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 在裙子下面？

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 是的

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: ON THE SOFA
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 在沙发上

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Two fingers?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 两根手指？

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. Slow, then less slow
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 是的。慢点，然后快点

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Very. Let me show you something before I put my shoes on
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 非常高兴。在我穿上鞋子之前让我给你看看东西

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Tell me if I’m doing better than he does
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 告诉我我是不是比他做得更好

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’m not answering that. Keep going
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我不回答这个。继续

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Under the Dress
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 裙子下

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There. Don’t you dare keep score of that
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 在那里。你敢记分吗

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You’re close
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你很接近

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know. Don’t stop
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我知道。别停下来

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That sound. Does he get that too?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 那个声音。他也能听到吗？

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Sit back. My turn
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 坐好，轮到我了

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: HER TURN
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 她的回合

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You don’t have to—
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你不必——

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know. I want to
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我知道。我想要

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Is this the part where I lose to him on purpose?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 这是我故意输给他的时候吗？

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: This is the part where you stop talking. Hands in my hair. Don’t pull me off unless I say
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 这是你停止说话的时刻。手放在我的头发上。除非我说，否则别把我拉开

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Between His Knees
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 在他的腿间

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’m close
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我快到了

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. Stay there
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 好。就待在那里

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: In Her Mouth
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 在她的嘴里

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You didn’t have to swallow
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 你不必吞下去

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wanted to. Don’t look that pleased
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 我想这样做。别看得那么得意

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Stay
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 留下来

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There 😊 I managed to look like I had longer than twenty minutes to get ready
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 看 😊 我成功让自己看起来准备了超过二十分钟

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: It’s to reward me for being so attentive to my studies 😌
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 这是奖励我学习这么认真 😌

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I still have the rest of the reward to enjoy
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 我还有剩下的奖励要享受呢

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: You really sent that to him?
How did the practice test go?
She seems sure of herself here, and I'm still learning what that means for me.
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 她在这里似乎很笃定，而我还在慢慢理解，这对我意味着什么。

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: {{name:ethan}} giving cunnilingus as a reward after the successful practice test
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: {{name:ethan}} 在成功的模拟考试后给我口交作为奖励

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Careful… if you finish too early you’ll get penalty points
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 小心… 如果你太快结束会扣分的
{{name:ethan}} 尽管有警告，还是加大了力度

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: You’re not only good at studies…
For the next lessons… what’s the objective?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 下节课… 目标是什么？

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: But we’ll have to go deeper into the subjects
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 但我们得更深入地探讨这些主题

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Then I’m really looking forward to going deeper into all of that 😌
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 那我真的期待深入了解这些 😌

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: But I passed it with flying colors 😌
Not too disappointed you didn’t get the punishment?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: 你不太失望没受到惩罚吗？

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Did you enjoy this little day?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: 你喜欢今天的小日子吗？

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: The part where you watched everything during the game session 😌
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: 你在游戏过程中看了一切的那部分 😌

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Looking forward to the next training session 😌
If you admit properly I’ll show you something even better
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: 如果你好好承认的话，我会给你看更好的东西

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Look what your best friend left me like when he left
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: 看看你最好的朋友离开时给我留下的样子

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: The part where I sent you a photo of my reward 😌
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: 我发给你我奖励的照片的那部分 😌

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: And that’s the kind of crazy you love
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: 这就是你喜欢的那种疯狂

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Be ready to see even more
I don’t know what you’re talking about
Too bad… I had another surprise for you if you liked it
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: 太可惜了……如果你喜欢的话，我还有另一个惊喜给你

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: For finally admitting it, you get a reward too
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: 因为你终于承认了，你也得到了一个奖励

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: After putting your phone down, you settle back beside {{name:lena}} and fall asleep together.
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: 放下手机后，你又回到 {{name:lena}} 身边，一起入睡。

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Good morning ☀️
Trying to wake up slowly
Of course you are 😏
I swear you never rest your thumbs
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: 我发誓你从不让你的拇指休息

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: You're happy when my fingers are used to text you, no?
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: 当我的手指用来给你发信息时，你是开心的，对吧？

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: That's true ❤️
By the way…
About the tickets for our trip
I don't even know what to do with them now
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: 我现在甚至不知道该怎么处理他们。

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: What do you think I should do?
Give them to someone who really needs a break
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: 把它们给真正需要休息的人。

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Keep them and why not go with {{name:aiden}}?
