story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: 保留它们，为什么不和 {{name:aiden}} 一起去呢？

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Keep them and find someone else to go with
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: 把他们留下，找其他人一起去。

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Hey you 🙂
That's actually really kind of you 😊
You always try to do the right thing
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: 你总是努力做正确的事

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Of course I am, look at how much luck I have these days thanks to karma 😅
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: 当然是的，看看我这些天多么幸运，都是因为业力的关系 😅

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Well having me as your girlfriend is not good enough?
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: 那么把我当你的女朋友还不够好吗？

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: It is! I'm the luckiest man in the world ❤️
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: 是的！我是世界上最幸运的人 ❤️

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Really?
I swear
I'm also the luckiest girl in the world
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: 我也是世界上最幸运的女孩。

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: How are you feeling this morning?
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: 你今天早上感觉怎么样？

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: For having a vegetable as your man? Not sure about that 😄
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: 把蔬菜当作你的男人？对此不太确定 😄

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: You know how much I love vegetables 😉
You're too sweet
With {{name:aiden}}?
Why?
He always wanted to go to that island and at least he has his two legs
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: 他一直想去那个岛，至少他还有他的两条腿。

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: I don't think I will be very comfortable going alone with him
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: 我觉得我一个人和他在一起会很不自在。

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: I'm okay
Even if he is my friend and your best friend, it feels weird no?
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: 即使他是我的朋友，也是你最好的朋友，这感觉很奇怪，对吧？

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Now that you said it like that I guess it does
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: 既然你这么说，我想确实是这样。

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: But I trust you both and I don't want you to miss the trip just because of me and at the same time he will finally have the trip to the island he wanted so much
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: 但我相信你们俩，我不想因为我而让你们错过这次旅行，同时他终于可以去他一直想去的岛屿旅行。

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: You're right I'm thinking too much
And it is in more than a month so I got time to think about it
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: 而且还有一个多月的时间，所以我有时间考虑一下。

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Exactly
You won't be jealous?
Of course I will
My best friend going to the vacation we prepared and spending time with my girlfriend in my place, who on earth won't be jealous!
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: 我最好的朋友去度假，我们准备好了，和我女朋友在我家一起度过时光，谁会不嫉妒呢！

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: That's true, and sweet it shows that you care a lot about me ❤️
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: 这是真的，甜蜜地表明你非常关心我 ❤️

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: What about you?
That's called love
You're too much of a sweet talker
Only with you ❤️
You better 😌
Someone else?
That feels a little cold 😕
Sorry I didn't mean it that way
I'm good 😊
It's more like you need to find someone else who would like to go to the island with you so you can enjoy the trip even if it's not with me
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: 更像是你需要找其他人一起去岛上，这样即使不是和我一起，你也能享受这次旅行。

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Yeah…
You're upset?
No
I mean I just wasn't expecting you to say something like that
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: 我只是没想到你会说这样的话。

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Why? I did not mean it in a bad way
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: 为什么？我不是那个意思。

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: I know sorry I made a big deal out of nothing
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: 我知道，抱歉我把小事搞得很严重。

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: It's just that I'm sad that I won't go with you
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: 我只是很难过我不能和你一起去。

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Me too and you know it
But next time as soon as I'm healed we will go together ❤️
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: 但下次我一康复，我们就一起去 ❤️

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Still in bed actually 🛌
I hope so
Promise
Also
I’m coming over today
Sasha and I postponed our plans, so I can spend the day with you 😌
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: 我和莎莎推迟了原来的安排，所以今天可以陪你一整天 😌

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: You really don’t have to come all the way here on your only day off
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: 你真的不需要在你唯一的休息日跑到这里来。

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: I don’t want you to feel like you have to
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: 我不想让你觉得你必须要这样做。

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: I know
But I want to
I miss you
And I’d come anyway even if you tried to stop me 😌
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: 即使你试图阻止我，我还是会来的😌

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Thank you
That really means a lot
See you in half an hour ❤️
5 MINUTES LATER
Saving last night's outfit for my rescheduled day out with Sasha. Plans change, good choices stay.
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: 昨晚选的那套衣服，留着改天和 Sasha 出门时穿。计划会变，好选择不会。

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Saving last night's outfit for my rescheduled day out with Sasha. Plans change, good choices stay.
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: 昨晚选的那套衣服，留着改天和 Sasha 出门时穿。计划会变，好选择不会。

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: And what are you doing?
Saving last night's outfit for my rescheduled day out with Sasha. Plans change, good choices stay.
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: 昨晚选的那套衣服，留着改天和 Sasha 出门时穿。计划会变，好选择不会。

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Playing on the PlayStation

story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.source: Are you awake?
It’s going to be okay. Don’t overthink it
And if something happens, we’ll figure out a solution together
story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.translation: 如果发生什么事，我们会一起想办法解决。

story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.source: Yes..  you're right
By the way, {{name:lena}} is coming over today
story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.translation: 顺便说一下，{{name:lena}} 今天要过来。

story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.source: That’s good
You shouldn’t stay alone too much
story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.translation: 你不应该待太久一个人。

story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.source: I’ll come by later and air your room a little
story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.translation: 我稍后会过来通风一下你的房间。

story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.source: It needs fresh air anyway
Thank you
You’re welcome
How is the leg this morning?
It’s okay. Still a little stiff
That’s normal
Just don’t try to be brave and overdo it
story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.translation: 别试图表现得勇敢，过度了可不好。

story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.source: How are you?
I’m alright
Stress is starting to get to me about going back to work, but I’ll manage
story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.translation: 压力开始让我对回去工作感到焦虑，但我会应对的。

story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.source: You don’t need to worry about me
Are you sure?

story/DAY3/DAY3_03_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: Do one chill match later, no ranked sweat
story/DAY3/DAY3_03_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: 稍后进行一场轻松的比赛，不要排位赛的压力。

story/DAY3/DAY3_03_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: One game later if you want. Doctor mode orders
story/DAY3/DAY3_03_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: 再玩一局，如果你想的话。医生模式命令

story/DAY3/DAY3_03_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: Ping me if your leg hurts later
story/DAY3/DAY3_03_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: 如果你腿后面疼的话，给我发消息。

story/DAY3/DAY3_03_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: How are you actually doing this morning?
story/DAY3/DAY3_03_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: 你今天早上过得怎么样？

story/DAY3/DAY3_03_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: Head is still heavy from yesterday
story/DAY3/DAY3_03_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: 头还是因为昨天的事而感到沉重。

story/DAY3/DAY3_03_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: I almost called because your replies were slow
story/DAY3/DAY3_03_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: 我差点打电话，因为你的回复太慢了。

story/DAY3/DAY3_03_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: If those guys ever show up again, I swear I'll break their...
story/DAY3/DAY3_03_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: 如果那些家伙再出现，我发誓我会打断他们的...

story/DAY3/DAY3_03_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: Forget it, bad idea. I am trying to stay calm
story/DAY3/DAY3_03_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: 算了，坏主意。我正在努力保持冷静。

story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.translation: 你现在是健身房警察了吗？🙄

story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.source: Stop acting like everything is an attack
story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.translation: 别再表现得好像一切都是攻击。

story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.source: I was just asking because I've seen you going more often lately
story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.translation: 我只是问问，因为我最近看到你去得更频繁了。

story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.source: I'm getting in shape and it takes work
story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.translation: 我正在锻炼身体，这需要努力。

story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.source: And don't blame the leg for all of it
story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.translation: 别把所有责任都推到腿上。

story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.source: I know what my body looks like
story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.translation: 我知道我的身体看起来是什么样的

story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.source: Right now I can't do any sport
story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.translation: 现在我不能做任何运动。
需要我的备用充电器回来

story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.source: But when I'm healed, I'll get back in shape
story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.translation: 但当我康复时，我会恢复状态。

story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.source: If you see her, tell her I want it back before lunch
story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.translation: 如果你见到她，告诉她我想在午餐前要回来。

story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.source: You're going to the gym today?

story/DAY3/DAY3_05_HAILEY_RUGBY_THANKS.j.source: In my '{{name:hailey}} owes me one' book
story/DAY3/DAY3_05_HAILEY_RUGBY_THANKS.j.translation: 在我的'{{name:hailey}}欠我一个人情'书中

story/DAY3/DAY3_05_HAILEY_RUGBY_THANKS.j.source: Thanks for dealing with my rugby mess yesterday 🏉
story/DAY3/DAY3_05_HAILEY_RUGBY_THANKS.j.translation: 谢谢你昨天处理我的橄榄球麻烦 🏉

story/DAY3/DAY3_05_HAILEY_RUGBY_THANKS.j.source: I know I kind of dropped it on you like a little menace 😇
story/DAY3/DAY3_05_HAILEY_RUGBY_THANKS.j.translation: 我知道我有点像个小恶棍一样把这个扔给你了 😇

story/DAY3/DAY3_05_HAILEY_RUGBY_THANKS.j.source: You made it sound like a house emergency
story/DAY3/DAY3_05_HAILEY_RUGBY_THANKS.j.translation: 你把它说得像是房子着火了一样。
这是一个房屋紧急情况 😌
一个运动时尚的紧急情况 💅🏉

story/DAY3/DAY3_06_LENA_DOOR.json::steps.source: Or I'll climb through the window
story/DAY3/DAY3_06_LENA_DOOR.json::steps.translation: 否则我就从窗户爬进来

story/DAY3/DAY3_06_LENA_DOOR.json::steps.source: I'm really fast when I want something
story/DAY3/DAY3_06_LENA_DOOR.json::steps.translation: 我想要某样东西的时候真的很快。

story/DAY3/DAY3_06_LENA_DOOR.json::steps.source: And I want to see youuu

story/DAY3/DAY3_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_LAUN.source: And I can move a little by myself already
story/DAY3/DAY3_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_LAUN.translation: 我已经可以自己稍微移动一下了。

story/DAY3/DAY3_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_LAUN.source: I just don’t want you to push it and hurt yourself because nobody is around
story/DAY3/DAY3_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_LAUN.translation: 我只是不想让你勉强自己受伤，因为周围没有人。

story/DAY3/DAY3_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_LAUN.source: So ask if you need anything
story/DAY3/DAY3_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_LAUN.translation: 所以如果你需要什么，请问我。

story/DAY3/DAY3_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_LAUN.source: Everything is folded. I’ll give it to you when {{name:lena}} is gone
story/DAY3/DAY3_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_LAUN.translation: 衣服都叠好了，等{{name:lena}}走了我再给你

story/DAY3/DAY3_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_LAUN.source: Also, don’t forget. I start work again tomorrow
story/DAY3/DAY3_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_LAUN.translation: 另外，别忘了。我明天又要上班了。

story/DAY3/DAY3_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_LAUN.source: So in the afternoon I won’t be here to help you
story/DAY3/DAY3_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_LAUN.translation: 所以下午我不在这里帮你。

story/DAY3/DAY3_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_LAUN.source: But {{name:hailey}} and {{name:mason}} will be here to help me
story/DAY3/DAY3_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_LAUN.translation: 但是 {{name:hailey}} 和 {{name:mason}} 会来帮我。

story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.source: Did you hurt yourself when you came to open the door?
story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.translation: 你在来开门的时候受伤了吗？

story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.source: I’ll call {{name:hailey}} or {{name:evelyn}} if they’re there
story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.translation: 如果她们在的话，我就打电话给{{name:hailey}}或者{{name:evelyn}}

story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.source: Anyway, I’m sending you the photos I took today 📸
story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.translation: 无论如何，我把今天拍的照片发给你了 📸

story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.source: And send me the ones you took 😏
And if I did… I’d keep them for myself 😌
story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.translation: 如果我真的这样做了… 我会把它们留给我自己 😌

story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.source: I don’t care 😤 Send them or I curse you forever
story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.translation: 我不在乎 😤 发送它们，否则我会永远诅咒你

story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.source: Oh wow 😳 You took more than I thought
story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.translation: 哦哇 😳 你拿的比我想的多

story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.source: I look ugly… you should delete them
story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.translation: 我看起来很丑……你应该把它们删掉。

story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.source: You’re the most beautiful girl I know ❤️
story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.translation: 你是我认识的最美丽的女孩 ❤️

story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.source: But thank you… that means a lot 🥺
story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.translation: 但谢谢你……这对我来说意义重大 🥺

story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.source: Thank you for taking care of me today
Stop… that’s too many compliments 😅, but i feel the same
story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.translation: 停… 夸奖太多了 😅，但我也有同样的感觉

story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.source: I’m going to take a shower now 🚿

story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.translation: 给我发一张洗澡的自拍吗？😇

story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.source: In the shower? You never stop!
story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.translation: 在洗澡吗？你从来没有停过！
也许😌 如果你表现得好
我走的时候好好休息，好吗？

story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.source: It was the best part of my week
story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.translation: 这是我一周中最美好的时刻。

story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.source: But seriously, if you need water, food, or someone to reach a shelf because your leg is being dramatic, just say it 🤍
story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.translation: 但说真的，如果你需要水、食物，或者有人帮你拿到架子上的东西，因为你的腿在发作，直接说出来就行 🤍

story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.source: Try not to abuse the service though 😌
story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.translation: 尽量不要滥用这个服务哦 😌
否则我会让你付出代价 😇

story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.source: {{name:evelyn}} told me she starts work again tomorrow
story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.translation: {{name:evelyn}}告诉我她明天要重新上班了

story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.source: So if you need something while she's out, she said you'll have to beg for my help 😇
story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.translation: 所以如果她不在的时候你需要什么，她说你得乞求我的帮助 😇

story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.source: That sounds surprisingly unlike something {{name:evelyn}} would say
story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.translation: 这听起来与 {{name:evelyn}} 说的完全不同。

story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.source: She said it, I was there 😌
Alright, alright, maybe she didn't say anything about begging 😇
story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.translation: 好吧，好吧，也许她没有说过关于乞求的事 😇

story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.source: Wow, how quick of you to turn to the truth
story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.translation: 哇，你转向真相的速度真快。

story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.source: Please appreciate how much personal growth this is 😇
story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.translation: 请欣赏这有多少个人成长 😇

story/DAY3/DAY3_10_MASON_EVELYN_FOOD_LEG.translation: 小心点，这样{{name:evelyn}}就不用担心了

story/DAY3/DAY3_11_EVELYN_NIGHT_OUTFIT_H.source: I need to pick an outfit for tomorrow
story/DAY3/DAY3_11_EVELYN_NIGHT_OUTFIT_H.translation: 我需要为明天挑选一套衣服。

story/DAY3/DAY3_11_EVELYN_NIGHT_OUTFIT_H.source: You look good in all of them
I don’t want to look out of place
I feel a little better now
Yes, see you and good luck
It’s been so long that I don’t even know what to wear anymore
story/DAY3/DAY3_11_EVELYN_NIGHT_OUTFIT_H.translation: 已经过了很久，我甚至不知道该穿什么了。

story/DAY3/DAY3_11_EVELYN_NIGHT_OUTFIT_H.source: Just tell me which one makes me look the least ugly
story/DAY3/DAY3_11_EVELYN_NIGHT_OUTFIT_H.translation: 就告诉我哪一个让我看起来最不丑。

story/DAY3/DAY3_11_EVELYN_NIGHT_OUTFIT_H.source: Show me and I’ll tell you which one looks best
story/DAY3/DAY3_11_EVELYN_NIGHT_OUTFIT_H.translation: 给我看看，我会告诉你哪个看起来最好

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Talk nicely or I delete the photo 😈
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 好好说话，否则我就删掉照片 😈

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Now I feel clean and sleepy 😌
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 现在我感觉干净又困了😌

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: But I may have a little gift for you
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 但我可能有一个小礼物给你

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Now I need to see it
You don't even know what it is 😶
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 你甚至不知道那是什么 😶

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: If it's from you it's already perfect
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 如果是你发来的，那已经完美了。
马尾辫还是扎起来的头发？🤭
否则我真的会删除所有内容

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: And don't show them to anyone
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 并且不要把它们展示给任何人

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: So now I can talk to you until I fall asleep 💤
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 所以现在我可以和你聊到我睡着为止 💤

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Emotional reassurance strengthens trust and intimacy
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 情感上的安慰增强了信任和亲密感

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Playful ambiguity detected, tension may increase attraction
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 发现了顽皮的模糊性，紧张感可能会增加吸引力

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Critical moment detected, distancing may weaken emotional security
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 检测到关键时刻，保持距离可能会削弱情感安全感

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: That's why I sent them to you
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 这就是我把它们发给你的原因。

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: I loved having you here with me
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 我很喜欢你和我在一起。

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: When you're better we should go somewhere together
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 等你好些了，我们应该一起去某个地方。

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: We'll do it when you're completely healed
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 等你完全康复后我们再做。

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: To make up for the missed trip
She has to go back to work tomorrow
Money is getting tight and they need her
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 钱越来越紧张，他们需要她。

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: I just hope it's not like last time
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 我只希望这次不要像上次一样。
即使穿着睡衣，你也很美。

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: And when you're better you'll be able to help her
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 等你康复后，你就能帮助她了。
请给我一张晚安的图片？

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: I’m removing my makeup before bed

story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.source: I'm sure they'll feel the same so don't worry
story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.translation: 我相信他们也会有同样的感觉，所以别担心。

story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.source: I made breakfast and it's ready
Do you want me to bring it to you?
story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.translation: 你想让我把它带给你吗？

story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.source: Are you going to take a shower this morning?
How are you feeling this morning?
story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.translation: 你今天早上感觉怎么样？

story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.source: The store doesn't want to take her back
So we will have to endure her mess until we die
story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.translation: 所以我们得忍受她的麻烦，直到我们死去。

story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.source: Or we find some crazy guy who wants her
story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.translation: 或者我们找个疯狂的人来追她。

story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.source: I will be a bit busy this morning
I need to prepare everything for going back to work
story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.translation: 我需要准备好一切以便回去工作。

story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.source: My bag my clothes and a few documents
story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.translation: 我的包，我的衣服和一些文件

story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.source: So if you need something ask {{name:hailey}} or {{name:mason}}
story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.translation: 所以如果你需要什么就问{{name:hailey}}或者{{name:mason}}吧

story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.source: Just do what you have to do
Thank you for taking care of me
The same stress as a first day I guess
story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.translation: 我想这和第一天的压力是一样的。

story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.source: But I'm happy to see my colleagues!
story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.translation: 但我很高兴见到我的同事们！

story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.source: Hello mister secretary 😌
(I'm a grown woman, I'm a grown woman 😌)
story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.translation: （我是个成年女人，我是个成年女人😌）

story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.source: ( Don't kill him 😇)
How many of you are there in your head?
story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.translation: 你们在你脑子里有多少个？

story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.source: Enough to bury you in the garden 🌸
Anyway
How are you doing today?
Better than yesterday
Still slow though
Slow is fine, or more like your normal speed 😌
story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.translation: 慢也可以，或者更像你正常的速度😌

story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.source: You better train to run fast
Random warning 😇
You'll see what happens to bad frogs when I'm fully healed
story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.translation: 当我完全恢复时，你会看到坏青蛙会发生什么。

story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.source: Threats don't reach my princess ears
story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.translation: 威胁无法传入我公主的耳中

story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.source: Goodbye peasant 😇
I need either {{name:aiden}} or {{name:mason}} to take me to rugby on Wednesday
story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.translation: 我需要{{name:aiden}}或者{{name:mason}}带我去周三的橄榄球比赛

story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.source: I'm planning ahead because apparently that's what mature women do 😌
story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.translation: 我在提前计划，因为显然这就是成熟女性所做的 😌

story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.source: Who are you?
What have you done to my {{name:hailey}}
story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.translation: 你对我的 {{name:hailey}} 做了什么？

story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.source: How dare you say that 😤
That's not how a proper majordomo is supposed to behave 😌
story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.translation: 这不是一个合格的管家应该有的行为 😌

story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.source: Are you a princess?
More like a frog to me
story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.translation: 对我来说更像是一只青蛙

story/DAY4/DAY4_03_LENA_LUNCH.json::step.source: You can stay if you want
story/DAY4/DAY4_03_LENA_LUNCH.json::step.translation: 如果你想的话，可以留下来。

story/DAY4/DAY4_03_LENA_LUNCH.json::step.source: They say he's the most handsome guy at uni
story/DAY4/DAY4_03_LENA_LUNCH.json::step.translation: 他们说他是大学里最帅的男生。
我和女孩们在一起吃饭

story/DAY4/DAY4_03_LENA_LUNCH.json::step.source: We both know how he really is
story/DAY4/DAY4_03_LENA_LUNCH.json::step.translation: 我们都知道他真实的样子。

story/DAY4/DAY4_03_LENA_LUNCH.json::step.source: Still, it's true that he's handsome
But I only look at you so I don't care 😌
story/DAY4/DAY4_03_LENA_LUNCH.json::step.translation: 但我只看着你，所以我不在乎 😌

story/DAY4/DAY4_03_LENA_LUNCH.json::step.source: I only look at you too ❤️
I'll let you enjoy lunch with your friends
story/DAY4/DAY4_03_LENA_LUNCH.json::step.translation: 我让你和朋友们一起享受午餐。

story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.source: Like caring about each other a little
story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.translation: 像是稍微关心彼此一下

story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.source: Since when do you care what I do
story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.translation: 你从什么时候开始关心我做什么了

story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.source: It's just hard to have a conversation with you without you getting mad
story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.translation: 和你聊天就是很难，不是你生气就是我生气。

story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.source: I just wish we could talk a little less aggressively
story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.translation: 我只希望我们能少一点攻击性地交谈。

story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.source: And care about each other a little more
It was in the living room
So I don't care about you
I stayed with you the whole time at the hospital
I even carried you to your bed when we got home
story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.translation: 我甚至把你抱到床上，当我们回到家时。

story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.source: And that's just about the accident
story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.translation: 这就是关于事故的全部。

story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.source: Never mind the rest of the year
And thank you again for that
I just want us to talk for reasons other than needing something
story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.translation: 我只是想让我们谈谈，而不是因为需要什么。

story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.source: Don't you have a girlfriend for that
story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.translation: 你没有女朋友来做这个吗
这不是关于约会你的事

story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.source: I just want to know you better
And have a good time with you sometimes
story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.translation: 有时候和你在一起很开心

story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.source: I'll try to be less aggressive
story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.translation: 我会尽量少一些攻击性。

story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.source: Then {{name:hailey}} took it or the couch ate it
story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.translation: 然后要么是{{name:hailey}}拿走了，要么就是沙发吃掉了

story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.source: Is it too hard for you to text me for anything other than complaints?
story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.translation: 除了抱怨之外，你就不能发信息给我吗？

story/DAY4/DAY4_05_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: I can carry ranked later if you are up for it
story/DAY4/DAY4_05_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: 如果你愿意的话，我可以稍后带你打排位。

story/DAY4/DAY4_05_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: Keep laughing, I am dropping 30 tonight
Before you roast me, yes my hair looks stupid
story/DAY4/DAY4_05_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: 在你嘲笑我之前，是的，我的头发看起来很傻。

story/DAY4/DAY4_05_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: Say that louder, I need motivation
Do your rehab and stop trying to be a hero
story/DAY4/DAY4_05_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: 做你的康复，别再试图当英雄。

story/DAY4/DAY4_06_EVELYN_16H_GOING_TO_W.source: It can get busy in the evening

story/DAY4/DAY4_06_EVELYN_16H_GOING_TO_W.translation: 有空的时候给我发信息。

story/DAY4/DAY4_06_EVELYN_16H_GOING_TO_W.source: I checked your medication and your food
story/DAY4/DAY4_06_EVELYN_16H_GOING_TO_W.translation: 我检查了你的药物和食物

story/DAY4/DAY4_06_EVELYN_16H_GOING_TO_W.source: Try not to stress too much okay
It still feels a little strange going back
story/DAY4/DAY4_06_EVELYN_16H_GOING_TO_W.translation: 回去还是感觉有点奇怪

story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.source: You look like the kind of person who would file a very sad complaint from bed 😌
story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.translation: 你看起来像是那种会在床上提交非常悲伤投诉的人 😌

story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.source: A very bad one if it's really late, so hurry 😌
story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.translation: 如果真的很晚，那就非常糟糕，所以快点 😌

story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.source: Let me just buy some rat poison on the way home
story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.translation: 让我在回家的路上买些老鼠药。

story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.source: Don't starve before I get there mister rat🤍
story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.translation: 在我到达之前不要饿死，老鼠先生🤍

story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.source: How no, what about your limousine?
story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.translation: 怎么可能，你的豪华轿车呢？

story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.source: Don't you dare make fun of me 😒
Since you're broken and no one is home
story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.translation: 因为你坏了，家里没有人。

story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.source: I'm coming back with a friend instead
story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.translation: 我会带着一个朋友回来。

story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.source: Which means your food is getting delivered to your room a little later than planned 😇
story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.translation: 这意味着你的食物会比计划晚一点送到你的房间 😇

story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.source: You say that like I'm about to file a complaint
story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.translation: 你这么说就像我马上要投诉一样。

story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: Then I went straight to the shower 😌
So now you look unfairly pretty?
story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: 所以现在你看起来不公平地漂亮？

story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: Pretty enough that I need proof with my own eyes
story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: 美得让我需要亲眼见证。

story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: I'm tired and now I'm blushing

story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: 你发短信给我的时候更好。

story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: So you don't have to worry
But I want to talk to you a little more
story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: 但我想再和你聊一会儿

story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: I want to stay and talk to you
Go rest, you need it after your long day
story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: 去休息吧，经过你漫长的一天，你需要它。

story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: But it's true, so that makes me even more annoyed 🙄
story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: 但这是真的，所以我更烦了 🙄

story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: I'm only saying it because I care about you
story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: 我这么说只是因为我关心你。

story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: I want you in good shape tomorrow
story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: 我希望你明天状态良好。

story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: Then go sleep if you understand
story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: 那么如果你明白就去睡觉吧

story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: I made something quick when I got back
story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: 我回来的时候做了点快餐。

story/DAY4/DAY4_09_MASON_GYM_LATE_RETURN.source: Stopped at the gym on the way back
story/DAY4/DAY4_09_MASON_GYM_LATE_RETURN.translation: 在回来的路上停在了健身房

story/DAY4/DAY4_09_MASON_GYM_LATE_RETURN.source: A couple idiots there tried to waste my time
story/DAY4/DAY4_09_MASON_GYM_LATE_RETURN.translation: 那几个傻瓜试图浪费我的时间。

story/DAY4/DAY4_09_MASON_GYM_LATE_RETURN.source: Didn't want you wondering where I was
story/DAY4/DAY4_09_MASON_GYM_LATE_RETURN.translation: 不想让你担心我在哪里

story/DAY5/DAY5_00_PLAYER_TEXT_EVELYN_RE.source: Or maybe he just understood boundaries this time
story/DAY5/DAY5_00_PLAYER_TEXT_EVELYN_RE.translation: 或者这次他只是理解了界限

story/DAY5/DAY5_00_PLAYER_TEXT_EVELYN_RE.source: I was a little slow at first
But muscle memory comes back quickly
story/DAY5/DAY5_00_PLAYER_TEXT_EVELYN_RE.translation: 但肌肉记忆很快就会恢复。

story/DAY5/DAY5_00_PLAYER_TEXT_EVELYN_RE.source: And you, how was your day?
I'm going to prepare dinner earlier today, tell me when you're hungry, I will bring it to you directly
story/DAY5/DAY5_00_PLAYER_TEXT_EVELYN_RE.translation: 我今天会早点准备晚餐，告诉我你什么时候饿了，我会直接把它带给你。

story/DAY5/DAY5_00_PLAYER_TEXT_EVELYN_RE.source: I had forgotten how exhausting it can be
But it felt good to be back
I saw him during the evening

story/DAY5/DAY5_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: Would have been better with you next to me
And you, eat something this morning

story/DAY5/DAY5_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: 我午餐时会给你发信息 💕

story/DAY5/DAY5_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: So thank you for forcing me to go to bed early 😌
story/DAY5/DAY5_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: 所以谢谢你让我早早上床睡觉 😌

story/DAY5/DAY5_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: I do have good ideas sometimes
story/DAY5/DAY5_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: 我有时候确实有好主意。

story/DAY5/DAY5_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: But yes, this one was good

story/DAY5/DAY5_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: 你今天早上的腿怎么样？

story/DAY5/DAY5_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: Better I think, i can move around more
story/DAY5/DAY5_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: 我觉得更好，我可以更灵活地移动。

story/DAY5/DAY5_02_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.source: And how he's going to drag you outside the second you can walk again
story/DAY5/DAY5_02_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.translation: 而他会在你再次能走的那一刻把你拖出去

story/DAY5/DAY5_02_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.source: And the girls are drinking his every word 🙄
At this point I think the girls would eat him alive if they could
story/DAY5/DAY5_02_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.translation: 在这个时候，我觉得如果她们能的话，肯定会把他活吃了。

story/DAY5/DAY5_02_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.source: He just sat down like he owns the table 😭
story/DAY5/DAY5_02_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.translation: 他就像拥有这张桌子一样坐下了 😭

story/DAY5/DAY5_03_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.source: I'm thinking about you a lot today
I wish I could just leave and come lay next to you for ten minutes
story/DAY5/DAY5_03_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.translation: 我希望我能离开，来你身边躺十分钟。

story/DAY5/DAY5_03_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.source: Ten minutes would turn into two hours
story/DAY5/DAY5_03_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.translation: 十分钟会变成两个小时

story/DAY5/DAY5_03_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.source: Uni is finally over for today
story/DAY5/DAY5_03_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.translation: 今天的大学课程终于结束了

story/DAY5/DAY5_03_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.source: And then I would fail everything because of you
story/DAY5/DAY5_03_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.translation: 然后我会因为你而失败一切

story/DAY5/DAY5_03_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.source: Text me if you need anything okay?
story/DAY5/DAY5_03_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.translation: 如果你需要什么，给我发信息，好吗？

story/DAY5/DAY5_03_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.source: I have to go back now
Now I still have work until 14
Then my part time job until 18 😭
story/DAY5/DAY5_03_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.translation: 然后我的兼职工作到18岁 😭

story/DAY5/DAY5_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: Do not get used to it
I just want your brain occupied for a bit
story/DAY5/DAY5_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: 我只是想让你的脑子忙碌一会儿

story/DAY5/DAY5_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: Send me one word later: alive
Or are you pretending to be productive today?
story/DAY5/DAY5_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: 还是你今天在假装高效？

story/DAY5/DAY5_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: Liar, but I respect the confidence
story/DAY5/DAY5_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: 说谎，但我尊重这种自信

story/DAY5/DAY5_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: Then we do chill games, no screaming
story/DAY5/DAY5_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: 然后我们玩轻松的游戏，不要尖叫

story/DAY5/DAY5_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: And if you do not feel it, we skip
story/DAY5/DAY5_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: 如果你没有感觉到，我们就跳过。

story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.source: A girl in class is losing her mind over some guy she barely knows
story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.translation: 班上的一个女孩因为一个她几乎不认识的男孩而失去理智。

story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.source: So now everyone is doing that whole crush autopsy 😭
story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.translation: 所以现在大家都在进行那种暗恋解剖 😭

story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.source: I said people like confidence and good timing
story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.translation: 我说人们喜欢自信和良好的时机

story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.source: I know, what would your advice be?
story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.translation: 我知道，你有什么建议吗？

story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.source: Just be yourself, be funny, be kind, be honest, that's probably all
story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.translation: 做你自己，幽默一点，善良一点，诚实一点，这大概就是全部。

story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.source: So all I need is a sparkling personality? 😌
story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.translation: 所以我只需要一个闪亮的个性？😌

story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.source: Do you have five minutes or are you pretending to be very important?
story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.translation: 你有五分钟吗，还是在假装自己很重要？

story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.source: Okay, that's enough emotional labor for your afternoon 😇
story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.translation: 好的，今天下午的情感劳动就到此为止了 😇

story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.source: If you need more help for your monologue, I'm here 😌
story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.translation: 如果你需要更多关于独白的帮助，我在这里 😌

story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.source: I can make time for the small people
story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.translation: 我可以抽时间给小人物。

story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.source: Do you fall for people fast or do you act difficult first?
story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.translation: 你是很快就对人产生好感，还是先表现得很难接近？

story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.source: Why? Are you planning on jumping from the roof onto someone? 😌
story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.translation: 为什么？你打算从屋顶跳到某人身上吗？😌

story/DAY5/DAY5_06_MASON_STORE_OR_FOOD_R.source: Then soda and a few biscuits 😌
story/DAY5/DAY5_06_MASON_STORE_OR_FOOD_R.translation: 然后是汽水和几块饼干😌

story/DAY5/DAY5_06_MASON_STORE_OR_FOOD_R.source: Want me to change your clothes and brush your teeth too
story/DAY5/DAY5_06_MASON_STORE_OR_FOOD_R.translation: 要我帮你换衣服和刷牙吗？

story/DAY5/DAY5_06_MASON_STORE_OR_FOOD_R.source: Might grab food too if the line doesn't piss me off
story/DAY5/DAY5_06_MASON_STORE_OR_FOOD_R.translation: 如果队伍不让我生气的话，我可能也会去吃点东西。

story/DAY5/DAY5_06_MASON_STORE_OR_FOOD_R.source: A drink and whatever is easiest 🙂
story/DAY5/DAY5_06_MASON_STORE_OR_FOOD_R.translation: 一杯饮料和最简单的东西 🙂

story/DAY5/DAY5_06_MASON_STORE_OR_FOOD_R.source: You asked a guy with one busted leg
story/DAY5/DAY5_06_MASON_STORE_OR_FOOD_R.translation: 你问了一个腿受伤的家伙

story/DAY5/DAY5_06_MASON_STORE_OR_FOOD_R.source: Your leg's hurt, you're not sick, asshole
story/DAY5/DAY5_06_MASON_STORE_OR_FOOD_R.translation: 你腿受伤了，你没生病，混蛋

story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.source: I will pretend i didnt see that
story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.translation: 我会假装我没看到那个

story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.source: I knew keeping you around had value
story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.translation: 我知道留着你是有价值的

story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.source: Don't get emotional, you still haven't seen the options yet 😇
story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.translation: 别激动，你还没看到选项呢 😇

story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.source: I have a party on Saturday night
story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.translation: 我星期六晚上有个派对

story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.source: So I may need your opinion on hair tomorrow
story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.translation: 所以我可能需要你明天对头发的意见

story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.source: And if it goes badly, you are legally required to save me
story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.translation: 如果事情发展得很糟，你有法律责任救我。

story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.source: Or you will have to pay for the damage
story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.translation: 否则你将不得不为损坏支付费用。

story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.source: How am I saving you from hair?
story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.translation: 我怎么能帮你摆脱头发？

story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.source: By telling me when I look insane before I leave the house 😌
story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.translation: 在我出门之前告诉我我看起来很疯狂 😌

story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.source: That seems hard, you will hear me everyday
story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.translation: 这听起来很难，你每天都会听到我。

story/DAY5/DAY5_08_LENA_NIGHT_TIRED.json.source: I'm going to sleep early tonight
Then don't stay up for me

story/DAY5/DAY5_08_LENA_NIGHT_TIRED.json.translation: 今天真的让我精疲力竭。

story/DAY5/DAY5_08_LENA_NIGHT_TIRED.json.source: At least you didn't skip dinner
Look at you sounding all responsible now 🙄
story/DAY5/DAY5_08_LENA_NIGHT_TIRED.json.translation: 看看你现在听起来多负责任 🙄

story/DAY5/DAY5_08_LENA_NIGHT_TIRED.json.source: I still need to finish one thing for tomorrow
story/DAY5/DAY5_08_LENA_NIGHT_TIRED.json.translation: 我还需要完成一件事情，为了明天。

story/DAY5/DAY5_08_LENA_NIGHT_TIRED.json.source: Just don't drag it out too long
Uni and both jobs in one day
story/DAY5/DAY5_08_LENA_NIGHT_TIRED.json.translation: 大学和两份工作在一天内

story/DAY5/DAY5_08_LENA_NIGHT_TIRED.json.source: Listen to you ordering me around 😒
Someone has to protect your last brain cell
story/DAY5/DAY5_08_LENA_NIGHT_TIRED.json.translation: 有人得保护你最后一个脑细胞。

story/DAY5/DAY5_08_LENA_NIGHT_TIRED.json.source: Not sure I'll fall asleep right away

story/DAY5/DAY5_09_MASON_FITNESS_ACCOUNT.source: So you can copy me and finally get some muscle
story/DAY5/DAY5_09_MASON_FITNESS_ACCOUNT.translation: 所以你可以模仿我，终于拥有一些肌肉。

story/DAY5/DAY5_09_MASON_FITNESS_ACCOUNT.source: I'm making the first post tonight
story/DAY5/DAY5_09_MASON_FITNESS_ACCOUNT.translation: 我今晚要发第一条帖子

story/DAY5/DAY5_09_MASON_FITNESS_ACCOUNT.source: You better be the first like
story/DAY5/DAY5_09_MASON_FITNESS_ACCOUNT.translation: 你最好是第一个喜欢的。

story/DAY5/DAY5_09_MASON_FITNESS_ACCOUNT.source: I finally made my fitness page
story/DAY5/DAY5_09_MASON_FITNESS_ACCOUNT.translation: 我终于创建了我的健身页面

story/DAY5/DAY5_09_MASON_FITNESS_ACCOUNT.source: Or at least make it look like I have more than three followers
story/DAY5/DAY5_09_MASON_FITNESS_ACCOUNT.translation: 或者至少让它看起来我有超过三个粉丝

story/DAY5/DAY5_09_MASON_FITNESS_ACCOUNT.source: Is that a request or an order

story/DAY5/DAY5_10_EVELYN_NIGHT_LATE_HOM.source: I will be very late tonight
Okay, be careful on your way back
story/DAY5/DAY5_10_EVELYN_NIGHT_LATE_HOM.translation: 好的，回来的路上小心点。

story/DAY6/DAY6_00_EVELYN_MORNING_CHECKI.source: He looked at me strangely a few times
It was still quite a long day
I slept as soon as I got home
I will make breakfast in a few minutes
story/DAY6/DAY6_00_EVELYN_MORNING_CHECKI.translation: 我会在几分钟内做早餐。

story/DAY6/DAY6_00_EVELYN_MORNING_CHECKI.source: Tell me if you want it brought to you
story/DAY6/DAY6_00_EVELYN_MORNING_CHECKI.translation: 告诉我你是否想要它送到你那里

story/DAY6/DAY6_00_EVELYN_MORNING_CHECKI.source: Don't worry take your time, {{name:hailey}} already made me breakfast, just rest
story/DAY6/DAY6_00_EVELYN_MORNING_CHECKI.translation: 别担心，慢慢来，{{name:hailey}}已经给我做了早餐，放松一下吧。

story/DAY6/DAY6_00_EVELYN_MORNING_CHECKI.source: Thank you to both of you
We had more people than expected
story/DAY6/DAY6_00_EVELYN_MORNING_CHECKI.translation: 我们的人比预期的要多。

story/DAY6/DAY6_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: Still stiff when I get up, but I can feel it's getting better
story/DAY6/DAY6_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: 起床时还是有些僵硬，但我能感觉到在好转。

story/DAY6/DAY6_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: Someone has to keep you in one piece 😌
story/DAY6/DAY6_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: 总得有人让你保持完整 😌
今天又是一样的日常吗？
我的闹钟今天感觉很邪恶
然后就是之后的常规混乱

story/DAY6/DAY6_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: Only because you keep cheering me on
story/DAY6/DAY6_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: 只是因为你一直在为我加油

story/DAY6/DAY6_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: Now that's the kind of answer I like
Come on, only two more weeks and then you're free
story/DAY6/DAY6_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: 快点，再过两周你就自由了。
我午餐时会给你发信息 💕

story/DAY6/DAY6_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: Did you sleep better at least?
story/DAY6/DAY6_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: 你至少睡得好一点了吗？

story/DAY6/DAY6_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: How are you feeling this morning?
story/DAY6/DAY6_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: 你今天早上感觉怎么样？

story/DAY6/DAY6_02_PLAYER_TEXT_HAILEY_SH.source: Move faster and I become nicer
I actually made it all the way to the bathroom and now I'm stuck here
story/DAY6/DAY6_02_PLAYER_TEXT_HAILEY_SH.translation: 我实际上一路走到了浴室，现在我被困在这里。

story/DAY6/DAY6_02_PLAYER_TEXT_HAILEY_SH.source: You said two minutes ten minutes ago
story/DAY6/DAY6_02_PLAYER_TEXT_HAILEY_SH.translation: 你说过两分钟前是十分钟。

story/DAY6/DAY6_02_PLAYER_TEXT_HAILEY_SH.source: And I still need to wash too
Also this is very rude for someone loitering outside a bathroom door 😭
story/DAY6/DAY6_02_PLAYER_TEXT_HAILEY_SH.translation: 这对在浴室门外徘徊的人来说也非常无礼 😭

story/DAY6/DAY6_03_MASON_EVELYN_CHECK_LE.source: I get a lot of time for myself
story/DAY6/DAY6_03_MASON_EVELYN_CHECK_LE.translation: 我有很多时间属于自己

story/DAY6/DAY6_03_MASON_EVELYN_CHECK_LE.source: And sorry I can't help much around the house
story/DAY6/DAY6_03_MASON_EVELYN_CHECK_LE.translation: 抱歉，我在家里帮不上太多忙。

story/DAY6/DAY6_03_MASON_EVELYN_CHECK_LE.source: I really need to save money for next year
story/DAY6/DAY6_03_MASON_EVELYN_CHECK_LE.translation: 我真的需要为明年省钱。

story/DAY6/DAY6_03_MASON_EVELYN_CHECK_LE.source: It's good when we talk sometimes
story/DAY6/DAY6_03_MASON_EVELYN_CHECK_LE.translation: 有时候我们聊天挺好的

story/DAY6/DAY6_03_MASON_EVELYN_CHECK_LE.source: Said I should check if you actually ate
story/DAY6/DAY6_03_MASON_EVELYN_CHECK_LE.translation: 说我应该检查你是否真的吃了。

story/DAY6/DAY6_03_MASON_EVELYN_CHECK_LE.source: And if you need anything brought up
story/DAY6/DAY6_03_MASON_EVELYN_CHECK_LE.translation: 如果你需要提到任何事情

story/DAY6/DAY6_04_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN_CHAR.translation: 他真的接受了你的桌子

story/DAY6/DAY6_04_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN_CHAR.source: Then I go straight to work
Eat properly and not too many video games
story/DAY6/DAY6_04_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN_CHAR.translation: 好好吃饭，不要玩太多电子游戏。

story/DAY6/DAY6_04_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN_CHAR.source: Sorry I can't read very well today
story/DAY6/DAY6_04_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN_CHAR.translation: 抱歉，我今天读得不太好。

story/DAY6/DAY6_04_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN_CHAR.source: You're lucky that leg is already hurt
story/DAY6/DAY6_04_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN_CHAR.translation: 你真幸运，那条腿已经受伤了。

story/DAY6/DAY6_04_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN_CHAR.source: See you when class is over ❤️
He really has an effect on girls
story/DAY6/DAY6_04_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN_CHAR.translation: 他对女孩们真的有影响

story/DAY6/DAY6_04_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN_CHAR.source: They laugh at everything he says
story/DAY6/DAY6_04_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN_CHAR.translation: 他们嘲笑他所说的一切

story/DAY6/DAY6_04_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN_CHAR.source: Good thing you already have your man to make you laugh ❤️
story/DAY6/DAY6_04_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN_CHAR.translation: 好在你已经有了让你笑的男人 ❤️

story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.source: Mission completed 😌
story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.translation: 任务完成 😌

story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.source: Since the meeting me, myself and I had two days ago 😌
story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.translation: 自从我、我自己和我两天前开会以来😌

story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.source: You're doing great in the role 😇
story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.translation: 你在这个角色中表现得很棒 😇

story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.source: You're impossible
story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.translation: 你真是不可理喻。

story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.source: Thank you, see you tonight young Padawan 😌
story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.translation: 谢谢，今晚见，小帕达旺 😌

story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.source: Wait, one more job for my emergency stylist 😇
story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.translation: 等等，我的应急造型师还有一个任务 😇

story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.source: For Saturday's party: loose waves or a high ponytail?
story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.translation: 周六的派对，披着大波浪还是扎高马尾？

story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.source: Loose waves. You can't go wrong with those
story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.translation: 披着大波浪吧。选这个准没错

story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.source: High ponytail. Easier to dance with
story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.translation: 高马尾吧。跳舞更方便

story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.source: Loose waves it is. Soft, cute, and completely innocent 😌
story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.translation: 那就大波浪啦。温柔、可爱，而且绝对清纯 😌

story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.source: Thanks for warning {{name:mason}} about the ride 🤍
story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.translation: 谢谢你提醒{{name:mason}}关于这次搭车的事🤍

story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.source: High ponytail it is. Practical AND cute. Look at you thinking ahead 😌
story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.translation: 那就高马尾啦。方便又可爱。看你想得多周到 😌

story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.source: Styling crisis solved. My work here is done
story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.translation: 发型危机解决。我的任务完成了

story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.source: Thanks 🤍 Don't retire yet, I still need to choose the outfit
story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.translation: 谢谢 🤍 先别退休，我还没挑好衣服呢

story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.source: {{mason:He}} did the full dramatic sigh, but {{mason:he}} got the message 😇
story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.translation: {{mason:He}}做了个夸张的叹气，但{{mason:he}}收到了信息 😇

story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.source: Why not thank {{mason:him}} yourself?
story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.translation: 为什么不自己感谢{{mason:him}}呢？

story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.source: I'm too shy 😌
story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.translation: 我太害羞了 😌

story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.source: Yes of course, shy to thank {{mason:him}} but not shy to ask for a ride
story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.translation: 当然可以，虽然不好意思感谢{{mason:him}}，但却不怕请求搭车。

story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.source: Touché 😇
story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.translation: 触碰 😇

story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.source: But that's your job
story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.translation: 但那是你的工作

story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.source: House logistics manager, remember?
story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.translation: 房屋物流经理，记得吗？

story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.source: Since when?
story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.translation: 从什么时候开始的？

story/DAY6/DAY6_06_LENA_AFTER_UNI_TO_JOB.source: I'll text you on my break 💕
story/DAY6/DAY6_06_LENA_AFTER_UNI_TO_JOB.translation: 我会在休息时给你发信息 💕

story/DAY6/DAY6_06_LENA_AFTER_UNI_TO_JOB.source: I barely survived that last class
story/DAY6/DAY6_06_LENA_AFTER_UNI_TO_JOB.translation: 我刚刚勉强熬过那节课。

story/DAY6/DAY6_06_LENA_AFTER_UNI_TO_JOB.source: My brain checked out halfway through
story/DAY6/DAY6_06_LENA_AFTER_UNI_TO_JOB.translation: 我的大脑在中途就不管了

story/DAY6/DAY6_06_LENA_AFTER_UNI_TO_JOB.source: And now I'm on my way to work
story/DAY6/DAY6_06_LENA_AFTER_UNI_TO_JOB.translation: 现在我正在去工作的路上。

story/DAY6/DAY6_07_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.source: Still playing video games I guess?
story/DAY6/DAY6_07_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.translation: 我想你还在玩视频游戏吧？

story/DAY6/DAY6_07_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.source: You're going to hurt yourself if you're not careful
story/DAY6/DAY6_07_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.translation: 如果你不小心，你会伤到自己。

story/DAY6/DAY6_07_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.source: I'm almost done and I'm tired of not being able to move
story/DAY6/DAY6_07_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.translation: 我快完成了，但我厌倦了不能移动。

story/DAY6/DAY6_07_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.source: I'm pushing a little but it doesn't hurt too much for now
story/DAY6/DAY6_07_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.translation: 我有点用力，但现在还不太疼。

story/DAY6/DAY6_07_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.source: I'll text you when I can ❤️
story/DAY6/DAY6_07_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.translation: 我有空的时候会给你发信息 ❤️

story/DAY6/DAY6_07_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.source: That was the plan, you stupid 😭
story/DAY6/DAY6_07_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.translation: 那就是计划，你这个傻瓜 😭

story/DAY6/DAY6_07_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.source: Just enough to breathe a little

story/DAY6/DAY6_08_EVELYN_16H_GOING_TO_W.source: Everything is prepared for tonight just like yesterday
story/DAY6/DAY6_08_EVELYN_16H_GOING_TO_W.translation: 今晚的一切准备就绪，就像昨天一样。

story/DAY6/DAY6_08_EVELYN_16H_GOING_TO_W.source: Dinner is in the fridge in case you get hungry
story/DAY6/DAY6_08_EVELYN_16H_GOING_TO_W.translation: 晚餐在冰箱里，以防你饿了。

story/DAY6/DAY6_08_EVELYN_16H_GOING_TO_W.source: Try not to stay up too late
Okay, good luck and be safe
story/DAY6/DAY6_08_EVELYN_16H_GOING_TO_W.translation: 好的，祝你好运，注意安全。

story/DAY6/DAY6_08_EVELYN_16H_GOING_TO_W.source: I will text you when I can
story/DAY6/DAY6_08_EVELYN_16H_GOING_TO_W.translation: 我会在可以的时候给你发信息。

story/DAY6/DAY6_09_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: And if someone starts acting weird around you again
story/DAY6/DAY6_09_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: 如果有人在你身边再次表现得奇怪

story/DAY6/DAY6_09_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: Tell me first before you try to handle it alone
story/DAY6/DAY6_09_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: 在你尝试独自处理之前，先告诉我。

story/DAY6/DAY6_09_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: Update me later, even if it is just two words
story/DAY6/DAY6_09_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: 稍后告诉我，即使只有两个字。
你像个母亲一样担心吗？

story/DAY6/DAY6_09_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: I just stepped out for air anyway
Can swing by if you need anything
story/DAY6/DAY6_09_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: 如果你需要什么，可以随时过来。

story/DAY6/DAY6_10_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: 你看起来真是太好看了。

story/DAY6/DAY6_10_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: And now I really wish I was there
story/DAY6/DAY6_10_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: 现在我真的希望我在那儿。

story/DAY6/DAY6_10_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: To take care of you properly
As much as you'd let me

story/DAY6/DAY6_10_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: 我在做一些快速的东西

story/DAY6/DAY6_10_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: I'd take care of all of you
I have time to make up for once I'm not injured anymore
story/DAY6/DAY6_10_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: 一旦我不再受伤，我就有时间弥补。

story/DAY6/DAY6_10_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: And what if I want to take care of you even before that?
story/DAY6/DAY6_10_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: 那如果我想在那之前就照顾你呢？

story/DAY6/DAY6_10_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: Because you're already hard to resist
story/DAY6/DAY6_10_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: 因为你已经让人难以抗拒了

story/DAY6/DAY6_10_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: Maybe I like making it difficult for you 😌
story/DAY6/DAY6_10_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: 也许我喜欢让你感到困难 😌

story/DAY6/DAY6_10_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: Then I'm changing and going straight to bed
story/DAY6/DAY6_10_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: 那我就换衣服，直接上床睡觉。

story/DAY6/DAY6_10_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: You're doing a very good job
How about next time I come over
You let me spoil you a little
I would deserve all that attention?

story/DAY6/DAY6_10_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: 显然只是为了治疗目的

story/DAY6/DAY6_10_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: Even with one bad leg I could still eat you alive
story/DAY6/DAY6_10_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: 即使只有一条坏腿，我仍然可以把你活活吃掉。

story/DAY6/DAY6_10_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: Maybe I'll wear as little as possible so no clothes gets in the way
story/DAY6/DAY6_10_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: 也许我会尽量少穿点衣服，这样就不会妨碍到我。

story/DAY6/DAY6_10_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: What kind of clothes would do that?
I'm not used to doing things like this so don't say anything
story/DAY6/DAY6_10_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: 我不习惯这样做，所以别说什么。

story/DAY6/DAY6_10_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: That was just my inner voice
Nothing would get in the way with that little on
story/DAY6/DAY6_10_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: 没有什么能阻挡那小家伙。

story/DAY6/DAY6_10_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: I'll need proof before I believe you
story/DAY6/DAY6_10_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: 在我相信你之前，我需要证据。

story/DAY6/DAY6_10_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: When you're free and on vacation we'll have all the time we want
story/DAY6/DAY6_10_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: 当你有空并且在度假时，我们将有我们想要的所有时间。

story/DAY6/DAY6_10_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: We can take care of each other as much as we want
story/DAY6/DAY6_10_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: 我们可以尽情照顾彼此。

story/DAY6/DAY6_10_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: You must have been really tired 😌
Goodnight beautiful and thank you for tonight
story/DAY6/DAY6_10_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: 晚安，美丽的你，谢谢今晚的陪伴。
我会在之后给你发信息。

story/DAY6/DAY6_11_MASON_COACH_QUESTION..source: But it's the only gym in the area
story/DAY6/DAY6_11_MASON_COACH_QUESTION..translation: 但这是这个地区唯一的健身房。

story/DAY6/DAY6_11_MASON_COACH_QUESTION..source: I might have a few leads

story/DAY6/DAY6_11_MASON_COACH_QUESTION..translation: 你知道一个严肃的教练吗？

story/DAY6/DAY6_11_MASON_COACH_QUESTION..source: Because the gym is getting annoying
story/DAY6/DAY6_11_MASON_COACH_QUESTION..translation: 因为健身房变得令人烦恼

story/DAY6/DAY6_11_MASON_COACH_QUESTION..source: And I don't progress the way I want 😒
story/DAY6/DAY6_11_MASON_COACH_QUESTION..translation: 而我没有按照我想要的方式进展 😒

story/DAY6/DAY6_12_PLAYER_TEXT_EVELYN_NO.source: You haven't answered in a while
story/DAY6/DAY6_12_PLAYER_TEXT_EVELYN_NO.translation: 你有一段时间没有回答了
有空的时候给我发信息。

story/DAY6/DAY6_12_PLAYER_TEXT_EVELYN_NO.source: That was {{name:evelyn}} in Sexminator's photo... I recognize the outfit I helped her choose. Why hasn't she answered?
story/DAY6/DAY6_12_PLAYER_TEXT_EVELYN_NO.translation: Sexminator照片里的人是{{name:evelyn}}……我认得那身衣服，是我帮她选的。她为什么还没回复？

story/DAY7/DAY7_00_LENA_MORNING_NO_CLASS.source: I felt bad when I woke up
I thought it was cute that you fell asleep like that
story/DAY7/DAY7_00_LENA_MORNING_NO_CLASS.translation: 我觉得你那样睡着真可爱。

story/DAY7/DAY7_00_LENA_MORNING_NO_CLASS.source: I pictured you snoring and drooling on your pillow
story/DAY7/DAY7_00_LENA_MORNING_NO_CLASS.translation: 我想象你在枕头上打鼾流口水。

story/DAY7/DAY7_00_LENA_MORNING_NO_CLASS.source: But I'll make it up to you, today
story/DAY7/DAY7_00_LENA_MORNING_NO_CLASS.translation: 但我会在今天弥补你的。

story/DAY7/DAY7_00_LENA_MORNING_NO_CLASS.source: Two classes got cancelled this morning

story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Do you have anything planned this weekend?
story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 你这个周末有什么计划吗？

story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: You mean drooling on your pillow?
story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 你是说在枕头上流口水？

story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: I'm really going to break your other leg, by accident of course
story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 我真的会不小心折断你另一条腿。

story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Yeah, I was waiting for you
I'm showing this text to my lawyer, madame
story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 我正在把这段文字给我的律师看，女士

story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: I'll just kill you with kisses instead
You do have some guts, I'll give you that
story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 你确实有点胆量，我得承认这一点。

story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Now sleep before I change my mind and come annoy you some more
story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 现在睡觉吧，免得我改变主意再来烦你。

story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Can I at least get a goodnight pic?
story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 我至少能得到一张晚安照片吗？

story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Only because you waited for me
Wow, harder and harder to fall asleep now
story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 哇，现在越来越难入睡了

story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: I didn't want to end the day without hearing from you
story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 我不想在没有听到你的消息的情况下结束这一天。

story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: I thought you said I talk too much
story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: 我以为你说我话太多了

story/DAY8/DAY8_00_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: That's the only thing keeping me alive 😌
story/DAY8/DAY8_00_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: 这就是让我活下去的唯一理由 😌

story/DAY8/DAY8_00_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: Pretty good, I'm feeling better and better
story/DAY8/DAY8_00_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: 挺好的，我感觉越来越好。

story/DAY8/DAY8_00_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: Text me if you need me
story/DAY8/DAY8_00_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: 如果你需要我，给我发信息。

story/DAY8/DAY8_00_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: My body already knows it's the end of the week
story/DAY8/DAY8_00_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: 我的身体已经知道这周快结束了

story/DAY8/DAY8_00_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: I'll text you when I can
story/DAY8/DAY8_00_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: 我有空的时候会给你发信息。

story/DAY8/DAY8_00_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: Did you sleep okay at least?
But not enough to make me a morning person
story/DAY8/DAY8_00_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: 但这还不足以让我成为一个早起的人。

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: We need to find a solution
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: 我们需要找到一个解决方案

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: Then tell me what you want me to do
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: 然后告诉我你想让我做什么

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: Commitment choice detected, your answer will permanently lock {{name:evelyn}} into a stable route
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: 检测到承诺选择，您的回答将永久锁定 {{name:evelyn}} 进入稳定路线

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: Commitment choice detected, your answer will permanently lock {{name:evelyn}} into a shared tension route
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: 检测到承诺选择，您的回答将永久锁定 {{name:evelyn}} 进入共享紧张路线。

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: Commitment choice detected, your answer will permanently lock {{name:evelyn}} into a high risk route
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: 检测到承诺选择，您的答案将永久将 {{name:evelyn}} 锁定在高风险路线。

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: We find a safer plan together
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: 我们一起找到一个更安全的计划

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: I will find a job, something I can do from home
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: 我会找一份工作，能在家做的工作。

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: You should not do that alone
You do not need to suffer there
If I bribe him a little he should find me something quickly
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: 如果我稍微贿赂他一下，他应该能很快帮我找到一些东西。

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: I did not answer because it was too late
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: 我没有回答，因为太晚了。

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: But I will take care of you even more
Give me one or two days and I will find something
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: 给我一两天，我会找到一些东西。

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: In the meantime, just say you are sick
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: 在此期间，就说你生病了

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: I do not want you to carry everything
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: 我不想让你扛着所有东西。
我仍然可以在那里工作

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: My manager is making it difficult for me
A few days will not kill us
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: 几天不会要了我们的命。

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: We are not that poor yet
I still have the money I saved for the trip
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: 我仍然有我为旅行存的钱。

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: I will use it if we need to
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: 如果我们需要的话，我会使用它。

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: But I do not think we will
I just need the right opportunity
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: 我只需要一个合适的机会

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: Then I will not go back tonight
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: 那么我今晚就不回去了。

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: But tell me quickly when you find something for me
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: 但当你找到什么东西时，快告诉我。

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: I just have to bear with him
I know it is not the best
But I cannot help you yet
As soon as I can walk again I will work
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: 我一恢复行走就会工作。

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: And you will be able to leave
I am sorry you have to endure him
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: 我很抱歉你必须忍受他。

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: If he gets too annoying just kick him in the balls
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: 如果他太烦人，就踢他的蛋蛋。

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: He watches me like I owe him something
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: 他看着我，就像我欠了他什么一样。

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: But I also hate feeling like a burden to you
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: 但我也讨厌让你觉得我是一种负担。

story/DAY8/DAY8_02_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_PIC.translation: 我希望这座城市能幸存下来

story/DAY8/DAY8_02_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_PIC.source: If I find a few options, you might be forced to give your opinion later 🤍
story/DAY8/DAY8_02_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_PIC.translation: 如果我找到几个选项，你可能会被迫稍后给出你的意见 🤍

story/DAY8/DAY8_02_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_PIC.source: Too bad it wasn't a question 😌
Better than yesterday and the day before
Finally my room is going to get cleaned 😌
story/DAY8/DAY8_02_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_PIC.translation: 终于我的房间要被打扫了 😌

story/DAY8/DAY8_02_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_PIC.source: You're so sweet in the morning
I might go shopping this afternoon
story/DAY8/DAY8_02_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_PIC.translation: 我可能今天下午去购物。

story/DAY8/DAY8_02_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_PIC.source: I need to find an evening outfit for Saturday night
story/DAY8/DAY8_02_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_PIC.translation: 我需要为星期六晚上找一套晚装。

story/DAY8/DAY8_02_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_PIC.source: So this is a fashion emergency?
story/DAY8/DAY8_02_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_PIC.translation: 所以这是时尚紧急情况吗？

story/DAY8/DAY8_03_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.source: But still, how dare he try to steal my job and brag about it
story/DAY8/DAY8_03_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.translation: 但他居然敢试图抢我的工作并为此自夸。

story/DAY8/DAY8_03_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.source: I'm going to break his leg too
I get it but that's not a good idea
story/DAY8/DAY8_03_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.translation: 我明白了，但这不是个好主意。

story/DAY8/DAY8_03_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.source: He'd make you nurse him too
He won't even know how close to death he was
story/DAY8/DAY8_03_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.translation: 他甚至不知道自己离死亡有多近。

story/DAY8/DAY8_03_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.source: I have to go back now
I'm going straight to work after this
I guess he feels lonely without you
story/DAY8/DAY8_03_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.translation: 我想他没有你会感到孤独。

story/DAY8/DAY8_03_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.source: So now I have to put up with him instead
story/DAY8/DAY8_03_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.translation: 所以现在我得忍受他了。

story/DAY8/DAY8_03_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.source: He's telling everyone he's your nurse now
story/DAY8/DAY8_03_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.translation: 他在告诉大家他现在是你的护士。

story/DAY8/DAY8_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: I never say no to gaming
Except when I kick your ass
My setup is finally clean for once
story/DAY8/DAY8_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: 我的设置终于干净了一次

story/DAY8/DAY8_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: Do not zoom in, my cable management is still criminal
story/DAY8/DAY8_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: 不要放大，我的线缆管理还是很糟糕的。

story/DAY8/DAY8_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: That is a generous lie but I'll take it
story/DAY8/DAY8_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: 那是一个慷慨的谎言，但我接受。

story/DAY8/DAY8_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: How are you doing right now?

story/DAY8/DAY8_05_MASON_NORMAL_DAY_TEXT.source: If you need something else, ask {{name:hailey}} or {{name:evelyn}} before they leave
story/DAY8/DAY8_05_MASON_NORMAL_DAY_TEXT.translation: 如果你还需要别的，记得在她们走之前问{{name:hailey}}或者{{name:evelyn}}哦

story/DAY8/DAY8_05_MASON_NORMAL_DAY_TEXT.source: Just enough to text you once 🙄
story/DAY8/DAY8_05_MASON_NORMAL_DAY_TEXT.translation: 刚好能给你发一次信息 🙄

story/DAY8/DAY8_06_HAILEY_SHOPPING_ADVIC.source: For a moment you did sound like an adult 😌
story/DAY8/DAY8_06_HAILEY_SHOPPING_ADVIC.translation: 有那么一瞬间，你听起来像个成年人 😌

story/DAY8/DAY8_06_HAILEY_SHOPPING_ADVIC.source: Help me or I set your PC on fire 😇
story/DAY8/DAY8_06_HAILEY_SHOPPING_ADVIC.translation: 帮我，否则我就把你的电脑烧了 😇

story/DAY8/DAY8_06_HAILEY_SHOPPING_ADVIC.source: Tell me which one suits me best 😌
All of them look good on you 😌

story/DAY8/DAY8_06_HAILEY_SHOPPING_ADVIC.translation: 可爱、安全，而且依然漂亮 😇

story/DAY8/DAY8_06_HAILEY_SHOPPING_ADVIC.source: So you admit I'm already a femme fatale 😇
story/DAY8/DAY8_06_HAILEY_SHOPPING_ADVIC.translation: 所以你承认我已经是个致命女人了 😇

story/DAY8/DAY8_06_HAILEY_SHOPPING_ADVIC.source: One look is cute and safe, one is a little bolder, and one makes me look like I'm pretending to be older than I am
story/DAY8/DAY8_06_HAILEY_SHOPPING_ADVIC.translation: 一个看起来可爱又安全，一个稍微大胆一点，还有一个让我看起来像是在假装比实际年龄大

story/DAY8/DAY8_06_HAILEY_SHOPPING_ADVIC.source: I'm keeping your answer in mind 🤍
Tomorrow's party is supposed to be fun, but suddenly it feels like everything means something
story/DAY8/DAY8_06_HAILEY_SHOPPING_ADVIC.translation: 明天的派对本来应该很有趣，但突然感觉一切都变得有意义了。

story/DAY8/DAY8_07_LENA_TO_WORK.json::st.source: Text me if anything feels off
story/DAY8/DAY8_07_LENA_TO_WORK.json::st.translation: 如果有什么不对劲，请给我发信息。

story/DAY8/DAY8_08_EVELYN_16H_GOING_TO_W.source: It has been tense again today
So I want to be there early
I will text when I can

story/DAY8/DAY8_08_EVELYN_16H_GOING_TO_W.translation: 如果可以的话，吃点东西。

story/DAY8/DAY8_09_LENA_HOME_EARLY_NIGHT.source: At least today was my last day before the weekend
story/DAY8/DAY8_09_LENA_HOME_EARLY_NIGHT.translation: 至少今天是我周末前的最后一天

story/DAY8/DAY8_09_LENA_HOME_EARLY_NIGHT.source: Take a shower, eat, all that
story/DAY8/DAY8_09_LENA_HOME_EARLY_NIGHT.translation: 洗个澡，吃点东西，所有这些

story/DAY8/DAY8_10_MASON_NEEDS_ANSWER.js.source: Want to play when I get home?
Alright, come get your ass kicked when you get home 😌
story/DAY8/DAY8_10_MASON_NEEDS_ANSWER.js.translation: 好吧，等你回家时来挨打吧 😌

story/DAY8/DAY8_10_MASON_NEEDS_ANSWER.js.source: And don't blame me if you cry after
You really want to spend your life in a wheelchair?
story/DAY8/DAY8_10_MASON_NEEDS_ANSWER.js.translation: 你真的想一辈子坐在轮椅上吗？
我现在需要一些具体的东西 😒

story/DAY8/DAY8_10_MASON_NEEDS_ANSWER.js.source: I just want to give you the real version, not the rushed one
story/DAY8/DAY8_10_MASON_NEEDS_ANSWER.js.translation: 我只想给你真实的版本，而不是匆忙的。

story/DAY8/DAY8_10_MASON_NEEDS_ANSWER.js.source: It should be ready later tonight
story/DAY8/DAY8_10_MASON_NEEDS_ANSWER.js.translation: 今晚稍晚就可以准备好了

story/DAY8/DAY8_11_ONLYFUN_POST_EVELYN_2.source: Touching reunion with an old friend

story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.source: Okay, real problem 😭
story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.translation: 好的，真正的问题 😭

story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.source: You're being dramatic
story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.translation: 你太戏剧化了

story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.source: I'm trying to cope 😇
story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.translation: 我在努力应对 😇

story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.source: Direct intimacy path detected. Personal tutoring may deepen trust and emotional dependency
story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.translation: 检测到直接亲密路径。个人辅导可能会加深信任和情感依赖。

story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.source: Structured distance path detected. A {{name:tutor}} at home or online may keep things controlled
story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.translation: 检测到结构化的距离路径。在家或在线的{{name:tutor}}可能会让事情保持在控制之中

story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.source: Authority exposure path detected. Keeping the main teacher involved may increase dependence and risky closeness
story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.translation: 检测到权威暴露路径。保持主要教师的参与可能会增加依赖性和风险亲密度。

story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.source: Do the private lessons with your main teacher
story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.translation: 和你的主教练进行私人课程

story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.source: I'll find you a {{name:tutor}} at home or online
story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.translation: 我会帮你找一个在家或在线的{{name:tutor}}

story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.source: I'll help you study myself
story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.translation: 我会帮你自己学习。

story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.source: It might be the simplest way to fix this fast
story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.translation: 这可能是最快解决问题的简单方法。

story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.source: I got an email from my principal
story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.translation: 我收到了校长发来的邮件

story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.source: You really trust that option? 😒
story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.translation: 你真的相信这个选项吗？😒

story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.source: Not trust
story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.translation: 不信。

story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.source: I just think it will push you more than anyone else would
story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.translation: 我只是觉得这会比其他人更能推动你。

story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.source: Mhm
story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.translation: 嗯。

story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.source: I hate that this might be the smart answer 😭
story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.translation: 我讨厌这可能是聪明的答案😭。

story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.source: That way it stays simple and under control
story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.translation: 这样保持简单和可控。

story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.source: My grades are apparently worse than I thought 😭
story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.translation: 我的成绩显然比我想的还要糟糕 😭

story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.source: That actually sounds way better 😌
story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.translation: 这听起来确实好得多😌。

story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.source: But that means I have to do homework every day 😭
story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.translation: 但这意味着我每天都得做作业😭。

story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.source: That's kind of how studying works 😌
story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.translation: 这就是学习的方式😌。

story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.source: Okay
story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.translation: 好的

story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.source: Let's do that then
story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.translation: 那就这么办吧。

story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.source: We'll do it properly and fix this together
story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.translation: 我们好好做，把这个问题解决。

story/DAY8/DAY8_12_HAILEY_ROUTE_LOCK_OUT.source: So now they're saying I need private lessons
