story/DAY9/love/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_L.translation: 有关于工作的消息记得告诉我哦

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_L.source: I wanted to thank you again
And for offering to handle the financial side for a while
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_L.translation: 还愿意暂时处理财务方面的事情

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_L.source: But I still do not feel right letting you manage that while you are injured
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_L.translation: 但我还是觉得不太好让你在受伤的时候管理这些

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNIN.source: And... thank you for last night
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNIN.translation: 还有... 谢谢你昨晚的陪伴

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNIN.source: I was scared of saying it wrong
You're not making it easy for me to stay serious 😭
I feel better after talking like that
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNIN.translation: 说完这些我感觉好多了

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNIN.source: I don't need everything to be perfect right away
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNIN.translation: 我不需要一切立刻完美

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNIN.source: I just want us to keep being like this
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNIN.translation: 我只想让我们一直保持这样

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNIN.source: Because I really like where this is going with us
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNIN.translation: 因为我真的很喜欢我们之间的发展

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNIN.source: You being careful with me is not a bad thing
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNIN.translation: 你对我小心翼翼并不是坏事。

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNIN.source: It actually makes me feel loved
Now I need five more minutes in bed after that
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNIN.translation: 现在我需要再在床上待五分钟。
我真的很需要那段睡眠

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNIN.source: But I should clean a little and work from home for a while
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNIN.translation: 但我应该稍微打扫一下，然后在家工作一段时间。

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNIN.source: Still soft and sleepy but better
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNIN.translation: 仍然柔软和困倦，但好一些了

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON.source: {{name:hailey}} is showing you the question on her computer
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON.translation: {{name:hailey}} 正在给你看她电脑上的题目

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON.source: The teacher said compare the two examples
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON.translation: 老师说要比较这两个例子

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON.source: Start with what changes between them
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON.translation: 先从它们之间的变化开始
然后写出为什么这很重要

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON.source: Okay I wrote the first answer
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON.translation: 好吧，我写了第一个答案

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON.source: You focused and you did it well
You need to do better than that 😤
I have to get ready before the party eats my evening 😇
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON.translation: 我得准备一下，不然派对就要吞掉我的晚上了 😇
你看起来准备好谈判了
一张工作表换一个赞美

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_05_MASON_AFTERNOON_.translation: 这……其实是个合理的观点

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_05_MASON_AFTERNOON_.source: Unless you somehow manage to lose a dumbbell overnight
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_05_MASON_AFTERNOON_.translation: 除非你今晚不小心把哑铃弄丢了

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_05_MASON_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm talented, but not that talented
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_05_MASON_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我有才华，但没那么有才华

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_05_MASON_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm still keeping an eye on you
I'm mostly waiting for my shift to end
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_05_MASON_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我主要是在等我的班结束

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_05_MASON_AFTERNOON_.source: So I started looking for games instead
I was thinking about this morning

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_05_MASON_AFTERNOON_.translation: 找到什么有趣的东西了吗？

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_05_MASON_AFTERNOON_.source: Looks like the kind of game that tests the player's teamwork 😅
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_05_MASON_AFTERNOON_.translation: 看起来是那种考验玩家团队合作的游戏 😅

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_05_MASON_AFTERNOON_.source: Don't expect me to carry you
Confident for someone who almost got defeated by a yoga mat this morning 😂
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_05_MASON_AFTERNOON_.translation: 你这自信的家伙，今天早上差点被瑜伽垫打败 😂

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_05_MASON_AFTERNOON_.source: We spent more time getting everything ready than actually exercising
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_05_MASON_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我们花了更多时间准备，而不是实际锻炼

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_05_MASON_AFTERNOON_.source: By the time we finally started, we were almost done
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_05_MASON_AFTERNOON_.translation: 等我们终于开始时，几乎就快结束了

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_05_MASON_AFTERNOON_.source: Everything is already in place for tomorrow
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_05_MASON_AFTERNOON_.translation: 明天的一切都已经准备好了

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: Hey
I would not need to move from the house
Just me, my PC, and some work I can handle from here
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: 就我、我的电脑，还有一些我可以在这里处理的工作

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: That would be wonderful
Really wonderful
Do you need anything else from me?
No
I think I have everything I need
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: 我想我已经有我需要的一切了

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: What about you?
Do you need anything?
I already have more than enough good things for me
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: 我已经有足够多的好东西了

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: I was trying not to ask too soon
That sounds suspiciously sweet
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: 这听起来有点过于甜蜜了

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: It was supposed to be
You taking care of me like this is already a lot
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: 你这样照顾我已经很了不起了

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: Careful
If you keep saying things like that, I might start feeling useful
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: 如果你继续这样说，我可能会开始觉得自己有用

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: Then maybe I should keep saying them
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: 那也许我应该继续说下去

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: You deserve to feel useful too
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: 你也值得觉得自己有用

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: I'll remember that
Good
Just keep me updated tonight
But do you have any news about that work you mentioned?
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: 不过你有关于你提到的工作的消息吗？

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: I'm curious about this mysterious job now
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: 我现在对这个神秘的工作很感兴趣

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: You'll be the first to know
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: 你会是第一个知道的人

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: I'll hold you to that 😌
Almost
I checked most of it already
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: 我已经检查过大部分了

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: I just want to verify a few more things before I promise anything
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: 我只是想再确认几件事情再答应你

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: So it is serious?
Yeah
If everything is clean, I will tell you properly tonight
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: 如果一切都没问题，我今晚会好好告诉你

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: It should be something pretty cool for me
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: 这应该是对我来说很酷的事情

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: Do you have two minutes?
I'll be doing moderation for a website and live channel
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: 我会为一个网站和直播频道做管理

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: The pay is pretty good
And everything can be done from my PC
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: 而且一切都可以在我的电脑上完成

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: That already sounds much better than having to leave the house
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: 这听起来比必须离开家好多了

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: The only downside is the schedule
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: 唯一的缺点就是时间安排

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: How so?
There aren't really any fixed hours
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: 其实没有固定的工作时间

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: When they need me, I have to be available immediately
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: 他们需要我时，我必须立即到位

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: And once a moderation session starts, I can't leave my PC until it's finished
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: 一旦开始审核，我就不能离开电脑，直到结束

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: Not for food
Just finishing drying my hair 😌
Barely for the bathroom
That does sound a little rough
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: 这听起来确实有点艰难

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: But I understand it too
If they need urgent moderation, they probably need someone there immediately
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: 如果他们需要紧急审核，肯定需要有人立刻到场

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: Will that be okay for you?
I think so
It's not perfect, but it's something I can actually do from home
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: 虽然不完美，但我可以在家做这件事

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: Then that's what matters
And now that I'm not working anymore, I'll have plenty of time
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: 现在我不工作了，会有很多时间

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: So don't worry about the rest
I'll make sure you always have food, water and everything you need nearby
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: 我会确保你身边总有食物、水和你需要的一切

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: You can focus on your work without worrying about anything else
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: 你可以专心工作，不用担心其他事情

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: You're going to spoil me
After everything you've done for me lately?
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: 在你最近为我做的一切之后？

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: I think it's only fair 😌
Thanks, {{name:evelyn}}
Anytime
DAY 10
Give me five minutes and I'll be there
5 MINUTES LATER
Alright, I'm available now
What's up?
It was about the work I mentioned earlier
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: 是关于我之前提到的工作

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: I wanted to explain what it actually is
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: 我想解释一下具体是什么

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: Yes finally, I was curious about it
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: 终于来了，我一直很好奇

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_08_MASON_EVENING_LO.source: Honestly, I hope I can get the cast off soon
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_08_MASON_EVENING_LO.translation: 老实说，我希望能尽快把石膏拆掉

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_08_MASON_EVENING_LO.source: But don't get stupid with it
That's exactly what someone stupid would say
Don't go to bed too late
The game won't be ready tonight
It's downloading like it has somewhere better to be
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_08_MASON_EVENING_LO.translation: 它下载得像是有更好的地方要去
明天的锻炼会精神焕发

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_09_HAILEY_EVENING_L.source: Do not start pacing like an old man
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_09_HAILEY_EVENING_L.translation: 别像个老头一样走来走去

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_09_HAILEY_EVENING_L.source: Start with what changes, then why it matters
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_09_HAILEY_EVENING_L.translation: 先说变化，然后再说为什么重要
我的大脑在多任务处理

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_09_HAILEY_EVENING_L.source: And you did a good job picking the outfit
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_09_HAILEY_EVENING_L.translation: 你挑的衣服也很不错哦

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_09_HAILEY_EVENING_L.source: Do not make it a thing
Cute and safe, exactly like you ordered
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_09_HAILEY_EVENING_L.translation: 可爱又安全，正如你所要求的

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_09_HAILEY_EVENING_L.source: Tell me how cute i am 😌

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_09_HAILEY_EVENING_L.translation: 现在要和女孩们一起去了

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.source: I was scared of how things would feel between us
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.translation: 我害怕我们之间的感觉会是怎样的

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.source: But I think we handled it well
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.translation: 但我觉得我们处理得很好

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.source: And I kept thinking about what you said this morning
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.translation: 我一直在想你今天早上说的话。

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.source: Also I changed into one of your shirts
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.translation: 我也换上了你的一件衬衫。

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.source: That feels illegal when I'm not there
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.translation: 当我不在的时候，这感觉像是违法的。

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.source: Are you flirting with me, lady?
What a lucky man I am
And I'm a really lucky girl to have you ❤️
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.translation: 我真是个幸运女孩，有你在身边 ❤️

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.source: I'm going to wash my face and get in bed before I start missing you too loudly
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.translation: 我去洗脸，然后上床，免得我开始太大声地想念你。

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.source: And lay down staring at the ceiling for a while
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.translation: 然后躺下，盯着天花板看了一会儿。

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTR.source: Just letting you know I handled it myself
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTR.translation: 只是想让你知道我自己处理了这件事。

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTR.source: I'm going back to that gym on my own terms
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTR.translation: 我会按照自己的方式回到那个健身房。

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTR.source: If they start bothering me again, we can settle it outside 😒
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTR.translation: 如果他们再来烦我，我们可以在外面解决 😒

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTR.source: But you could also ask to have them kicked out of the gym
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTR.translation: 但你也可以要求把他们赶出健身房。

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTR.source: One of them owns the place
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTR.translation: 其中一个人是这里的老板

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: He said I can stay after class and he will go through the assignment with me
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: 他说我可以下课后留下来，他会帮我看作业
就像一个真正的紧急学生一样😱

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: That is probably the fastest way to make you learn
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: 这可能是让你学习最快的方法

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: Like I am not doomed, just badly organized
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: 就像我并不是注定要失败，只是组织得不好

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: Your outfit choice is still under investigation
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: 你的穿搭选择还在调查中
即使在教授救援模式下？
尤其是在教授救援模式下

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: If I have to suffer academically, I deserve to look amazing later
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: 如果我得在学业上受苦，我就应该在之后看起来很棒

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: I will update you after his help session 😇
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: 我会在他的辅导后更新你😇
其实是中等的学业危机

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: Send it later and I will look
But school already answered about the private lessons
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: 但是学校已经回复了关于补习的事

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: They want me with my main professor
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: 他们想让我跟我的主教授一起

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Morning
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: 早上好

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: New outfits or something like that
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: 新衣服或者类似的东西

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: I feel like it will be somthing stupid and i don't want to change outfit anyway
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: 我觉得这会是些愚蠢的事情，而且我也不想换衣服。

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: What should I do if he pushes that on me?
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: 如果他把那个推给我，我该怎么办？

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Your reply here can have effect in the near future
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: 你在这里的回复可能会对未来产生影响

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Wait to see the outfits, then talk to him if you do not like them
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: 等着看看服装，如果你不喜欢就和他谈谈。

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Trust him, even if he is annoying he does run the bar well right?
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: 相信他，即使他很烦，但他确实经营得很好，对吧？

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: If it is not okay, tell him calmly and set a boundary
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: 如果不可以，平静地告诉他并设定一个界限。

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: So I do not refuse before I even know what it is
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: 所以我在还不知道是什么之前不会拒绝。

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Exactly
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: 确切地说

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Alright
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: 好的

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Morning, so how did it go at the bar last night?
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: 早上好，昨晚酒吧的情况怎么样？

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: You're right maybe im making a big fuse for nothing
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: 你说得对，也许我在为一些小事大惊小怪。

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Try to trust him on the work side
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: 尽量在工作方面信任他。

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: He is annoying, but the bar is still running, so he is doing something right
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: 他很烦人，但酒吧仍在营业，所以他做对了什么。

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: You really think so?
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: 你真的这么认为吗？

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Yes
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: 是的

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Just stay calm and do not assume the worst too early
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: 保持冷静，不要过早地假设最坏的情况。

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Okay
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: 好的

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: I will try to give him the benefit of the doubt
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: 我会试着给他一个怀疑的好处。

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: It was okay
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: 还不错

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Either way, don't worry about him that much, just work normally
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: 无论如何，别太担心他，正常工作就好

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Have a good time with your colleagues too
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: 也要和同事们好好相处

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: And text me the moment something feels wrong
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: 一有不对劲就给我发消息

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: I will
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: 我会

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Thank you for being in my corner
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: 感谢你一直支持我

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: It's normal don't worry
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: 没关系，别担心。

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: I kept my head down and did my work
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: 我低着头做我的工作。

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: But the manager watched everything like a hawk, quit annoying
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: 但经理像鹰一样盯着一切，真让人烦。

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: It is going to be fine
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: 一切都会好的

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: You just have to endure him for a bit and he will leave you alone
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: 你只需要忍耐他一会儿，他就会离开你。

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Yes you're right
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: 是的，你说得对。

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: At least I enjoy working with my colleagues
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: 至少我喜欢和同事们一起工作

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Oh also, that bastard said he might bring new dress code rules soon
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: 哦，还有，那家伙说他可能很快会带来新的着装规定

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: But I guess I needed the truth
That doesn't mean it felt good
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: 这并不意味着感觉很好

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: Knowing that you don't want me
It's not that I don't want you
It's just that right now I'm not ready for that
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: 只是现在我还没有准备好。

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: I just need a little time
I really didn't want to hurt you

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: 这就是我还在这里的原因

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: I'm going to clean a bit and work from home for a while
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: 我打算稍微清理一下，然后在家工作一段时间。

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: I need to keep my mind busy
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: 我需要让我的脑子忙起来
我真的很需要那段睡眠

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: And... thank you for being honest last night
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: 而且... 谢谢你昨晚的坦诚

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: Your room finally lost the fight
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: 你的房间终于输掉了这场战斗

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: Finally ! I always had hope in you
You look like you are supervising more than cleaning
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: 你看起来像是在监督而不是在清理

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: Hurry up and clean your room
Say that again and I am putting you in the donation bag
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: 再说一次我就把你放进捐赠袋里

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: {{name:evelyn}} found a box under my bed and gave me the mother look
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: {{name:evelyn}} 在我床下找到了一个盒子，还给了我一个母亲般的眼神

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: My lawyer said I should stay silent
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我的律师说我应该保持沉默

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: Now I need to go before she finds more evidence 😭
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: 现在我得走了，免得她找到更多证据 😭

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: {{name:evelyn}} decided today is apparently war against dust
We are doing a huge cleaning session
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我们正在进行一次大清理

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: Mostly is not a medical term
Especially when you act like you're fine
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: 尤其是当你表现得没事的时候
我并没有演得那么夸张

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: You don't trust me at all
I just don't trust your survival instincts
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: 我就是不信任你的生存本能

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: Just take it easy until I finish
Okay, my break is almost over
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: 好的，我的休息快结束了

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: I need to go act useful again
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: 我需要再次去表现得有用

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: I'll text you after my shift 😌
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: 我下班后会给你发信息 😌

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: Not terrible, just enough to make time feel slow
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: 不算糟糕，只是足够让时间感觉缓慢。

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: I'm basically living my dream right now
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: 我现在基本上在过我梦想中的生活。

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: Thank you, I practiced that lie
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: 谢谢，我练习了那个谎言。

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: Then you'd probably break the other one too 😒
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: 那你可能也会把另一条弄断 😒

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: I'm about to leave for the gym
The sooner I go, the sooner it's over
I'm still sorry I can't really help
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: 我还是很抱歉我帮不了你

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: Just tell me if anything happens
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: 如果发生什么事就告诉我

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: You'll run over there on one leg?

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Good news, I don't work tonight or tomorrow night
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: 好消息，我今晚和明晚都不工作

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Just focus on getting better, that's the most important thing right now
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: 专注于恢复，这才是现在最重要的事

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Thank you for everything you do
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: 谢谢你所做的一切

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm sorry for being such a burden right now
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: 抱歉现在给你添麻烦了

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Don't say that
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: 别这么说

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: You are not a burden
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: 你不是负担

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: And none of this is your fault
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: 这一切都不是你的错

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: You just need time to recover, that's all
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: 你只需要时间来恢复，仅此而已

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: After dinner tonight, we can spend some time together if you want 😊
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: 今晚吃完晚餐后，如果你想的话，我们可以一起待一会儿😊

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: I'd love that
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我很喜欢这个想法

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Then we'll do that
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: 那我们就这么定了

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: So I'll finally have some free time
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我终于有些空闲时间了

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: I think I'm going to use it to clean the house and do some laundry
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我想趁这个时间打扫屋子，洗点衣服

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Do you have anything that needs washing too?
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: 你有需要洗的东西吗？

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Yeah, I have a few things
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: 嗯，我有几件

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: But are you sure you don't need help?
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: 但你确定不需要帮忙吗？

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: No, don't worry
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: 不，别担心

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: You need to rest until you're fully healed
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: 你需要休息，直到完全康复

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: You're sure ?
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: 你确定吗？

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes, I know you want to help but I can handle this
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: 是的，我知道你想帮忙，但我可以处理这些

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_08_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.source: I might be a little late
Thank you for setting everything up
Take your time, i'm not starting without you 😊
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_08_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.translation: 慢慢来，我不会在你之前开始😊

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_08_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.source: {{name:mason}} is using the bathroom right now
I can't even brush my teeth yet
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_08_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.translation: 我连刷牙都还没来得及

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_08_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.source: I'll come downstairs in about fifteen minutes
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_08_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.translation: 我大约十五分钟后会下楼

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_08_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.source: I prepared the movie and the popcorn
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_08_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.translation: 我准备好了电影和爆米花

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_08_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.source: Now i'm only missing you and {{name:mason}}

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_09_MASON_EVENING_NTR.translation: 这应该能回答你的问题

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_09_MASON_EVENING_NTR.source: Are you almost done in the bathroom?
And yet you keep talking to me
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_09_MASON_EVENING_NTR.translation: 可你还是一直跟我说话

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_09_MASON_EVENING_NTR.source: I'll come out when I'm done
Because you've been in there forever
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_09_MASON_EVENING_NTR.translation: 因为你在里面待了太久

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_09_MASON_EVENING_NTR.source: I need to brush my teeth too
You don't need forty minutes to brush your teeth

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: Also yes I did the worksheet before leaving
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: 对了，我在离开前做了工作表

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: Professor would probably materialize from the shadows if I skipped it
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: 教授如果我不做就会从阴影中出现
你们两个真是太难搞了

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: But the party is actually at the principal's son's place 😭
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: 但派对其实是在校长儿子的家里 😭

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: I just crossed paths with him
He only gave me a little wave
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: 他只给了我一个小小的挥手

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: But now I feel weirdly shy because of the outfit
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: 但现在我因为这身衣服感到奇怪的害羞

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: Because I did not plan to be seen by him dressed like this
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: 因为我没打算让他看到我穿成这样

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: Stop looking smug through the phone
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: 别在电话那边得意洋洋的

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: He said I look more mature than usual and now I am blaming both of you 😇
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: 他说我看起来比平时成熟，现在我把责任推给你们两个 😇

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: My professor said it was nice too, which was weirdly stressful 💅
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: 我的教授也说这很好，这让我感到奇怪的压力 💅

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: Cute and safe, exactly like you ordered
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: 可爱又安全，正如你所要求的

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: Please say I look like a responsible student who definitely revises 😌
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: 请说我看起来像个绝对会复习的负责学生 😌

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: The party was actually really fun
I saw a bunch of people I had not seen in forever
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: 我见到了很多好久没见的人

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: So now my social battery is fully dead
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: 所以现在我的社交电量完全耗尽了

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: I talked a little with my professor
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: 我和我的教授聊了一会儿

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: He asked if I was enjoying the party and said the outfit suited me
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: 他问我是不是喜欢派对，还说我的衣服很适合我

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: I was not expecting to run into him there
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: 我没想到会在那儿碰到他
现在要和女孩们一起去了

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_11_LENA_NIGHT_NTR.js.source: But I feel like I'm getting better at it
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_11_LENA_NIGHT_NTR.js.translation: 但我觉得我在变得更好了。

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_11_LENA_NIGHT_NTR.js.source: It makes it a little more worth it
Can I see you before you go to bed?
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_11_LENA_NIGHT_NTR.js.translation: 我可以在你睡觉前见你吗？

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_11_LENA_NIGHT_NTR.js.source: I'm going to shower and go to bed
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_11_LENA_NIGHT_NTR.js.translation: 我要去洗澡，然后上床睡觉。
一遍又一遍的同样事情

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTS.source: Come play with me so i can kick your ass
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTS.translation: 来和我玩，这样我就可以打败你。

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTS.source: So who is it and when do I start?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTS.translation: 那么是谁，我什么时候开始？

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTS.source: Your coach should text me during the day if everything is good
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTS.translation: 你的教练应该在白天给我发短信，如果一切都好。

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTS.source: Why won't you say his name?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTS.translation: 你为什么不说他的名字？

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTS.source: Or is it because you have no one? 😒

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: That sounds way too dramatic for homework help 😭
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: 这听起来对作业帮助来说太戏剧化了😭

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: If this saves my grades and keeps me out of school humiliation then I owe you one 😇
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: 如果这能拯救我的成绩，让我免于在学校的羞辱，那我欠你一个😇

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: So your {{name:tutor}} plan is becoming a real thing
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: 所以你的{{name:tutor}}计划真的要实现了

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: I still can't believe I actually need help that badly 😭
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: 我还是不敢相信我真的需要这么多帮助😭

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: But having someone at home or online already sounds way less awful than staying after class with teachers
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: 但有个人在家或者在线上听起来比课后留校和老师待在一起好多了

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: I do have good ideas sometimes
Sometimes is doing a lot of work there 😌
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: 有时候这个词用得有点多😌

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: Did you actually find someone serious or are you just improvising with confidence again?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: 你真的找到了一个靠谱的人，还是又在自信地即兴发挥？

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: I told you I would handle it
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: 我告诉过你我会处理好的

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: Your future is safe with me
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: 你的未来在我手里是安全的

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Hey, are you awake?
I want to help
You are not useless, you are the one keeping everything running here
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: 你不是无用的，你是这里一切运转的关键

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Also I am looking for something we can do together
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: 我也在找我们可以一起做的事情

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: I might have a lead
But I want to verify it before I commit you to anything
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: 但我想在让你参与之前先确认一下

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: What kind of work?
Is it safe?
And is it legal?
Yes of course
It is mostly scheduling and meeting people in public
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: 主要是安排时间和在公共场合见人

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Morning, yeah I woke up a few minutes ago
No bar
No late nights forced by a manager
Meeting people?
For what?
Passive Insight says how you frame your next response can change her reaction
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: 被动洞察说你如何框定下一个回应会改变她的反应

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: It is like being a friend for a day, they pay for your time and company
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: 就像做一天朋友，他们为你的时间和陪伴付费

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: It is basically paid dates, but with strict rules and public places only
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: 基本上就是有偿约会，但有严格的规则，只能在公共场所

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: That sounds strange
People pay just to talk?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: 人们付钱只是为了聊天？

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Some people feel really lonely
How are you feeling today?
They want company without pressure
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: 他们想要没有压力的陪伴

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: And you are good at making people feel safe
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: 而你很擅长让人感到安全

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: And who knows, maybe you will find someone you like
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: 谁知道呢，也许你会找到喜欢的人

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: You took care of us for a long time, it is time for you to live your life too
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: 你照顾我们很久了，是时候让你也过自己的生活了

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: I am too old for that
No you are not, you are beautiful and still young, just give yourself a chance
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: 不，你并不老，你很美丽，依然年轻，给自己一个机会吧

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Hmm..I will see
Paid dates?
Better
That is not really my world
It does not mean you owe anything to anyone, it is more like acting for a day
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: 这并不意味着你欠任何人什么，更像是一天的表演

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: It is time and conversation
It pays really well
And we set boundaries before you accept any client so there is no risk
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: 而且在你接受任何客户之前我们会设定界限，这样就没有风险

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: And who knows, maybe you will find someone
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: 谁知道呢，也许你会找到某个人

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: You took care of us for a long time, it is time for you to live your life too
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: 你照顾我们很久了，是时候让你也过自己的生活了

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: I am too old for that
No you are not, you are beautiful, just give yourself a chance
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: 不，你并不老，你很美丽，给自己一个机会吧

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: I will see
But I still feel guilty
But i do not like the idea of being judged
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: 但我不喜欢被评判的想法

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: No one will judge you
And you will not be alone in this, I will check everything, check with the client and watch over you all day
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: 而且你并不孤单，我会检查一切，和客户确认，全天关注你

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: For now I will verify the platform and the rules
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: 现在我会验证平台和规则

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: If anything feels wrong we drop it
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: 如果有什么不对劲，我们就放弃

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Alright
I can try it and if I do not like it I will stop
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: 我可以试试，如果不喜欢就停止

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Of course, you only have a one week obligation anyway
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: 当然，你也只需一周的义务

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: I stayed home like you said but I feel like I let my colleagues down
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: 我按照你说的待在家里，但我觉得辜负了同事们

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Alright, when do I start?
I will text you once I know more
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: 一旦我知道更多信息就会发消息给你

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Okay
Thank you for taking care of me and finding me work
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: 谢谢你照顾我并帮我找工作

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: It is normal, go rest a little you deserve your day off
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: 这很正常，去休息一下吧，你值得放松一天

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Do not feel guilty, working there was not good for you anyway
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: 不要感到内疚，那里对你来说并不好

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: I told you I would handle it for the work, and for your coworkers it is fine, you can still see them outside work
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: 我告诉过你我会处理工作的事情，你的同事也没问题，你们可以在工作之外见面

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Yes that is true
But I do not want to be useless

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: It was a lot to hear
But I'm glad you told me instead of hiding it
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: 但我很高兴你告诉我，而不是隐瞒它。

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: I didn't want to lie to you
I just think I need a little time now
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: 我只是觉得我现在需要一点时间。

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: To understand where I stand in all this
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: 为了理解我在这一切中的立场

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: And where I stand with us 😕
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: 我在我们之间的立场是什么呢 😕

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: Not because I think you love me less
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: 不是因为我觉得你对我的爱减少了

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: More because I didn't expect things to feel like that
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: 更多是因为我没想到事情会感觉如此。

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: And you don't have to force anything for me
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: 你不需要为了我强迫自己。

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: I just want to move carefully
Because this really matters to me
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: 因为这对我来说真的很重要

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: Then give me a little time to figure out how I feel about all of this
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: 那么给我一点时间来理清我对这一切的感受

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: Take all the time you need

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: 我真的很需要那段睡眠

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: That helps more than you think 🥺
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: 这比你想象的要帮助多了 🥺

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: I'm going to clean a little and work from home for a bit
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: 我打算稍微清理一下，然后在家工作一会儿。

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: Still a little foggy but better 😌
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: 还是有点模糊，但好一些了 😌

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: And... thank you for being honest with me last night
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: 而且... 谢谢你昨晚对我诚实

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: I walked past a clothing store after class
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: 下课后我路过一家服装店

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: And they had a huge sale 😭
Do you know how hard it was not to go inside?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: 你知道我有多难忍住不进去吗？

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: You say that like it's a real struggle
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: 你说得好像这不是个真正的挣扎
这确实是个真正的挣扎

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: Your shopping addiction needs professional treatment
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: 你的购物瘾需要专业治疗

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: At least my clothes look good
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: 至少我的衣服看起来不错

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: You were definitely planning to buy it
Trying to enjoy a peaceful afternoon
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: 试着享受一个宁静的下午
关于那个{{name:tutor}}有什么新消息吗？

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: I should have an answer sometime today
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我今天应该能得到答案

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: I'll let you know as soon as I hear back
Please don't hire some terrifying genius
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: 请不要雇一个可怕的天才

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: You need to get better soon
I miss making fun of the way you walk 😌
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我想念嘲笑你走路的样子 😌

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: Hello
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: 你好

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: That sounds like exactly what she needs
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: 这正是她需要的！

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: I usually start by identifying the subjects causing the most trouble
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: 我通常会先找出最麻烦的科目。

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: Then we create a study plan and work through it step by step
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: 然后我们制定一个学习计划，逐步进行。

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: She's capable of doing well, but...
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: 她是有能力做好的，但……

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: She just struggles to stay motivated sometimes
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: 她有时候就是难以保持动力。

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: That's very common
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: 这很常见。

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: Most students are more capable than they think
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: 大多数学生的能力比他们想象的要强。

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: They just need structure and consistency
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: 他们只需要结构和一致性。

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: When would you be available?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: 你什么时候有空？

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: Tomorrow afternoon would work for me
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: 明天下午对我来说可以。

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: It's Ethan
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: 我是伊桑

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: I can come by, meet her and evaluate where she currently stands
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: 我可以过来，见见她，评估一下她目前的情况。

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: Perfect
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: 完美

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: I'll let her know
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: 我会告诉她的。

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: Great
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: 太好了

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: Feel free to message me if you have any questions before then
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: 如果你在那之前有任何问题，随时给我发消息哦。

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: I received your tutoring request earlier today
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: 我今天早些时候收到了你的辅导请求

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: Thanks for reaching out
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: 谢谢你联系我

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: I'm looking for someone who can help {{name:hailey}} prepare for her exams
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: 我在找能帮助{{name:hailey}}准备考试的人

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: What students do you usually work with?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: 你通常和什么样的学生合作？

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: I mainly work with high school and college students
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: 我主要和高中生和大学生合作

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: Perfect
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: 完美

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: And my goal isn't just to explain lessons
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: 我的目标不仅仅是讲解课程

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: I also help students build study habits and stay focused
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: 我还帮助学生建立学习习惯，保持专注

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: The guy clearly knows what he's doing
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: 这个家伙显然知道自己在做什么

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: He does have a crazy body
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: 他确实有个很棒的身材

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: Well that actually makes me feel a little better
At least I already know him
And I know he isn't some random creep you found online
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: 而且我知道他不是你在网上找到的随机怪人

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: You really have no faith in me
You wanted to keep his name a surprise
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: 你想让他的名字保持惊喜
真是不知感恩的小家伙

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: Still more grateful than you deserve 🙂
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: 但我还是比你应得的要感激 🙂

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: Tell {{name:aiden}} I'm ready whenever he is
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: 告诉 {{name:aiden}} 我随时准备好

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: He's a young coach who just moved to town
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: 他是个刚搬到镇上的年轻教练

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: Has he actually coached anyone before?
And where did you even find him?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: 你到底是从哪里找到他的？

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: He used to be one of {{name:aiden}}'s coaches
Okay that sounds a lot less suspicious
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: 哦，这听起来没那么可疑了

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: If he coached {{name:aiden}}, he probably knows what he's doing
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: 如果他教过{{name:aiden}}，那他应该知道自己在做什么

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: I'm curious to see what he can do
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: 我很好奇他能做些什么

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: Tell that Chris I'm ready whenever he is
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: 告诉那个Chris，我随时准备好

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: Mostly is not a medical term
Especially when you pretend you're fine
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: 尤其是当你假装你很好时
我并没有假装得那么严重

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: You don't trust me at all
I just don't trust your survival instincts
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: 我就是不信任你的生存本能

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: Please take it easy until I finish
I need to go act useful again
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: 我需要再次去表现得有用

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: I'll text you after my shift 😌
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: 我下班后会给你发信息 😌

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: Not terrible, just enough to make time move slowly
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: 不算糟糕，只是足够让时间变得缓慢

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: I'm basically living my dream right now
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: 我现在基本上在过我的梦想生活。

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: Thank you, I practiced that lie
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: 谢谢，我练习了那个谎言。

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Hey, are you really sure I'll be able to do that job?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: 嘿，你真的确定我能做这个工作吗？

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: But I can't help but worry about it a little
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: 但我还是有点担心

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: That's perfectly normal, it's a big change after all
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: 这很正常，毕竟这是个大变化

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: But I am confident that you will do great
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: 但我相信你会做得很棒

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Right now I am mostly making sure everything is legitimate
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: 现在我主要是在确保一切都是合法的

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: I want to verify all the details before I tell you to start
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我想在告诉你开始之前核实所有细节

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: That makes me feel a little better
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: 这让我感觉好一点

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Normally I should have all the answers tomorrow
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: 通常我明天就能得到所有答案

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: If everything checks out, you will be able to begin after that
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: 如果一切都没问题，你就可以在那之后开始

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Already tomorrow?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: 明天就可以？

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: That is sooner than I expected
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: 比我预期的要快

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Of course
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: 当然

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: I will explain everything in more detail tomorrow
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我会在明天更详细地解释一切

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Now you have my attention
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: 现在你吸引了我的注意

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: I am curious to know what you found
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我很好奇你发现了什么

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: And maybe a little nervous too
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: 也许还有点紧张

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: That is perfectly normal
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: 这很正常

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: We will take it one step at a time
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我们会一步一步来

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Alright
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: 好的

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Then I will wait for your message later 😊
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: 那我会等你稍后的消息😊

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Why are you asking?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: 你为什么问？

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Because I keep thinking about it
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: 因为我一直在想这件事

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm not that smart and don't have much experience in those things
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我不太聪明，也没有太多经验

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: And I am wondering if I will actually be good enough
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我在想我是否真的足够优秀

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: That's not true, you are more capable than you think
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: 这不是事实，你比你想象的更有能力

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: And even if you don't have experience, you can learn
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: 即使你没有经验，你也可以学习

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: I will be there to help you with everything you need
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我会在你需要的时候帮助你

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: I know, and I really appreciate that
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: 我知道，我真的很感激这一点

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_09_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.source: I figured this might motivate you 😌
I made steak and french fries
I know how much you love that
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_09_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.translation: 我知道你有多喜欢这个

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_09_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.source: Now I'm even more motivated to come downstairs
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_09_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.translation: 现在我更有动力下楼了

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_09_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.source: I'll see you in a minute then
Do you want to come downstairs?
Or should I bring your plate upstairs?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_09_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.translation: 还是我把你的盘子拿上来？

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_09_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.source: I should force myself to move a little
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_09_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.translation: 我应该强迫自己动一动

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.source: Hey, just imagine how unfair this is going to be
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.translation: 嘿，想象一下这有多不公平

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.source: Careful or I'll cancel your coach
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.translation: 小心点，不然我会取消你的教练

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.source: Thanks for taking the time to look for someone and finding me a coach
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.translation: 谢谢你花时间帮我找教练

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.source: That's one less thing I have to deal with
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.translation: 这又少了一件我需要处理的事

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.source: You dealing with anything by yourself would have been a miracle anyway
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.translation: 你自己处理任何事情都简直是个奇迹

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.source: I'm about to get a dream body while you're stuck in bed with your broken body
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.translation: 我马上就能拥有梦寐以求的身材，而你却只能躺在床上，受着伤

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.source: A dream body won't fix your face
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.translation: 梦寐以求的身材也不能修复你的脸

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.source: Jealousy doesn't look good on you
Neither will all that muscle when you still lose to me at everything
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.translation: 即使你有那么多肌肉，还是会在所有事情上输给我

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: I was hoping you'd forget about it
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: 我本希望你能忘了这事。

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: He wants to see where you're at and what needs work
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: 他想看看你的情况和需要改进的地方。

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: He's going to discover how cooked you are 😔
You're enjoying this way too much

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: 好啦，明天见家教，今晚先去派对 😌

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: I'll try to make a good first impression tomorrow 😊
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: 我会努力明天给他留下好印象😊

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: I'm heading to the party with the girls now. Goodnight, coach
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: 我现在和姐妹们去派对啦。晚安，教练

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: Have fun at the party, and get home safe
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: 派对玩得开心，回家注意安全

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: I talked to him this afternoon
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: 我今天下午跟他聊过了。

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: And he knows how to work with students preparing for exams
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: 而且他知道怎么帮助准备考试的学生。

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: So you're saying my academic rescue mission is officially happening 😭
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: 所以你是说我的学业救援任务正式开始了😭

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_12_LENA_NIGHT_NTS.js.source: But I feel like I'm getting better at it
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_12_LENA_NIGHT_NTS.js.translation: 但我觉得我在这方面越来越好了。

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_12_LENA_NIGHT_NTS.js.source: It makes it a little more worth it
Can I see you before you go to bed?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_12_LENA_NIGHT_NTS.js.translation: 我可以在你睡觉前见你吗？

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_12_LENA_NIGHT_NTS.js.source: I'm going to shower and go to bed

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_12_LENA_NIGHT_NTS.js.translation: 一遍又一遍的同样事情

ui.auto.choose_the_route_and_active_char.source: Choose the route and active characters for this checkpoint.

ui.auto.choose_the_route_lock_used_by_th.translation: 选择该天使用的路线锁定。

ui.auto.choose_your_account_name_and_sig.source: Choose your account name and sign in to OnlyFun after installing the app.
ui.auto.choose_your_account_name_and_sig.translation: 安装应用后，选择你的账户名并登录OnlyFun。

ui.auto.clears_only_hak_character_select.source: Clears only HAK character selection and IF branch cache, then reopens character selection.
ui.auto.clears_only_hak_character_select.translation: 仅清除HAK角色选择和IF分支缓存，然后重新打开角色选择。

ui.auto.clears_story_messages_and_settin.source: Clears story, messages and settings, but keeps all photos saved in the gallery.
ui.auto.clears_story_messages_and_settin.translation: 清除故事、消息和设置，但保留所有保存在图库中的照片。

ui.auto.coffee_city_lights_and_a_moment_.source: Coffee, city lights, and a moment to myself.
ui.auto.coffee_city_lights_and_a_moment_.translation: 咖啡、城市灯光，还有属于自己的片刻。

ui.auto.confident_and_generous_with_a_ta.source: Confident and generous, with a taste for couple-style outings.
ui.auto.confident_and_generous_with_a_ta.translation: 自信大方，喜欢情侣风格的约会。

ui.auto.contacts_will_appear_here_after_.source: Contacts will appear here after you name them in a conversation.
ui.auto.contacts_will_appear_here_after_.translation: 在对话中命名后，联系人会出现在这里。

ui.auto.discover_every_gallery_photo_in_.source: Discover every gallery photo in the game.
ui.auto.discover_every_gallery_photo_in_.translation: 发现游戏中的每一张画廊照片。

ui.auto.distribute_exactly_the_available.source: Distribute exactly the available HAK skill points.
ui.auto.distribute_exactly_the_available.translation: 精确分配可用的HAK技能点。
